39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)

46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)

51			}

54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())

66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}

106	func trackCheckSuccess(custom bool, commandPath, resolvedPath, version string) {
107		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
108			"provider":       providerID,
109			"custom_command": custom,
110			"command_path":   commandPath,
111			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
112			"version":        version,
113			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
114		})
115	}
116	
117	// trackCheckFailure emits the standard install-check failure analytics event.
118	func trackCheckFailure(custom bool, commandPath, resolvedPath, errorType, message string) {
119		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
120			"provider":       providerID,
121			"custom_command": custom,
122			"command_path":   commandPath,
123			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
124			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
125			"error_type":     errorType,
126			"error_message":  message,
127		})
128	}
129	
130	// sessionFile pairs a discovered pi session file with its header metadata.
131	type sessionFile struct {
132		Path   string
133		Header sessionHeader
134	}
135	
136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}
154	
155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}

13	// writeDebugRaw writes numbered JSON files (one per non-header entry) plus the
14	// central session-data.json via the shared spi helper. This matches the
15	// --debug-raw contract used by every provider.
16	func writeDebugRaw(sessionPath string, data *schema.SessionData) error {
17		if err := spi.WriteDebugSessionData(data.SessionID, data); err != nil {
18			return err
19		}
20		dir := spi.GetDebugDir(data.SessionID)
21		entries, err := readRawEntries(sessionPath)
22		if err != nil {
23			return err
24		}
25		return writeNumberedEntries(dir, entries)
26	}
27	
28	// writeNumberedEntries writes each raw entry as 1.json, 2.json, ... in dir.
29	func writeNumberedEntries(dir string, entries []json.RawMessage) error {
30		for i, raw := range entries {
31			filePath := filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", i+1))
32			payload, mErr := json.MarshalIndent(raw, "", "  ")
33			if mErr != nil {
34				continue
35			}
36			if wErr := os.WriteFile(filePath, payload, 0o644); wErr != nil {
37				return wErr
38			}
39		}
40		return nil
41	}
42	
43	// readRawEntries returns each non-header line of a session file as a raw JSON
44	// value, for debug-raw burst output. Uses bufio.Reader (via readLines) so
45	// arbitrarily large lines are captured without the 16MB bufio.Scanner cap.
46	func readRawEntries(path string) ([]json.RawMessage, error) {
47		var out []json.RawMessage
48		first := true
49		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
50			if first {
51				first = false // skip the session header line
52				return nil
53			}
54			out = append(out, json.RawMessage(line))
55			return nil
56		})
57		return out, err
58	}

```text
1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"bufio"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"errors"
7		"fmt"
8		"io"
9		"log/slog"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"strings"
13	)
14	
15	// Line-size sanity limits, mirroring claudecode/codex. bufio.Reader.ReadString
16	// has no line-size limit, so a 250MB cap guards against OOM from pathological or
17	// malicious files (a legitimate pi session line — a big tool result or base64
18	// image — can exceed the 16MB bufio.Scanner cap, so we do NOT use Scanner).
19	const (
20		KB                    = 1024
21		MB                    = 1024 * 1024
22		maxReasonableLineSize = 250 * MB
23	)
24	
25	// errStopRead is a sentinel a visit callback may return to stop iteration early
26	// (without error). readLines treats it as a clean stop.
27	var errStopRead = errors.New("stop reading")
28	
29	// readLines reads a pi session file line-by-line via bufio.Reader (unbounded
30	// line size, unlike bufio.Scanner) and calls visit for each non-empty trimmed
31	// line. Lines exceeding maxReasonableLineSize are refused with an error to
32	// prevent OOM. Returning errStopRead from visit stops iteration cleanly.
33	func readLines(path string, visit func(line string) error) error {
34		f, err := os.Open(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return fmt.Errorf("pi: opening session %s: %w", path, err)
37		}
38		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
39	
40		reader := bufio.NewReader(f)
41		lineNum := 0
42		for {
43			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
44			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
45				return fmt.Errorf("pi: reading line %d of %s: %w", lineNum+1, path, readErr)
46			}
47			line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
48			lineNum++
49			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
50			if trimmed != "" {
51				if len(trimmed) > maxReasonableLineSize {
52					slog.Warn("pi: line exceeds reasonable size limit",
53						"lineNumber", lineNum, "sizeMB", len(trimmed)/MB,
54						"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB, "file", filepath.Base(path))
55					return fmt.Errorf("pi: line %d of %s exceeds %dMB (refusing to process potentially malformed file)",
56						lineNum, path, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
57				}
58				if vErr := visit(trimmed); vErr != nil {
59					if errors.Is(vErr, errStopRead) {
60						return nil
61					}
62					return vErr
63				}
64			}
65			if readErr == io.EOF {
66				return nil
67			}
68		}
69	}
70	
71	// readEntries parses every line of the session file into a header (line 1) and
72	// a list of message/control entries (the rest). Malformed lines are skipped
73	// rather than aborting the whole parse.
74	func readEntries(path string) (*sessionHeader, []rawEntry, error) {
75		var header *sessionHeader
76		var entries []rawEntry
77		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
78			if header == nil {
79				h := sessionHeader{}
80				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
81					return fmt.Errorf("pi: parsing session header: %w", jErr)
82				}
83				header = &h
84				return nil
85			}
86			var e rawEntry
87			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
88				return nil // skip malformed line, keep going
89			}
90			// Skip entries missing the envelope fields the tree walk and exchange
91			// grouping rely on; a stray entry with no id can mislead leaf selection.
92			if e.Type == "" || e.ID == "" {
93				slog.Debug("pi: skipping entry with empty type or id", "file", path)
94				return nil
95			}
96			entries = append(entries, e)
97			return nil
98		})
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, nil, err
101		}
102		return header, entries, nil
103	}
104	
105	// leafPathEntries walks from the leaf (last entry in file order) to the root,
106	// reverses to chronological order, and applies compaction: if a compaction
107	// entry is on the path, entries before its firstKeptEntryId are dropped.
108	func leafPathEntries(entries []rawEntry) []rawEntry {
109		byID := indexByID(entries)
110		leaf := entries[len(entries)-1]
111		path := walkToRoot(leaf, byID)
112		reverse(path)
113		return applyCompaction(path)
114	}
115	
116	// indexByID builds an id -> entry lookup for the tree walk.
117	func indexByID(entries []rawEntry) map[string]rawEntry {
118		m := make(map[string]rawEntry, len(entries))
119		for _, e := range entries {
120			m[e.ID] = e
121		}
122		return m
123	}
124	
125	// walkToRoot collects entries from the given leaf up to the root (parentId
126	// null). A visited set guards against parentId cycles in corrupted sessions so
127	// the walk terminates instead of looping forever.
128	func walkToRoot(leaf rawEntry, byID map[string]rawEntry) []rawEntry {
129		var path []rawEntry
130		cur := leaf
131		visited := make(map[string]bool)
132		for !visited[cur.ID] {
133			visited[cur.ID] = true
134			path = append(path, cur)
135			if cur.ParentID == nil {
136				break
137			}
138			parent, ok := byID[*cur.ParentID]
139			if !ok {
140				break
141			}
142			cur = parent
143		}
144		return path
145	}
146	
147	// reverse reverses a slice of rawEntry in place.
148	func reverse(s []rawEntry) {
149		for i, j := 0, len(s)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
150			s[i], s[j] = s[j], s[i]
151		}
152	}
153	
154	// applyCompaction drops entries before the most recent compaction point when
155	// one or more compaction entries are on the path. pi's buildContextEntries
156	// builds context from the LATEST compaction's firstKeptEntryId forward (each
157	// new compaction summarizes prior compactions into itself), so when multiple
158	// compactions exist we use the last one in chronological order, not the first.
159	// If firstKeptEntryId is missing from the path, we keep from the compaction
160	// entry forward so pre-compaction entries are never accidentally retained.
161	func applyCompaction(path []rawEntry) []rawEntry {
162		last := -1
163		for i, e := range path {
164			if e.Type == entryCompaction {
165				last = i
166			}
167		}
168		if last < 0 {
169			return path
170		}
171		keptID := compactionFirstKept(path[last])
172		if keptID == "" {
173			return path[last:]
174		}
175		if idx := keepFromIndex(path, keptID); idx >= 0 {
176			return path[idx:]
177		}
178		return path[last:]
179	}
180	
181	// compactionFirstKept returns the firstKeptEntryId of a compaction entry. pi
182	// stores this as a top-level field on the entry (not inside a message
183	// payload), so it is decoded directly into rawEntry.FirstKeptEntryID.
184	func compactionFirstKept(e rawEntry) string {
185		return e.FirstKeptEntryID
186	}
187	
188	// keepFromIndex returns the index of the entry with id==keptID in path, or -1
189	// if not found.
190	func keepFromIndex(path []rawEntry, keptID string) int {
191		for i, e := range path {
192			if e.ID == keptID {
193				return i
194			}
195		}
196		return -1
197	}

12	// entryType constants for pi JSONL v3 session entries.
13	const (
14		entrySession             = "session"
15		entryMessage             = "message"
16		entryModelChange         = "model_change"
17		entryThinkingLevelChange = "thinking_level_change"

19		entryBranchSummary       = "branch_summary"

21		entryCustomMessage       = "custom_message"
22		entryLabel               = "label"
23		entrySessionInfo         = "session_info"
24	)
25	
26	// messageRole constants for pi message entries.
27	const (
28		roleUser          = "user"
29		roleAssistant     = "assistant"
30		roleToolResult    = "toolResult"
31		roleBashExecution = "bashExecution"
32		roleCustom        = "custom"
33		roleBranchSummary = "branchSummary"
34		roleCompaction    = "compactionSummary"
35	)

37	// rawEntry is the minimal envelope every pi entry shares. The message payload
38	// (for type=="message") is kept as raw json.RawMessage so we can decode it per
39	// role without fighting a single union struct. Compaction entries carry
40	// firstKeptEntryId as a top-level field (no message wrapper).
41	type rawEntry struct {
42		Type             string          `json:"type"`
43		ID               string          `json:"id"`
44		ParentID         *string         `json:"parentId"` // null for the first entry
45		Timestamp        string          `json:"timestamp"`
46		FirstKeptEntryID string          `json:"firstKeptEntryId,omitempty"` // compaction entries only
47		Message          json.RawMessage `json:"message,omitempty"`
48	}
49	
50	// sessionHeader is the first line of a pi session file (no id/parentId).
51	type sessionHeader struct {
52		Type      string `json:"type"`
53		Version   int    `json:"version"`
54		ID        string `json:"id"`
55		Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
56		Cwd       string `json:"cwd"`
57	}
58	
59	// contentBlock is one element of an assistant or user message content array.
60	type contentBlock struct {
61		Type     string         `json:"type"`
62		Text     string         `json:"text,omitempty"`
63		Thinking string         `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
64		ID       string         `json:"id,omitempty"`
65		Name     string         `json:"name,omitempty"`
66		Args     map[string]any `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
67	}
68	
69	// userMessage is a pi user-role message: content is string OR []contentBlock.
70	type userMessage struct {
71		Role      string          `json:"role"`
72		Content   json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
73		Timestamp int64           `json:"timestamp"`
74	}
75	
76	// assistantMessage is a pi assistant-role message.
77	type assistantMessage struct {
78		Role         string         `json:"role"`
79		Content      []contentBlock `json:"content"`
80		Provider     string         `json:"provider"`
81		Model        string         `json:"model"`
82		API          string         `json:"api"`
83		StopReason   string         `json:"stopReason"`
84		ErrorMessage string         `json:"errorMessage,omitempty"`
85		Usage        *piUsage       `json:"usage,omitempty"`
86	}
87	
88	// piUsage is the token-usage shape on a pi assistant message.
89	type piUsage struct {
90		Input       int64 `json:"input"`
91		Output      int64 `json:"output"`
92		CacheRead   int64 `json:"cacheRead"`
93		CacheWrite  int64 `json:"cacheWrite"`
94		TotalTokens int64 `json:"totalTokens"`
95	}

97	// toolResultMessage is a pi toolResult-role message (a top-level entry).
98	type toolResultMessage struct {
99		Role       string          `json:"role"`
100		ToolCallID string          `json:"toolCallId"`
101		ToolName   string          `json:"toolName"`
102		Content    []contentBlock  `json:"content"`
103		Details    json.RawMessage `json:"details,omitempty"` // tool-specific metadata (e.g. exitCode)
104		IsError    bool            `json:"isError"`
105	}
106	
107	// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
108	// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
109	// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
110	// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if header == nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
118		}
119		if header.Type != entrySession {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
121		}
122		if header.ID == "" {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
130	}
131	
132	// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
133	// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
134	// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
135	func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
136		if header.Version > 0 {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
138		}
139		return "v1"
140	}
141	
142	// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
143	func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
144		return &schema.SessionData{
145			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
146			Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
147				ID:      providerID,
148				Name:    providerName,
149				Version: piProviderVersion(header),
150			},
151			SessionID:     header.ID,
152			CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
153			WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
154			Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
155		}
156	}
157	
158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}
192	
193	// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating
194	// one if none exists yet.
195	func appendAssistant(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) *schema.Exchange {
196		if current == nil {
197			current = &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: e.ID, StartTime: e.Timestamp}
198		}
199		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, buildAgentMessages(e)...)
200		current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
201		return current
202	}
203	
204	// messageRole extracts .message.role from a message entry.
205	func messageRole(e rawEntry) string {
206		var m struct {
207			Role string `json:"role"`
208		}
209		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m)
210		return m.Role
211	}
212	
213	// mergeToolResult folds a toolResult entry into the matching agent ToolInfo in
214	// the current exchange, keyed by toolCallId == ToolInfo.UseID. It also advances
215	// the exchange EndTime to the toolResult's timestamp so downstream stats that
216	// read the last exchange's EndTime report the real final-event time.
217	func mergeToolResult(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) {
218		if current == nil {
219			return
220		}
221		var tr toolResultMessage
222		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &tr); err != nil {
223			return
224		}
225		content := toolResultContent(tr)
226		for i := range current.Messages {
227			msg := &current.Messages[i]
228			if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.UseID == tr.ToolCallID {
229				msg.Tool.Output = buildToolOutput(content, tr)
230				msg.Timestamp = e.Timestamp
231				current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
232				return
233			}
234		}
235	}
236	
237	// toolResultContent joins the text blocks of a toolResult message.
238	func toolResultContent(tr toolResultMessage) string {
239		var parts []string
240		for _, b := range tr.Content {
241			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
242				parts = append(parts, b.Text)
243			}
244		}
245		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
246	}
247	
248	// buildUserMessage maps a pi user message entry to a schema user Message.
249	// pi user content is either a plain string or an array of {type:text|image}.
250	func buildUserMessage(e rawEntry) schema.Message {
251		var um userMessage
252		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &um)
253		parts := userContentParts(um.Content)
254		return schema.Message{
255			ID:        e.ID,
256			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
257			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
258			Content:   parts,
259		}
260	}
261	
262	// userContentParts decodes a pi user message's content (string or array) into
263	// schema ContentParts. Image blocks are dropped in v1 (recorded as a gap).
264	func userContentParts(raw json.RawMessage) []schema.ContentPart {
265		if len(raw) == 0 {
266			return nil
267		}
268		if raw[0] == '"' {
269			var s string
270			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
271				return []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: s}}
272			}
273		}
274		var blocks []contentBlock
275		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
276			return nil
277		}
278		var parts []schema.ContentPart
279		for _, b := range blocks {
280			if b.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && b.Text != "" {
281				parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
282			}
283		}
284		return parts
285	}
286	
287	// buildAgentMessages maps a pi assistant message entry to one or more schema
288	// Messages: one Message holds the text+thinking content parts; each toolCall
289	// block becomes its own agent Message carrying a ToolInfo.
290	func buildAgentMessages(e rawEntry) []schema.Message {
291		var am assistantMessage
292		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &am); err != nil {
293			return nil
294		}
295		var parts []schema.ContentPart
296		var messages []schema.Message
297		for _, b := range am.Content {
298			switch b.Type {
299			case schema.ContentTypeText:
300				if b.Text != "" {
301					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
302				}
303			case schema.ContentTypeThinking:
304				if b.Thinking != "" {
305					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: b.Thinking})
306				}
307			case "toolCall":
308				messages = append(messages, buildToolMessage(e, b, am))
309			}
310		}
311		if len(parts) > 0 {
312			head := schema.Message{
313				ID:        e.ID,
314				Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
315				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
316				Model:     am.Model,
317				Content:   parts,
318				Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
319			}
320			return append([]schema.Message{head}, messages...)
321		}
322		if len(messages) == 0 {
323			return buildErrorMessage(e, am)
324		}
325		// Tool-call-only assistant message: carry model+usage once on the first
326		// tool message so no metadata is lost and no schema-invalid empty message
327		// is emitted.
328		messages[0].Model = am.Model
329		if messages[0].Usage == nil {
330			messages[0].Usage = mapUsage(am.Usage)
331		}
332		return messages
333	}
334	
335	// buildToolMessage builds an agent Message wrapping a ToolInfo from a toolCall.
336	// The parent assistant message's model is passed through so tool messages carry
337	// the same model metadata as text/thinking messages. The Message ID is derived
338	// from the parent entry id + the toolCall id, so multiple toolCalls in one
339	// assistant message get distinct Message IDs (downstream provenance keys use
340	// msg.ID as a deterministic component).
341	func buildToolMessage(e rawEntry, b contentBlock, am assistantMessage) schema.Message {
342		return schema.Message{
343			ID:        toolMessageID(e.ID, b.ID),
344			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
345			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
346			Model:     am.Model,
347			Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{
348				Name:  b.Name,
349				Type:  classifyToolType(b.Name),
350				UseID: b.ID,
351				Input: b.Args,
352			},
353		}
354	}
355	
356	// toolMessageID builds a unique Message ID for a tool-call message from the
357	// parent entry id and the toolCall id. This avoids duplicate Message IDs when a
358	// single assistant entry contains multiple toolCall blocks.
359	func toolMessageID(entryID, callID string) string {
360		if callID != "" {
361			return entryID + ":" + callID
362		}
363		return entryID
364	}
365	
366	// buildToolOutput constructs the ToolInfo.Output map from a toolResult's
367	// content, error flag, and optional details blob. details (e.g. exitCode) is
368	// decoded into a generic value so downstream consumers (markdown rendering,
369	// cloud) can surface structured tool metadata without re-parsing raw JSON.
370	func buildToolOutput(content string, tr toolResultMessage) map[string]any {
371		out := map[string]any{"content": content, "is_error": tr.IsError}
372		if len(tr.Details) > 0 {
373			var details any
374			if err := json.Unmarshal(tr.Details, &details); err == nil {
375				out["details"] = details
376			}
377		}
378		return out
379	}
380	
381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style
383	// cache fields (pi uses the same semantics).
384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}

14	
15	// Line-size sanity limits, mirroring claudecode/codex. bufio.Reader.ReadString
16	// has no line-size limit, so a 250MB cap guards against OOM from pathological or
17	// malicious files (a legitimate pi session line — a big tool result or base64
18	// image — can exceed the 16MB bufio.Scanner cap, so we do NOT use Scanner).
19	const (
20		KB                    = 1024
21		MB                    = 1024 * 1024
22		maxReasonableLineSize = 250 * MB
23	)
24	
25	// errStopRead is a sentinel a visit callback may return to stop iteration early
26	// (without error). readLines treats it as a clean stop.
27	var errStopRead = errors.New("stop reading")
28	
29	// readLines reads a pi session file line-by-line via bufio.Reader (unbounded
30	// line size, unlike bufio.Scanner) and calls visit for each non-empty trimmed
31	// line. Lines exceeding maxReasonableLineSize are refused with an error to
32	// prevent OOM. Returning errStopRead from visit stops iteration cleanly.
33	func readLines(path string, visit func(line string) error) error {
34		f, err := os.Open(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return fmt.Errorf("pi: opening session %s: %w", path, err)
37		}
38		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
39	
40		reader := bufio.NewReader(f)
41		lineNum := 0
42		for {
43			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
44			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
45				return fmt.Errorf("pi: reading line %d of %s: %w", lineNum+1, path, readErr)
46			}
47			line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
48			lineNum++
49			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
50			if trimmed != "" {
51				if len(trimmed) > maxReasonableLineSize {
52					slog.Warn("pi: line exceeds reasonable size limit",
53						"lineNumber", lineNum, "sizeMB", len(trimmed)/MB,
54						"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB, "file", filepath.Base(path))
55					return fmt.Errorf("pi: line %d of %s exceeds %dMB (refusing to process potentially malformed file)",
56						lineNum, path, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
57				}
58				if vErr := visit(trimmed); vErr != nil {
59					if errors.Is(vErr, errStopRead) {
60						return nil
61					}
62					return vErr
63				}
64			}
65			if readErr == io.EOF {
66				return nil
67			}
68		}
69	}
70	
71	// readEntries parses every line of the session file into a header (line 1) and
72	// a list of message/control entries (the rest). Malformed lines are skipped
73	// rather than aborting the whole parse.
74	func readEntries(path string) (*sessionHeader, []rawEntry, error) {
75		var header *sessionHeader
76		var entries []rawEntry
77		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
78			if header == nil {
79				h := sessionHeader{}
80				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
81					return fmt.Errorf("pi: parsing session header: %w", jErr)
82				}
83				header = &h
84				return nil
85			}
86			var e rawEntry
87			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
88				return nil // skip malformed line, keep going
89			}
90			// Skip entries missing the envelope fields the tree walk and exchange
91			// grouping rely on; a stray entry with no id can mislead leaf selection.
92			if e.Type == "" || e.ID == "" {
93				slog.Debug("pi: skipping entry with empty type or id", "file", path)
94				return nil
95			}
96			entries = append(entries, e)
97			return nil
98		})
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, nil, err
101		}
102		return header, entries, nil
103	}
104	
105	// leafPathEntries walks from the leaf (last entry in file order) to the root,
106	// reverses to chronological order, and applies compaction: if a compaction
107	// entry is on the path, entries before its firstKeptEntryId are dropped.
108	func leafPathEntries(entries []rawEntry) []rawEntry {
109		byID := indexByID(entries)
110		leaf := entries[len(entries)-1]
111		path := walkToRoot(leaf, byID)
112		reverse(path)
113		return applyCompaction(path)
114	}
115	
116	// indexByID builds an id -> entry lookup for the tree walk.
117	func indexByID(entries []rawEntry) map[string]rawEntry {
118		m := make(map[string]rawEntry, len(entries))
119		for _, e := range entries {
120			m[e.ID] = e
121		}
122		return m
123	}
124	
125	// walkToRoot collects entries from the given leaf up to the root (parentId
126	// null). A visited set guards against parentId cycles in corrupted sessions so
127	// the walk terminates instead of looping forever.
128	func walkToRoot(leaf rawEntry, byID map[string]rawEntry) []rawEntry {
129		var path []rawEntry
130		cur := leaf
131		visited := make(map[string]bool)
132		for !visited[cur.ID] {
133			visited[cur.ID] = true
134			path = append(path, cur)
135			if cur.ParentID == nil {
136				break
137			}
138			parent, ok := byID[*cur.ParentID]
139			if !ok {
140				break
141			}
142			cur = parent
143		}
144		return path
145	}
146	
147	// reverse reverses a slice of rawEntry in place.
148	func reverse(s []rawEntry) {
149		for i, j := 0, len(s)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
150			s[i], s[j] = s[j], s[i]
151		}
152	}
153	
154	// applyCompaction drops entries before the most recent compaction point when
155	// one or more compaction entries are on the path. pi's buildContextEntries
156	// builds context from the LATEST compaction's firstKeptEntryId forward (each
157	// new compaction summarizes prior compactions into itself), so when multiple
158	// compactions exist we use the last one in chronological order, not the first.
159	// If firstKeptEntryId is missing from the path, we keep from the compaction
160	// entry forward so pre-compaction entries are never accidentally retained.
161	func applyCompaction(path []rawEntry) []rawEntry {
162		last := -1
163		for i, e := range path {
164			if e.Type == entryCompaction {
165				last = i
166			}
167		}
168		if last < 0 {
169			return path
170		}
171		keptID := compactionFirstKept(path[last])
172		if keptID == "" {
173			return path[last:]
174		}
175		if idx := keepFromIndex(path, keptID); idx >= 0 {
176			return path[idx:]
177		}
178		return path[last:]
179	}
180	
181	// compactionFirstKept returns the firstKeptEntryId of a compaction entry. pi
182	// stores this as a top-level field on the entry (not inside a message
183	// payload), so it is decoded directly into rawEntry.FirstKeptEntryID.
184	func compactionFirstKept(e rawEntry) string {
185		return e.FirstKeptEntryID
186	}
187	
188	// keepFromIndex returns the index of the entry with id==keptID in path, or -1
189	// if not found.
190	func keepFromIndex(path []rawEntry, keptID string) int {
191		for i, e := range path {
192			if e.ID == keptID {
193				return i
194			}
195		}
196		return -1
197	}
198

1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// piSessionsRoot returns ~/.pi/agent/sessions, the directory under which pi
11	// stores one subdirectory per working directory (each named with the encoded
12	// cwd, see EncodeCwd). It does not require the directory to exist.
13	func piSessionsRoot() (string, error) {
14		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
15		if err != nil {
16			return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
17		}
18		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), nil
19	}
20	
21	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name.
22	// pi replaces every '/' in the absolute path with '-' and wraps the result with
23	// a leading '-' and a trailing '--', producing e.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
24	// "--Users-jane-proj--". The encoding is derived from real session dirs:
25	// "/Users/jakelevirne" -> "--Users-jakelevirne--" and
26	// "/Users/jakelevirne/dev/getspecstory" -> "--Users-jakelevirne-dev-getspecstory--".
27	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
28		encoded := strings.ReplaceAll(cwd, "/", "-")
29		return "-" + encoded + "--"
30	}
31	
32	// ProjectSessionDir returns the absolute path to pi's session subdirectory for
33	// the given project, WITHOUT requiring it to exist. Callers (DetectAgent, sync)
34	// check existence separately. The path is symlink-resolved before encoding so
35	// it matches the directory pi actually wrote to (pi encodes the real cwd); a
36	// relative or symlinked projectPath would otherwise produce a different name.
37	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
38		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
39		if err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
43		if cwd == "" {
44			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
45			if err != nil {
46				return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
50		if err != nil {
51			realPath = cwd // fall back to the raw path if resolution fails
52		}
53		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(realPath)), nil
54	}
55	
56	// SessionFilesInProject lists the *.jsonl files in the project's pi session
57	// directory. Returns an empty slice (no error) if the directory does not exist.
58	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
59		dir, err := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath)
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
64		if err != nil {
65			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
66				return nil, nil
67			}
68			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading session dir %s: %w", dir, err)
69		}
70		var files []string
71		for _, e := range entries {
72			if e.IsDir() {
73				continue
74			}
75			if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl") {
76				continue
77			}
78			files = append(files, filepath.Join(dir, e.Name()))
79		}
80		return files, nil
81	}

27	// Provider implements spi.Provider for the pi coding agent.
28	// pi stores sessions as JSONL v3 trees under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/.
29	type Provider struct{}
30	
31	// NewProvider returns a new pi provider instance.

34	// Name returns the human-readable provider name.
35	func (p *Provider) Name() string { return providerName }

37	// Check verifies the pi binary is on PATH and reports its version.
38	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
45		if err != nil {
46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
47			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "not_found", err.Error())
48			return spi.CheckResult{
49				Success:      false,
50				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi binary '%s' not found on PATH", cmdName),
51			}
52		}
53		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())
60			return spi.CheckResult{
61				Success:      false,
62				Location:     resolved,
63				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi version probe failed: %v", err),
64			}
65		}
66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}

136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the

138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}

155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}

290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}

318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}

37	// Check verifies the pi binary is on PATH and reports its version.
38	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
45		if err != nil {
46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
47			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "not_found", err.Error())
48			return spi.CheckResult{
49				Success:      false,
50				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi binary '%s' not found on PATH", cmdName),
51			}
52		}
53		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())
60			return spi.CheckResult{
61				Success:      false,
62				Location:     resolved,
63				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi version probe failed: %v", err),
64			}
65		}
66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}

136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}

155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}

177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.

188				continue

190			if h == nil {

192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}

251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}
425

107	// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
108	// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
109	// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
110	// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if header == nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
118		}
119		if header.Type != entrySession {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
121		}
122		if header.ID == "" {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
130	}

132	// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
133	// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
134	// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
135	func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
136		if header.Version > 0 {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
138		}
139		return "v1"
140	}

142	// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
143	func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
144		return &schema.SessionData{
145			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
146			Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
147				ID:      providerID,
148				Name:    providerName,
149				Version: piProviderVersion(header),
150			},
151			SessionID:     header.ID,
152			CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
153			WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
154			Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
155		}
156	}

158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}

198		}

262	// userContentParts decodes a pi user message's content (string or array) into
263	// schema ContentParts. Image blocks are dropped in v1 (recorded as a gap).

265		if len(raw) == 0 {

272			}

287	// buildAgentMessages maps a pi assistant message entry to one or more schema
288	// Messages: one Message holds the text+thinking content parts; each toolCall
289	// block becomes its own agent Message carrying a ToolInfo.
290	func buildAgentMessages(e rawEntry) []schema.Message {
291		var am assistantMessage
292		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &am); err != nil {
293			return nil

295		var parts []schema.ContentPart
296		var messages []schema.Message
297		for _, b := range am.Content {
298			switch b.Type {
299			case schema.ContentTypeText:
300				if b.Text != "" {
301					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
302				}
303			case schema.ContentTypeThinking:
304				if b.Thinking != "" {
305					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: b.Thinking})
306				}
307			case "toolCall":
308				messages = append(messages, buildToolMessage(e, b, am))
309			}
310		}
311		if len(parts) > 0 {
312			head := schema.Message{
313				ID:        e.ID,
314				Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
315				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
316				Model:     am.Model,
317				Content:   parts,
318				Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
319			}
320			return append([]schema.Message{head}, messages...)
321		}
322		if len(messages) == 0 {
323			return buildErrorMessage(e, am)
324		}
325		// Tool-call-only assistant message: carry model+usage once on the first
326		// tool message so no metadata is lost and no schema-invalid empty message
327		// is emitted.
328		messages[0].Model = am.Model
329		if messages[0].Usage == nil {

332		return messages

342		return schema.Message{

346			Model:     am.Model,

414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.

421					continue

423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {

427				}

433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}

107	// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
108	// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
109	// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
110	// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if header == nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
118		}
119		if header.Type != entrySession {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
121		}
122		if header.ID == "" {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
130	}

132	// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
133	// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
134	// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
135	func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
136		if header.Version > 0 {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
138		}
139		return "v1"
140	}
141	
142	// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
143	func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
144		return &schema.SessionData{
145			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
146			Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
147				ID:      providerID,
148				Name:    providerName,
149				Version: piProviderVersion(header),
150			},
151			SessionID:     header.ID,
152			CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
153			WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
154			Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
155		}
156	}
157	
158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}

193	// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating
194	// one if none exists yet.
