24	// GenerateAgentSession creates a SessionData from a Claude Code Session
25	// The session should already be parsed from JSONL with records in chronological order
26	func GenerateAgentSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string) (*SessionData, error) {
27		slog.Info("GenerateAgentSession: Starting", "sessionID", session.SessionUuid, "recordCount", len(session.Records))
28	
29		if len(session.Records) == 0 {
30			return nil, fmt.Errorf("session has no records")
31		}
32	
33		// Extract metadata from records
34		createdAt := extractCreatedAtFromRecords(session.Records)
35		if workspaceRoot == "" {
36			workspaceRoot = extractWorkspaceRootFromRecords(session.Records)
37		}
38	
39		// Group records into exchanges
40		exchanges, err := buildExchangesFromRecords(session.Records, workspaceRoot)
41		if err != nil {
42			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build exchanges: %w", err)
43		}
44	
45		// Assign exchangeId to each exchange (format: sessionId:index)
46		for i := range exchanges {
47			exchanges[i].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.SessionUuid, i)
48		}
49	
50		slog.Info("GenerateAgentSession: Built exchanges", "count", len(exchanges))
51	
52		// Populate FormattedMarkdown for all tools
53		for i := range exchanges {
54			for j := range exchanges[i].Messages {
55				msg := &exchanges[i].Messages[j]
56				if msg.Tool != nil {
57					formattedMd := formatToolAsMarkdown(msg.Tool, workspaceRoot)
58					msg.Tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formattedMd
59				}
60			}
61		}
62	
63		sessionData := &SessionData{
64			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
65			Provider: ProviderInfo{
66				ID:      "claude-code",
67				Name:    "Claude Code",
68				Version: "unknown",
69			},
70			SessionID:     session.SessionUuid,
71			CreatedAt:     createdAt,
72			WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot,
73			Exchanges:     exchanges,
74		}
75	
76		return sessionData, nil
77	}

79	// extractCreatedAtFromRecords extracts the earliest timestamp from JSONL records
80	func extractCreatedAtFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord) string {
81		if len(records) == 0 {
82			return time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339)
83		}
84	
85		// Get timestamp from first record
86		if timestamp, ok := records[0].Data["timestamp"].(string); ok && timestamp != "" {
87			return timestamp
88		}
89	
90		return time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339)
91	}
92	
93	// extractWorkspaceRootFromRecords extracts the workspace root from JSONL records
94	func extractWorkspaceRootFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord) string {
95		for _, record := range records {
96			if cwd, ok := record.Data["cwd"].(string); ok && cwd != "" {
97				return cwd
98			}
99		}
100		return ""
101	}

103	// buildExchangesFromRecords groups JSONL records into exchanges
104	// An exchange is a user prompt followed by agent responses and tool results
105	// Records are assumed to be in chronological order from JSONL parsing
106	func buildExchangesFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord, workspaceRoot string) ([]Exchange, error) {
107		var exchanges []Exchange
108		var currentExchange *Exchange
109		var exchangeStartTime string
110	
111		for _, record := range records {
112			recordType, _ := record.Data["type"].(string)
113			timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
114	
115			// Check if this is a sidechain message (subagent conversation)
116			// Note: warmup messages are filtered earlier by filterWarmupMessages
117			isSidechain, _ := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool)
118	
119			switch recordType {
120			case "user":
121				// Check if this is a tool result or a new user message
122				message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
123				messageContent, _ := message["content"].([]interface{})
124	
125				isToolResult := false
126				if len(messageContent) > 0 {
127					if firstContent, ok := messageContent[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
128						if contentType, ok := firstContent["type"].(string); ok && contentType == "tool_result" {
129							isToolResult = true
130						}
131					}
132				}
133	
134				if isToolResult {
135					// This is a tool result - merge it into the previous tool use
136					if currentExchange != nil {
137						mergeToolResultIntoExchange(currentExchange, messageContent, timestamp)
138						currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
139					}
140				} else {
141					// This is a new user prompt
142	
143					// Sidechain messages append to current exchange (parent agent talking to subagent)
144					// rather than starting a new exchange like regular user prompts do
145					if isSidechain {
146						if currentExchange == nil {
147							slog.Warn("Sidechain user message with no current exchange", "uuid", record.Data["uuid"])
148							continue
149						}
150						msg := buildUserMessage(record, isSidechain)
151						currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, msg)
152						currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
153						continue
154					}
155	
156					// Non-sidechain: start a new exchange
157					if currentExchange != nil {
158						exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
159					}
160	
161					currentExchange = &Exchange{
162						StartTime: timestamp,
163						Messages:  []Message{buildUserMessage(record, isSidechain)},
164					}
165				}
166	
167			case "assistant":
168				// Agent message - add to current exchange
169				if currentExchange == nil {
170					// Create exchange if we don't have one (shouldn't happen normally)
171					exchangeStartTime = timestamp
172					currentExchange = &Exchange{
173						StartTime: exchangeStartTime,
174						Messages:  []Message{},
175					}
176				}
177	
178				msg := buildAgentMessage(record, workspaceRoot, isSidechain)
179				currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, msg)
180				currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
181			}
182		}
183	
184		// Add the last exchange if exists
185		if currentExchange != nil && len(currentExchange.Messages) > 0 {
186			exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
187		}
188	
189		// Records are already in chronological order from JSONL parsing,
190		// so exchanges are also in order. No sorting needed.
191	
192		return exchanges, nil
193	}

195	// mergeToolResultIntoExchange finds the tool use in the exchange and adds the result to it.
196	// The resultTimestamp is the time the tool completed (from the tool_result JSONL record).
197	func mergeToolResultIntoExchange(exchange *Exchange, messageContent []interface{}, resultTimestamp string) {
198		// Extract tool_result data from message content
199		if len(messageContent) == 0 {
200			return
201		}
202	
203		toolResultMap, ok := messageContent[0].(map[string]interface{})
204		if !ok {
205			return
206		}
207	
208		// Get the tool_use_id that this result corresponds to
209		toolUseID, ok := toolResultMap["tool_use_id"].(string)
210		if !ok || toolUseID == "" {
211			return
212		}
213	
214		// Extract result content and error status
215		// Content can be either a string or an array of text objects (for Task tool results)
216		var content string
217		if contentStr, ok := toolResultMap["content"].(string); ok {
218			content = contentStr
219		} else if contentArray, ok := toolResultMap["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
220			// Array of text objects like [{"type":"text","text":"..."}]
221			var parts []string
222			for _, item := range contentArray {
223				if itemMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
224					if text, ok := itemMap["text"].(string); ok {
225						parts = append(parts, text)
226					}
227				}
228			}
229			content = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
230		}
231		isError, _ := toolResultMap["is_error"].(bool)
232	
233		// Find the message with matching tool use ID and add the output
234		for i := range exchange.Messages {
235			msg := &exchange.Messages[i]
236			if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.UseID == toolUseID {
237				msg.Tool.Output = map[string]interface{}{
238					"content":  content,
239					"is_error": isError,
240				}
241				// Update message timestamp to when the tool actually completed,
242				// not when the agent requested it (needed for provenance correlation)
243				msg.Timestamp = resultTimestamp
244				return
245			}
246		}
247	}

249	// buildUserMessage creates a Message from a user JSONL record
250	func buildUserMessage(record JSONLRecord, isSidechain bool) Message {
251		uuid, _ := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
252		timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
253	
254		message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
255		var contentParts []ContentPart
256	
257		// Handle different content formats
258		if content, ok := message["content"].(string); ok {
259			// Simple string content
260			contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
261				Type: "text",
262				Text: content,
263			})
264		} else if contentArray, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
265			// Array of content parts
266			for _, item := range contentArray {
267				if contentMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
268					contentType, _ := contentMap["type"].(string)
269	
270					switch contentType {
271					case "text":
272						text, _ := contentMap["text"].(string)
273						contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
274							Type: "text",
275							Text: text,
276						})
277					case "thinking":
278						thinking, _ := contentMap["thinking"].(string)
279						contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
280							Type: "thinking",
281							Text: thinking,
282						})
283						// tool_result is now merged into tool use, not handled here
284					}
285				}
286			}
287		}
288	
289		msg := Message{
290			ID:        uuid,
291			Timestamp: timestamp,
292			Role:      "user",
293			Content:   contentParts,
294		}
295	
296		// For sidechain messages, treat as agent (parent agent talking to subagent, not actual user input)
297		if isSidechain {
298			msg.Role = "agent"
299			msg.Metadata = map[string]interface{}{
300				"isSidechain": true,
301			}
302		}
303	
304		return msg
305	}

307	// buildAgentMessage creates a Message from an assistant JSONL record
308	func buildAgentMessage(record JSONLRecord, workspaceRoot string, isSidechain bool) Message {
309		uuid, _ := record.Data["uuid"].(string)
310		timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)
311	
312		message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
313		model, _ := message["model"].(string)

319		// Parse message content
320		if contentArray, ok := message["content"].([]interface{}); ok {
321			for _, item := range contentArray {
322				if contentMap, ok := item.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
323					contentType, _ := contentMap["type"].(string)
324	
325					switch contentType {
326					case "text":
327						text, _ := contentMap["text"].(string)
328						if text != "" {
329							contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
330								Type: "text",
331								Text: text,
332							})
333						}
334	
335					case "thinking":
336						// Preserve thinking content with its type
337						thinking, _ := contentMap["thinking"].(string)
338						if thinking != "" {
339							contentParts = append(contentParts, ContentPart{
340								Type: "thinking",
341								Text: thinking,
342							})
343						}
344	
345					case "tool_use":
346						// Extract tool information
347						toolName, _ := contentMap["name"].(string)
348						toolUseID, _ := contentMap["id"].(string)
349						toolInput, _ := contentMap["input"].(map[string]interface{})
350	
351						toolInfo = &ToolInfo{
352							Name:  toolName,
353							Type:  classifyToolType(toolName),
354							UseID: toolUseID,
355							Input: toolInput,
356						}
357	
358						// Extract path hints using the record's cwd, which tracks the
359						// shell's actual working directory (changes after cd commands)
360						recordCwd, _ := record.Data["cwd"].(string)

362							recordCwd = workspaceRoot
363						}
364						pathHints = extractPathHints(toolInput, recordCwd, workspaceRoot)
365					}
366				}
367			}

369	
370		// Also check for tool use result in the record
371		if toolUseResult, ok := record.Data["toolUseResult"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
372			if toolInfo != nil {
373				// Add output to existing tool info
374				toolInfo.Output = map[string]interface{}{
375					"type":     toolUseResult["type"],
376					"filePath": toolUseResult["filePath"],
377				}
378			}
379		}
380	
381		// Extract usage data if present
382		var usageInfo *Usage
383		if usage, ok := message["usage"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
384			usageInfo = &Usage{
385				InputTokens:              schema.GetIntFromMap(usage, "input_tokens"),
386				OutputTokens:             schema.GetIntFromMap(usage, "output_tokens"),
387				CacheCreationInputTokens: schema.GetIntFromMap(usage, "cache_creation_input_tokens"),
388				CacheReadInputTokens:     schema.GetIntFromMap(usage, "cache_read_input_tokens"),
389			}
390		}
391	
392		msg := Message{
393			ID:        uuid,
394			Timestamp: timestamp,
395			Role:      "agent",
396			Model:     model,

398			Tool:      toolInfo,

408		}

413	// classifyToolType maps tool names to standard tool types
414	func classifyToolType(toolName string) string {
415		toolName = strings.ToLower(toolName)
416	
417		switch toolName {
418		// "str_replace_editor", "write_file", "edit_file", "create_file", "append_to_file" are legacy tools, no longer in the agent
419		case "write", "edit", "multiedit", "str_replace_editor", "write_file", "edit_file", "create_file", "append_to_file":
420			return "write"
421		case "read", "webfetch", "read_file", "view_file", "cat": // "read_file", "view_file", "cat" are legacy tools, no longer in the agent
422			return "read"
423		case "grep", "glob", "websearch":
424			return "search"
425		case "bash", "taskoutput", "killshell":
426			return "shell"
427		case "notebookedit", "todowrite":
428			return "task"
429		case "enterplanmode", "exitplanmode", "askuserquestion", "skill", "lsp", "task":
430			return "generic"
431		default:
432			return "unknown"
433		}
434	}
435	
436	// extractPathHints extracts file paths from tool input.
437	// cwd is the shell's working directory at the time of the tool call (from the
438	// JSONL record's top-level cwd field), used to resolve relative paths in shell commands.
439	func extractPathHints(input map[string]interface{}, cwd, workspaceRoot string) []string {
440		var paths []string
441	
442		// Common path field names
443		pathFields := []string{"file_path", "path", "filename", "old_path", "new_path"}
444		arrayFields := []string{"paths", "files", "targets"}
445	
446		// Extract single path fields
447		for _, field := range pathFields {
448			if value, ok := input[field].(string); ok && value != "" {
449				normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
450				if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
451					paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
452				}
453			}
454		}
455	
456		// Extract array path fields
457		for _, field := range arrayFields {
458			if arr, ok := input[field].([]interface{}); ok {
459				for _, item := range arr {
460					if path, ok := item.(string); ok && path != "" {
461						normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
462						if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
463							paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
464						}
465					}
466				}
467			}
468		}
469	
470		// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
471		if command, ok := input["command"].(string); ok && command != "" {
472			shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
473			for _, sp := range shellPaths {
474				if !contains(paths, sp) {
475					paths = append(paths, sp)
476				}
477			}
478		}
479	
480		return paths
481	}
482	
483	// contains checks if a string slice contains a value
484	func contains(slice []string, value string) bool {
485		for _, item := range slice {
486			if item == value {
487				return true
488			}
489		}
490		return false
491	}
492	
493	// formatToolAsMarkdown generates formatted markdown for a tool (input + output)
494	// Returns the inner content only (no <tool-use> tags)
495	func formatToolAsMarkdown(tool *ToolInfo, workspaceRoot string) string {
496		var markdown strings.Builder
497	
498		// Add _cwd to input for path normalization in formatters
499		if tool.Input == nil {
500			tool.Input = make(map[string]interface{})
501		}
502		tool.Input["_cwd"] = workspaceRoot
503	
504		// Extract description if present
505		description := ""
506		if desc, ok := tool.Input["description"].(string); ok {
507			description = desc
508		}
509	
510		// Format tool use based on tool name using existing formatters
511		var toolContent string
512		if formatter, ok := toolFormatters[tool.Name]; ok {
513			// Use tool-specific formatter
514			toolContent = formatter(tool.Name, tool.Input, description)
515		} else {
516			// Use default formatter
517			toolContent = formatDefaultTool(tool.Name, tool.Input, description)
518		}
519	
520		// Add formatted tool content
521		if toolContent != "" {
522			markdown.WriteString(toolContent)
523			markdown.WriteString("\n")
524		}
525	
526		// Add tool result/output if present
527		if tool.Output != nil {
528			// Check for error first
529			if isError, ok := tool.Output["is_error"].(bool); ok && isError {
530				// Blank line before code fence helps parsers inside <details> tags
531				markdown.WriteString("\n```text\n")
532				if content, ok := tool.Output["content"].(string); ok {
533					cleaned := stripSystemReminders(content)
534					cleaned = stripANSIEscapeSequences(cleaned)
535					markdown.WriteString(cleaned)
536				}
537				markdown.WriteString("\n```\n")
538			} else {
539				// Regular result
540				if content, ok := tool.Output["content"].(string); ok {
541					cleaned := stripSystemReminders(content)
542					cleaned = stripANSIEscapeSequences(cleaned)
543					// Only trim trailing spaces/tabs, preserve all newlines
544					cleaned = strings.TrimRight(cleaned, " \t")
545	
546					// Special handling for AskUserQuestion - parse and format the answer nicely
547					if tool.Name == "AskUserQuestion" {
548						answer := parseAskUserQuestionAnswer(cleaned)
549						if answer != "" {
550							fmt.Fprintf(&markdown, "\n**Answer:** %s\n", answer)
551						} else if cleaned != "" {
552							// Fallback to code block if parsing fails
553							markdown.WriteString("\n```text\n")
554							markdown.WriteString(cleaned)
555							markdown.WriteString("\n```\n")
556						}
557					} else if strings.TrimSpace(cleaned) != TodoWriteSuccessMessage && cleaned != "" {
558						// Skip TodoWrite success messages
559						// Blank line before code fence helps parsers inside <details> tags
560						markdown.WriteString("\n```text\n")
561						markdown.WriteString(cleaned)
562						markdown.WriteString("\n```\n")
563					}
564				}
565			}
566		}
567	
568		return markdown.String()
569	}
570

```text
1	package piagent

3	import (
```

```text
17	)

19	const (
20		providerID    = "pi"
21		providerName  = "Pi"
22		defaultCmd    = "pi"
23		versionFlag   = "--version"
24		notYetSupport = "pi: %s not yet supported for the pi provider (v1 ships sync/list/search/reindex only)"
25	)
26	
27	// Provider implements spi.Provider for the pi coding agent.
28	// pi stores sessions as JSONL v3 trees under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/.
29	type Provider struct{}
30	
31	// NewProvider returns a new pi provider instance.
32	func NewProvider() *Provider { return &Provider{} }
33	
34	// Name returns the human-readable provider name.
35	func (p *Provider) Name() string { return providerName }
36	
37	// Check verifies the pi binary is on PATH and reports its version.
38	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
45		if err != nil {
46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
47			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "not_found", err.Error())
48			return spi.CheckResult{
49				Success:      false,
50				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi binary '%s' not found on PATH", cmdName),
51			}
52		}
53		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())
60			return spi.CheckResult{
61				Success:      false,
62				Location:     resolved,
63				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi version probe failed: %v", err),
64			}
65		}
66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}
73	
74	// DetectAgent reports whether pi has created sessions for the given project.
75	func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, _ bool) bool {
76		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
77		if err != nil {
78			slog.Debug("pi: DetectAgent error", "error", err)
79			return false
80		}
81		return len(files) > 0
82	}

104	// trackCheckSuccess emits the standard install-check success analytics event,
105	// matching the shape other providers use.
106	func trackCheckSuccess(custom bool, commandPath, resolvedPath, version string) {
107		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
108			"provider":       providerID,
109			"custom_command": custom,
110			"command_path":   commandPath,
111			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
112			"version":        version,
113			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
114		})
115	}
116	
117	// trackCheckFailure emits the standard install-check failure analytics event.
118	func trackCheckFailure(custom bool, commandPath, resolvedPath, errorType, message string) {
119		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
120			"provider":       providerID,
121			"custom_command": custom,
122			"command_path":   commandPath,
123			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
124			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
125			"error_type":     errorType,
126			"error_message":  message,
127		})
128	}
129	
130	// sessionFile pairs a discovered pi session file with its header metadata.
131	type sessionFile struct {
132		Path   string
133		Header sessionHeader
134	}
135	
136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}
154	
155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}
425
```

```text
29		providerListOnce  sync.Once // Ensures provider list is built only once
30	}
31	
32	// Global registry instance
33	var (
34		registry = &Registry{
35			providers: make(map[string]spi.Provider),
36		}
37		once sync.Once
38	)
39	
40	// ensureInitialized makes sure providers are registered
41	func (r *Registry) ensureInitialized() {
42		once.Do(func() {
43			r.registerAll()
44		})
45	}
46	
47	// registerAll registers all known providers.
48	// This is the ONLY place that needs to be updated when adding new providers.
49	func (r *Registry) registerAll() {
50		r.mu.Lock()
51		defer r.mu.Unlock()
52	
53		if r.initialized {
54			slog.Debug("Provider registry already initialized, skipping registration")
55			return
56		}
57	
58		slog.Debug("Initializing provider registry")
59	
60		// Register providers with simple IDs
61		// Each provider directly implements the spi.Provider interface
62		claudeProvider := claudecode.NewProvider()
63		r.providers["claude"] = claudeProvider
64		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "claude", "name", claudeProvider.Name())
65	
66		cursorProvider := cursorcli.NewProvider()
67		r.providers["cursor"] = cursorProvider
68		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "cursor", "name", cursorProvider.Name())
69	
70		codexProvider := codexcli.NewProvider()
71		r.providers["codex"] = codexProvider
72		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "codex", "name", codexProvider.Name())
73	
74		geminiProvider := geminicli.NewProvider()
75		r.providers["gemini"] = geminiProvider
76		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "gemini", "name", geminiProvider.Name())
77	
78		droidProvider := droidcli.NewProvider()
79		r.providers["droid"] = droidProvider
80		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "droid", "name", droidProvider.Name())
81	
82		deepseekProvider := deepseektui.NewProvider()
83		r.providers["deepseek"] = deepseekProvider
84		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "deepseek", "name", deepseekProvider.Name())
85	
86		piProvider := piagent.NewProvider()
87		r.providers["pi"] = piProvider
88		slog.Debug("Registered provider", "id", "pi", "name", piProvider.Name())
89	
90		r.initialized = true
91		slog.Info("Provider registry initialized", "count", len(r.providers), "providers", r.ListIDsUnsafe())
92	}
93	
94	// ListIDsUnsafe returns provider IDs without locking (for internal use only)
95	func (r *Registry) ListIDsUnsafe() []string {
96		ids := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
97		for id := range r.providers {
98			ids = append(ids, id)
99		}
100		sort.Strings(ids)
101		return ids
102	}
103	
104	// GetRegistry returns the global registry instance
105	func GetRegistry() *Registry {
106		registry.ensureInitialized()
107		return registry
108	}
109	
110	// Get retrieves a provider by ID (case-insensitive)
111	func (r *Registry) Get(id string) (spi.Provider, error) {
112		r.ensureInitialized()
113		r.mu.RLock()
114		defer r.mu.RUnlock()
115	
116		// Case-insensitive lookup
117		for provID, provider := range r.providers {
118			if strings.EqualFold(provID, id) {
119				slog.Debug("Retrieved provider", "requested_id", id, "matched_id", provID, "name", provider.Name())
120				return provider, nil
121			}
122		}
123	
124		// Log available providers when lookup fails to aid debugging
125		availableIDs := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
126		for id := range r.providers {
127			availableIDs = append(availableIDs, id)
128		}
129		sort.Strings(availableIDs)
130	
131		slog.Warn("Provider not found",
132			"requested_id", id,
133			"available_providers", availableIDs)
134	
135		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider '%s' not found", id)
136	}
137	
138	// GetAll returns all registered providers as a map of ID to Provider
139	func (r *Registry) GetAll() map[string]spi.Provider {
140		r.ensureInitialized()
141		r.mu.RLock()
142		defer r.mu.RUnlock()
143	
144		// Return a copy to prevent external modification
145		result := make(map[string]spi.Provider)
146		for id, provider := range r.providers {
147			result[id] = provider
148		}
149	
150		return result
151	}
152	
153	// ListIDs returns all registered provider IDs (sorted)
154	func (r *Registry) ListIDs() []string {
155		r.ensureInitialized()
156		r.mu.RLock()
157		defer r.mu.RUnlock()
158	
159		ids := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
160		for id := range r.providers {
161			ids = append(ids, id)
162		}
163	
164		sort.Strings(ids)
165		return ids
166	}
167	
168	// GetDefault returns the default provider (Claude)
169	func (r *Registry) GetDefault() (spi.Provider, error) {
170		r.ensureInitialized()
171		slog.Debug("Getting default provider (claude)")
172		return r.Get("claude")
173	}
174	
175	// GetProviderList returns a formatted string listing all providers.
176	// Used for help text and error messages.
177	// The result is cached since providers are static for the lifetime of the process.
178	func (r *Registry) GetProviderList() string {
179		r.ensureInitialized()
180	
181		// Build the provider list only once and cache it
182		r.providerListOnce.Do(func() {
183			r.mu.RLock()
184			defer r.mu.RUnlock()
185	
186			if len(r.providers) == 0 {
187				r.providerListCache = "No providers registered"
188				return
189			}
190	
191			// Get sorted IDs for consistent ordering
192			ids := make([]string, 0, len(r.providers))
193			for id := range r.providers {
194				ids = append(ids, id)
195			}
196			sort.Strings(ids)
197	
198			// Build the formatted list by accessing providers directly (no Get() calls)
199			var parts []string
200			for _, id := range ids {
201				if provider, ok := r.providers[id]; ok {
202					parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", id, provider.Name()))
203				}
204			}
205	
206			r.providerListCache = strings.Join(parts, ", ")
207		})
208	
209		return r.providerListCache
210	}
211
```

```text
12	// entryType constants for pi JSONL v3 session entries.
13	const (

15		entryMessage             = "message"
16		entryModelChange         = "model_change"
17		entryThinkingLevelChange = "thinking_level_change"

31		roleBashExecution = "bashExecution"
32		roleCustom        = "custom"

34		roleCompaction    = "compactionSummary"

37	// rawEntry is the minimal envelope every pi entry shares. The message payload
38	// (for type=="message") is kept as raw json.RawMessage so we can decode it per
39	// role without fighting a single union struct. Compaction entries carry
40	// firstKeptEntryId as a top-level field (no message wrapper).
41	type rawEntry struct {
42		Type             string          `json:"type"`
43		ID               string          `json:"id"`
44		ParentID         *string         `json:"parentId"` // null for the first entry
45		Timestamp        string          `json:"timestamp"`

47		Message          json.RawMessage `json:"message,omitempty"`
48	}

54		ID        string `json:"id"`
55		Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
56		Cwd       string `json:"cwd"`
57	}

60	type contentBlock struct {

62		Text     string         `json:"text,omitempty"`

74	}

104		IsError    bool            `json:"isError"`

106	
107	// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
108	// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
109	// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
110	// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if header == nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
118		}
119		if header.Type != entrySession {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
121		}
122		if header.ID == "" {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
130	}
131	
132	// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
133	// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
134	// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
135	func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
136		if header.Version > 0 {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
138		}
139		return "v1"
140	}
141	
142	// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
143	func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
144		return &schema.SessionData{
145			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
146			Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
147				ID:      providerID,
148				Name:    providerName,
149				Version: piProviderVersion(header),
150			},
151			SessionID:     header.ID,
152			CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
153			WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
154			Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
155		}
156	}
157	
158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}
192	
193	// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating
194	// one if none exists yet.
195	func appendAssistant(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) *schema.Exchange {
196		if current == nil {
197			current = &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: e.ID, StartTime: e.Timestamp}
198		}
199		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, buildAgentMessages(e)...)
200		current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
201		return current
202	}
203	
204	// messageRole extracts .message.role from a message entry.
205	func messageRole(e rawEntry) string {
206		var m struct {
207			Role string `json:"role"`
208		}
209		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m)
210		return m.Role
211	}
212	
213	// mergeToolResult folds a toolResult entry into the matching agent ToolInfo in
214	// the current exchange, keyed by toolCallId == ToolInfo.UseID. It also advances
215	// the exchange EndTime to the toolResult's timestamp so downstream stats that
216	// read the last exchange's EndTime report the real final-event time.
217	func mergeToolResult(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) {
218		if current == nil {
219			return
220		}
221		var tr toolResultMessage
222		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &tr); err != nil {
223			return
224		}
225		content := toolResultContent(tr)
226		for i := range current.Messages {
227			msg := &current.Messages[i]
228			if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.UseID == tr.ToolCallID {
229				msg.Tool.Output = buildToolOutput(content, tr)
230				msg.Timestamp = e.Timestamp
231				current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
232				return
233			}
234		}
235	}
236	
237	// toolResultContent joins the text blocks of a toolResult message.
238	func toolResultContent(tr toolResultMessage) string {
239		var parts []string
240		for _, b := range tr.Content {
241			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
242				parts = append(parts, b.Text)
243			}
244		}
245		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
246	}
247	
248	// buildUserMessage maps a pi user message entry to a schema user Message.
249	// pi user content is either a plain string or an array of {type:text|image}.
250	func buildUserMessage(e rawEntry) schema.Message {
251		var um userMessage
252		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &um)
253		parts := userContentParts(um.Content)
254		return schema.Message{
255			ID:        e.ID,
256			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
257			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
258			Content:   parts,
259		}
260	}
261	
262	// userContentParts decodes a pi user message's content (string or array) into
263	// schema ContentParts. Image blocks are dropped in v1 (recorded as a gap).
264	func userContentParts(raw json.RawMessage) []schema.ContentPart {
265		if len(raw) == 0 {
266			return nil
267		}
268		if raw[0] == '"' {
269			var s string
270			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
271				return []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: s}}
272			}
273		}
274		var blocks []contentBlock
275		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
276			return nil
277		}
278		var parts []schema.ContentPart
279		for _, b := range blocks {
280			if b.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && b.Text != "" {
281				parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
282			}
283		}
284		return parts
285	}
286	
287	// buildAgentMessages maps a pi assistant message entry to one or more schema
288	// Messages: one Message holds the text+thinking content parts; each toolCall
289	// block becomes its own agent Message carrying a ToolInfo.
290	func buildAgentMessages(e rawEntry) []schema.Message {
291		var am assistantMessage
292		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &am); err != nil {
293			return nil
294		}
295		var parts []schema.ContentPart
296		var messages []schema.Message
297		for _, b := range am.Content {
298			switch b.Type {
299			case schema.ContentTypeText:
300				if b.Text != "" {
301					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
302				}
303			case schema.ContentTypeThinking:
304				if b.Thinking != "" {
305					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: b.Thinking})
306				}
307			case "toolCall":
308				messages = append(messages, buildToolMessage(e, b, am))
309			}
310		}
311		if len(parts) > 0 {
312			head := schema.Message{
313				ID:        e.ID,
314				Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
315				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
316				Model:     am.Model,
317				Content:   parts,
318				Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
319			}
320			return append([]schema.Message{head}, messages...)
321		}
322		if len(messages) == 0 {
323			return buildErrorMessage(e, am)
324		}
325		// Tool-call-only assistant message: carry model+usage once on the first
326		// tool message so no metadata is lost and no schema-invalid empty message
327		// is emitted.
328		messages[0].Model = am.Model
329		if messages[0].Usage == nil {
330			messages[0].Usage = mapUsage(am.Usage)
331		}
332		return messages
333	}
334	
335	// buildToolMessage builds an agent Message wrapping a ToolInfo from a toolCall.
336	// The parent assistant message's model is passed through so tool messages carry
337	// the same model metadata as text/thinking messages. The Message ID is derived
338	// from the parent entry id + the toolCall id, so multiple toolCalls in one
339	// assistant message get distinct Message IDs (downstream provenance keys use
340	// msg.ID as a deterministic component).
341	func buildToolMessage(e rawEntry, b contentBlock, am assistantMessage) schema.Message {
342		return schema.Message{
343			ID:        toolMessageID(e.ID, b.ID),
344			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
345			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
346			Model:     am.Model,
347			Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{
348				Name:  b.Name,
349				Type:  classifyToolType(b.Name),
350				UseID: b.ID,
351				Input: b.Args,
352			},
353		}
354	}
355	
356	// toolMessageID builds a unique Message ID for a tool-call message from the
357	// parent entry id and the toolCall id. This avoids duplicate Message IDs when a
358	// single assistant entry contains multiple toolCall blocks.
359	func toolMessageID(entryID, callID string) string {
360		if callID != "" {
361			return entryID + ":" + callID
362		}
363		return entryID
364	}
365	
366	// buildToolOutput constructs the ToolInfo.Output map from a toolResult's
367	// content, error flag, and optional details blob. details (e.g. exitCode) is
368	// decoded into a generic value so downstream consumers (markdown rendering,
369	// cloud) can surface structured tool metadata without re-parsing raw JSON.
370	func buildToolOutput(content string, tr toolResultMessage) map[string]any {
371		out := map[string]any{"content": content, "is_error": tr.IsError}
372		if len(tr.Details) > 0 {
373			var details any
374			if err := json.Unmarshal(tr.Details, &details); err == nil {
375				out["details"] = details
376			}
377		}
378		return out
379	}
380	
381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style
383	// cache fields (pi uses the same semantics).
384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}
494
```

```text
62	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, codexCmd string, isCustom bool, stderrOutput string) string {
63		var errorMsg strings.Builder
64	
65		switch errorType {
66		case "not_found":
67			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  🔍 Could not find Codex CLI at: %s\n\n", codexCmd)
68			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n\n")
69			if isCustom {
70				errorMsg.WriteString("     • Double-check the custom command/path you provided\n")
71				errorMsg.WriteString("     • Ensure the file exists and is executable\n")
72				errorMsg.WriteString("     • If the binary lives elsewhere, point to it with an absolute path\n")
73			} else {
74				errorMsg.WriteString("     1. Check common installation locations:\n")
75				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Homebrew: /opt/homebrew/bin/codex (installed via `brew install codex`)\n")
76				errorMsg.WriteString("        • npm: $(npm bin -g)/codex (installed via `npm install -g codex`)\n")
77				errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
78				errorMsg.WriteString("     2. If it's already installed, try:\n")
79				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Check if 'codex' is in your PATH\n")
80				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Use -c flag to specify the full path\n")
81				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Example: specstory check codex -c \"/opt/local/bin/codex\"")
82			}
83		case "permission_denied":
84			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  🔒 Permission denied when trying to run: %s\n\n", codexCmd)
85			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Try the following:\n")
86			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "     • Ensure the binary is executable: chmod +x %s\n", codexCmd)
87			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Run the command manually to confirm it works outside SpecStory\n")
88		case "no_output":
89			errorMsg.WriteString("  ⚠️  No version information from codex\n\n")
90			errorMsg.WriteString("  🤔 The command ran but produced no output\n")
91			errorMsg.WriteString("  ❓ Expected: Version information from codex\n\n")
92			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Please verify you're pointing at the Codex CLI binary:\n")
93			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running '" + codexCmd + " --version' directly\n")
94			errorMsg.WriteString("     • If you're using a wrapper script, pass the real codex binary with -c\n")
95		default:
96			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  ⚠️  Error running '%s --version'\n", codexCmd)
97			if stderrOutput != "" {
98				fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  📋 Error details: %s\n", stderrOutput)
99			}
100			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
101			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Troubleshooting tips:\n")
102			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure the Codex CLI is correctly installed\n")
103			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running 'codex --version' directly in your terminal\n")
104			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Check https://developers.openai.com/codex/quickstart for installation help\n")
105		}
106	
107		return errorMsg.String()
108	}

111	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
112		codexCmd, _ := parseCodexCommand(customCommand)
113		isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
114	
115		resolvedPath := codexCmd
116		if !filepath.IsAbs(codexCmd) {
117			if path, err := exec.LookPath(codexCmd); err == nil {
118				resolvedPath = path
119			}
120		}
121	
122		versionOutput, versionFlag, stderrOutput, err := runCodexVersionCommand(codexCmd)
123		if err != nil {
124			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
125			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
126				"provider":       "codex",
127				"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
128				"command_path":   codexCmd,
129				"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
130				"error_type":     errorType,
131				"version_flag":   versionFlag,
132				"stderr":         stderrOutput,
133				"error_message":  err.Error(),
134			})
135	
136			errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, codexCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
137	
138			return spi.CheckResult{
139				Success:      false,
140				Version:      "",
141				Location:     resolvedPath,
142				ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
143			}
144		}
145	
146		if versionOutput == "" {
147			errorType := "no_output"
148			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
149				"provider":       "codex",
150				"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
151				"command_path":   codexCmd,
152				"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
153				"error_type":     errorType,
154				"version_flag":   versionFlag,
155				"stderr":         stderrOutput,
156			})
157	
158			errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, codexCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
159	
160			return spi.CheckResult{
161				Success:      false,
162				Version:      "",
163				Location:     resolvedPath,
164				ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
165			}
166		}
167	
168		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
169			"provider":       "codex",
170			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
171			"command_path":   resolvedPath,
172			"version":        versionOutput,
173			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
174		})
175	
176		slog.Debug("Codex CLI check successful", "version", versionOutput, "location", resolvedPath, "flag", versionFlag)
177	
178		return spi.CheckResult{
179			Success:      true,
180			Version:      versionOutput,
181			Location:     resolvedPath,
182			ErrorMessage: "",
183		}
184	}

186	// DetectAgent checks if OpenAI Codex CLI has been used in the given project path.
187	func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
188		// Try to find sessions using the shared helper (stop on first match)
189		sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", true)
190	
191		// Handle different error cases with helpful output
192		if err != nil {
193			// Check if it's a home directory error
194			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
195				slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Failed to resolve user home directory", "error", err)
196				if helpOutput {
197					fmt.Println()
198					log.UserWarn("Could not scan Codex CLI sessions for this directory.\n")
199					log.UserMessage("Reason: failed to determine your home directory.\n")
200					fmt.Println()
201				}
202				return false
203			}
204	
205			// Check if it's a sessions directory error
206			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") {
207				homeDir, _ := osUserHomeDir()
208				sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
209	
210				slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Codex sessions directory not accessible", "error", err)
211				if helpOutput {
212					fmt.Println()
213					log.UserWarn("No Codex CLI sessions were found for this directory.\n")
214					log.UserMessage("Codex CLI stores activity under ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/. We couldn't find that directory.\n\n")
215					log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
216					log.UserMessage("  1. Run `specstory run codex` to launch Codex CLI in this project\n")
217					log.UserMessage("  2. Or start Codex CLI manually, then run `specstory sync codex` afterward\n\n")
218					log.UserMessage("Expected sessions directory: %s\n", sessionsRoot)
219					fmt.Println()
220				}
221				return false
222			}
223	
224			// Unknown error
225			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Error finding sessions", "error", err)
226			return false
227		}
228	
229		// Check if we found any sessions
230		if len(sessions) > 0 {
231			session := sessions[0]
232			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Codex CLI activity detected",
233				"sessionID", session.SessionID,
234				"sessionPath", session.SessionPath)
235			return true
236		}
237	
238		// No sessions found - provide helpful output
239		if helpOutput {
240			homeDir, _ := osUserHomeDir()
241			sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
242	
243			fmt.Println()
244			log.UserWarn("No Codex CLI sessions were found for this directory.\n")
245			log.UserMessage("Codex CLI hasn't saved a session with this working directory yet.\n")
246			log.UserMessage("Codex stores sessions in ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/ as JSONL files.\n\n")
247			log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
248			log.UserMessage("  1. Run `specstory run codex` to launch Codex CLI here\n")
249			log.UserMessage("  2. Or open Codex CLI manually in this project, then try syncing again\n\n")
250			log.UserMessage("Checked sessions directory: %s\n", sessionsRoot)
251			fmt.Println()
252		}
253	
254		return false
255	}

257	// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves chat sessions for the given project path.
258	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
259		// Find all sessions for this project (don't stop on first)
260		sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", false)
261		if err != nil {
262			// If sessions directory doesn't exist, return empty list (not an error)
263			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") ||
264				strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") ||
265				strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
266				return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil
267			}
268			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find codex sessions: %w", err)
269		}
270	
271		totalSessions := len(sessions)
272	
273		// Convert to AgentChatSession structs with progress reporting
274		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
275		for i, sessionInfo := range sessions {
276			session, err := processSessionToAgentChat(&sessionInfo, projectPath, debugRaw)
277			if err != nil {
278				slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: Failed to process session",
279					"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
280					"error", err)
281				// Report progress even for failed sessions
282				if progress != nil {
283					progress(i+1, totalSessions)
284				}
285				continue // Skip sessions we can't process
286			}
287	
288			// Skip empty sessions (processSessionToAgentChat returns nil for empty sessions)
289			if session == nil {
290				slog.Debug("GetAgentChatSessions: Skipping empty session",
291					"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
292				// Report progress even for empty sessions
293				if progress != nil {
294					progress(i+1, totalSessions)
295				}
296				continue
297			}
298	
299			result = append(result, *session)
300	
301			// Report progress after each session
302			if progress != nil {
303				progress(i+1, totalSessions)
304			}
305		}
306	
307		return result, nil
308	}

310	// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a chat session by ID.

312		// Find the specific session (will short-circuit when found)
313		sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, sessionID, false)

322		}

330		return processSessionToAgentChat(&sessions[0], projectPath, debugRaw)
```
