333	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single Codex session directly from its native file
334	// path, implementing spi.PathSessionReader. It skips findCodexSessions' whole-tree walk —
335	// which is what makes the by-id GetAgentChatSession O(N) per call, and a reindex of every
336	// session O(N²) — by reading session_meta from the known file and handing off to the same
337	// processSessionToAgentChat the by-id path uses. originCwd is the workspace root, matching
338	// what GetAgentChatSession passes as projectPath.
339	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath string, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
340		meta, err := loadCodexSessionMeta(nativePath)
341		if err != nil {
342			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to load codex session meta: %w", err)
343		}
344		// debugRaw is only set when a caller wants provider-specific raw dumps + RawData; reindex
345		// (the only caller) never does. Honor it via the full path so that behavior is unchanged.
346		if debugRaw {
347			info := codexSessionInfo{
348				SessionID:   strings.TrimSpace(meta.Payload.ID),
349				SessionPath: nativePath,
350				Meta:        meta,
351			}
352			return processSessionToAgentChat(&info, originCwd, debugRaw)
353		}
354		// Index fast path: read records only (skip the whole-file rawData string reindex never
355		// reads) and skip slug derivation (reindex uses the slug from enumeration). The SessionData
356		// produced here is identical to the full path's.
357		records, err := readSessionRecords(nativePath)
358		if err != nil {
359			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session data: %w", err)
360		}
361		if len(records) == 0 {
362			return nil, nil
363		}
364		sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(records, originCwd)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate SessionData: %w", err)
367		}
368		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
369			SessionID:   strings.TrimSpace(meta.Payload.ID),
370			CreatedAt:   meta.Timestamp,
371			SessionData: sessionData,
372		}, nil
373	}
374	
375	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Codex CLI in interactive mode and monitors for session updates.
376	// The function blocks until the Codex CLI exits. During execution, it watches for JSONL file changes
377	// and invokes sessionCallback for each update, enabling real-time markdown generation and cloud sync.
378	func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
379		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Starting Codex CLI execution and monitoring",
380			"projectPath", projectPath,
381			"customCommand", customCommand,
382			"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
383			"debugRaw", debugRaw)
384	
385		// Log if resuming a specific session
386		if resumeSessionID != "" {
387			slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Will resume specific Codex session", "sessionID", resumeSessionID)
388		}
389	
390		// Set up the callback which enables real-time markdown generation and cloud sync during
391		// interactive sessions. As Codex CLI writes JSONL updates, the watcher detects changes
392		// and invokes this callback, allowing immediate processing without blocking the agent's
393		// execution. The defer ensures cleanup when the agent exits.
394		SetWatcherCallback(sessionCallback)
395		defer ClearWatcherCallback()
396	
397		// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
398		SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
399	
400		// Start watching for Codex sessions in the background
401		slog.Info("Initializing Codex session monitoring...")
402	
403		if err := WatchForCodexSessions(projectPath, resumeSessionID); err != nil {
404			// Log the error but don't fail - watcher might work later
405			slog.Error("Failed to start Codex session watcher", "error", err)
406		}
407	
408		// Execute Codex CLI - this blocks until Codex exits
409		slog.Info("Executing Codex CLI", "command", customCommand, "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID)
410		err := ExecuteCodex(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
411	
412		// Stop the watcher goroutine and wait for it to finish before returning
413		slog.Info("Codex CLI has exited, stopping watcher")
414		StopWatcher()
415	
416		// Return any execution error
417		if err != nil {
418			return fmt.Errorf("codex CLI execution failed: %w", err)
419		}
420	
421		return nil
422	}
423	
424	// WatchAgent watches for Codex CLI agent activity and calls the callback with AgentChatSession
425	// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for existing activity
426	// Runs until error or context cancellation (blocks indefinitely)
427	func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
428		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Starting Codex CLI activity monitoring",
429			"projectPath", projectPath,
430			"debugRaw", debugRaw)
431	
432		// The watcher callback directly passes AgentChatSession (which now contains SessionData)
433		wrappedCallback := func(agentChatSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
434			slog.Debug("WatchAgent: Received AgentChatSession",
435				"sessionID", agentChatSession.SessionID,
436				"hasSessionData", agentChatSession.SessionData != nil)
437	
438			// Call the user's callback with the AgentChatSession
439			sessionCallback(agentChatSession)
440		}
441	
442		// Set up the callback for the watcher
443		SetWatcherCallback(wrappedCallback)
444		defer ClearWatcherCallback()
445	
446		// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
447		SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
448	
449		// Start watching for Codex sessions in the background
450		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Initializing Codex session monitoring...")
451	
452		if err := WatchForCodexSessions(projectPath, ""); err != nil {
453			slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to start Codex session watcher", "error", err)
454			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start watcher: %w", err)
455		}
456	
457		// Block until context is cancelled
458		// The watcher runs in a background goroutine and will continue
459		// until context is cancelled or the process exits
460		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Watcher started, blocking until context cancelled")
461	
462		// Wait for context cancellation
463		<-ctx.Done()
464	
465		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
466		StopWatcher()
467	
468		return ctx.Err()
469	}
470	
471	// findCodexSessions traverses the Codex CLI sessions directory structure and finds
472	// sessions that match the given project path.
473	//
474	// Short-circuit behavior:
475	//   - If targetSessionID is provided: stops when that specific session is found (ignores stopOnFirst)
476	//   - If targetSessionID is empty and stopOnFirst is true: stops after finding first matching session
477	//   - If targetSessionID is empty and stopOnFirst is false: returns all matching sessions
478	func findCodexSessions(projectPath string, targetSessionID string, stopOnFirst bool) ([]codexSessionInfo, error) {
479		normalizedProjectPath := normalizeCodexPath(projectPath)
480		if normalizedProjectPath == "" {
481			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Unable to normalize project path", "projectPath", projectPath)
482		}
483	
484		homeDir, err := osUserHomeDir()
485		if err != nil {
486			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to resolve user home directory", "error", err)
487			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to determine home directory: %w", err)
488		}
489	
490		sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
491		rootInfo, err := os.Stat(sessionsRoot)
492		if err != nil {
493			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
494				slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex sessions directory not found", "path", sessionsRoot)
495			} else {
496				slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to stat Codex sessions directory", "path", sessionsRoot, "error", err)
497			}
498			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions directory not accessible: %w", err)
499		}
500	
501		if !rootInfo.IsDir() {
502			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex sessions root is not a directory", "path", sessionsRoot)
503			return nil, fmt.Errorf("sessions root is not a directory: %s", sessionsRoot)
504		}
505	
506		yearEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(sessionsRoot)
507		if err != nil {
508			slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex sessions root", "path", sessionsRoot, "error", err)
509			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read sessions root: %w", err)
510		}
511	
512		var sessions []codexSessionInfo
513	
514		// Traverse year/month/day directory structure
515		for _, yearEntry := range yearEntries {
516			if !yearEntry.IsDir() {
517				continue
518			}
519	
520			yearPath := filepath.Join(sessionsRoot, yearEntry.Name())
521			monthEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(yearPath)
522			if err != nil {
523				slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex year directory", "path", yearPath, "error", err)
524				continue
525			}
526	
527			for _, monthEntry := range monthEntries {
528				if !monthEntry.IsDir() {
529					continue
530				}
531	
532				monthPath := filepath.Join(yearPath, monthEntry.Name())
533				dayEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(monthPath)
534				if err != nil {
535					slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex month directory", "path", monthPath, "error", err)
536					continue
537				}
538	
539				for _, dayEntry := range dayEntries {
540					if !dayEntry.IsDir() {
541						continue
542					}
543	
544					dayPath := filepath.Join(monthPath, dayEntry.Name())
545					sessionEntries, err := readDirSortedDesc(dayPath)
546					if err != nil {
547						slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to read Codex day directory", "path", dayPath, "error", err)
548						continue
549					}
550	
551					for _, sessionEntry := range sessionEntries {
552						if sessionEntry.IsDir() {
553							continue
554						}
555						if filepath.Ext(sessionEntry.Name()) != ".jsonl" {
556							continue
557						}
558	
559						sessionPath := filepath.Join(dayPath, sessionEntry.Name())
560						meta, err := loadCodexSessionMeta(sessionPath)
561						if err != nil {
562							slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Failed to load Codex session meta", "path", sessionPath, "error", err)
563							continue
564						}
565	
566						sessionID := strings.TrimSpace(meta.Payload.ID)
567						normalizedCWD := normalizeCodexPath(meta.Payload.CWD)
568						if normalizedCWD == "" {
569							slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Session meta missing cwd", "sessionID", sessionID, "path", sessionPath)
570							continue
571						}
572	
573						// Check if this session matches the project path
574						matched := false
575						if normalizedProjectPath != "" {
576							if normalizedCWD == normalizedProjectPath || strings.EqualFold(normalizedCWD, normalizedProjectPath) {
577								matched = true
578							}
579						} else if normalizedCWD == projectPath || strings.EqualFold(normalizedCWD, projectPath) {
580							matched = true
581						}
582	
583						if matched {
584							// If we're searching for a specific session, skip sessions that don't match
585							if targetSessionID != "" && sessionID != targetSessionID {
586								continue
587							}
588	
589							slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Codex CLI session matched project",
590								"sessionID", sessionID,
591								"sessionPath", sessionPath)
592	
593							sessions = append(sessions, codexSessionInfo{
594								SessionID:   sessionID,
595								SessionPath: sessionPath,
596								Meta:        meta,
597							})
598	
599							// Short-circuit logic:
600							// 1. If we have a target sessionID and this matches, we're done
601							if targetSessionID != "" && sessionID == targetSessionID {
602								slog.Debug("findCodexSessions: Found target session, stopping search", "sessionID", targetSessionID)
603								return sessions, nil
604							}
605	
606							// 2. If stopOnFirst is true (and no target sessionID), return first match
607							if targetSessionID == "" && stopOnFirst {
608								return sessions, nil
609							}
610	
611							// 3. Otherwise, continue collecting all matching sessions
612						}
613					}
614				}
615			}
616		}
617	
618		return sessions, nil
619	}
620	
621	// readSessionRawData reads all JSONL records and the raw JSONL content from a Codex session.
622	func readSessionRawData(sessionPath string) ([]map[string]interface{}, string, error) {
623		return readCodexJSONL(sessionPath, true)
624	}
625	
626	// readSessionRecords reads only the parsed JSONL records, skipping construction of the raw
627	// JSONL string. reindex parses on this path: the raw content (up to the full file size — some
628	// Codex sessions are hundreds of MB) is never read when indexing, so building it is pure waste.
629	func readSessionRecords(sessionPath string) ([]map[string]interface{}, error) {
630		records, _, err := readCodexJSONL(sessionPath, false)
631		return records, err
632	}
633	
634	// readCodexJSONL reads a Codex session's JSONL records, and — when collectRaw is true — the raw
635	// JSONL content as one string. Callers that only need records pass collectRaw=false to skip the
636	// whole-file string builder.
637	func readCodexJSONL(sessionPath string, collectRaw bool) ([]map[string]interface{}, string, error) {
638		file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
639		if err != nil {
640			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
641		}
642		defer func() {
643			_ = file.Close()
644		}()
645	
646		var records []map[string]interface{}
647		var rawBuilder strings.Builder
648	
649		// Use bufio.Reader instead of Scanner to handle arbitrarily large lines
650		// Scanner has a token size limit (even with custom buffer), but Reader does not
651		reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
652	
653		lineNumber := 0
654		for {
655			// Read line using ReadString which has no size limit
656			line, err := reader.ReadString('\n')
657			line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
658	
659			// EOF is expected at end of file, other errors are genuine failures
660			if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
661				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("error reading line %d: %w", lineNumber+1, err)
662			}
663	
664			// Determine if we're at end of file and if we have content to process
665			atEOF := err == io.EOF
666			hasContent := len(line) > 0
667	
668			// Increment line number for every line read (including empty lines) to match text editor line numbers
669			if hasContent || !atEOF {
670				lineNumber++
671			}
672	
673			// If no content, either skip empty line or exit at EOF
674			if !hasContent {
675				if atEOF {
676					break // Reached end of file with no content
677				}
678				continue // Empty line in middle of file, skip it
679			}
680	
681			// Sanity check to prevent OOM from pathological files
682			if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
683				slog.Warn("line exceeds reasonable size limit",
684					"lineNumber", lineNumber,
685					"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
686					"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB,
687					"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath))
688				return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("line %d exceeds reasonable size limit (%d MB): refusing to process potentially malformed file",
689					lineNumber, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
690			}
691	
692			// Log when processing unusually large lines (helps debug performance issues)
693			if len(line) > 10*MB {
694				slog.Debug("processing large JSONL line",
695					"lineNumber", lineNumber,
696					"sizeMB", len(line)/MB,
697					"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath))
698			}
699	
700			// Trim whitespace and skip empty lines
701			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
702			if line == "" {
703				if atEOF {
704					break
705				}
706				continue
707			}
708	
709			// Accumulate raw JSONL only when the caller asked for it (reindex does not).
710			if collectRaw {
711				rawBuilder.WriteString(line)
712				rawBuilder.WriteString("\n")
713			}
714	
715			// Parse JSON
716			var record map[string]interface{}
717			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); err != nil {
718				// Log warning and skip corrupted lines rather than failing entire parse
719				slog.Warn("Skipping corrupted JSONL line",
720					"file", filepath.Base(sessionPath),
721					"line", lineNumber,
722					"error", err)
723				if atEOF {
724					break
725				}
726				continue
727			}
728	
729			records = append(records, record)
730	
731			// After processing record, check if we're done
732			if atEOF {
733				break
734			}
735		}
736	
737		return records, rawBuilder.String(), nil
738	}
739	
740	// loadCodexSessionMeta reads the first JSON line from a session file and parses the session metadata.
741	func loadCodexSessionMeta(sessionPath string) (*codexSessionMeta, error) {
742		file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
743		if err != nil {
744			return nil, err
745		}
746		defer func() {
747			_ = file.Close()
748		}()
749	
750		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
751		if !scanner.Scan() {
752			if scanErr := scanner.Err(); scanErr != nil {
753				return nil, scanErr
754			}
755			return nil, errors.New("codex session meta not found")
756		}
757	
758		line := strings.TrimSpace(scanner.Text())
759		if line == "" {
760			return nil, errors.New("codex session meta is empty")
761		}
762	
763		var meta codexSessionMeta
764		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &meta); err != nil {
765			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse codex session meta: %w", err)
766		}
767	
768		if meta.Type != "session_meta" {
769			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected codex session record type: %s", meta.Type)
770		}
771	
772		return &meta, nil
773	}
774	
775	// processSessionToAgentChat converts a codexSessionInfo into an AgentChatSession by reading
776	// the session data, generating SessionData, and optionally writing debug files. Returns nil if
777	// the session is empty or cannot be read.
778	func processSessionToAgentChat(sessionInfo *codexSessionInfo, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
779		// Read the session data
780		records, rawData, err := readSessionRawData(sessionInfo.SessionPath)
781		if err != nil {
782			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session data: %w", err)
783		}
784	
785		// Skip empty sessions
786		if len(records) == 0 {
787			return nil, nil
788		}
789	
790		// Get timestamp from metadata
791		timestamp := sessionInfo.Meta.Timestamp
792	
793		// Generate slug from first user message
794		firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(records)
795		slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
796		if slug == "" {
797			slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: No user message for slug yet",
798				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
799		} else {
800			slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Generated slug from user message",
801				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
802				"slug", slug)
803		}
804	
805		// Generate SessionData from records
806		sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(records, workspaceRoot)
807		if err != nil {
808			slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", sessionInfo.SessionID, "error", err)
809			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate SessionData: %w", err)
810		}
811	
812		// Write provider-specific debug files if requested
813		if debugRaw {
814			if err := writeDebugRawFiles(sessionInfo.SessionID, records); err != nil {
815				slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Failed to write debug files",
816					"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
817					"error", err)
818				// Don't fail the operation if debug output fails
819			}
820		}
821	
822		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
823			SessionID:   sessionInfo.SessionID,
824			CreatedAt:   timestamp,
825			Slug:        slug,
826			SessionData: sessionData,
827			RawData:     rawData,
828		}, nil
829	}
830	
831	// writeDebugRawFiles writes debug JSON files for a Codex CLI session.
832	// Each record is written as a numbered JSON file in .specstory/debug/<session-id>/
833	func writeDebugRawFiles(sessionID string, records []map[string]interface{}) error {
834		// Get the debug directory path
835		debugDir := spi.GetDebugDir(sessionID)
836	
837		// Create the debug directory
838		if err := os.MkdirAll(debugDir, 0755); err != nil {
839			return fmt.Errorf("failed to create debug directory: %w", err)
840		}
841	
842		// Write each record as a pretty-printed JSON file
843		for index, record := range records {
844			// Create filename with 1-based index for readability
845			filename := fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", index+1)
846			debugPath := filepath.Join(debugDir, filename)
847	
848			// Pretty print the record
849			prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(record, "", "  ")
850			if err != nil {
851				slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to marshal record to JSON",
852					"index", index,
853					"error", err)
854				continue
855			}
856	
857			// Write the file
858			if err := os.WriteFile(debugPath, prettyJSON, 0644); err != nil {
859				slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to write debug file",
860					"path", debugPath,
861					"error", err)
862				continue
863			}
864	
865			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Wrote debug file",
866				"path", debugPath,
867				"index", index)
868		}
869	
870		return nil
871	}
872	
873	// findFirstUserMessage extracts the first user message from Codex CLI session records.
874	// Returns empty string if no user message is found.
875	func findFirstUserMessage(records []map[string]interface{}) string {
876		for _, record := range records {
877			// Get record type
878			recordType, ok := record["type"].(string)
879			if !ok || recordType != "event_msg" {
880				continue
881			}
882	
883			// Get payload
884			payload, ok := record["payload"].(map[string]interface{})
885			if !ok {
886				continue
887			}
888	
889			// Check if this is a user message
890			payloadType, ok := payload["type"].(string)
891			if !ok || payloadType != "user_message" {
892				continue
893			}
894	
895			// Extract the message content
896			message, ok := payload["message"].(string)
897			if !ok || message == "" {
898				continue
899			}
900	
901			// Found the first user message
902			slog.Debug("findFirstUserMessage: Found first user message",
903				"message", message[:min(len(message), 100)])
904			return message
905		}
906	
907		slog.Debug("findFirstUserMessage: No user message found in session")
908		return ""
909	}
910	
911	// ListAgentChatSessions retrieves lightweight session metadata without full parsing
912	// This is much faster than GetAgentChatSessions as it only reads minimal data from each session
913	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
914		// Find all sessions for this project (don't stop on first)
915		sessions, err := findCodexSessions(projectPath, "", false)
916		if err != nil {
917			// If sessions directory doesn't exist, return empty list (not an error)
918			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions directory not accessible") ||
919				strings.Contains(err.Error(), "sessions root") ||
920				strings.Contains(err.Error(), "home directory") {
921				return []spi.SessionMetadata{}, nil
922			}
923			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to find codex sessions: %w", err)
924		}
925	
926		// Extract metadata from each session
927		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(sessions))
928		for _, sessionInfo := range sessions {
929			metadata, err := extractCodexSessionMetadata(&sessionInfo)
930			if err != nil {
931				slog.Warn("Failed to extract session metadata",
932					"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
933					"path", sessionInfo.SessionPath,
934					"error", err)
935				continue
936			}
937	
938			// Skip empty sessions (no metadata means empty session)
939			if metadata == nil {
940				slog.Debug("Skipping empty session", "sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
941				continue
942			}
943	
944			result = append(result, *metadata)
945		}
946	
947		return result, nil
948	}
949	
950	// extractCodexSessionMetadata reads minimal data from a Codex CLI session to extract metadata
951	// Returns nil if the session is empty or has no user messages
952	func extractCodexSessionMetadata(sessionInfo *codexSessionInfo) (*spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
953		file, err := os.Open(sessionInfo.SessionPath)
954		if err != nil {
955			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
956		}
957		defer func() {
958			_ = file.Close()
959		}()
960	
961		reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
962		var firstUserMessage string
963		lineNum := 0
964	
965		// Read records until we find a user message or reach EOF.
966		// Why: ReadString can return data AND io.EOF on the last line (no trailing newline),
967		// so we always process the line first, then check for EOF once at the bottom.
968		for {
969			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
970			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
971				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read line: %w", readErr)
972			}
973	
974			lineNum++
975			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
976	
977			if line != "" {
978				// Parse JSON record
979				var record map[string]interface{}
980				if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); jsonErr != nil {
981					slog.Warn("Skipping malformed JSONL line",
982						"file", filepath.Base(sessionInfo.SessionPath),
983						"line", lineNum,
984						"error", jsonErr)
985				} else if recordType, ok := record["type"].(string); ok && recordType == "event_msg" {
986					if payload, ok := record["payload"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
987						if payloadType, ok := payload["type"].(string); ok && payloadType == "user_message" {
988							if message, ok := payload["message"].(string); ok && message != "" {
989								firstUserMessage = message
990							}
991						}
992					}
993				}
994			}
995	
996			// Single exit: found what we need, or reached end of file
997			if firstUserMessage != "" || readErr == io.EOF {
998				break
999			}
1000		}
1001	
1002		// If no user message found, session is empty
1003		if firstUserMessage == "" {
1004			return nil, nil
1005		}
1006	
1007		// Generate slug from first user message
1008		slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
1009	
1010		// Generate human-readable name from first user message
1011		name := spi.GenerateReadableName(firstUserMessage)
1012	
1013		return &spi.SessionMetadata{
1014			SessionID: sessionInfo.SessionID,
1015			CreatedAt: sessionInfo.Meta.Timestamp,
1016			Slug:      slug,
1017			Name:      name,
1018		}, nil
1019	}
1020	
1021	// codexSessionHeader is the minimal metadata enumeration needs from a session file: the
1022	// session_meta fields plus the first user message (for slug/name), produced in a SINGLE pass.
1023	type codexSessionHeader struct {
1024		sessionID        string
1025		cwd              string
1026		createdAt        string
1027		firstUserMessage string
1028	}
1029	
1030	// userMessageMarker is the cheap substring screen for a Codex user_message record. Every real
1031	// user_message record contains it (it is the payload "type" value), so screening on it before a
1032	// full JSON parse never misses one; a rare false positive (the literal text inside an injected
1033	// context record) just costs one extra parse that codexUserMessageText then rejects.
1034	const userMessageMarker = `"user_message"`
1035	
1036	// scanCodexSessionHeader reads a Codex session file ONCE and extracts the session_meta
1037	// (id/cwd/timestamp from line 1) and the first user message. It deliberately avoids fully
1038	// parsing the large injected-context records (environment, instructions, AGENTS.md — often MB
1039	// each) that precede the first user message: each line is first cheaply screened for the
1040	// user_message marker, and only a candidate line is JSON-decoded. The result is identical to the
1041	// prior loadCodexSessionMeta + extractCodexSessionMetadata pair, in one pass instead of two opens.
1042	// Returns (nil, nil) for a session with no user message — treated as empty, as before.
1043	func scanCodexSessionHeader(sessionPath string) (*codexSessionHeader, error) {
1044		file, err := os.Open(sessionPath)
1045		if err != nil {
1046			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
1047		}
1048		defer func() { _ = file.Close() }()
1049	
1050		reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
1051		h := &codexSessionHeader{}
1052		lineNum := 0
1053		for {
1054			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
1055			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
1056				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read line: %w", readErr)
1057			}
1058			lineNum++
1059	
1060			// Skip a pathological/oversized line, for parity with readCodexJSONL's
1061			// maxReasonableLineSize cap (this parallel scan must not be the weaker path). Such a
1062			// line cannot be the small user_message we seek; line 1 has its own tighter limit below.
1063			if len(line) > maxReasonableLineSize {
1064				if readErr == io.EOF {
1065					break
1066				}
1067				continue
1068			}
1069	
1070			if lineNum == 1 {
1071				// Line 1 is session_meta. Keep loadCodexSessionMeta's 64 KB first-line limit so
1072				// the set of indexed sessions is unchanged from the Scanner-based path.
1073				trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
1074				if trimmed != "" {
1075					if len(trimmed) > bufio.MaxScanTokenSize {
1076						return nil, errors.New("codex session meta exceeds line limit")
1077					}
1078					var meta codexSessionMeta
1079					if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(trimmed), &meta); err != nil {
1080						return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse codex session meta: %w", err)
1081					}
1082					if meta.Type != "session_meta" {
1083						return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected codex session record type: %s", meta.Type)
1084					}
1085					h.sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(meta.Payload.ID)
1086					h.cwd = meta.Payload.CWD
1087					h.createdAt = meta.Timestamp
1088				}
1089			} else if strings.Contains(line, userMessageMarker) {
1090				// Cheap screen passed: only now pay for a full parse. The big context records before
1091				// the first user message lack the marker and are skipped without a parse. The marker
1092				// is interior JSON, so the screen runs on the RAW line — no TrimSpace copy of a
1093				// possibly multi-MB context record; only a real match (a small line) is parsed.
1094				if msg := codexUserMessageText(strings.TrimSpace(line)); msg != "" {
1095					h.firstUserMessage = msg
1096					break
1097				}
1098			}
1099	
1100			if readErr == io.EOF {
1101				break
1102			}
1103		}
1104	
1105		if h.sessionID == "" {
1106			return nil, errors.New("codex session meta not found")
1107		}
1108		if h.firstUserMessage == "" {
1109			return nil, nil // no user message → empty session, excluded from enumeration
1110		}
1111		return h, nil
1112	}
1113	
1114	// codexUserMessageText returns the message text when line is an event_msg user_message with a
1115	// non-empty message, else "". It is only called for lines that passed the userMessageMarker
1116	// screen, and applies the same structural checks extractCodexSessionMetadata used.
1117	func codexUserMessageText(line string) string {
1118		var record map[string]interface{}
1119		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); err != nil {
1120			return ""
1121		}
1122		if recordType, _ := record["type"].(string); recordType != "event_msg" {
1123			return ""
1124		}
1125		payload, ok := record["payload"].(map[string]interface{})
1126		if !ok {
1127			return ""
1128		}
1129		if payloadType, _ := payload["type"].(string); payloadType != "user_message" {
1130			return ""
1131		}
1132		message, _ := payload["message"].(string)
1133		return message
1134	}
1135	
1136	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every Codex CLI session across all projects. It is the
1137	// no-progress form of ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress.
1138	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
1139		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
1140	}
1141	
1142	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates every Codex CLI session across all projects by
1143	// walking ~/.codex/sessions for *.jsonl rollouts (Codex sessions are not project-keyed by
1144	// directory; the originating cwd lives in the session_meta record), reporting scan progress into r
1145	// (nil-safe). The per-file header read is the dominant cost of `specstory reindex` (parsing each
1146	// file's injected context), so headers are scanned in parallel across CPUs; output order is
1147	// irrelevant (reindex dedups and sorts later). Implements spi.ProgressEnumerator. See
1148	// docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
1149	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
1150		homeDir, err := osUserHomeDir()
1151		if err != nil {
1152			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to determine home directory: %w", err)
1153		}
1154		sessionsRoot := codexSessionsRoot(homeDir)
1155		if _, err := os.Stat(sessionsRoot); err != nil {
1156			// No sessions directory yet → nothing to enumerate (not an error).
1157			return []spi.GlobalSessionRef{}, nil
1158		}
1159	
1160		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(sessionsRoot, "codex", r, func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
1161			h, err := scanCodexSessionHeader(path)
1162			if err != nil {
1163				return nil, err
1164			}
1165			if h == nil {
1166				return nil, nil // empty session (no user message)
1167			}
1168			return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
1169				SessionID:  h.sessionID,
1170				CreatedAt:  h.createdAt,
1171				Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(h.firstUserMessage),
1172				Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(h.firstUserMessage),
1173				NativePath: path,
1174				OriginCwd:  h.cwd,
1175			}, nil
1176		})
1177	}

1	package spi
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"log/slog"
6		"os"

8		"runtime"

12	
13	// GlobalSessionRef is a lightweight, project-discovering reference to a single
14	// native session, returned by Provider.ListAllAgentChatSessions.
15	//
16	// Unlike the project-scoped ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath), the project is NOT
17	// an input here: each ref carries the originating working directory (read from inside
18	// the session) so the caller — the `specstory reindex` command — can resolve project
19	// identity with utils.ComputeProjectID. The project is discovered, not supplied.
20	//
21	// It is intentionally metadata-only (no full SessionData parse); reindex re-fetches
22	// full data per ref via GetAgentChatSession(OriginCwd, SessionID) when it needs the
23	// conversation body. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
24	type GlobalSessionRef struct {
25		SessionID  string // native session id (uuid)
26		CreatedAt  string // ISO 8601 creation timestamp (first turn), may be empty
27		Slug       string // filename-safe slug derived from the first user message
28		Name       string // human-readable description (may be empty)
29		NativePath string // absolute path the provider opens to read this session
30		OriginCwd  string // working directory the session was launched from (-> project_id)
31	}
32	
33	// PathSessionReader is an OPTIONAL capability a Provider may implement: parse a single
34	// session directly from its already-known native file path, skipping the by-id discovery
35	// search that GetAgentChatSession performs.
36	//
37	// Why: some providers locate a session by scanning their native store. Codex's by-id
38	// lookup walks the entire ~/.codex/sessions tree on every call, so resolving N sessions
39	// that way is O(N²). reindex already holds each session's exact file path
40	// (GlobalSessionRef.NativePath) from enumeration, so a path-keyed parse turns that back
41	// into O(N). reindex prefers this when a provider implements it and the ref carries a
42	// NativePath, and falls back to GetAgentChatSession otherwise.
43	//
44	// originCwd is the session's originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd),
45	// passed through as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
46	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath.
47	type PathSessionReader interface {
48		GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath string, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*AgentChatSession, error)
49	}
50	
51	// ScanReporter accumulates a provider's enumeration progress (sessions found) so the CLI can
52	// render a live "scanning" display. It is safe for concurrent use and safe to call on a nil
53	// receiver (a no-op), so providers can report unconditionally.
54	type ScanReporter struct {
55		found atomic.Int64
56	}
57	
58	// Add records that n more sessions have been found. Files that yield no session (warmup-only or
59	// sidechain-only transcripts) are deliberately not counted, so the running total reflects real
60	// sessions rather than raw files.
61	func (r *ScanReporter) Add(n int) {
62		if r != nil {
63			r.found.Add(int64(n))
64		}
65	}
66	
67	// Found returns the number of sessions found so far.
68	func (r *ScanReporter) Found() int64 {
69		if r == nil {
70			return 0
71		}
72		return r.found.Load()
73	}
74	
75	// ProgressEnumerator is an OPTIONAL Provider capability: enumerate all sessions while reporting
76	// scan progress into r (which may be nil — ScanReporter is nil-safe, so report unconditionally).
77	// Providers that don't implement it are enumerated via ListAllAgentChatSessions with no live
78	// feedback. reindex uses this to render a per-agent "Scanning agents…" display.
79	type ProgressEnumerator interface {
80		ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *ScanReporter) ([]GlobalSessionRef, error)
81	}
82	
83	// ScanSessionsInParallel walks root for *.jsonl session files and scans each one concurrently
84	// with scan, returning the collected refs. It is the shared engine behind each provider's
85	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress: providers differ only in where their sessions live (root)
86	// and how a single file's header maps to a GlobalSessionRef (scan).
87	//
88	// scan returns (ref, nil) to include a session, (nil, nil) to skip a non-session file
89	// (warmup-only / empty / sidechain-only), or (nil, err) to log-and-skip a malformed file.
90	// Files are independent and the per-file read+parse is CPU-bound, so scanning fans out across
91	// CPUs; output order is unspecified (reindex dedups and sorts later). r counts sessions found
92	// (not files scanned) and is nil-safe. label names the provider in scan-failure logs.
93	func ScanSessionsInParallel(root, label string, r *ScanReporter, scan func(path string) (*GlobalSessionRef, error)) ([]GlobalSessionRef, error) {
94		// Phase 1: collect file paths (dirents only — no opens).
95		var paths []string
96		walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
97			if err != nil {
98				return nil // skip unreadable entries rather than abort the whole sweep
99			}
100			if d.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(path) != ".jsonl" {
101				return nil
102			}
103			paths = append(paths, path)
104			return nil
105		})
106		if walkErr != nil {
107			return nil, fmt.Errorf("walking %s sessions: %w", label, walkErr)
108		}
109	
110		// Phase 2: scan headers in parallel. min(NumCPU, 12) is always ≥ 1, so no lower-bound guard.
111		workers := min(runtime.NumCPU(), 12)
112		pathCh := make(chan string, workers)
113		refs := make([]GlobalSessionRef, 0, len(paths))
114		var mu sync.Mutex
115		var wg sync.WaitGroup
116		for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
117			wg.Add(1)
118			go func() {
119				defer wg.Done()
120				for path := range pathCh {
121					ref, scanErr := safeScan(scan, path)
122					if scanErr != nil {
123						slog.Warn("reindex: failed to scan session", "agent", label, "path", path, "error", scanErr)
124						continue
125					}
126					if ref == nil {
127						continue // not a session (warmup / empty / sidechain)
128					}
129					mu.Lock()
130					refs = append(refs, *ref)
131					mu.Unlock()
132					r.Add(1) // count sessions found, not files scanned
133				}
134			}()
135		}
136		for _, path := range paths {
137			pathCh <- path
138		}
139		close(pathCh)
140		wg.Wait()
141		return refs, nil
142	}
143	
144	// safeScan runs scan(path), converting a panic into an error so one malformed session file is
145	// logged and skipped (via the caller's normal error path) rather than crashing the whole sweep.
146	func safeScan(scan func(string) (*GlobalSessionRef, error), path string) (ref *GlobalSessionRef, err error) {
147		defer func() {
148			if r := recover(); r != nil {
149				ref, err = nil, fmt.Errorf("panic scanning session: %v", r)
150			}
151		}()
152		return scan(path)
153	}

49	// CreateReindexCommand builds the `specstory reindex` command: a full, from-scratch
50	// rebuild of the restore index (~/.specstory/sessions.db) of every coding-agent session
51	// SpecStory can find, across all projects and providers. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
52	func CreateReindexCommand() *cobra.Command {
53		cmd := &cobra.Command{
54			Use:   "reindex",
55			Short: "Rebuild the restore index of all known agent sessions",
56			Long: `Rebuild the restore index used by 'specstory resume'.
57	
58	'reindex' enumerates every session across all installed agents and projects and writes a
59	searchable index to ~/.specstory/sessions.db. It is incremental: a session whose native
60	file is unchanged since it was last indexed is skipped, so re-runs are fast. Use --force to
61	re-index everything regardless. The index is a derived cache: it is safe to delete.`,
62			Args: cobra.NoArgs,
63			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
64				force, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("force")
65				return runReindex(force)
66			},
67		}
68		cmd.Flags().Bool("force", false, "re-index every session even if unchanged")
69		return cmd

72	// reindexItem is one unit of work: a session to parse and index. size/mtime are the

74	type reindexItem struct {

83	func runReindex(force bool) error {

86		// Graceful Ctrl+C: stop feeding work, flush what's written, exit cleanly.

88		defer cancel()

99	
100		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
101	
102		// ---- Phase 1: enumerate every provider concurrently, then dedup ----
103		ids, provs, perProvider := enumerateAll(registry, true)
104	
105		// Existing fingerprints, so unchanged sessions can be skipped (the incremental path).
106		fingerprints := map[string]sessionindex.Fingerprint{}
107		if !force {
108			if fps, err := store.Fingerprints(); err != nil {
109				slog.Warn("reindex: could not load fingerprints, re-indexing all", "error", err)
110			} else {

112			}
113		}
114	
115		best, order, foundPerAgent := dedupRefs(ids, provs, perProvider)
116		found := len(order)
117		cache := &projectIDCache{m: map[string]projectIDName{}}
118		work, totals, unchanged := selectWork(order, best, fingerprints, "", force, cache)
119	
120		if found == 0 {
121			fprintln(os.Stderr, "No agent sessions found to index.")
122			return nil
123		}
124		fprintf(os.Stderr, "✓   Found %d sessions  ·  %s\n", found, summarizeCounts(ids, foundPerAgent))
125		if len(work) == 0 {

127			return nil
128		}
129		if unchanged > 0 {

131		} else {
132			fprintln(os.Stderr, "")
133		}

135		// ---- Phase 2+3: parse (worker pool) → write (single goroutine), with live progress ----
136		prog := newReindexProgress(ids, totals)
137		prog.begin()
138		indexedAt := start.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
139		writeErr := processWork(ctx, store, work, cache, indexedAt, min(runtime.NumCPU(), 12), prog)
140		prog.end()

142		if writeErr != nil {
143			return fmt.Errorf("writing restore index: %w", writeErr)
144		}

146		// ---- Summary (counts reflect the WHOLE index, not just this run's work) ----
147		elapsed := time.Since(start)
148		projects, _ := store.ProjectCount(unknownProjectID)
149		unattributed, _ := store.UnattributedCount(unknownProjectID)
150		printReindexSummary(ids, foundPerAgent, dbPath, elapsed, prog.totalDone(), unchanged, projects, unattributed)
151		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventReindexCompleted, analytics.Properties{
152			"sessions":     len(work),
153			"unchanged":    unchanged,

161	// ---- reindex engine (shared by the foreground command and the background warm) ----
162	
163	// enumerateAll concurrently lists every installed provider's sessions. The returned slices
164	// are index-aligned: provs[i]/perProvider[i] correspond to ids[i] (a nil provs[i] marks a
165	// provider that failed to load). When visible, it renders a live "Scanning agents…" line
166	// (foreground reindex); the background warm passes visible=false and stays silent.
167	func enumerateAll(registry *factory.Registry, visible bool) (ids []string, provs []spi.Provider, perProvider [][]spi.GlobalSessionRef) {
168		ids = registry.ListIDs()
169		perProvider = make([][]spi.GlobalSessionRef, len(ids))
170		provs = make([]spi.Provider, len(ids))
171	
172		var scan *scanProgress
173		if visible {
174			scan = newScanProgress(ids)
175			scan.begin()
176			defer scan.end()
177		}
178	
179		var ewg sync.WaitGroup
180		for i, id := range ids {
181			prov, err := registry.Get(id)
182			if err != nil {
183				continue
184			}
185			provs[i] = prov
186			reporter := scan.reporterFor(id)
187			ewg.Add(1)
188			go func(i int, id string, prov spi.Provider, reporter *spi.ScanReporter) {
189				defer ewg.Done()
190				refs := enumerateOne(id, prov, reporter)
191				perProvider[i] = refs
192				scan.markDone(id, len(refs))
193			}(i, id, prov, reporter)
194		}
195		ewg.Wait()
196		return ids, provs, perProvider
197	}

199	// enumerateOne enumerates a single provider's sessions, preferring the progress-reporting path
200	// (Codex, the long pole, ticks the live line; the rest snap to their final count via markDone).
201	// A panic in a provider's enumeration (e.g. a malformed session tree) is recovered and logged so
202	// one bad provider degrades to "no sessions" rather than crashing the entire reindex/warm sweep.
203	func enumerateOne(id string, prov spi.Provider, reporter *spi.ScanReporter) (refs []spi.GlobalSessionRef) {
204		defer func() {
205			if r := recover(); r != nil {
206				slog.Error("reindex: provider enumeration panicked", "provider", id, "panic", r)
207				refs = nil
208			}
209		}()
210		var err error
211		if pe, ok := prov.(spi.ProgressEnumerator); ok {
212			refs, err = pe.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(reporter)
213		} else {
214			refs, err = prov.ListAllAgentChatSessions()
215		}
216		if err != nil {
217			slog.Warn("reindex: enumeration failed", "provider", id, "error", err)
218		}
219		return refs
220	}
221	
222	// dedupRefs collapses enumerated refs by (agent, session_id), keeping the freshest file. A
223	// resumed session can span MULTIPLE native files sharing one id; they all map to one
224	// (agent, session_id) row, so without dedup the duplicates ping-pong — each run, one file's
225	// stat never matches the fingerprint the other file just stored, re-indexing both forever.
226	// Keeping the freshest by mtime makes the fingerprint stable. Sessions with no native id are
227	// dropped (unresumable, and would collide on the PK). order is first-seen order (deterministic
228	// processing); foundPerAgent is the distinct-session count per agent (for the "Found" line).
229	func dedupRefs(ids []string, provs []spi.Provider, perProvider [][]spi.GlobalSessionRef) (best map[string]reindexItem, order []string, foundPerAgent map[string]int) {
230		best = map[string]reindexItem{}
231		foundPerAgent = map[string]int{}
232		for i, id := range ids {
233			if provs[i] == nil {
234				continue
235			}
236			for _, ref := range perProvider[i] {
237				if strings.TrimSpace(ref.SessionID) == "" {
238					slog.Debug("reindex: skipping session with no id", "agent", id, "path", ref.NativePath)
239					continue
240				}
241				size, mtime := statNative(ref.NativePath)
242				item := reindexItem{agent: id, prov: provs[i], ref: ref, size: size, mtime: mtime}
243				key := sessionindex.FingerprintKey(id, ref.SessionID)
244				if cur, ok := best[key]; ok {
245					if mtime > cur.mtime {
246						best[key] = item
247					}
248					continue
249				}
250				best[key] = item
251				order = append(order, key)
252			}
253		}
254		for _, key := range order {
255			foundPerAgent[best[key].agent]++
256		}
257		return best, order, foundPerAgent
258	}
259	
260	// selectWork applies the incremental fingerprint skip (and an optional project filter) to the
261	// deduped set. projectFilter "" means all projects; otherwise only sessions whose originating
262	// cwd resolves to that project id are kept (used by the background warm's current-project
263	// pass). totals is the per-agent to-do count (drives the foreground progress bars).
264	func selectWork(order []string, best map[string]reindexItem, fingerprints map[string]sessionindex.Fingerprint, projectFilter string, force bool, cache *projectIDCache) (work []reindexItem, totals map[string]int, unchanged int) {
265		totals = map[string]int{}
266		for _, key := range order {
267			item := best[key]
268			if projectFilter != "" {
269				if pid, _ := cache.resolve(item.ref.OriginCwd); pid != projectFilter {
270					continue
271				}
272			}
273			fp, ok := fingerprints[key]
274			// A soft-deleted (user-tombstoned) session is never re-indexed, even if its native file
275			// changed since — otherwise a delete wouldn't stick. This skip just avoids re-parsing the
276			// body; upsertOne's tombstone guard is the actual backstop (and covers --force, where the
277			// fingerprint map is empty so this branch can't fire). Restored only by wiping sessions.db.
278			if ok && fp.Deleted {
279				unchanged++
280				continue
281			}
282			if ok && fp.Size == item.size && fp.Mtime == item.mtime && fp.Version == reindexVersion {
283				unchanged++
284				continue // already indexed and unchanged
285			}
286			// A session absent from the fingerprint set has no sessions row, hence no sessions_fts
287			// row either (the pair is written atomically) — so the writer can skip the O(rows)
288			// standalone-FTS delete. Under --force the fingerprint map is deliberately empty, so
289			// absence proves nothing; keep the delete to avoid duplicate FTS rows.
290			item.isNew = !force && !ok
291			work = append(work, item)
292			totals[item.agent]++
293		}
294		return work, totals, unchanged
295	}
296	
297	// reindexReporter receives per-session progress from processWork. The foreground command
298	// passes *reindexProgress (live bars); the background warm passes nopReporter (silent).
299	type reindexReporter interface {
300		observe(projectID string)
301		inc(agent string)
302	}
303	
304	// nopReporter is the silent reporter used by the background warm.
305	type nopReporter struct{}
306	
307	func (nopReporter) observe(string) {}
308	func (nopReporter) inc(string)     {}
309	
310	// processWork parses each work item (worker pool) and writes the results to the store via a
311	// single writer goroutine, reporting progress through rep. It stops feeding work when ctx is
312	// cancelled; the writer flushes what it already received. If the writer fails (a store write
313	// error), it closes writerDone and stops draining, so the workers and the feed loop both
314	// select on writerDone to tear the pipeline down — otherwise a full sessionsCh buffer would
315	// block every worker forever and wwg.Wait would deadlock. Returns the writer's error, if any.
316	func processWork(ctx context.Context, store *sessionindex.Store, work []reindexItem, cache *projectIDCache, indexedAt string, workers int, rep reindexReporter) error {
317		if len(work) == 0 {
318			return nil
319		}
320		if workers < 1 {
321			workers = 1
322		}
323	
324		// Schedule the largest sessions first. A few huge Codex files (hundreds of MB) would
325		// otherwise be end-of-run stragglers that leave most worker cores idle; starting them
326		// first overlaps them with the long tail of small sessions. Order does not affect the
327		// resulting index.
328		sort.SliceStable(work, func(i, j int) bool { return work[i].size > work[j].size })
329	
330		sessionsCh := make(chan sessionindex.Session, 256)
331		var writeErr error
332		writerDone := make(chan struct{})
333		go func() {
334			defer close(writerDone)
335			writeErr = drainToStore(store, sessionsCh)
336		}()
337	
338		workCh := make(chan reindexItem)
339		var wwg sync.WaitGroup
340		for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
341			wwg.Add(1)
342			go func() {
343				defer wwg.Done()
344				for item := range workCh {
345					sess := buildSession(item, cache, indexedAt)
346					rep.observe(sess.ProjectID)
347					// Abandon the push if the writer has already exited on a write error; without
348					// this, a full sessionsCh would block here forever (nothing drains it).
349					select {
350					case sessionsCh <- sess:
351						rep.inc(item.agent)
352					case <-writerDone:
353						return
354					}
355				}
356			}()
357		}
358	
359		for _, item := range work {
360			select {
361			case <-ctx.Done():
362				goto closing
363			case <-writerDone: // writer failed — stop feeding rather than block on a full buffer
364				goto closing
365			case workCh <- item:
366			}
367		}
368	closing:
369		close(workCh)
370		wwg.Wait()
371		close(sessionsCh)
372		<-writerDone
373		return writeErr
374	}
375	
376	// warmIndexInBackground keeps ~/.specstory/sessions.db warm as a side effect of resume/search.
377	// It runs two SILENT incremental passes over its own writer handle: the current project first
378	// (so its rows refresh quickly, and the open TUI re-queries via onProjectWarmed), then the full
379	// corpus. It enumerates once and reuses the result for both passes. It stops promptly when ctx
380	// is cancelled (the TUI exited); an abandoned write batch is safe under WAL. Errors are logged
381	// at debug and never surfaced — warmth is best-effort.
382	func warmIndexInBackground(ctx context.Context, dbPath, currentProjectID string, onProjectWarmed func()) {
383		store, err := sessionindex.Open(dbPath)
384		if err != nil {
385			slog.Debug("warm: could not open index", "error", err)
386			return
387		}
388		defer func() { _ = store.Close() }()
389	
390		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
391		ids, provs, perProvider := enumerateAll(registry, false)
392		if ctx.Err() != nil {
393			return
394		}
395		best, order, _ := dedupRefs(ids, provs, perProvider)
396		cache := &projectIDCache{m: map[string]projectIDName{}}
397		indexedAt := time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
398	
399		// Gentle: fewer workers than a foreground reindex, since the user is interacting.
400		workers := min(runtime.NumCPU(), 4)
401	
402		// Pass 1 — the current project, so its rows are fresh almost immediately.
403		fps, _ := store.Fingerprints()
404		work, _, _ := selectWork(order, best, fps, currentProjectID, false, cache)
405		if err := processWork(ctx, store, work, cache, indexedAt, workers, nopReporter{}); err != nil {
406			slog.Debug("warm: current-project pass failed", "error", err)
407		}
408		if ctx.Err() != nil {
409			return
410		}
411		if onProjectWarmed != nil {
412			onProjectWarmed() // let the open TUI re-query the (now fresh) current project
413		}
414	
415		// Pass 2 — everything else. Reload fingerprints so pass-1's writes now register as
416		// unchanged and are skipped, leaving only the rest of the corpus to parse.
417		fps, _ = store.Fingerprints()
418		work, _, _ = selectWork(order, best, fps, "", false, cache)
419		if err := processWork(ctx, store, work, cache, indexedAt, workers, nopReporter{}); err != nil {
420			slog.Debug("warm: full pass failed", "error", err)
421		}
422	}
423	
424	// ---- real-time indexing (watch / run / resume launch) ----
425	
426	// LiveIndexer keeps ~/.specstory/sessions.db current in real time, alongside the markdown
427	// files that watch/run/resume already write as a session changes. It holds one writer handle
428	// for the command's lifetime and upserts a single row per detected update, reusing the same
429	// content derivation as reindex. The project is resolved once (a watch/run has a fixed cwd).
430	//
431	// Everything is best-effort: real-time indexing must never disrupt the agent or the markdown
432	// write, so construction failures yield a nil *LiveIndexer (whose methods are no-ops) and
433	// per-update errors are logged at debug. A live row carries no native-file fingerprint
434	// (Size/Mtime/NativePath are unknown without enumerating), so the next reindex re-verifies and
435	// rewrites it with a stable fingerprint — the live row is correct and queryable in the interim.
436	type LiveIndexer struct {
437		store       *sessionindex.Store
438		cwd         string
439		projectID   string
440		projectName string
441		indexedAt   string
442	
443		mu       sync.Mutex
444		lastSeen map[string]string // session id -> last indexed UpdatedAt, to skip no-op upserts
445	}
446	
447	// NewLiveIndexer opens the index for writing and resolves the project for cwd. It returns nil
448	// (not an error) when the index can't be opened, so the caller keeps running with real-time
449	// indexing simply disabled. The caller owns Close.
450	func NewLiveIndexer(cwd string) *LiveIndexer {
451		dbPath, err := sessionindex.DefaultPath()
452		if err != nil {
453			slog.Debug("live index: no db path; real-time indexing disabled", "error", err)
454			return nil
455		}
456		store, err := sessionindex.Open(dbPath)
457		if err != nil {
458			slog.Debug("live index: cannot open index; real-time indexing disabled", "error", err)
459			return nil
460		}
461		projectID, projectName, err := utils.ComputeProjectID(cwd)
462		if err != nil || projectID == "" {
463			projectID, projectName = unknownProjectID, ""
464		}
465		return &LiveIndexer{
466			store:       store,
467			cwd:         cwd,
468			projectID:   projectID,
469			projectName: projectName,
470			indexedAt:   time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
471			lastSeen:    map[string]string{},
472		}
473	}
474	
475	// Record upserts the live session into the index. agentID is the provider's registry id (e.g.
476	// "claude"). It skips the write when the session's last activity hasn't advanced since the
477	// previous record (the watcher can fire repeatedly without new content). Safe on a nil
478	// receiver, and serialized so concurrent provider watchers don't contend on the single writer.
479	func (li *LiveIndexer) Record(agentID string, sess *spi.AgentChatSession) {
480		if li == nil || sess == nil || sess.SessionData == nil {
481			return
482		}
483		data := sess.SessionData
484	
485		updatedAt := sess.CreatedAt
486		if ts := lastTimestamp(data); ts != "" {
487			updatedAt = ts
488		}
489	
490		li.mu.Lock()
491		defer li.mu.Unlock()
492	
493		// Nothing advanced since the last write → skip the (FTS-heavy) upsert.
494		if updatedAt != "" && li.lastSeen[sess.SessionID] == updatedAt {
495			return
496		}
497	
498		// Skip the whole-table FTS delete (session_id/agent are UNINDEXED, so it scans the entire
499		// FTS) when this session has no existing row to replace. Only the first write of a session
500		// in this process can be new, and even then only if it isn't already in the index from a
501		// prior run — so we check by primary key just once, before lastSeen records the write.
502		isNew := false
503		if _, written := li.lastSeen[sess.SessionID]; !written {
504			if exists, err := li.store.Exists(agentID, sess.SessionID); err == nil {
505				isNew = !exists
506			}
507		}
508	
509		userTurns, totalTurns := countTurns(data)
510		row := sessionindex.Session{
511			ProjectID:    li.projectID,
512			ProjectName:  li.projectName,
513			Agent:        agentID,
514			SessionID:    sess.SessionID,
515			CreatedAt:    sess.CreatedAt,
516			UpdatedAt:    updatedAt,
517			UserTurns:    userTurns,
518			TotalTurns:   totalTurns,
519			Slug:         sess.Slug,
520			OriginCwd:    li.cwd,
521			IndexVersion: reindexVersion,
522			IndexedAt:    li.indexedAt,
523			Body:         flattenBody(data),
524			IsNew:        isNew,
525		}
526		if err := li.store.Upsert(row); err != nil {
527			slog.Debug("live index: upsert failed", "sessionId", sess.SessionID, "error", err)
528			return
529		}
530		li.lastSeen[sess.SessionID] = updatedAt
531	}
532	
533	// Close releases the writer handle. Safe on a nil receiver.
534	func (li *LiveIndexer) Close() {
535		if li == nil {
536			return
537		}
538		if err := li.store.Close(); err != nil {
539			slog.Debug("live index: close failed", "error", err)
540		}
541	}
542	
543	// buildSession turns one enumeration ref into a fully-built index row. Every session
544	// yields a row from its metadata; the body + turn counts + last-activity time are
545	// ENRICHED via a full parse only when the originating cwd lets us re-locate the
546	// session (so Cursor, whose cwd is unknown for now, lands metadata-only). Nothing is
547	// dropped.
548	func buildSession(item reindexItem, cache *projectIDCache, indexedAt string) sessionindex.Session {
549		ref := item.ref
550		projectID, projectName := cache.resolve(ref.OriginCwd)
551	
552		sess := sessionindex.Session{
553			ProjectID:    projectID,
554			ProjectName:  projectName,
555			Agent:        item.agent,
556			SessionID:    ref.SessionID,
557			CreatedAt:    ref.CreatedAt,
558			UpdatedAt:    ref.CreatedAt, // default; overwritten by last-turn timestamp below
559			Slug:         ref.Slug,
560			Name:         ref.Name,
561			NativePath:   ref.NativePath,
562			OriginCwd:    ref.OriginCwd,
563			Size:         item.size, // captured during the freshness check (no re-stat)
564			Mtime:        item.mtime,
565			IndexVersion: reindexVersion,
566			IndexedAt:    indexedAt,
567			IsNew:        item.isNew,
568		}
569	
570		if ref.OriginCwd == "" {
571			return sess // cannot re-locate without a cwd → metadata-only
572		}
573		full, err := parseFullSession(item.prov, ref)
574		if err != nil || full == nil || full.SessionData == nil {
575			slog.Debug("reindex: full parse unavailable, indexing metadata only",
576				"agent", item.agent, "session", ref.SessionID, "error", err)
577			return sess
578		}
579	
580		data := full.SessionData
581		sess.Body = flattenBody(data)
582		sess.UserTurns, sess.TotalTurns = countTurns(data)
583		if ts := lastTimestamp(data); ts != "" {
584			sess.UpdatedAt = ts
585		}
586		return sess
587	}
588	
589	// parseFullSession reads a session's full data for indexing. It prefers a provider's
590	// path-keyed parse (spi.PathSessionReader) using the ref's already-known NativePath, which
591	// avoids the provider's by-id discovery search — for Codex that search walks the entire
592	// ~/.codex/sessions tree, so this is the difference between an O(N) and an O(N²) reindex.
593	// Providers without the capability (or refs lacking a NativePath) fall back to the by-id
594	// lookup. Parsing the known NativePath is also more consistent: the row's freshness
595	// fingerprint is stat'd from NativePath, so the body now comes from that same file.
596	func parseFullSession(prov spi.Provider, ref spi.GlobalSessionRef) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
597		if pr, ok := prov.(spi.PathSessionReader); ok && ref.NativePath != "" {
598			return pr.GetAgentChatSessionByPath(ref.NativePath, ref.OriginCwd, false)
599		}
600		return prov.GetAgentChatSession(ref.OriginCwd, ref.SessionID, false)
601	}
602	
603	// drainToStore writes parsed sessions to the index in batched transactions.
604	func drainToStore(store *sessionindex.Store, ch <-chan sessionindex.Session) error {
605		batch := make([]sessionindex.Session, 0, reindexWriteBatch)
606		flush := func() error {
607			if err := store.UpsertBatch(batch); err != nil {
608				return err
609			}
610			batch = batch[:0]
611			return nil
612		}
613		for sess := range ch {
614			batch = append(batch, sess)
615			if len(batch) >= reindexWriteBatch {
616				if err := flush(); err != nil {
617					return err
618				}
619			}
620		}
621		return flush()
622	}
623	
624	// ---- session field derivation ----
625	
626	// flattenBody renders SessionData to plain user/agent text for full-text indexing,
627	// reusing the reconstruction flattener (synthetic noise already stripped). No
628	// migration note is prepended — this is index content, not a resumed transcript.
629	func flattenBody(data *schema.SessionData) string {
630		turns := spi.FlattenSessionData(data, "")
631		var b strings.Builder
632		for _, t := range turns {
633			if t.Text == "" {
634				continue
635			}
636			if b.Len() > 0 {
637				b.WriteString("\n\n")
638			}
639			b.WriteString(t.Text)
640		}
641		return b.String()
642	}
643	
644	// countTurns returns (user prompts, all messages) across the session's exchanges.
645	func countTurns(data *schema.SessionData) (userTurns, totalTurns int) {
646		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
647			for _, m := range ex.Messages {
648				totalTurns++
649				if m.Role == schema.RoleUser {
650					userTurns++
651				}
652			}
653		}
654		return userTurns, totalTurns
655	}
656	
657	// lastTimestamp returns the last non-empty message timestamp in the session, or "".
658	func lastTimestamp(data *schema.SessionData) string {
659		last := ""
660		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
661			for _, m := range ex.Messages {
662				if m.Timestamp != "" {
663					last = m.Timestamp
664				}
665			}
666		}
667		return last
668	}
669	
670	// statNative returns the native file's size (bytes) and mtime (epoch ms), or zeros.
671	func statNative(path string) (size, mtimeMs int64) {
672		info, err := os.Stat(path)
673		if err != nil {
674			return 0, 0
675		}
676		return info.Size(), info.ModTime().UnixMilli()
677	}
678	
679	// ---- project identity cache (cwd -> project id/name) ----
680	
681	type projectIDName struct{ id, name string }
682	
683	// projectIDCache memoizes ComputeProjectID by cwd, since many sessions share a cwd and
684	// each resolution walks the filesystem to the git root.
685	type projectIDCache struct {
686		mu sync.Mutex
687		m  map[string]projectIDName
688	}
689	
690	func (c *projectIDCache) resolve(cwd string) (string, string) {
691		if strings.TrimSpace(cwd) == "" {
692			return unknownProjectID, ""
693		}
694		c.mu.Lock()
695		defer c.mu.Unlock()
696		if v, ok := c.m[cwd]; ok {
697			return v.id, v.name
698		}
699		id, name, err := utils.ComputeProjectID(cwd)
700		if err != nil || id == "" {
701			id, name = unknownProjectID, ""
702		}
703		c.m[cwd] = projectIDName{id, name}
704		return id, name
705	}
706	
707	// ---- helpers ----
708	
709	// summarizeCounts renders "claude 683 · codex 70 · …" in registry order, omitting zeros.
710	func summarizeCounts(ids []string, totals map[string]int) string {
711		var parts []string
712		for _, id := range ids {
713			if totals[id] > 0 {
714				parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s %d", id, totals[id]))
715			}
716		}
717		return strings.Join(parts, " · ")
718	}
719	
720	// ---- live progress (per-agent bars) ----
721	
722	// reindexProgress renders live per-agent progress. Workers bump atomic per-agent
723	// counters and observe project ids; a single render goroutine redraws the block in
724	// place on a TTY (ANSI cursor-up), or prints periodic plain lines otherwise. No worker
725	// draws directly. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md "Reindex Progress UX".
726	type reindexProgress struct {
727		agents []string          // agents with >0 sessions, in registry order
728		totals map[string]int    // per-agent session totals
729		done   map[string]*int64 // per-agent completed counters (atomic)
730		tty    bool
731	
732		mu       sync.Mutex
733		projects map[string]struct{} // distinct non-unknown project ids seen
734	
735		stopCh     chan struct{}
736		doneCh     chan struct{}
737		linesDrawn int
738	}
739	
740	func newReindexProgress(ids []string, totals map[string]int) *reindexProgress {
741		done := make(map[string]*int64)
742		var agents []string
743		for _, id := range ids {
744			if totals[id] > 0 {
745				agents = append(agents, id)
746				done[id] = new(int64)
747			}
748		}
749		return &reindexProgress{
750			agents:   agents,
751			totals:   totals,
752			done:     done,
753			tty:      isTerminal(os.Stderr),
754			projects: map[string]struct{}{},
755			stopCh:   make(chan struct{}),
756			doneCh:   make(chan struct{}),
757		}
758	}
759	
760	func (p *reindexProgress) begin() {
761		go p.loop()
762	}
763	
764	func (p *reindexProgress) end() {
765		close(p.stopCh)
766		<-p.doneCh
767		p.draw(true) // final frame at 100%
768	}
769	
770	func (p *reindexProgress) inc(agent string) {
771		if c := p.done[agent]; c != nil {
772			atomic.AddInt64(c, 1)
773		}
774	}
775	
776	func (p *reindexProgress) observe(projectID string) {
777		// Unknown-project sessions are not counted toward the live "projects" total (the
778		// final unattributed count comes from the DB at summary time).
779		if projectID == unknownProjectID {
780			return
781		}
782		p.mu.Lock()
783		p.projects[projectID] = struct{}{}
784		p.mu.Unlock()
785	}
786	
787	func (p *reindexProgress) projectCount() int {
788		p.mu.Lock()
789		defer p.mu.Unlock()
790		return len(p.projects)
791	}
792	
793	func (p *reindexProgress) totalDone() int {
794		var n int64
795		for _, c := range p.done {
796			n += atomic.LoadInt64(c)
797		}
798		return int(n)
799	}
800	
801	func (p *reindexProgress) grandTotal() int {
802		n := 0
803		for _, a := range p.agents {
804			n += p.totals[a]
805		}
806		return n
807	}
808	
809	func (p *reindexProgress) loop() {
810		defer close(p.doneCh)
811		interval := 100 * time.Millisecond
812		if !p.tty {
813			interval = 1500 * time.Millisecond
814		}
815		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
816		defer ticker.Stop()
817		for {
818			select {
819			case <-p.stopCh:
820				return
821			case <-ticker.C:
822				p.draw(false)
823			}
824		}
825	}
826	
827	func (p *reindexProgress) draw(final bool) {
828		if !p.tty {
829			if !final { // the final state is covered by the summary line
830				fprintf(os.Stderr, "indexed %d/%d…\n", p.totalDone(), p.grandTotal())
831			}
832			return
833		}
834	
835		lines := p.frameLines()
836		var b strings.Builder
837		if p.linesDrawn > 0 {
838			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\033[%dA", p.linesDrawn) // move cursor up to the block's top
839		}
840		for _, ln := range lines {
841			b.WriteString("\033[2K") // clear the line, then redraw it
842			b.WriteString(ln)
843			b.WriteString("\n")
844		}
845		fprint(os.Stderr, b.String())
846		p.linesDrawn = len(lines)
847	}
848	
849	func (p *reindexProgress) frameLines() []string {
850		doneN, totalN := p.totalDone(), p.grandTotal()
851		lines := []string{
852			fmt.Sprintf("Indexing  %d/%d · %d projects", doneN, totalN, p.projectCount()),
853			"",
854		}
855	
856		nameW := 0
857		for _, a := range p.agents {
858			if len(a) > nameW {
859				nameW = len(a)
860			}
861		}
862		for _, a := range p.agents {
863			d := atomic.LoadInt64(p.done[a])
864			t := int64(p.totals[a])
865			check := ""
866			if d >= t {
867				check = " ✓"
868			}
869			lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("  %-*s %s %d/%d%s", nameW, a, progressBar(d, t), d, t, check))
870		}
871		return lines
872	}
873	
874	// progressBar renders a fixed-width unicode bar, e.g. ▕███████░░░░░░░▏.
875	func progressBar(done, total int64) string {
876		const w = 14
877		filled := 0
878		if total > 0 {
879			filled = int(done * int64(w) / total)
880		}
881		if filled > w {
882			filled = w
883		}
884		return "▕" + strings.Repeat("█", filled) + strings.Repeat("░", w-filled) + "▏"
885	}
886	
887	// isTerminal reports whether f is a character device (an interactive terminal),
888	// using only the standard library (no isatty dependency).
889	func isTerminal(f *os.File) bool {
890		info, err := f.Stat()
891		if err != nil {
892			return false
893		}
894		return info.Mode()&os.ModeCharDevice != 0
895	}
896	
897	// ---- scan progress (live "Scanning agents…" line) ----
898	
899	// scanSpinner is the braille spinner cycled while enumerating.
900	var scanSpinner = []string{"⠋", "⠙", "⠹", "⠸", "⠼", "⠴", "⠦", "⠧", "⠇", "⠏"}
901	
902	// scanAgent holds one provider's live enumeration counter.
903	type scanAgent struct {
904		id string
905		r  *spi.ScanReporter
906	}
907	
908	// scanProgress renders one live line while enumerateAll scans providers in parallel:
909	//
910	//	🔍  Scanning agents…  ⠹  codex 18420 · claude 3195 · cursor 10
911	//
912	// Codex and Claude (the long poles) report sessions-found via spi.ProgressEnumerator; every
913	// provider snaps to its final count via markDone when it finishes. Counts are sessions, not raw
914	// files (warmup/sidechain transcripts are excluded). On a non-TTY it prints periodic plain lines.
915	// A nil *scanProgress is fully silent — the background warm passes nil.
916	type scanProgress struct {
917		agents []*scanAgent
918		byID   map[string]*scanAgent
919		tty    bool
920		spin   int
921	
922		stopCh     chan struct{}
923		doneCh     chan struct{}
924		linesDrawn int
925	}
926	
927	func newScanProgress(ids []string) *scanProgress {
928		agents := make([]*scanAgent, 0, len(ids))
929		byID := make(map[string]*scanAgent, len(ids))
930		for _, id := range ids {
931			a := &scanAgent{id: id, r: &spi.ScanReporter{}}
932			agents = append(agents, a)
933			byID[id] = a
934		}
935		return &scanProgress{
936			agents: agents,
937			byID:   byID,
938			tty:    isTerminal(os.Stderr),
939			stopCh: make(chan struct{}),
940			doneCh: make(chan struct{}),
941		}
942	}
943	
944	// reporterFor returns a provider's live reporter (nil-safe: a nil scanProgress yields nil, which
945	// providers treat as "do not report").
946	func (s *scanProgress) reporterFor(id string) *spi.ScanReporter {
947		if s == nil {
948			return nil
949		}
950		if a := s.byID[id]; a != nil {
951			return a.r
952		}
953		return nil
954	}
955	
956	// markDone reconciles a provider's running count to its final session count — a no-op for the
957	// reporting providers (Codex/Claude), and the only count for providers that never report
958	// (Cursor/Gemini/etc., which appear the moment they finish).
959	func (s *scanProgress) markDone(id string, final int) {
960		if s == nil {
961			return
962		}
963		if a := s.byID[id]; a != nil {
964			if delta := final - int(a.r.Found()); delta != 0 {
965				a.r.Add(delta)
966			}
967		}
968	}
969	
970	func (s *scanProgress) begin() {
971		if s == nil {
972			return
973		}
974		if !s.tty {
975			fprintln(os.Stderr, "\n🔍  Scanning agents…")
976		} else {
977			fprintln(os.Stderr) // blank line above the live line
978			s.draw()            // show immediately, before the first tick
979		}
980		go s.loop()
981	}
982	
983	func (s *scanProgress) end() {
984		if s == nil {
985			return
986		}
987		close(s.stopCh)
988		<-s.doneCh
989		if s.tty && s.linesDrawn > 0 {
990			// Erase the live line so the caller's "✓ Found…" line takes its place.
991			fprint(os.Stderr, "\033[1A\033[2K")
992		}
993	}
994	
995	func (s *scanProgress) loop() {
996		defer close(s.doneCh)
997		interval := 100 * time.Millisecond
998		if !s.tty {
999			interval = 1500 * time.Millisecond
1000		}
1001		t := time.NewTicker(interval)
1002		defer t.Stop()
1003		for {
1004			select {
1005			case <-s.stopCh:
1006				return
1007			case <-t.C:
1008				s.spin++
1009				if s.tty {
1010					s.draw()
1011				} else {
1012					fprintf(os.Stderr, "    scanning… %s\n", s.counts())
1013				}
1014			}
1015		}
1016	}
1017	
1018	func (s *scanProgress) draw() {
1019		var b strings.Builder
1020		if s.linesDrawn > 0 {
1021			b.WriteString("\033[1A") // up to the live line
1022		}
1023		b.WriteString("\033[2K") // clear it, then redraw
1024		b.WriteString(s.line())
1025		b.WriteString("\n")
1026		fprint(os.Stderr, b.String())
1027		s.linesDrawn = 1
1028	}
1029	
1030	func (s *scanProgress) line() string {
1031		return fmt.Sprintf("🔍  Scanning agents…  %s  %s", scanSpinner[s.spin%len(scanSpinner)], s.counts())
1032	}
1033	
1034	func (s *scanProgress) counts() string {
1035		var parts []string
1036		for _, a := range s.agents {
1037			found := a.r.Found()
1038			if found == 0 {
1039				continue // not started, or finished with no sessions
1040			}
1041			// Plain integers (no thousands separators), matching the "Found …" summary line.
1042			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s %d", a.id, found))
1043		}
1044		if len(parts) == 0 {
1045			return "…"
1046		}
1047		return strings.Join(parts, " · ")
1048	}
1049	
1050	// ---- summary ----
1051	
1052	func printReindexSummary(ids []string, perAgent map[string]int, dbPath string, elapsed time.Duration, indexed, unchanged, projects, unattributed int) {
1053		w := os.Stderr
1054		if unchanged > 0 {
1055			fprintf(w, "\n✓   Indexed %d sessions (%d unchanged) into %s  (%.1fs)\n\n", indexed, unchanged, prettyPath(dbPath), elapsed.Seconds())
1056		} else {
1057			fprintf(w, "\n✓   Indexed %d sessions into %s  (%.1fs)\n\n", indexed, prettyPath(dbPath), elapsed.Seconds())
1058		}
1059		fprintf(w, "      %s\n\n", summarizeCounts(ids, perAgent))
1060		if unattributed > 0 {
1061			fprintf(w, "      %d projects  ·  %d unattributed\n", projects, unattributed)
1062		} else {
1063			fprintf(w, "      %d projects\n", projects)
1064		}
1065		fprintf(w, "\n")
1066	}
1067	
1068	// prettyPath abbreviates the user's home directory to ~ for display.
1069	func prettyPath(p string) string {
1070		if home, err := os.UserHomeDir(); err == nil && strings.HasPrefix(p, home) {
1071			return "~" + p[len(home):]
1072		}
1073		return p
1074	}

147	// extractSessionMetadata parses the session_meta record (first line)
148	func extractSessionMetadata(records []map[string]interface{}) (sessionID, createdAt, cwd string, err error) {
149		if len(records) == 0 {
150			return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("no records to extract metadata from")
151		}
152	
153		firstRecord := records[0]
154		recordType, ok := firstRecord["type"].(string)
155		if !ok || recordType != "session_meta" {
156			return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("first record is not session_meta: %v", recordType)
157		}
158	
159		payload, ok := firstRecord["payload"].(map[string]interface{})
160		if !ok {
161			return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("session_meta payload is missing or invalid")
162		}
163	
164		sessionID, _ = payload["id"].(string)
165		createdAt, _ = payload["timestamp"].(string)
166		cwd, _ = payload["cwd"].(string)
167	
168		if sessionID == "" {
169			return "", "", "", fmt.Errorf("session_meta is missing session ID")
170		}
171	
172		if createdAt == "" {
173			// Fall back to record timestamp
174			createdAt, _ = firstRecord["timestamp"].(string)
175		}
176	
177		return sessionID, createdAt, cwd, nil
178	}
