// DetectAgent reports whether the Factory Droid CLI agent is relevant for the given
// projectPath based on existing session files. When helpOutput is true, it may log
// warnings or print detection help to guide the user if detection fails.
func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
	files, err := listSessionFiles()
	if err != nil {
		if helpOutput {
			log.UserWarn("Factory Droid detection failed: %v", err)
		}
		return false
	}
	if len(files) == 0 {
		if helpOutput {
			printDetectionHelp()
		}
		return false
	}
	if projectPath == "" {
		return true
	}
	for _, file := range files {
		if sessionMentionsProject(file.Path, projectPath) {
			return true
		}
	}
	if helpOutput {
		printDetectionHelp()
	}
	return false
}

// GetAgentChatSessions returns all available agent chat sessions from the Factory Droid CLI,
// optionally filtered to sessions associated with the given projectPath. When debugRaw is true,
// additional raw session details may be included in the converted sessions.
func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
	files, err := listSessionFiles()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, len(files))
	normalizedProject := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)

	// Filter files to those matching the project (for accurate progress count)
	var matchingFiles []sessionFile
	for _, file := range files {
		if normalizedProject != "" && !sessionMentionsProject(file.Path, normalizedProject) {
			continue
		}
		matchingFiles = append(matchingFiles, file)
	}

	totalFiles := len(matchingFiles)

	for i, file := range matchingFiles {

// writeJSONToDebugDir writes pretty-printed JSON to a debug directory
func writeJSONToDebugDir(uuid string, filename string, data map[string]interface{}, logPrefix string) error {
	// Create debug directory structure
	debugDir := spi.GetDebugDir(uuid)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(debugDir, 0755); err != nil {
		slog.Error("Failed to create debug directory",
			"directory", debugDir,
			"error", err)
		return nil // Continue without failing
	}

	// Create the full file path
	jsonFilePath := filepath.Join(debugDir, filename)

	// Pretty print the JSON with 2 spaces indentation
	prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(data, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		slog.Error("Failed to marshal JSON",
			"filename", filename,
			"error", err)
		return nil // Continue without failing
	}

	// Write the file
	if err := os.WriteFile(jsonFilePath, prettyJSON, 0644); err != nil {
		slog.Error("Failed to write JSON file",
			"logPrefix", logPrefix,
			"path", jsonFilePath,
			"error", err)
		return nil // Continue without failing
	}

	slog.Debug("Debug JSON written",
		"logPrefix", logPrefix,
		"path", jsonFilePath)

	return nil
}

	return writeJSONToDebugDir(uuid, filename, data, "Debug")
}

// processSessionToAgentChat converts a codexSessionInfo into an AgentChatSession by reading
// the session data, generating SessionData, and optionally writing debug files. Returns nil if
// the session is empty or cannot be read.
func processSessionToAgentChat(sessionInfo *codexSessionInfo, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
	// Read the session data
	records, rawData, err := readSessionRawData(sessionInfo.SessionPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read session data: %w", err)
	}

	// Skip empty sessions
	if len(records) == 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}

	// Get timestamp from metadata
	timestamp := sessionInfo.Meta.Timestamp

	// Generate slug from first user message
	firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(records)
	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
	if slug == "" {
		slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: No user message for slug yet",
			"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID)
	} else {
		slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Generated slug from user message",
			"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
			"slug", slug)
	}

	// Generate SessionData from records
	sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(records, workspaceRoot)
	if err != nil {
		slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", sessionInfo.SessionID, "error", err)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to generate SessionData: %w", err)
	}

	// Write provider-specific debug files if requested
	if debugRaw {
		if err := writeDebugRawFiles(sessionInfo.SessionID, records); err != nil {
			slog.Debug("processSessionToAgentChat: Failed to write debug files",
				"sessionID", sessionInfo.SessionID,
				"error", err)
			// Don't fail the operation if debug output fails
		}
	}

	return &spi.AgentChatSession{
		SessionID:   sessionInfo.SessionID,
		CreatedAt:   timestamp,
		Slug:        slug,
		SessionData: sessionData,
		RawData:     rawData,
	}, nil
}

// writeDebugRawFiles writes debug JSON files for a Codex CLI session.
// Each record is written as a numbered JSON file in .specstory/debug/<session-id>/
func writeDebugRawFiles(sessionID string, records []map[string]interface{}) error {
	// Get the debug directory path
	debugDir := spi.GetDebugDir(sessionID)

	// Create the debug directory
	if err := os.MkdirAll(debugDir, 0755); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create debug directory: %w", err)
	}

	// Write each record as a pretty-printed JSON file
	for index, record := range records {
		// Create filename with 1-based index for readability
		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%d.json", index+1)
		debugPath := filepath.Join(debugDir, filename)

		// Pretty print the record
		prettyJSON, err := json.MarshalIndent(record, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to marshal record to JSON",
				"index", index,
				"error", err)
			continue
		}

		// Write the file
		if err := os.WriteFile(debugPath, prettyJSON, 0644); err != nil {
			slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Failed to write debug file",
				"path", debugPath,
				"error", err)
			continue
		}

		slog.Debug("writeDebugRawFiles: Wrote debug file",
			"path", debugPath,
			"index", index)
	}

	return nil

import json, glob, sys
for f in glob.glob('/Users/jakelevirne/.pi/agent/sessions/*/*.jsonl'):
    entries = []
    with open(f) as fh:
        for i, line in enumerate(fh):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line: continue
            try: e = json.loads(line)
            except: continue
            if i == 0: continue
            if e.get('id'):
                entries.append(e)
    ids = {}
    children = {}
    roots = []
    dups = 0
    for e in entries:
        if e['id'] in ids: dups += 1
        ids[e['id']] = e
        p = e.get('parentId')
        if p is None: roots.append(e['id'])
        else: children.setdefault(p, []).append(e['id'])
    branch_points = {p: c for p, c in children.items() if len(c) > 1}
    missing_parents = [e['id'] for e in entries if e.get('parentId') and e['parentId'] not in ids]
    # leaf path from last entry
    leaf = entries[-1]
    path = set()
    cur = leaf
    while True:
        if cur['id'] in path: break
        path.add(cur['id'])
        p = cur.get('parentId')
        if p is None or p not in ids: break
        cur = ids[p]
    off_path_msgs = [e['id'] for e in entries if e['id'] not in path and e.get('type') == 'message']
    print(f, 'entries=%d roots=%d dups=%d branchpoints=%d missing_parents=%s off_path_messages=%d' % (len(entries), len(roots), dups, len(branch_points), missing_parents, len(off_path_msgs)))
    if branch_points:
        print('   branch points:', branch_points)
    if off_path_msgs:
        print('   off-path messages:', off_path_msgs[:20])

19	// ValidateSessionData runs schema validation on SessionData when in debug mode.
20	// Validation is only performed when debugRaw is true to avoid overhead in normal operation.
21	// Returns true if validation passed or was skipped, false if validation failed.
22	func ValidateSessionData(session *spi.AgentChatSession, debugRaw bool) bool {
23		if !debugRaw || session.SessionData == nil {
24			return true
25		}
26		if !session.SessionData.Validate() {
27			slog.Warn("SessionData failed schema validation, proceeding anyway",
28				"sessionId", session.SessionID)
29			return false
30		}
31		return true
32	}
33	
34	// WriteDebugSessionData writes debug session data when debugRaw is enabled.
35	// Logs warnings on failure but does not fail the operation.
36	func WriteDebugSessionData(session *spi.AgentChatSession, debugRaw bool) {
37		if !debugRaw || session.SessionData == nil {
38			return
39		}
40		if err := spi.WriteDebugSessionData(session.SessionID, session.SessionData); err != nil {
41			slog.Warn("Failed to write debug session data", "sessionId", session.SessionID, "error", err)
42		}
43	}
44	
45	// FormatFilenameTimestamp formats a timestamp for use in filenames.
46	// The format is filesystem-safe and matches the markdown title format.
47	func FormatFilenameTimestamp(t time.Time, useUTC bool) string {
48		if useUTC {
49			// Use UTC with Z suffix: "2006-01-02_15-04-05Z"
50			return t.UTC().Format("2006-01-02_15-04-05") + "Z"
51		}
52		// Use local timezone with offset: "2006-01-02_15-04-05-0700"
53		return t.Local().Format("2006-01-02_15-04-05-0700")
54	}
55	
56	// BuildSessionFilePath constructs the full markdown file path for a session.
57	// All callers need consistent filename generation from session metadata.
58	func BuildSessionFilePath(session *spi.AgentChatSession, historyDir string, useUTC bool) string {
59		timestamp, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, session.CreatedAt)
60		timestampStr := FormatFilenameTimestamp(timestamp, useUTC)
61	
62		filename := timestampStr
63		if session.Slug != "" {
64			filename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", timestampStr, session.Slug)
65		}
66		return filepath.Join(historyDir, filename+".md")
67	}
68	
69	// ProcessingOptions holds flags that control session processing behavior.
70	type ProcessingOptions struct {
71		OnlyCloudSync      bool // Skip local markdown writes and only sync to cloud
72		ShowOutput         bool // Print progress to stdout
73		IsAutosave         bool // Called from run/watch (true) vs sync command (false)
74		DebugRaw           bool // Enable schema validation (only in debug mode to avoid overhead)
75		UseUTC             bool // Timestamp format: true=UTC, false=local
76		NoTelemetryPrompts bool // Exclude user prompt text from telemetry spans for privacy
77	}
78	
79	// ProcessSingleSession writes markdown and triggers cloud sync for a single session.
80	// ctx is used for OTel trace/span propagation (no-op when telemetry is disabled).
81	// Returns the size of the markdown content in bytes.
82	func ProcessSingleSession(ctx context.Context, session *spi.AgentChatSession, config utils.OutputConfig, opts ProcessingOptions) (int, error) {
83		if session == nil || session.SessionData == nil {
84			return 0, fmt.Errorf("session or session data is nil")
85		}
86	
87		// Track processing start time for metrics
88		processingStart := time.Now()
89	
90		// Create a context with a deterministic trace ID from the session ID.
91		// This groups all spans for the same session into a single trace, even
92		// across multiple invocations in autosave mode.
93		ctx = telemetry.ContextWithSessionTrace(ctx, session.SessionID)
94	
95		// Start an OTel span for this session processing (no-op when telemetry is disabled)
96		ctx, span := telemetry.Tracer("specstory").Start(ctx, "process_session")
97		defer span.End()
98	
99		// Compute session statistics
100		agentName := session.SessionData.Provider.Name
101		stats := telemetry.ComputeSessionStats(agentName, session)
102	
103		// Record metrics (no-op when telemetry is disabled)
104		defer func() {
105			telemetry.RecordSessionMetrics(ctx, stats, time.Since(processingStart))
106		}()
107	
108		// Set session span attributes
109		telemetry.SetSessionSpanAttributes(span, stats)
110	
111		// Create child spans for each exchange
112		if len(session.SessionData.Exchanges) > 0 {
113			telemetry.ProcessExchangeSpans(ctx, stats, session.SessionData.Exchanges, opts.NoTelemetryPrompts)
114		}
115	
116		ValidateSessionData(session, opts.DebugRaw)
117		WriteDebugSessionData(session, opts.DebugRaw)
118	
119		// Generate markdown from SessionData
120		markdownContent, err := GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession(session.SessionData, false, opts.UseUTC)

30	// filterWarmupMessages removes warmup messages (sidechain messages before first real message)
31	func filterWarmupMessages(records []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
32		// Find first non-sidechain message
33		firstRealMessageIndex := -1
34		for i, record := range records {
35			if isSidechain, ok := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool); !ok || !isSidechain {
36				firstRealMessageIndex = i
37				break
38			}
39		}
40	
41		// No real messages found
42		if firstRealMessageIndex == -1 {
43			return []JSONLRecord{}
44		}
45	
46		// Return records starting from first real message
47		return records[firstRealMessageIndex:]
48	}
49	
50	// processSession filters warmup messages and converts a Session to an AgentChatSession
51	// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
52	func processSession(session Session, workspaceRoot string, debugRaw bool) *spi.AgentChatSession {
53		// Write debug files first (even for warmup-only sessions)
54		if debugRaw {
55			// Write debug files and get the record-to-file mapping
56			_ = writeDebugRawFiles(session) // Unused but needed for side effect
57		}
58	
59		// Filter warmup messages
60		filteredRecords := filterWarmupMessages(session.Records)
61	
62		// Skip if no real messages remain after filtering warmup
63		if len(filteredRecords) == 0 {
64			slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid)
65			return nil
66		}
67	
68		// Create session with filtered records
69		filteredSession := Session{
70			SessionUuid: session.SessionUuid,
71			Records:     filteredRecords,
72		}
73	
74		// Get timestamp from root record
75		rootRecord := filteredSession.Records[0]
76		timestamp := rootRecord.Data["timestamp"].(string)
77	
78		// Get the slug
79		slug := FileSlugFromRootRecord(filteredSession)
80	
81		// Generate SessionData from filtered session
82		sessionData, err := GenerateAgentSession(filteredSession, workspaceRoot)
83		if err != nil {
84			slog.Error("Failed to generate SessionData", "sessionId", session.SessionUuid, "error", err)
85			return nil
86		}
87	
88		// Convert session records to JSONL format for raw data
89		// Note: Uses unfiltered session.Records (not filteredSession.Records) to preserve
90		// all records including warmup messages in the raw data for complete audit trail
91		var rawDataBuilder strings.Builder
92		for _, record := range session.Records {
93			jsonBytes, _ := json.Marshal(record.Data)
94			rawDataBuilder.Write(jsonBytes)
95			rawDataBuilder.WriteString("\n")
96		}
97	
98		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
99			SessionID:   session.SessionUuid,
100			CreatedAt:   timestamp, // ISO 8601 timestamp
101			Slug:        slug,
102			SessionData: sessionData,
103			RawData:     rawDataBuilder.String(),
104		}
105	}

112	// buildCheckErrorMessage creates a user-facing error message tailored to the failure type.
113	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, claudeCmd string, isCustom bool, stderrOutput string) string {
114		var errorMsg strings.Builder
115	
116		switch errorType {
117		case "not_found":
118			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  🔍 Could not find Claude Code at: %s\n", claudeCmd)
119			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
120			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
121			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
122			if isCustom {
123				errorMsg.WriteString("     The specified path doesn't exist. Please check:\n")
124				fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "     • Is Claude Code installed at %s?\n", claudeCmd)
125				errorMsg.WriteString("     • Did you type the path correctly?")
126			} else {
127				errorMsg.WriteString("     1. Make sure Claude Code is installed:\n")
128				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Visit https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart\n")
129				errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
130				errorMsg.WriteString("     2. If it's already installed, try:\n")
131				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Check if 'claude' is in your PATH\n")
132				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Use -c flag to specify the full path\n")
133				errorMsg.WriteString("        • Example: specstory check claude -c \"~/.claude/local/claude\"")
134			}
135		case "permission_denied":
136			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  🔒 Permission denied when trying to run: %s\n", claudeCmd)
137			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
138			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Here's how to fix this:\n")
139			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "     • Check file permissions: chmod +x %s\n", claudeCmd)
140			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running with elevated permissions if needed")
141		case "unexpected_output":
142			fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  ⚠️  Unexpected output from 'claude -v': %s\n", strings.TrimSpace(stderrOutput))
143			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
144			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 This might not be Claude Code. Expected output containing '(Claude Code)'.\n")
145			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure you have Claude Code installed, not a different 'claude' command\n")
146			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Visit https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation")
147		default:
148			errorMsg.WriteString("  ⚠️  Error running 'claude -v'\n")
149			if stderrOutput != "" {
150				fmt.Fprintf(&errorMsg, "  📋 Error details: %s\n", stderrOutput)
151			}
152			errorMsg.WriteString("\n")
153			errorMsg.WriteString("  💡 Troubleshooting tips:\n")
154			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Make sure Claude Code is properly installed\n")
155			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Try running 'claude -v' directly in your terminal\n")
156			errorMsg.WriteString("     • Check https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/quickstart for installation help")
157		}
158	
159		return errorMsg.String()
160	}

162	// Check verifies Claude Code installation and returns version info
163	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
164		// Parse the command (no resume session for version check)
165		claudeCmd, _ := parseClaudeCommand(customCommand, "")
166	
167		// Determine if custom command was used
168		isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
169	
170		// Resolve the actual path of the command
171		resolvedPath := claudeCmd
172		if !filepath.IsAbs(claudeCmd) {
173			// Try to find the command in PATH
174			if path, err := exec.LookPath(claudeCmd); err == nil {
175				resolvedPath = path
176			}
177		}
178	
179		// Run claude -v to check version (ignore custom args for version check)
180		cmd := exec.Command(claudeCmd, "-v")
181		var out bytes.Buffer
182		var errOut bytes.Buffer
183		cmd.Stdout = &out
184		cmd.Stderr = &errOut
185	
186		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
187			// Track installation check failure
188			errorType := "unknown"
189	
190			var execErr *exec.Error
191			var pathErr *os.PathError
192	
193			// Check error types in order of specificity
194			switch {
195			case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
196				errorType = "not_found"
197			case errors.As(err, &pathErr):
198				if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrNotExist) {
199					errorType = "not_found"
200				} else if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission) {
201					errorType = "permission_denied"
202				}
203			case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
204				errorType = "permission_denied"
205			}
206	
207			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(errOut.String())
208			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
209				"provider":       "claude",
210				"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
211				"command_path":   claudeCmd,
212				"error_type":     errorType,
213				"error_message":  err.Error(),
214			})
215	
216			errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
217	
218			return spi.CheckResult{
219				Success:      false,
220				Version:      "",
221				Location:     resolvedPath,
222				ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
223			}
224		}
225	
226		// Check if output contains "Claude Code"
227		output := out.String()
228		if !strings.Contains(output, "(Claude Code)") {
229			// Track unexpected output error
230			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
231				"provider":       "claude",
232				"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
233				"command_path":   claudeCmd,
234				"error_type":     "unexpected_output",
235				"output":         strings.TrimSpace(output),
236			})
237	
238			errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage("unexpected_output", claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, output)
239	
240			return spi.CheckResult{
241				Success:      false,
242				Version:      "",
243				Location:     resolvedPath,
244				ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
245			}
246		}
247	
248		// Success! Track it
249		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
250			"provider":       "claude",
251			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
252			"command_path":   resolvedPath,
253			"version":        strings.TrimSpace(output),
254		})
255	
256		return spi.CheckResult{
257			Success:      true,
258			Version:      strings.TrimSpace(output),
259			Location:     resolvedPath,
260			ErrorMessage: "",
261		}
262	}

264	// DetectAgent checks if Claude Code has been used in the given project directory
265	func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
266		// Get the Claude Code project directory for the given path
267		claudeProjectPath, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
268		if err != nil {
269			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Failed to get Claude Code project directory", "error", err)
270			return false
271		}
272	
273		// Check if the Claude Code project directory exists
274		if info, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectPath); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
275			slog.Debug("DetectAgent: Claude Code project found", "path", claudeProjectPath)
276			return true
277		}
278	
279		slog.Debug("DetectAgent: No Claude Code project found", "expected_path", claudeProjectPath)
280	
281		// If helpOutput is requested, provide helpful guidance
282		if helpOutput {
283			fmt.Println() // Add visual separation
284			log.UserWarn("No Claude Code project found for this directory.\n")
285			log.UserMessage("Claude Code hasn't created a project folder for your current directory yet.\n")
286			log.UserMessage("This happens when Claude Code hasn't been run in this directory.\n\n")
287			log.UserMessage("To fix this:\n")
288			log.UserMessage("  1. Run 'specstory run' to start Claude Code in this directory\n")
289			log.UserMessage("  2. Or run Claude Code directly with `claude`, then try syncing again\n\n")
290			log.UserMessage("Expected project folder: %s\n", claudeProjectPath)
291			fmt.Println() // Add trailing newline
292		}
293	
294		return false
295	}

297	// GetAgentChatSessions retrieves all chat sessions for the given project path
298	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
299		// Get the Claude Code project directory
300		claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
301		if err != nil {
302			return nil, err
303		}
304	
305		// Check if project directory exists
306		if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
307			return []spi.AgentChatSession{}, nil // No sessions if no project
308		}
309	
310		// Parse JSONL files with progress callback
311		parser := NewJSONLParser()
312		err = parser.ParseProjectSessionsWithProgress(claudeProjectDir, progress)
313		if err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316	
317		// Convert sessions to AgentChatSession structs
318		result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, len(parser.Sessions))
319		for _, session := range parser.Sessions {
320			// Skip empty sessions (no records)
321			if len(session.Records) == 0 {
322				continue
323			}
324	
325			// Process session (filter warmup, generate SessionData)
326			chatSession := processSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
327			if chatSession != nil {
328				result = append(result, *chatSession)
329			}
330		}
331	
332		return result, nil
333	}
334	
335	// GetAgentChatSession retrieves a single chat session by ID for the given project path
336	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath string, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
337		// Get the Claude Code project directory
338		claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
339		if err != nil {
340			return nil, err
341		}
342	
343		// Check if project directory exists
344		if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
345			return nil, nil // No sessions if no project
346		}
347	
348		// Parse only the session we're looking for
349		parser := NewJSONLParser()
350		err = parser.ParseSingleSession(claudeProjectDir, sessionID)
351		if err != nil {
352			// If session not found, return nil (not an error)
353			if strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not found") {
354				return nil, nil
355			}
356			return nil, err
357		}
358	
359		// Find the session
360		sessionPointer := parser.FindSession(sessionID)
361		if sessionPointer == nil {
362			return nil, nil
363		}
364		session := *sessionPointer
365	
366		// Skip empty sessions (no records)
367		if len(session.Records) == 0 {
368			return nil, nil
369		}
370	
371		// Process session (filter warmup, generate SessionData)
372		return processSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw), nil
373	}

375	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes Claude Code in interactive mode and watches for session updates
376	func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
377		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Starting Claude Code execution and monitoring",
378			"projectPath", projectPath,
379			"customCommand", customCommand,
380			"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
381			"debugRaw", debugRaw)
382	
383		// Validate resume session ID if provided (Claude Code uses UUID format)
384		if resumeSessionID != "" {
385			resumeSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(resumeSessionID)
386			// Simple UUID validation for Claude Code sessions
387			if len(resumeSessionID) != 36 || !strings.Contains(resumeSessionID, "-") {
388				return fmt.Errorf("invalid session ID format for Claude Code: %s (must be a UUID)", resumeSessionID)
389			}
390			slog.Info("Resuming Claude Code session", "sessionId", resumeSessionID)
391		}
392	
393		// Set up the callback which enables real-time markdown generation and cloud sync during
394		// interactive sessions. As Claude Code writes JSONL updates, the watcher detects
395		// changes and invokes this callback, allowing immediate processing without blocking
396		// the agent's execution. The defer ensures cleanup when the agent exits.
397		SetWatcherCallback(sessionCallback)
398		defer ClearWatcherCallback()
399	
400		// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
401		SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
402	
403		// Start watching for project directory in the background
404		slog.Info("Initializing project directory monitoring...")
405	
406		if err := WatchForProjectDir(); err != nil {
407			// Log the error but don't fail - watcher might work later
408			slog.Error("Failed to start project directory watcher", "error", err)
409		}
410	
411		// Execute Claude Code - this blocks until Claude exits
412		slog.Info("Executing Claude Code", "command", customCommand)
413		err := ExecuteClaude(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
414	
415		// Stop the watcher goroutine before returning
416		slog.Info("Claude Code has exited, stopping watcher")
417		StopWatcher()
418	
419		// Return any execution error
420		if err != nil {
421			return fmt.Errorf("claude Code execution failed: %w", err)
422		}
423	
424		return nil
425	}
426	
427	// WatchAgent watches for Claude Code agent activity and calls the callback with AgentChatSession
428	// Does NOT execute the agent - only watches for existing activity
429	// Runs until error or context cancellation
430	func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
431		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Starting Claude Code activity monitoring",
432			"projectPath", projectPath,
433			"debugRaw", debugRaw)
434	
435		// The watcher callback directly passes AgentChatSession (which now contains SessionData)
436		wrappedCallback := func(agentChatSession *spi.AgentChatSession) {
437			slog.Debug("WatchAgent: Received AgentChatSession",
438				"sessionID", agentChatSession.SessionID,
439				"hasSessionData", agentChatSession.SessionData != nil)
440	
441			// Call the user's callback with the AgentChatSession
442			sessionCallback(agentChatSession)
443		}
444	
445		// Set up the callback for the watcher
446		SetWatcherCallback(wrappedCallback)
447		defer ClearWatcherCallback()
448	
449		// Set debug raw mode for the watcher
450		SetWatcherDebugRaw(debugRaw)
451	
452		// Get the Claude Code project directory for the specified project path
453		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Initializing project directory monitoring...")
454	
455		claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
456		if err != nil {
457			slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to get Claude Code project directory", "error", err)
458			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get project directory: %w", err)
459		}
460	
461		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Project directory found", "directory", claudeProjectDir)
462	
463		if err := startProjectWatcher(claudeProjectDir); err != nil {
464			slog.Error("WatchAgent: Failed to start project watcher", "error", err)
465			return fmt.Errorf("failed to start watcher: %w", err)
466		}
467	
468		// Block until context is cancelled
469		// The watcher runs in a background goroutine and will continue
470		// until context is cancelled or the process exits
471		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Watcher started, blocking until context cancelled")
472	
473		// Wait for context cancellation
474		<-ctx.Done()
475	
476		slog.Info("WatchAgent: Context cancelled, stopping watcher")
477		StopWatcher()
478	
479		return ctx.Err()
480	}
481	
482	// isSyntheticMessage checks if a message is synthetic/internal and should be skipped
483	// when looking for the first real user message (e.g. for the session title/slug).
484	// Filters warmup prompts, title-generation prompts, and slash-command noise (the
485	// command invocation, its local stdout/stderr, and the local-command caveat) — these
486	// are conversation scaffolding, not the user's actual prompt. Without this, a session
487	// that opens with a slash command gets an empty title and falls back to its UUID.
488	func isSyntheticMessage(content string) bool {
489		// warmup and the <TEXTBLOCK> title-generation wrapper can be embedded anywhere
490		// in the record, so match them with Contains.
491		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(content), "warmup") {
492			return true
493		}
494		if strings.Contains(content, "<TEXTBLOCK>") {
495			return true
496		}
497		// The slash-command scaffolding tags (shared with reconstruction via
498		// spi.SyntheticCommandTags) and the interrupt marker REPLACE the prompt, so they
499		// appear at the very START of the record. Match by prefix so a real prompt that
500		// merely mentions a tag mid-sentence is still treated as real. The interrupt
501		// marker's "…for tool use" variant is caught by the same prefix.
502		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(content)
503		for _, marker := range spi.SyntheticCommandTags {
504			if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, marker) {
505				return true
506			}
507		}
508		return strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "[Request interrupted by user")
509	}
510	
511	// extractContentText extracts plain text from a message content field.
512	// The content field may be either a plain string or a JSON array of typed content
513	// blocks (e.g. [{type:"text",text:"..."},{type:"tool_use",...}]).
514	// When it's an array, all "text"-type blocks are joined with newlines.
515	// This handles the Claude Code JSONL format where IDE context tags (e.g.
516	// <ide_opened_file>) are injected as separate text blocks before the real question.
517	func extractContentText(content interface{}) string {
518		switch v := content.(type) {
519		case string:
520			return v
521		case []interface{}:
522			var parts []string
523			for _, block := range v {
524				if m, ok := block.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
525					if t, _ := m["type"].(string); t == "text" {
526						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
527							parts = append(parts, text)
528						}
529					}
530				}
531			}
532			slog.Debug("extractContentText: extracted text from content block array",
533				"blockCount", len(v),
534				"textParts", len(parts))
535			return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
536		default:
537			return ""
538		}
539	}
540	
541	// findFirstUserMessage finds the first user message in a session for slug generation
542	// Returns empty string if no suitable user message is found
543	func findFirstUserMessage(session Session) string {
544		for _, record := range session.Records {
545			// Check if this is a user message
546			if recordType, ok := record.Data["type"].(string); !ok || recordType != "user" {
547				continue
548			}
549	
550			// Skip meta user messages
551			if isMeta, ok := record.Data["isMeta"].(bool); ok && isMeta {
552				continue
553			}
554	
555			// Extract content from message - content may be a string or a list of blocks
556			if message, ok := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
557				content := extractContentText(message["content"])
558				if content != "" {
559					// Skip synthetic messages (warmup, title generation prompts, etc.)
560					if isSyntheticMessage(content) {
561						continue
562					}
563					return content
564				}
565			}
566		}
567		return ""
568	}
569	
570	// FileSlugFromRootRecord generates the slug part of the filename from the session
571	// Returns the human-readable slug derived from the first user message, or empty string if none
572	func FileSlugFromRootRecord(session Session) string {
573		// Find the first user message and generate slug from it
574		firstUserMessage := findFirstUserMessage(session)
575		slog.Debug("FileSlugFromRootRecord: First user message",
576			"sessionId", session.SessionUuid,
577			"message", firstUserMessage)
578	
579		slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)
580		slog.Debug("FileSlugFromRootRecord: Generated slug",
581			"sessionId", session.SessionUuid,
582			"slug", slug)
583	
584		return slug
585	}

587	// ListAgentChatSessions retrieves lightweight session metadata without full parsing
588	// This is much faster than GetAgentChatSessions as it only reads minimal data from each session
589	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
590		// Get the Claude Code project directory
591		claudeProjectDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectDir(projectPath)
592		if err != nil {
593			return nil, err
594		}
595	
596		// Check if project directory exists
597		if _, err := os.Stat(claudeProjectDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
598			return []spi.SessionMetadata{}, nil // No sessions if no project
599		}
600	
601		// Collect all JSONL files in the project directory
602		var sessionFiles []string
603		err = filepath.Walk(claudeProjectDir, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
604			if err != nil {
605				return err
606			}
607			if info.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".jsonl") {
608				return nil
609			}
610			sessionFiles = append(sessionFiles, path)
611			return nil
612		})
613		if err != nil {
614			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to scan project directory: %w", err)
615		}
616	
617		// Extract metadata from each session file
618		sessions := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(sessionFiles))
619		for _, filePath := range sessionFiles {
620			metadata, err := extractSessionMetadata(filePath)
621			if err != nil {
622				slog.Warn("Failed to extract session metadata",
623					"file", filePath,
624					"error", err)
625				continue
626			}
627	
628			// Skip warmup-only sessions (no metadata means warmup-only)
629			if metadata == nil {
630				slog.Debug("Skipping warmup-only session", "file", filePath)
631				continue
632			}
633	
634			sessions = append(sessions, *metadata)
635		}
636	
637		return sessions, nil
638	}
639	
640	// claudeSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one pass:
641	// identity + first-message metadata, plus the originating cwd (Claude Code stamps a
642	// top-level "cwd" on every conversational record). foundRealMessage is false for
643	// warmup-only sessions (no real messages).
644	type claudeSessionScan struct {
645		sessionID        string
646		timestamp        string
647		firstUserMessage string
648		commandFallback  string // slash command title when there is no free-text prompt
649		cwd              string
650		foundRealMessage bool
651	}
652	
653	// scanClaudeSession reads minimal data from a session file: session id, first-real
654	// timestamp, first user message, and originating cwd. Shared by the project-scoped
655	// metadata path and the global enumeration (ListAllAgentChatSessions).
656	func scanClaudeSession(filePath string) (*claudeSessionScan, error) {
657		file, err := os.Open(filePath)
658		if err != nil {
659			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
660		}
661		defer func() {
662			_ = file.Close()
663		}()
664	
665		reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
666		scan := &claudeSessionScan{}
667	
668		// Read records until we find everything we need.
669		// Why: ReadString can return data AND io.EOF on the last line (no trailing newline),
670		// so we always process the line first, then check for EOF once at the bottom.
671		lineNum := 0
672		for {
673			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
674			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
675				return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read line: %w", readErr)
676			}
677	
678			lineNum++
679			line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
680	
681			if line != "" {
682				// Parse JSON record
683				var record map[string]interface{}
684				if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); jsonErr != nil {
685					slog.Warn("Skipping malformed JSONL line",
686						"file", filepath.Base(filePath),
687						"line", lineNum,
688						"error", jsonErr)
689				} else {
690					// Extract session ID (from any record)
691					if scan.sessionID == "" {
692						if sid, ok := record["sessionId"].(string); ok {
693							scan.sessionID = sid
694						}
695					}
696	
697					// Capture the originating cwd (first record that carries one). This is
698					// the input to project-identity resolution for the restore index.
699					if scan.cwd == "" {
700						if cwd, ok := record["cwd"].(string); ok && cwd != "" {
701							scan.cwd = cwd
702						}
703					}
704	
705					// Only process non-sidechain, non-system records for message extraction
706					isSidechain, _ := record["isSidechain"].(bool)
707					recordType, hasType := record["type"].(string)
708					isSystemRecord := hasType && (recordType == "file-history-snapshot" || recordType == "file-change")
709	
710					if !isSidechain && !isSystemRecord {
711						scan.foundRealMessage = true
712						// created_at = the first real record that actually carries a timestamp.
713						// (The leading {mode,sessionId,type} record has none, so we can't gate
714						// timestamp capture on "first real record" — it would stay empty.)
715						if scan.timestamp == "" {
716							if ts, ok := record["timestamp"].(string); ok && ts != "" {
717								scan.timestamp = ts
718							}
719						}
720	
721						// Extract first user message for slug (if this is a user message)
722						// Content may be a string or a list of typed blocks (see extractContentText)
723						if scan.firstUserMessage == "" && hasType && recordType == "user" {
724							isMeta, _ := record["isMeta"].(bool)
725							if !isMeta {
726								if message, ok := record["message"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
727									content := extractContentText(message["content"])
728									if content != "" {
729										if isSyntheticMessage(content) {
730											// A slash-command session may have no free-text prompt;
731											// remember the command name as a fallback title.
732											if scan.commandFallback == "" {
733												scan.commandFallback = extractCommandName(content)
734											}
735										} else {
736											scan.firstUserMessage = content
737										}
738									}
739								}
740							}
741						}
742					}
743				}
744			}
745	
746			// Single exit: found everything we need, or reached end of file
747			if (scan.sessionID != "" && scan.timestamp != "" && scan.firstUserMessage != "" && scan.cwd != "") || readErr == io.EOF {
748				break
749			}
750		}
751	
752		// Fall back to the slash command when there was no real user prompt (so a
753		// command-only session shows e.g. "/code-review" instead of its UUID).
754		if scan.firstUserMessage == "" {
755			scan.firstUserMessage = scan.commandFallback
756		}
757		return scan, nil
758	}
759	
760	// extractCommandName pulls the slash command from a Claude Code command record, e.g.
761	// "<command-name>/code-review</command-name>…" -> "/code-review". Falls back to the
762	// bare command-message name (prefixed with "/"). Returns "" when none is present.
763	func extractCommandName(content string) string {
764		if c := between(content, "<command-name>", "</command-name>"); c != "" {
765			return c
766		}
767		if c := between(content, "<command-message>", "</command-message>"); c != "" {
768			return "/" + c
769		}
770		return ""
771	}
772	
773	// between returns the text between the first open/close markers, trimmed, or "".
774	func between(s, openTag, closeTag string) string {
775		_, after, ok := strings.Cut(s, openTag)
776		if !ok {
777			return ""
778		}
779		inner, _, ok := strings.Cut(after, closeTag)
780		if !ok {
781			return ""
782		}
783		return strings.TrimSpace(inner)
784	}
785	
786	// extractSessionMetadata reads minimal data from a session file to extract metadata
787	// Returns nil if the session is warmup-only (no real messages)
788	func extractSessionMetadata(filePath string) (*spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
789		scan, err := scanClaudeSession(filePath)
790		if err != nil {
791			return nil, err
792		}
793	
794		// If no real message was found, this is a warmup-only session
795		if !scan.foundRealMessage {
796			return nil, nil
797		}
798	
799		return &spi.SessionMetadata{
800			SessionID: scan.sessionID,
801			CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
802			Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
803			Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
804		}, nil
805	}
806	
807	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every Claude Code session across all projects. It is the
808	// no-progress form of ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress.
809	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
810		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
811	}
812	
813	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates every Claude Code session across all projects by
814	// walking ~/.claude/projects/*/ for *.jsonl (the originating cwd comes from inside each session;
815	// the project directory name is a lossy, irreversible encoding of the path), reporting scan
816	// progress into r (nil-safe). Headers are scanned in parallel across CPUs; output order is
817	// irrelevant (reindex dedups and sorts later). Implements spi.ProgressEnumerator. See
818	// docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
819	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
820		projectsDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir()
821		if err != nil {
822			// No projects directory yet → nothing to enumerate (not an error).
823			return []spi.GlobalSessionRef{}, nil
824		}
825	
826		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(projectsDir, "claude", r, func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
827			scan, scanErr := scanClaudeSession(path)
828			if scanErr != nil {
829				return nil, scanErr
830			}
831			if !scan.foundRealMessage {
832				return nil, nil // warmup-only or sidechain-only transcript (not a session)
833			}
834			return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
835				SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
836				CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
837				Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
838				Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
839				NativePath: path,
840				OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
841			}, nil
842		})
843	}
844

1	package utils
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"log/slog"
8		"sync"
9	
10		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
11		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi/factory"
12	)
13	
14	// WatchAgents starts watchers for all registered providers concurrently.
15	// Convenience wrapper around WatchProviders that resolves the full provider registry.
16	func WatchAgents(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(providerID string, session *spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
17		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
18		providers := registry.GetAll()
19	
20		if len(providers) == 0 {
21			return fmt.Errorf("no providers registered")
22		}
23	
24		return WatchProviders(ctx, projectPath, providers, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
25	}
26	
27	// WatchProviders starts watchers for the given providers concurrently.
28	// Calls sessionCallback when any provider detects activity.
29	// Runs until context is cancelled or all watchers stop.
30	// Context cancellation (Ctrl+C) is treated as a clean exit, not an error.
31	//
32	// Parameters:
33	//   - ctx: Context for cancellation and timeout control
34	//   - projectPath: Agent's working directory to watch
35	//   - providers: map of provider ID to provider instance to watch
36	//   - debugRaw: whether to write debug raw data files
37	//   - sessionCallback: called with provider ID and AgentChatSession data on each update
38	//
39	// The callback includes the provider ID to help consumers route/filter sessions.
40	// The callback should not block as it may delay other provider notifications.
41	func WatchProviders(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, providers map[string]spi.Provider, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(providerID string, session *spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
42		slog.Info("WatchProviders: Starting multi-provider watch", "projectPath", projectPath, "providerCount", len(providers), "debugRaw", debugRaw)
43	
44		// Track last-seen message count per session to suppress duplicate callbacks.
45		// Providers fire callbacks on every JSONL change, but not all changes produce
46		// new messages in the parsed SessionData. Messages are append-only, so a
47		// matching total count means nothing meaningful changed.
48		var mu sync.Mutex
49		lastMsgCount := make(map[string]int)
50	
51		var wg sync.WaitGroup
52		errChan := make(chan error, len(providers))
53	
54		for providerID, provider := range providers {
55			wg.Add(1)
56			go func() {
57				defer wg.Done()
58	
59				slog.Info("WatchProviders: Starting watcher for provider", "providerID", providerID, "providerName", provider.Name())
60	
61				// Wrap the callback to deduplicate and include provider ID
62				wrappedCallback := func(session *spi.AgentChatSession) {
63					if session == nil || session.SessionData == nil {
64						return
65					}
66	
67					// Count total messages across all exchanges
68					totalMsgs := 0
69					for _, exchange := range session.SessionData.Exchanges {
70						totalMsgs += len(exchange.Messages)
71					}
72	
73					// Skip if message count hasn't changed for this session
74					mu.Lock()
75					prev, seen := lastMsgCount[session.SessionID]
76					if seen && prev == totalMsgs {
77						mu.Unlock()
78						slog.Debug("WatchProviders: Skipping duplicate callback",
79							"providerID", providerID,
80							"sessionID", session.SessionID,
81							"totalMsgs", totalMsgs)
82						return
83					}
84					lastMsgCount[session.SessionID] = totalMsgs
85					mu.Unlock()
86	
87					slog.Debug("WatchProviders: Provider callback fired",
88						"providerID", providerID,
89						"sessionID", session.SessionID,
90						"totalMsgs", totalMsgs)
91	
92					sessionCallback(providerID, session)
93				}
94	
95				err := provider.WatchAgent(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, wrappedCallback)
96				if err != nil {
97					// Context cancellation is expected when user presses Ctrl+C, not an error
98					if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
99						slog.Info("WatchProviders: Provider watcher stopped", "provider", provider.Name())
100						errChan <- nil
101					} else {
102						slog.Error("WatchProviders: Provider watcher failed", "provider", provider.Name(), "error", err)
103						errChan <- fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", provider.Name(), err)
104					}
105				} else {
106					errChan <- nil
107				}
108			}()
109		}
110	
111		// Wait for all watchers to complete (they run until Ctrl+C)
112		wg.Wait()
113	
114		// Drain error channel — errors are already logged in the goroutines with full context
115		for range len(providers) {
116			<-errChan
117		}
118	
119		return nil
120	}
121

24		notYetSupport = "pi: %s not yet supported for the pi provider (v1 ships sync/list/search/reindex only)"
25	)

27	// Provider implements spi.Provider for the pi coding agent.
28	// pi stores sessions as JSONL v3 trees under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/.
29	type Provider struct{}
30	
31	// NewProvider returns a new pi provider instance.
32	func NewProvider() *Provider { return &Provider{} }
33	
34	// Name returns the human-readable provider name.
35	func (p *Provider) Name() string { return providerName }
36	
37	// Check verifies the pi binary is on PATH and reports its version.
38	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
45		if err != nil {
46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
47			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "not_found", err.Error())
48			return spi.CheckResult{
49				Success:      false,
50				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi binary '%s' not found on PATH", cmdName),
51			}
52		}
53		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())
60			return spi.CheckResult{
61				Success:      false,
62				Location:     resolved,
63				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi version probe failed: %v", err),
64			}
65		}
66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}

129	
130	// sessionFile pairs a discovered pi session file with its header metadata.
131	type sessionFile struct {
132		Path   string
133		Header sessionHeader
134	}
135	
136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}
154	
155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}
425

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Extract pi official session-format docs from real session

```bash
F=~/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-jakelevirne-dev-getspecstory--/2026-07-09T18-48-54-004Z_019f4836-1df4-79e7-83b0-57a808be0c71.jsonl
python3 -c "
import json
with open('$F') as f:
    for line in f:
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        try: e=json.loads(line)
        except: continue
        m=e.get('message',{})
        if isinstance(m,dict) and m.get('role')=='toolResult':
            d=m.get('details') or {}
            if isinstance(d,dict) and 'session-format' in json.dumps(d.get('urls','')):
                for c in m.get('content',[]):
                    if c.get('type')=='text':
                        print(c['text'][:12000])
                break
"
```

```text
Sessions are stored as JSONL (JSON Lines) files. Each line is a JSON object with a `type` field. Session entries form a tree structure via `id`/`parentId` fields, enabling in-place branching without creating new files.

```
~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<path>--/<timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl
```

Where `<path>` is the working directory with `/` replaced by `-`.

Sessions can be removed by deleting their `.jsonl` files under `~/.pi/agent/sessions/`.

Pi also supports deleting sessions interactively from `/resume` (select a session and press `Ctrl+D`, then confirm). When available, pi uses the `trash` CLI to avoid permanent deletion.

Sessions have a version field in the header:

*   **Version 1**: Linear entry sequence (legacy, auto-migrated on load)
*   **Version 2**: Tree structure with `id`/`parentId` linking
*   **Version 3**: Renamed `hookMessage` role to `custom` (extensions unification)

Existing sessions are automatically migrated to the current version (v3) when loaded.

Source on GitHub ([pi-mono](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono)):

*   [`packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts`](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts) - Session entry types and SessionManager
*   [`packages/coding-agent/src/core/messages.ts`](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/messages.ts) - Extended message types (BashExecutionMessage, CustomMessage, etc.)
*   [`packages/ai/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/ai/src/types.ts) - Base message types (UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ToolResultMessage)
*   [`packages/agent/src/types.ts`](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/agent/src/types.ts) - AgentMessage union type

For TypeScript definitions in your project, inspect `node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/` and `node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/`.

Session entries contain `AgentMessage` objects. Understanding these types is essential for parsing sessions and writing extensions.

Messages contain arrays of typed content blocks:

```
interface TextContent {
  type: "text";
  text: string;
}

interface ImageContent {
  type: "image";
  data: string;      // base64 encoded
  mimeType: string;  // e.g., "image/jpeg", "image/png"
}

interface ThinkingContent {
  type: "thinking";
  thinking: string;
}

interface ToolCall {
  type: "toolCall";
  id: string;
  name: string;
  arguments: Record<string, any>;
}
```

### Base Message Types (from pi-ai)

[Copied](#base-message-types-from-pi-ai)

```
interface UserMessage {
  role: "user";
  content: string | (TextContent | ImageContent)[];
  timestamp: number;  // Unix ms
}

interface AssistantMessage {
  role: "assistant";
  content: (TextContent | ThinkingContent | ToolCall)[];
  api: string;
  provider: string;
  model: string;
  usage: Usage;
  stopReason: "stop" | "length" | "toolUse" | "error" | "aborted";
  errorMessage?: string;
  timestamp: number;
}

interface ToolResultMessage {
  role: "toolResult";
  toolCallId: string;
  toolName: string;
  content: (TextContent | ImageContent)[];
  details?: any;      // Tool-specific metadata
  isError: boolean;
  timestamp: number;
}

interface Usage {
  input: number;
  output: number;
  cacheRead: number;
  cacheWrite: number;
  totalTokens: number;
  cost: {
    input: number;
    output: number;
    cacheRead: number;
    cacheWrite: number;
    total: number;
  };
}
```

### Extended Message Types (from pi-coding-agent)

[Copied](#extended-message-types-from-pi-coding-agent)

```
interface BashExecutionMessage {
  role: "bashExecution";
  command: string;
  output: string;
  exitCode: number | undefined;
  cancelled: boolean;
  truncated: boolean;
  fullOutputPath?: string;
  excludeFromContext?: boolean;  // true for !! prefix commands
  timestamp: number;
}

interface CustomMessage {
  role: "custom";
  customType: string;            // Extension identifier
  content: string | (TextContent | ImageContent)[];
  display: boolean;              // Show in TUI
  details?: any;                 // Extension-specific metadata
  timestamp: number;
}

interface BranchSummaryMessage {
  role: "branchSummary";
  summary: string;
  fromId: string;                // Entry we branched from
  timestamp: number;
}

interface CompactionSummaryMessage {
  role: "compactionSummary";
  summary: string;
  tokensBefore: number;
  timestamp: number;
}
```

### AgentMessage Union

[Copied](#agentmessage-union)

```
type AgentMessage =
  | UserMessage
  | AssistantMessage
  | ToolResultMessage
  | BashExecutionMessage
  | CustomMessage
  | BranchSummaryMessage
  | CompactionSummaryMessage;
```

All entries (except `SessionHeader`) extend `SessionEntryBase`:

```
interface SessionEntryBase {
  type: string;
  id: string;           // 8-char hex ID
  parentId: string | null;  // Parent entry ID (null for first entry)
  timestamp: string;    // ISO timestamp
}
```

First line of the file. Metadata only, not part of the tree (no `id`/`parentId`).

```
{"type":"session","version":3,"id":"uuid","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:00:00.000Z","cwd":"/path/to/project"}
```

For sessions with a parent (created via `/fork`, `/clone`, or `newSession({ parentSession })`):

```
{"type":"session","version":3,"id":"uuid","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:00:00.000Z","cwd":"/path/to/project","parentSession":"/path/to/original/session.jsonl"}
```

### SessionMessageEntry

[Copied](#sessionmessageentry)

A message in the conversation. The `message` field contains an `AgentMessage`.

```
{"type":"message","id":"a1b2c3d4","parentId":"prev1234","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:00:01.000Z","message":{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}}
{"type":"message","id":"b2c3d4e5","parentId":"a1b2c3d4","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:00:02.000Z","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Hi!"}],"provider":"anthropic","model":"claude-sonnet-4-5","usage":{...},"stopReason":"stop"}}
{"type":"message","id":"c3d4e5f6","parentId":"b2c3d4e5","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:00:03.000Z","message":{"role":"toolResult","toolCallId":"call_123","toolName":"bash","content":[{"type":"text","text":"output"}],"isError":false}}
```

Emitted when the user switches models mid-session.

```
{"type":"model_change","id":"d4e5f6g7","parentId":"c3d4e5f6","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:05:00.000Z","provider":"openai","modelId":"gpt-4o"}
```

### ThinkingLevelChangeEntry

[Copied](#thinkinglevelchangeentry)

Emitted when the user changes the thinking/reasoning level.

```
{"type":"thinking_level_change","id":"e5f6g7h8","parentId":"d4e5f6g7","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:06:00.000Z","thinkingLevel":"high"}
```

Created when context is compacted. Stores a summary of earlier messages.

```
{"type":"compaction","id":"f6g7h8i9","parentId":"e5f6g7h8","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:10:00.000Z","summary":"User discussed X, Y, Z...","firstKeptEntryId":"c3d4e5f6","tokensBefore":50000}
```

Optional fields:

*   `details`: Implementation-specific data (e.g., `{ readFiles: string[], modifiedFiles: string[] }` for default, or custom data for extensions)
*   `fromHook`: `true` if generated by an extension, `false`/`undefined` if pi-generated (legacy field name)

### BranchSummaryEntry

[Copied](#branchsummaryentry)

Created when switching branches via `/tree` with an LLM generated summary of the left branch up to the common ancestor. Captures context from the abandoned path.

```
{"type":"branch_summary","id":"g7h8i9j0","parentId":"a1b2c3d4","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:15:00.000Z","fromId":"f6g7h8i9","summary":"Branch explored approach A..."}
```

Optional fields:

*   `details`: File tracking data (`{ readFiles: string[], modifiedFiles: string[] }`) for default, or custom data for extensions
*   `fromHook`: `true` if generated by an extension, `false`/`undefined` if pi-generated (legacy field name)

Extension state persistence. Does NOT participate in LLM context.

```
{"type":"custom","id":"h8i9j0k1","parentId":"g7h8i9j0","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:20:00.000Z","customType":"my-extension","data":{"count":42}}
```

Use `customType` to identify your extension's entries on reload. Interactive mode can render custom entries via `pi.registerEntryRenderer(customType, renderer)`, but they still do not participate in LLM context.

### CustomMessageEntry

[Copied](#custommessageentry)

Extension-injected messages that DO participate in LLM context.

```
{"type":"custom_message","id":"i9j0k1l2","parentId":"h8i9j0k1","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:25:00.000Z","customType":"my-extension","content":"Injected context...","display":true}
```

Fields:

*   `content`: String or `(TextContent | ImageContent)[]` (same as UserMessage)
*   `display`: `true` = show in TUI with distinct styling, `false` = hidden
*   `details`: Optional extension-specific metadata (not sent to LLM)

User-defined bookmark/marker on an entry.

```
{"type":"label","id":"j0k1l2m3","parentId":"i9j0k1l2","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:30:00.000Z","targetId":"a1b2c3d4","label":"checkpoint-1"}
```

Set `label` to `undefined` to clear a label.

Session metadata (e.g., user-defined display name). Set via `/name`, `--name` / `-n`, or `pi.setSessionName()` in extensions.

```
{"type":"session_info","id":"k1l2m3n4","parentId":"j0k1l2m3","timestamp":"2024-12-03T14:35:00.000Z","name":"Refactor auth module"}
```

The session name is displayed in the session selector (`/resume`) instead of the first message when set.

Entries form a tree:

*   First entry has `parentId: null`
*   Each subsequent entry points to its parent via `parentId`
*   Branching creates new children from an earlier entry
*   The "leaf" is the current position in the tree

```
[user msg] ─── [assistant] ─── [user msg] ─── [assistant] ─┬─ [user msg] ← current leaf
                                                            │
                                                            └─ [branch_summary] ─── [user msg] ← alternate branch
```

`buildContextEntries()` walks from the current leaf to the root, producing the active entry list while honoring compaction:

1.  Collects all entries on the path
2.  If a `CompactionEntry` is on the path:
    *   Includes the compaction entry first
    *   Then entries from `firstKeptEntryId` to compaction
    *   Then entries after compaction
3.  Preserves non-message entries in the selected range so interactive mode can render them

`buildSessionContext()` builds on that entry list to produce the message list for the LLM:

1.  Extracts current model and thinking level settings from the full path
2.  Converts selected entries to messages:
    *   `message` -> stored `AgentMessage`
    *   `compaction` -> `compactionSummary`
    *   `branch_summary` -> `branchSummary`
    *   `custom_message` -> `CustomMessage`
    *   `custom` -> no context message

```

```text
package claudecode

import (
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

// projectDirNameRegex matches any character that is not alphanumeric or a dash.
// Claude Code replaces each such character with a dash to map a working directory
// to a project folder name under ~/.claude/projects.
var projectDirNameRegex = regexp.MustCompile(`[^a-zA-Z0-9-]`)

// encodeProjectDirName converts a real (symlink-resolved) path into Claude Code's
// project directory name: non-alphanumeric/dash characters become dashes, with a
// guaranteed leading dash. Example: "/Users/sean/app" -> "-Users-sean-app".
func encodeProjectDirName(realPath string) string {
	name := projectDirNameRegex.ReplaceAllString(realPath, "-")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "-") {
		name = "-" + name
	}
	return name
}

// resolveClaudeProjectDir returns ~/.claude/projects/<encoded> for the given
// project path, resolving symlinks, WITHOUT requiring the directory to exist.
// Used when writing a reconstructed session into the store (the caller creates
// the directory). Distinct from GetClaudeCodeProjectDir, which requires the
// projects directory to already exist.
func resolveClaudeProjectDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
	homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get user home directory: %v", err)
	}

	cwd := projectPath
	if cwd == "" {
		cwd, err = os.Getwd()
		if err != nil {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get current working directory: %v", err)
		}
	}

	// Resolve symlinks to match Claude Code's behavior; fall back to the raw path
	// if resolution fails (e.g., a path component does not exist yet).
	realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
	if err != nil {
		realPath = cwd
	}

	return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".claude", "projects", encodeProjectDirName(realPath)), nil
}

// GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir returns the path to the Claude Code projects directory
func GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir() (string, error) {
	// Get user's home directory
	homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get user home directory: %v", err)
	}

	// Construct the path to .claude/projects
	projectsDir := filepath.Join(homeDir, ".claude", "projects")

	// Check if the directory exists
	if _, err := os.Stat(projectsDir); err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("claude projects directory not found at %s", projectsDir)
		}
		return "", fmt.Errorf("error checking Claude projects directory: %v", err)
	}

	return projectsDir, nil
}

// GetClaudeCodeProjectDir returns the Claude Code project directory for the given path.
// If no path is provided (empty string), it uses the current working directory.
```

// extractCodexSessionMetadata reads minimal data from a Codex CLI session to extract metadata
// Returns nil if the session is empty or has no user messages
func extractCodexSessionMetadata(sessionInfo *codexSessionInfo) (*spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(sessionInfo.SessionPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open session file: %w", err)
	}
	defer func() {
		_ = file.Close()
	}()

	reader := bufio.NewReader(file)
	var firstUserMessage string
	lineNum := 0

	// Read records until we find a user message or reach EOF.
	// Why: ReadString can return data AND io.EOF on the last line (no trailing newline),
	// so we always process the line first, then check for EOF once at the bottom.
	for {
		line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
		if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read line: %w", readErr)
		}

		lineNum++
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)

		if line != "" {
			// Parse JSON record
			var record map[string]interface{}
			if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &record); jsonErr != nil {
				slog.Warn("Skipping malformed JSONL line",
					"file", filepath.Base(sessionInfo.SessionPath),
					"line", lineNum,
					"error", jsonErr)
			} else if recordType, ok := record["type"].(string); ok && recordType == "event_msg" {
				if payload, ok := record["payload"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					if payloadType, ok := payload["type"].(string); ok && payloadType == "user_message" {
						if message, ok := payload["message"].(string); ok && message != "" {
							firstUserMessage = message
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		// Single exit: found what we need, or reached end of file
		if firstUserMessage != "" || readErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
	}

	// If no user message found, session is empty
	if firstUserMessage == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	// Generate slug from first user message
	slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstUserMessage)

	// Generate human-readable name from first user message
	name := spi.GenerateReadableName(firstUserMessage)

	return &spi.SessionMetadata{
		SessionID: sessionInfo.SessionID,
		CreatedAt: sessionInfo.Meta.Timestamp,
		Slug:      slug,
		Name:      name,
	}, nil
}

function buildEntryIndex(entries, byId) {
    if (byId)
        return byId;
    const index = new Map();
    for (const entry of entries) {
        index.set(entry.id, entry);
    }

}
function buildSessionPath(entries, leafId, byId) {
    const index = buildEntryIndex(entries, byId);
    let leaf;
    if (leafId === null) {
        return [];
    }
    if (leafId) {
        leaf = index.get(leafId);
    }
    leaf ??= entries[entries.length - 1];
    if (!leaf) {
        return [];
    }
    const path = [];
    let current = leaf;
    while (current) {
        path.push(current);
        current = current.parentId ? index.get(current.parentId) : undefined;
    }
    path.reverse();
    return path;
}
function getSessionContextSettings(path) {
    let thinkingLevel = "off";
    let model = null;
    for (const entry of path) {
        if (entry.type === "thinking_level_change") {
            thinkingLevel = entry.thinkingLevel;
        }
        else if (entry.type === "model_change") {
            model = { provider: entry.provider, modelId: entry.modelId };
        }
        else if (entry.type === "message" && entry.message.role === "assistant") {
            model = { provider: entry.message.provider, modelId: entry.message.model };
        }
    }
