```text
// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
	header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if header == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
	}
	if header.Type != entrySession {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
	}
	if header.ID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
	}
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
	}
	ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
	return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
}

// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
	if header.Version > 0 {
		return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
	}
	return "v1"
}

// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
	return &schema.SessionData{
		SchemaVersion: "1.0",
		Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
			ID:      providerID,
			Name:    providerName,
			Version: piProviderVersion(header),
		},
		SessionID:     header.ID,
		CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
		WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
		Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
	}
}

// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
	var exchanges []schema.Exchange
	var current *schema.Exchange
	commit := func() {
		if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
			exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
		}
	}
	for _, e := range ordered {
		if e.Type != entryMessage {
			continue
		}
		switch messageRole(e) {
		case roleUser:
			commit()
			current = &schema.Exchange{
				ExchangeID: e.ID,
				StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
				EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
				Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
			}
		case roleAssistant:
			current = appendAssistant(current, e)
		case roleToolResult:
			mergeToolResult(current, e)
		}
	}
	commit()
	return exchanges
}

// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating
// one if none exists yet.
func appendAssistant(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) *schema.Exchange {
	if current == nil {
		current = &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: e.ID, StartTime: e.Timestamp}
	}
	current.Messages = append(current.Messages, buildAgentMessages(e)...)
	current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
```

```text
			seenSessions := make(map[string]bool)

			// Session callback for watch mode output
			sessionCallback := func(providerID string, sess *spi.AgentChatSession) {
				// Check if markdown file already exists to determine if this is an update or creation
				fileFullPath := session.BuildSessionFilePath(sess, config.GetHistoryDir(), useUTC)
				_, fileExistsErr := os.Stat(fileFullPath)
				fileExists := fileExistsErr == nil

				// Process the session (write markdown and sync to cloud)
				// Don't show output during watch mode
				// This is autosave mode (true)
				markdownSize, err := session.ProcessSingleSession(ctx, sess, config, session.ProcessingOptions{
					OnlyCloudSync:      onlyCloudSync,
					IsAutosave:         true,
					DebugRaw:           debugRaw,
					UseUTC:             useUTC,
					NoTelemetryPrompts: noTelemetryPrompts,
				})
				if err != nil {
					// Log error but continue - don't fail the whole watch
					// In watch mode, we prioritize keeping the watcher running.
					// Failed markdown writes or cloud syncs can be retried later via
					// the sync command, so we just log and continue.
					slog.Error("Failed to process session update",
						"sessionId", sess.SessionID,
						"provider", providerID,
						"error", err)
					return
				}

				// Mirror the markdown write into the restore index in real time.
				liveIndex.Record(providerID, sess)

				// Suppress output for existing sessions seen for the first time (initial scan).
				// New sessions (!fileExists) always get output since they represent real activity.
				seenMu.Lock()
				firstSeen := !seenSessions[sess.SessionID]
				seenSessions[sess.SessionID] = true
				seenMu.Unlock()
				if firstSeen && fileExists {
					return
				}

				// Output formatted line to stdout for watch mode
				if !log.IsSilent() {
					// Determine if this was an update or creation
					action := "updated"
					if !fileExists {
						action = "created"
					}

					// Get timestamps from session data
					startTime := sess.CreatedAt
					endTime := startTime
					if sess.SessionData != nil && sess.SessionData.UpdatedAt != "" {
						endTime = sess.SessionData.UpdatedAt
					}

					// Count messages by role
					userPrompts := 0
					agentActivity := 0
					if sess.SessionData != nil {
						for _, exchange := range sess.SessionData.Exchanges {
							for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
								if msg.Role == schema.RoleUser {
									userPrompts++
								} else {
									agentActivity++
								}
							}
						}
					}

					// Output the formatted line
					if jsonOutput {
						record := map[string]interface{}{
							"timestamp":          time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
							"action":             action,
							"session_id":         sess.SessionID,
							"start_time":         startTime,
							"end_time":           endTime,
							"provider":           providerID,
							"markdown_size":      markdownSize,
							"total_user_prompts": userPrompts,
							"agent_activity":     agentActivity,
						}
						if !onlyCloudSync {
							record["markdown_file"] = fileFullPath
						}
						_ = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(record)
					} else {
						emoji := "♻️"
						if action == "created" {
							emoji = "✨"
						}
						activityWord := "activities"
						if agentActivity == 1 {
							activityWord = "activity"
						}
						promptWord := "prompts"
						if userPrompts == 1 {
							promptWord = "prompt"
						}
						fmt.Printf("  %s  %s  %s · %s · %d %s · %d agent %s\n",
							time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
							emoji,
							providerID,
							truncateSessionID(sess.SessionID),
							userPrompts,
							promptWord,
							agentActivity,
							activityWord)
					}
				}

				// Push agent events to provenance engine for correlation
				provenance.ProcessEvents(ctx, provenanceEngine, sess)
			}

			return utils.WatchProviders(ctx, cwd, providers, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
		},
	}
```

```text
107	// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
108	// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
109	// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
110	// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if header == nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
118		}
119		if header.Type != entrySession {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
121		}
122		if header.ID == "" {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
130	}

132	// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
133	// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
134	// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
135	func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
136		if header.Version > 0 {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
138		}
139		return "v1"
140	}

142	// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
143	func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
144		return &schema.SessionData{
145			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
146			Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
147				ID:      providerID,
148				Name:    providerName,
149				Version: piProviderVersion(header),
150			},
151			SessionID:     header.ID,
152			CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
153			WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
154			Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
155		}
156	}

158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}

193	// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating

196		if current == nil {

198		}
199		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, buildAgentMessages(e)...)
200		current.EndTime = e.Timestamp

213	// mergeToolResult folds a toolResult entry into the matching agent ToolInfo in

215	// the exchange EndTime to the toolResult's timestamp so downstream stats that
216	// read the last exchange's EndTime report the real final-event time.
217	func mergeToolResult(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) {
218		if current == nil {

262	// userContentParts decodes a pi user message's content (string or array) into
263	// schema ContentParts. Image blocks are dropped in v1 (recorded as a gap).
264	func userContentParts(raw json.RawMessage) []schema.ContentPart {
265		if len(raw) == 0 {
266			return nil
267		}
268		if raw[0] == '"' {
269			var s string
270			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
271				return []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: s}}
272			}
273		}
274		var blocks []contentBlock
275		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
276			return nil
277		}
278		var parts []schema.ContentPart
279		for _, b := range blocks {
280			if b.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && b.Text != "" {
281				parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
282			}
283		}
284		return parts

287	// buildAgentMessages maps a pi assistant message entry to one or more schema
288	// Messages: one Message holds the text+thinking content parts; each toolCall
289	// block becomes its own agent Message carrying a ToolInfo.
290	func buildAgentMessages(e rawEntry) []schema.Message {
291		var am assistantMessage
292		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &am); err != nil {
293			return nil
294		}
295		var parts []schema.ContentPart
296		var messages []schema.Message
297		for _, b := range am.Content {
298			switch b.Type {
299			case schema.ContentTypeText:
300				if b.Text != "" {
301					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
302				}
303			case schema.ContentTypeThinking:
304				if b.Thinking != "" {
305					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: b.Thinking})
306				}
307			case "toolCall":

312			head := schema.Message{

366	// buildToolOutput constructs the ToolInfo.Output map from a toolResult's
367	// content, error flag, and optional details blob. details (e.g. exitCode) is
368	// decoded into a generic value so downstream consumers (markdown rendering,
369	// cloud) can surface structured tool metadata without re-parsing raw JSON.
370	func buildToolOutput(content string, tr toolResultMessage) map[string]any {
371		out := map[string]any{"content": content, "is_error": tr.IsError}
372		if len(tr.Details) > 0 {
373			var details any
374			if err := json.Unmarshal(tr.Details, &details); err == nil {
375				out["details"] = details
376			}
377		}
378		return out
379	}
380	
381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style
383	// cache fields (pi uses the same semantics).
384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}
```

```text
// buildSession turns one enumeration ref into a fully-built index row. Every session
// yields a row from its metadata; the body + turn counts + last-activity time are
// ENRICHED via a full parse only when the originating cwd lets us re-locate the
// session (so Cursor, whose cwd is unknown for now, lands metadata-only). Nothing is
// dropped.
func buildSession(item reindexItem, cache *projectIDCache, indexedAt string) sessionindex.Session {
	ref := item.ref
	projectID, projectName := cache.resolve(ref.OriginCwd)

	sess := sessionindex.Session{
		ProjectID:    projectID,
		ProjectName:  projectName,
		Agent:        item.agent,
		SessionID:    ref.SessionID,
		CreatedAt:    ref.CreatedAt,
		UpdatedAt:    ref.CreatedAt, // default; overwritten by last-turn timestamp below
		Slug:         ref.Slug,
		Name:         ref.Name,
		NativePath:   ref.NativePath,
		OriginCwd:    ref.OriginCwd,
		Size:         item.size, // captured during the freshness check (no re-stat)
		Mtime:        item.mtime,
		IndexVersion: reindexVersion,
		IndexedAt:    indexedAt,
		IsNew:        item.isNew,
	}

	if ref.OriginCwd == "" {
		return sess // cannot re-locate without a cwd → metadata-only
	}
	full, err := parseFullSession(item.prov, ref)
	if err != nil || full == nil || full.SessionData == nil {
		slog.Debug("reindex: full parse unavailable, indexing metadata only",
			"agent", item.agent, "session", ref.SessionID, "error", err)
		return sess
	}

	data := full.SessionData
	sess.Body = flattenBody(data)
	sess.UserTurns, sess.TotalTurns = countTurns(data)
	if ts := lastTimestamp(data); ts != "" {
		sess.UpdatedAt = ts
	}
	return sess
}

// parseFullSession reads a session's full data for indexing. It prefers a provider's
// path-keyed parse (spi.PathSessionReader) using the ref's already-known NativePath, which
// avoids the provider's by-id discovery search — for Codex that search walks the entire
// ~/.codex/sessions tree, so this is the difference between an O(N) and an O(N²) reindex.
// Providers without the capability (or refs lacking a NativePath) fall back to the by-id
// lookup. Parsing the known NativePath is also more consistent: the row's freshness
// fingerprint is stat'd from NativePath, so the body now comes from that same file.
func parseFullSession(prov spi.Provider, ref spi.GlobalSessionRef) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
	if pr, ok := prov.(spi.PathSessionReader); ok && ref.NativePath != "" {
		return pr.GetAgentChatSessionByPath(ref.NativePath, ref.OriginCwd, false)
	}
	return prov.GetAgentChatSession(ref.OriginCwd, ref.SessionID, false)
```

```text
107	// GetIntFromMap safely extracts an int from a map[string]interface{}.
108	// JSON numbers are unmarshaled as float64, so we handle that case.
109	func GetIntFromMap(m map[string]interface{}, key string) int {
110		if m == nil {
111			return 0
112		}
113		if val, ok := m[key]; ok {
114			switch v := val.(type) {
115			case float64:
116				return int(v)
117			case int64:
118				return int(v)
119			case int:
120				return v
121			}
122		}
123		return 0
124	}
```

```text
281	// Handles Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Droid CLI specific token fields.
282	func countExchangeTokens(exchange schema.Exchange) TokenUsage {

286				// Common fields (all providers)

288				usage.OutputTokens += msg.Usage.OutputTokens

291				usage.CacheReadInputTokens += msg.Usage.CacheReadInputTokens
292				// Codex CLI specific

295				// Gemini CLI specific
```

```text
539	// buildDAGs constructs parent/child DAGs from records
540	func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGs(records []JSONLRecord) [][]JSONLRecord {
541		// Build a parentUuid->children adjacency map in one pass. Precomputing children here is what
542		// keeps DAG building O(N): the traversal below can then look a node's children up directly.
543		// The previous version re-scanned the entire record set to find children at every node it
544		// visited, making a whole-project parse O(N²) — tens of seconds for a project with ~25k
545		// records (the dominant cost of `specstory sync`).
546		childrenByParent := make(map[string][]JSONLRecord)
547		roots := []JSONLRecord{}
548		for _, record := range records {
549			if _, ok := record.Data["uuid"].(string); !ok {
550				continue // a record with no uuid can be neither traversed nor linked
551			}
552			if parentUuid, ok := record.Data["parentUuid"].(string); ok {
553				childrenByParent[parentUuid] = append(childrenByParent[parentUuid], record)
554			} else if record.Data["parentUuid"] == nil {
555				// A nil parentUuid marks a root node (the start of a conversation).
556				roots = append(roots, record)
557			}
558		}
559	
560		// Sort each child list by timestamp once, giving the same deterministic traversal order the
561		// per-node sort used to — but paid O(N log N) total across the forest instead of per visit.
562		for parentUuid := range childrenByParent {
563			children := childrenByParent[parentUuid]
564			sort.Slice(children, func(i, j int) bool {
565				tsI, _ := children[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
566				tsJ, _ := children[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
567				return tsI < tsJ
568			})
569		}
570	
571		// Build a DAG for each root
572		dags := [][]JSONLRecord{}
573		for _, root := range roots {
574			dag := p.buildDAGFromRoot(root, childrenByParent)
575			if len(dag) > 0 {
576				dags = append(dags, dag)
577			}
578		}
579	
580		return dags
581	}
582	
583	// buildDAGFromRoot builds a DAG starting from a root node, following the precomputed
584	// parentUuid->children adjacency (already timestamp-sorted in buildDAGs).
585	func (p *JSONLParser) buildDAGFromRoot(root JSONLRecord, childrenByParent map[string][]JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
586		dag := []JSONLRecord{}
587		visited := make(map[string]bool)
588	
589		var traverse func(node JSONLRecord)
590		traverse = func(node JSONLRecord) {
591			uuid, ok := node.Data["uuid"].(string)
592			if !ok || visited[uuid] {
593				return
594			}
595	
596			visited[uuid] = true
597			dag = append(dag, node)
598	
599			// Children are precomputed and already sorted by timestamp.
600			for _, child := range childrenByParent[uuid] {
601				traverse(child)
602			}
603		}
604	
605		traverse(root)
606		return dag
607	}
608	
609	// flattenDAG flattens a DAG into an array ordered by timestamp
610	func (p *JSONLParser) flattenDAG(dag []JSONLRecord) []JSONLRecord {
611		// Sort by timestamp, with parent-child relationships as tiebreaker
612		sort.Slice(dag, func(i, j int) bool {
613			tsI, _ := dag[i].Data["timestamp"].(string)
614			tsJ, _ := dag[j].Data["timestamp"].(string)
615			if tsI != tsJ {
616				return tsI < tsJ
617			}
618			// If timestamps are equal, check parent-child relationship
619			uuidI, _ := dag[i].Data["uuid"].(string)
620			uuidJ, _ := dag[j].Data["uuid"].(string)
621			parentI, _ := dag[i].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
622			parentJ, _ := dag[j].Data["parentUuid"].(string)
623	
624			// If j is the parent of i, j should come first
625			if parentI == uuidJ {
626				return false
627			}
628			// If i is the parent of j, i should come first
629			if parentJ == uuidI {
630				return true
631			}
632			// Otherwise, sort by UUID for deterministic ordering
633			return uuidI < uuidJ
634		})
635	
636		return dag
637	}
638	
639	// FindSession returns a pointer to the session with the given UUID
640	func (p *JSONLParser) FindSession(sessionUuid string) *Session {
641		for i := range p.Sessions {
642			if p.Sessions[i].SessionUuid == sessionUuid {
643				return &p.Sessions[i]
644			}
645		}
646		return nil
647	}
648	
649	// FindRecord returns a pointer to the first record that matches the given filter function
650	func (p *JSONLParser) FindRecord(filter func(JSONLRecord) bool) *JSONLRecord {
651		for i := range p.Records {
652			if filter(p.Records[i]) {
653				return &p.Records[i]
654			}
655		}
656		return nil
657	}
```

```text
22		entryLabel               = "label"
23		entrySessionInfo         = "session_info"
24	)

26	// messageRole constants for pi message entries.
27	const (
28		roleUser          = "user"
29		roleAssistant     = "assistant"
30		roleToolResult    = "toolResult"
31		roleBashExecution = "bashExecution"
32		roleCustom        = "custom"
33		roleBranchSummary = "branchSummary"
34		roleCompaction    = "compactionSummary"
35	)
36	
37	// rawEntry is the minimal envelope every pi entry shares. The message payload
38	// (for type=="message") is kept as raw json.RawMessage so we can decode it per
39	// role without fighting a single union struct. Compaction entries carry
40	// firstKeptEntryId as a top-level field (no message wrapper).
41	type rawEntry struct {
42		Type             string          `json:"type"`
43		ID               string          `json:"id"`
44		ParentID         *string         `json:"parentId"` // null for the first entry
45		Timestamp        string          `json:"timestamp"`
46		FirstKeptEntryID string          `json:"firstKeptEntryId,omitempty"` // compaction entries only
47		Message          json.RawMessage `json:"message,omitempty"`
48	}
49	
50	// sessionHeader is the first line of a pi session file (no id/parentId).
51	type sessionHeader struct {
52		Type      string `json:"type"`
53		Version   int    `json:"version"`
54		ID        string `json:"id"`
55		Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
56		Cwd       string `json:"cwd"`
57	}
58	
59	// contentBlock is one element of an assistant or user message content array.
60	type contentBlock struct {
61		Type     string         `json:"type"`
62		Text     string         `json:"text,omitempty"`
63		Thinking string         `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
64		ID       string         `json:"id,omitempty"`
65		Name     string         `json:"name,omitempty"`
66		Args     map[string]any `json:"arguments,omitempty"`
67	}
68	
69	// userMessage is a pi user-role message: content is string OR []contentBlock.
70	type userMessage struct {
71		Role      string          `json:"role"`
72		Content   json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
73		Timestamp int64           `json:"timestamp"`
74	}
75	
76	// assistantMessage is a pi assistant-role message.
77	type assistantMessage struct {
78		Role         string         `json:"role"`
79		Content      []contentBlock `json:"content"`
80		Provider     string         `json:"provider"`
81		Model        string         `json:"model"`
82		API          string         `json:"api"`
83		StopReason   string         `json:"stopReason"`
84		ErrorMessage string         `json:"errorMessage,omitempty"`
85		Usage        *piUsage       `json:"usage,omitempty"`
86	}
87	
88	// piUsage is the token-usage shape on a pi assistant message.
89	type piUsage struct {
90		Input       int64 `json:"input"`
91		Output      int64 `json:"output"`
92		CacheRead   int64 `json:"cacheRead"`
93		CacheWrite  int64 `json:"cacheWrite"`
94		TotalTokens int64 `json:"totalTokens"`
95	}
96	
97	// toolResultMessage is a pi toolResult-role message (a top-level entry).
98	type toolResultMessage struct {
99		Role       string          `json:"role"`
100		ToolCallID string          `json:"toolCallId"`
101		ToolName   string          `json:"toolName"`
102		Content    []contentBlock  `json:"content"`
103		Details    json.RawMessage `json:"details,omitempty"` // tool-specific metadata (e.g. exitCode)
104		IsError    bool            `json:"isError"`
105	}
106	
107	// ParseSession reads a pi JSONL v3 session file and maps its current leaf-path
108	// branch into the unified schema.SessionData. It honors compaction entries:
109	// when a compaction entry is on the leaf path, entries before firstKeptEntryId
110	// are dropped from the conversation (matching pi's buildContextEntries).
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		if header == nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: no session header in %s", path)
118		}
119		if header.Type != entrySession {
120			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: %s is not a pi session (header type %q)", path, header.Type)
121		}
122		if header.ID == "" {
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session header in %s has no id", path)
124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil
130	}
131	
132	// piProviderVersion derives the provider version string recorded on SessionData
133	// from the pi session header's format version (e.g. v3). Always non-empty so
134	// schema.Validate() does not warn about a missing provider.version.
135	func piProviderVersion(header *sessionHeader) string {
136		if header.Version > 0 {
137			return fmt.Sprintf("v%d", header.Version)
138		}
139		return "v1"
140	}
141	
142	// buildSessionData maps the ordered leaf-path entries into schema.SessionData.
143	func buildSessionData(header *sessionHeader, ordered []rawEntry) *schema.SessionData {
144		return &schema.SessionData{
145			SchemaVersion: "1.0",
146			Provider: schema.ProviderInfo{
147				ID:      providerID,
148				Name:    providerName,
149				Version: piProviderVersion(header),
150			},
151			SessionID:     header.ID,
152			CreatedAt:     header.Timestamp,
153			WorkspaceRoot: header.Cwd,
154			Exchanges:     buildExchanges(ordered),
155		}
156	}
157	
158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}
192	
193	// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating
194	// one if none exists yet.
195	func appendAssistant(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) *schema.Exchange {
196		if current == nil {
197			current = &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: e.ID, StartTime: e.Timestamp}
198		}
199		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, buildAgentMessages(e)...)
200		current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
201		return current
202	}
203	
204	// messageRole extracts .message.role from a message entry.
205	func messageRole(e rawEntry) string {
206		var m struct {
207			Role string `json:"role"`
208		}
209		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m)
210		return m.Role
211	}
212	
213	// mergeToolResult folds a toolResult entry into the matching agent ToolInfo in
214	// the current exchange, keyed by toolCallId == ToolInfo.UseID. It also advances
215	// the exchange EndTime to the toolResult's timestamp so downstream stats that
216	// read the last exchange's EndTime report the real final-event time.
217	func mergeToolResult(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) {
218		if current == nil {
219			return
220		}
221		var tr toolResultMessage
222		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &tr); err != nil {
223			return
224		}
225		content := toolResultContent(tr)
226		for i := range current.Messages {
227			msg := &current.Messages[i]
228			if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.UseID == tr.ToolCallID {
229				msg.Tool.Output = buildToolOutput(content, tr)
230				msg.Timestamp = e.Timestamp
231				current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
232				return
233			}
234		}
235	}
236	
237	// toolResultContent joins the text blocks of a toolResult message.
238	func toolResultContent(tr toolResultMessage) string {
239		var parts []string
240		for _, b := range tr.Content {
241			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
242				parts = append(parts, b.Text)
243			}
244		}
245		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
246	}
247	
248	// buildUserMessage maps a pi user message entry to a schema user Message.
249	// pi user content is either a plain string or an array of {type:text|image}.
250	func buildUserMessage(e rawEntry) schema.Message {
251		var um userMessage
252		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &um)
253		parts := userContentParts(um.Content)
254		return schema.Message{
255			ID:        e.ID,
256			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
257			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
258			Content:   parts,
259		}
260	}
261	
262	// userContentParts decodes a pi user message's content (string or array) into
263	// schema ContentParts. Image blocks are dropped in v1 (recorded as a gap).
264	func userContentParts(raw json.RawMessage) []schema.ContentPart {
265		if len(raw) == 0 {
266			return nil
267		}
268		if raw[0] == '"' {
269			var s string
270			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
271				return []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: s}}
272			}
273		}
274		var blocks []contentBlock
275		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
276			return nil
277		}
278		var parts []schema.ContentPart
279		for _, b := range blocks {
280			if b.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && b.Text != "" {
281				parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
282			}
283		}
284		return parts
285	}
286	
287	// buildAgentMessages maps a pi assistant message entry to one or more schema
288	// Messages: one Message holds the text+thinking content parts; each toolCall
289	// block becomes its own agent Message carrying a ToolInfo.
290	func buildAgentMessages(e rawEntry) []schema.Message {
291		var am assistantMessage
292		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &am); err != nil {
293			return nil
294		}
295		var parts []schema.ContentPart
296		var messages []schema.Message
297		for _, b := range am.Content {
298			switch b.Type {
299			case schema.ContentTypeText:
300				if b.Text != "" {
301					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
302				}
303			case schema.ContentTypeThinking:
304				if b.Thinking != "" {
305					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: b.Thinking})
306				}
307			case "toolCall":
308				messages = append(messages, buildToolMessage(e, b, am))
309			}
310		}
311		if len(parts) > 0 {
312			head := schema.Message{
313				ID:        e.ID,
314				Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
315				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
316				Model:     am.Model,
317				Content:   parts,
318				Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
319			}
320			return append([]schema.Message{head}, messages...)
321		}
322		if len(messages) == 0 {
323			return buildErrorMessage(e, am)
324		}
325		// Tool-call-only assistant message: carry model+usage once on the first
326		// tool message so no metadata is lost and no schema-invalid empty message
327		// is emitted.
328		messages[0].Model = am.Model
329		if messages[0].Usage == nil {
330			messages[0].Usage = mapUsage(am.Usage)
331		}
332		return messages
333	}
334	
335	// buildToolMessage builds an agent Message wrapping a ToolInfo from a toolCall.
336	// The parent assistant message's model is passed through so tool messages carry
337	// the same model metadata as text/thinking messages. The Message ID is derived
338	// from the parent entry id + the toolCall id, so multiple toolCalls in one
339	// assistant message get distinct Message IDs (downstream provenance keys use
340	// msg.ID as a deterministic component).
341	func buildToolMessage(e rawEntry, b contentBlock, am assistantMessage) schema.Message {
342		return schema.Message{
343			ID:        toolMessageID(e.ID, b.ID),
344			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
345			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
346			Model:     am.Model,
347			Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{
348				Name:  b.Name,
349				Type:  classifyToolType(b.Name),
350				UseID: b.ID,
351				Input: b.Args,
352			},
353		}
354	}
355	
356	// toolMessageID builds a unique Message ID for a tool-call message from the
357	// parent entry id and the toolCall id. This avoids duplicate Message IDs when a
358	// single assistant entry contains multiple toolCall blocks.
359	func toolMessageID(entryID, callID string) string {
360		if callID != "" {
361			return entryID + ":" + callID
362		}
363		return entryID
364	}
365	
366	// buildToolOutput constructs the ToolInfo.Output map from a toolResult's
367	// content, error flag, and optional details blob. details (e.g. exitCode) is
368	// decoded into a generic value so downstream consumers (markdown rendering,
369	// cloud) can surface structured tool metadata without re-parsing raw JSON.
370	func buildToolOutput(content string, tr toolResultMessage) map[string]any {
371		out := map[string]any{"content": content, "is_error": tr.IsError}
372		if len(tr.Details) > 0 {
373			var details any
374			if err := json.Unmarshal(tr.Details, &details); err == nil {
375				out["details"] = details
376			}
377		}
378		return out
379	}
380	
381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style
383	// cache fields (pi uses the same semantics).
384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}
```

```text
	// Branching
	// =========================================================================

	/**
	 * Start a new branch from an earlier entry.
	 * Moves the leaf pointer to the specified entry. The next appendXXX() call
	 * will create a child of that entry, forming a new branch. Existing entries
	 * are not modified or deleted.
	 */
	branch(branchFromId: string): void {
		if (!this.byId.has(branchFromId)) {
			throw new Error(`Entry ${branchFromId} not found`);
		}
		this.leafId = branchFromId;
	}

	/**
	 * Reset the leaf pointer to null (before any entries).
	 * The next appendXXX() call will create a new root entry (parentId = null).
	 * Use this when navigating to re-edit the first user message.
	 */
	resetLeaf(): void {
		this.leafId = null;
	}

	/**
	 * Start a new branch with a summary of the abandoned path.
	 * Same as branch(), but also appends a branch_summary entry that captures
	 * context from the abandoned conversation path.
	 */
	branchWithSummary(branchFromId: string | null, summary: string, details?: unknown, fromHook?: boolean): string {
```

```text
482	// isSyntheticMessage checks if a message is synthetic/internal and should be skipped
483	// when looking for the first real user message (e.g. for the session title/slug).
484	// Filters warmup prompts, title-generation prompts, and slash-command noise (the
485	// command invocation, its local stdout/stderr, and the local-command caveat) — these
486	// are conversation scaffolding, not the user's actual prompt. Without this, a session
487	// that opens with a slash command gets an empty title and falls back to its UUID.
488	func isSyntheticMessage(content string) bool {
489		// warmup and the <TEXTBLOCK> title-generation wrapper can be embedded anywhere
490		// in the record, so match them with Contains.
491		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(content), "warmup") {
492			return true
493		}
494		if strings.Contains(content, "<TEXTBLOCK>") {
495			return true
496		}
497		// The slash-command scaffolding tags (shared with reconstruction via

511	// extractContentText extracts plain text from a message content field.
512	// The content field may be either a plain string or a JSON array of typed content
513	// blocks (e.g. [{type:"text",text:"..."},{type:"tool_use",...}]).
514	// When it's an array, all "text"-type blocks are joined with newlines.
515	// This handles the Claude Code JSONL format where IDE context tags (e.g.
516	// <ide_opened_file>) are injected as separate text blocks before the real question.
517	func extractContentText(content interface{}) string {
518		switch v := content.(type) {
519		case string:
520			return v
521		case []interface{}:
522			var parts []string
523			for _, block := range v {
524				if m, ok := block.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
525					if t, _ := m["type"].(string); t == "text" {
526						if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
527							parts = append(parts, text)
528						}
529					}
530				}
531			}
532			slog.Debug("extractContentText: extracted text from content block array",
533				"blockCount", len(v),
534				"textParts", len(parts))
535			return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
536		default:
537			return ""
538		}
539	}
```

```text
103	// Keeping these here means every provider rejects the same cases with the same
104	// messages and cannot drift apart.
105	func PrepareTurns(data *schema.SessionData, opts ReconstructOptions) ([]Turn, error) {
106		if data == nil {
107			return nil, errors.New("cannot reconstruct nil session data")
108		}
```

```text
// BuildSessionFilePath constructs the full markdown file path for a session.
// All callers need consistent filename generation from session metadata.
func BuildSessionFilePath(session *spi.AgentChatSession, historyDir string, useUTC bool) string {
	timestamp, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, session.CreatedAt)
	timestampStr := FormatFilenameTimestamp(timestamp, useUTC)

	filename := timestampStr
	if session.Slug != "" {
		filename = fmt.Sprintf("%s-%s", timestampStr, session.Slug)
	}
	return filepath.Join(historyDir, filename+".md")
}

// ProcessingOptions holds flags that control session processing behavior.
type ProcessingOptions struct {
	OnlyCloudSync      bool // Skip local markdown writes and only sync to cloud
	ShowOutput         bool // Print progress to stdout
	IsAutosave         bool // Called from run/watch (true) vs sync command (false)
	DebugRaw           bool // Enable schema validation (only in debug mode to avoid overhead)
	UseUTC             bool // Timestamp format: true=UTC, false=local
```

```text
111	func ParseSession(path string) (*schema.SessionData, error) {
112		header, entries, err := readEntries(path)

124		}
125		if len(entries) == 0 {
126			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: session %s has no entries", header.ID)
127		}
128		ordered := leafPathEntries(entries)
129		return buildSessionData(header, ordered), nil

158	// buildExchanges groups ordered entries into schema exchanges. A new user
159	// message starts a new exchange; assistant messages append to the current
160	// exchange; toolResults merge into the matching ToolInfo. Control entries
161	// (model_change, custom, etc.) are skipped from the conversation body.
162	func buildExchanges(ordered []rawEntry) []schema.Exchange {
163		var exchanges []schema.Exchange
164		var current *schema.Exchange
165		commit := func() {
166			if current != nil && len(current.Messages) > 0 {
167				exchanges = append(exchanges, *current)
168			}
169		}
170		for _, e := range ordered {
171			if e.Type != entryMessage {
172				continue
173			}
174			switch messageRole(e) {
175			case roleUser:
176				commit()
177				current = &schema.Exchange{
178					ExchangeID: e.ID,
179					StartTime:  e.Timestamp,
180					EndTime:    e.Timestamp,
181					Messages:   []schema.Message{buildUserMessage(e)},
182				}
183			case roleAssistant:
184				current = appendAssistant(current, e)
185			case roleToolResult:
186				mergeToolResult(current, e)
187			}
188		}
189		commit()
190		return exchanges
191	}
192	
193	// appendAssistant appends an assistant message to the current exchange, creating
194	// one if none exists yet.
195	func appendAssistant(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) *schema.Exchange {
196		if current == nil {
197			current = &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: e.ID, StartTime: e.Timestamp}
198		}
199		current.Messages = append(current.Messages, buildAgentMessages(e)...)
200		current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
201		return current
202	}
203	
204	// messageRole extracts .message.role from a message entry.
205	func messageRole(e rawEntry) string {
206		var m struct {
207			Role string `json:"role"`
208		}
209		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m)
210		return m.Role
211	}
212	
213	// mergeToolResult folds a toolResult entry into the matching agent ToolInfo in
214	// the current exchange, keyed by toolCallId == ToolInfo.UseID. It also advances
215	// the exchange EndTime to the toolResult's timestamp so downstream stats that
216	// read the last exchange's EndTime report the real final-event time.
217	func mergeToolResult(current *schema.Exchange, e rawEntry) {
218		if current == nil {
219			return
220		}
221		var tr toolResultMessage
222		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &tr); err != nil {
223			return
224		}
225		content := toolResultContent(tr)
226		for i := range current.Messages {
227			msg := &current.Messages[i]
228			if msg.Tool != nil && msg.Tool.UseID == tr.ToolCallID {
229				msg.Tool.Output = buildToolOutput(content, tr)
230				msg.Timestamp = e.Timestamp
231				current.EndTime = e.Timestamp
232				return
233			}
234		}
235	}
236	
237	// toolResultContent joins the text blocks of a toolResult message.
238	func toolResultContent(tr toolResultMessage) string {
239		var parts []string
240		for _, b := range tr.Content {
241			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
242				parts = append(parts, b.Text)
243			}
244		}
245		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
246	}
247	
248	// buildUserMessage maps a pi user message entry to a schema user Message.
249	// pi user content is either a plain string or an array of {type:text|image}.
250	func buildUserMessage(e rawEntry) schema.Message {
251		var um userMessage
252		_ = json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &um)
253		parts := userContentParts(um.Content)
254		return schema.Message{
255			ID:        e.ID,
256			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
257			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
258			Content:   parts,
259		}
260	}
261	
262	// userContentParts decodes a pi user message's content (string or array) into
263	// schema ContentParts. Image blocks are dropped in v1 (recorded as a gap).
264	func userContentParts(raw json.RawMessage) []schema.ContentPart {
265		if len(raw) == 0 {
266			return nil
267		}
268		if raw[0] == '"' {
269			var s string
270			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
271				return []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: s}}
272			}
273		}
274		var blocks []contentBlock
275		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
276			return nil
277		}
278		var parts []schema.ContentPart
279		for _, b := range blocks {
280			if b.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && b.Text != "" {
281				parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
282			}
283		}
284		return parts
285	}
286	
287	// buildAgentMessages maps a pi assistant message entry to one or more schema
288	// Messages: one Message holds the text+thinking content parts; each toolCall
289	// block becomes its own agent Message carrying a ToolInfo.
290	func buildAgentMessages(e rawEntry) []schema.Message {
291		var am assistantMessage
292		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &am); err != nil {
293			return nil
294		}
295		var parts []schema.ContentPart
296		var messages []schema.Message
297		for _, b := range am.Content {
298			switch b.Type {
299			case schema.ContentTypeText:
300				if b.Text != "" {
301					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: b.Text})
302				}
303			case schema.ContentTypeThinking:
304				if b.Thinking != "" {
305					parts = append(parts, schema.ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: b.Thinking})
306				}
307			case "toolCall":
308				messages = append(messages, buildToolMessage(e, b, am))
309			}
310		}
311		if len(parts) > 0 {
312			head := schema.Message{
313				ID:        e.ID,
314				Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
315				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
316				Model:     am.Model,
317				Content:   parts,
318				Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
319			}
320			return append([]schema.Message{head}, messages...)
321		}
322		if len(messages) == 0 {
323			return buildErrorMessage(e, am)
324		}
325		// Tool-call-only assistant message: carry model+usage once on the first
326		// tool message so no metadata is lost and no schema-invalid empty message
327		// is emitted.
328		messages[0].Model = am.Model
329		if messages[0].Usage == nil {
330			messages[0].Usage = mapUsage(am.Usage)
331		}
332		return messages
333	}
334	
335	// buildToolMessage builds an agent Message wrapping a ToolInfo from a toolCall.
336	// The parent assistant message's model is passed through so tool messages carry
337	// the same model metadata as text/thinking messages. The Message ID is derived
338	// from the parent entry id + the toolCall id, so multiple toolCalls in one
339	// assistant message get distinct Message IDs (downstream provenance keys use
340	// msg.ID as a deterministic component).
341	func buildToolMessage(e rawEntry, b contentBlock, am assistantMessage) schema.Message {
342		return schema.Message{
343			ID:        toolMessageID(e.ID, b.ID),
344			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
345			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
346			Model:     am.Model,
347			Tool: &schema.ToolInfo{
348				Name:  b.Name,
349				Type:  classifyToolType(b.Name),
350				UseID: b.ID,
351				Input: b.Args,
352			},
353		}
354	}
355	
356	// toolMessageID builds a unique Message ID for a tool-call message from the
357	// parent entry id and the toolCall id. This avoids duplicate Message IDs when a
358	// single assistant entry contains multiple toolCall blocks.
359	func toolMessageID(entryID, callID string) string {
360		if callID != "" {
361			return entryID + ":" + callID
362		}
363		return entryID
364	}
365	
366	// buildToolOutput constructs the ToolInfo.Output map from a toolResult's
367	// content, error flag, and optional details blob. details (e.g. exitCode) is
368	// decoded into a generic value so downstream consumers (markdown rendering,
369	// cloud) can surface structured tool metadata without re-parsing raw JSON.
370	func buildToolOutput(content string, tr toolResultMessage) map[string]any {
371		out := map[string]any{"content": content, "is_error": tr.IsError}
372		if len(tr.Details) > 0 {
373			var details any
374			if err := json.Unmarshal(tr.Details, &details); err == nil {
375				out["details"] = details
376			}
377		}
378		return out
379	}
380	
381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style
383	// cache fields (pi uses the same semantics).
384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}
494
```

```go
// on this machine. Temporary repro for a code-review finding; not for commit.
func TestSlugDivergenceRepro(t *testing.T) {
	paths := []string{"testdata/real_world.jsonl"}
	real := os.Getenv("HOME") + "/.pi/agent/sessions/--Users-jakelevirne-dev-tmp-pi-format-demo--/2026-07-09T21-27-45-067Z_019f48c7-8cab-7f8f-bda1-70730f0d56c3.jsonl"
	if _, err := os.Stat(real); err == nil {
		paths = append(paths, real)
	}
	for _, p := range paths {
		scan, err := scanPiSession(p)
		if err != nil || scan == nil {
			t.Fatalf("scan %s: %v %v", p, scan, err)
		}
		scanSlug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage)
		data, err := ParseSession(p)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("parse %s: %v", p, err)
		}
		parseSlug := deriveSlug(data)
		t.Logf("path=%s\n  scanSlug =%q (from %q)\n  parseSlug=%q", p, scanSlug, scan.firstUserMessage, parseSlug)
		if scanSlug == parseSlug {
			t.Logf("  -> SLUGS AGREE")
		} else {
			t.Logf("  -> SLUGS DIVERGE")
		}
	}
}
```

```text
// isSyntheticMessage checks if a message is synthetic/internal and should be skipped
// when looking for the first real user message (e.g. for the session title/slug).
// Filters warmup prompts, title-generation prompts, and slash-command noise (the
// command invocation, its local stdout/stderr, and the local-command caveat) — these
// are conversation scaffolding, not the user's actual prompt. Without this, a session
// that opens with a slash command gets an empty title and falls back to its UUID.
func isSyntheticMessage(content string) bool {
	// warmup and the <TEXTBLOCK> title-generation wrapper can be embedded anywhere
	// in the record, so match them with Contains.
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(content), "warmup") {
		return true
	}
	if strings.Contains(content, "<TEXTBLOCK>") {
		return true
	}
	// The slash-command scaffolding tags (shared with reconstruction via
	// spi.SyntheticCommandTags) and the interrupt marker REPLACE the prompt, so they
	// appear at the very START of the record. Match by prefix so a real prompt that
	// merely mentions a tag mid-sentence is still treated as real. The interrupt
	// marker's "…for tool use" variant is caught by the same prefix.
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(content)
	for _, marker := range spi.SyntheticCommandTags {
		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, marker) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "[Request interrupted by user")
}

// extractContentText extracts plain text from a message content field.
// The content field may be either a plain string or a JSON array of typed content
// blocks (e.g. [{type:"text",text:"..."},{type:"tool_use",...}]).
// When it's an array, all "text"-type blocks are joined with newlines.
// This handles the Claude Code JSONL format where IDE context tags (e.g.
// <ide_opened_file>) are injected as separate text blocks before the real question.
func extractContentText(content interface{}) string {
	switch v := content.(type) {
	case string:
		return v
	case []interface{}:
		var parts []string
		for _, block := range v {
			if m, ok := block.(map[string]interface{}); ok {
				if t, _ := m["type"].(string); t == "text" {
					if text, ok := m["text"].(string); ok && text != "" {
						parts = append(parts, text)
					}
				}
			}
		}
		slog.Debug("extractContentText: extracted text from content block array",
			"blockCount", len(v),
			"textParts", len(parts))
		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
	default:
		return ""
	}
}
```

```text
// buildExchangesFromRecords groups JSONL records into exchanges
// An exchange is a user prompt followed by agent responses and tool results
// Records are assumed to be in chronological order from JSONL parsing
func buildExchangesFromRecords(records []JSONLRecord, workspaceRoot string) ([]Exchange, error) {
	var exchanges []Exchange
	var currentExchange *Exchange
	var exchangeStartTime string

	for _, record := range records {
		recordType, _ := record.Data["type"].(string)
		timestamp, _ := record.Data["timestamp"].(string)

		// Check if this is a sidechain message (subagent conversation)
		// Note: warmup messages are filtered earlier by filterWarmupMessages
		isSidechain, _ := record.Data["isSidechain"].(bool)

		switch recordType {
		case "user":
			// Check if this is a tool result or a new user message
			message, _ := record.Data["message"].(map[string]interface{})
			messageContent, _ := message["content"].([]interface{})

			isToolResult := false
			if len(messageContent) > 0 {
				if firstContent, ok := messageContent[0].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
					if contentType, ok := firstContent["type"].(string); ok && contentType == "tool_result" {
						isToolResult = true
					}
				}
			}

			if isToolResult {
				// This is a tool result - merge it into the previous tool use
				if currentExchange != nil {
					mergeToolResultIntoExchange(currentExchange, messageContent, timestamp)
					currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
				}
			} else {
				// This is a new user prompt

				// Sidechain messages append to current exchange (parent agent talking to subagent)
				// rather than starting a new exchange like regular user prompts do
				if isSidechain {
					if currentExchange == nil {
						slog.Warn("Sidechain user message with no current exchange", "uuid", record.Data["uuid"])
						continue
					}
					msg := buildUserMessage(record, isSidechain)
					currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, msg)
					currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
					continue
				}

				// Non-sidechain: start a new exchange
				if currentExchange != nil {
					exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
				}

				currentExchange = &Exchange{
					StartTime: timestamp,
					Messages:  []Message{buildUserMessage(record, isSidechain)},
				}
			}

		case "assistant":
			// Agent message - add to current exchange
			if currentExchange == nil {
				// Create exchange if we don't have one (shouldn't happen normally)
				exchangeStartTime = timestamp
				currentExchange = &Exchange{
					StartTime: exchangeStartTime,
					Messages:  []Message{},
				}
			}

			msg := buildAgentMessage(record, workspaceRoot, isSidechain)
			currentExchange.Messages = append(currentExchange.Messages, msg)
			currentExchange.EndTime = timestamp
		}
	}

	// Add the last exchange if exists
	if currentExchange != nil && len(currentExchange.Messages) > 0 {
		exchanges = append(exchanges, *currentExchange)
	}

	// Records are already in chronological order from JSONL parsing,
	// so exchanges are also in order. No sorting needed.

	return exchanges, nil
}
```

```text
86	}

88	// piUsage is the token-usage shape on a pi assistant message.
89	type piUsage struct {
90		Input       int64 `json:"input"`
91		Output      int64 `json:"output"`
92		CacheRead   int64 `json:"cacheRead"`
93		CacheWrite  int64 `json:"cacheWrite"`
94		TotalTokens int64 `json:"totalTokens"`
95	}
```
