130	// sessionFile pairs a discovered pi session file with its header metadata.
131	type sessionFile struct {
132		Path   string
133		Header sessionHeader
134	}
135	
136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}
154	
155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}
425

// parseCodexCommand splits a custom command string into the binary path and its arguments.
// An empty custom command falls back to the detected default binary.
// Supports quoted strings with spaces: codex --arg "value with spaces"
func parseCodexCommand(customCommand string) (string, []string) {
	if customCommand != "" {
		parts := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
		if len(parts) > 0 {
			return expandTilde(parts[0]), parts[1:]
		}
	}

	return getDefaultCodexCommand(), nil
}

// getDefaultCodexCommand looks for the codex binary in common installation locations.
func getDefaultCodexCommand() string {
	if path, ok := findHomebrewCodex(); ok {
		return path
	}

---
	return "claude"
}

// expandTilde expands ~ to the user's home directory
func expandTilde(path string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") {
		homeDir, err := os.UserHomeDir()
		if err == nil {
			return filepath.Join(homeDir, path[2:])
		}
	}
	return path
}

// parseClaudeCommand parses a custom command string into executable and arguments.
// If customCommand is empty, returns the default command.
// If resumeSessionId is provided, appends "--resume <sessionId>" to the arguments.
// Supports quoted strings with spaces: claude --arg "value with spaces"
// Example: "claude --model gpt-4" returns ("claude", ["--model", "gpt-4"])
func parseClaudeCommand(customCommand string, resumeSessionId string) (string, []string) {
	var cmd string
	var args []string

	if customCommand == "" {
		cmd = getDefaultClaudeCommand()
		args = nil
	} else {
		parts := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
		if len(parts) == 0 {
			cmd = getDefaultClaudeCommand()
			args = nil
		} else {
			// Expand tilde in the command path
			cmd = expandTilde(parts[0])
			args = parts[1:]
		}
	}

	// Append --resume flag if sessionId is provided
	if resumeSessionId != "" {
		args = append(args, "--resume", resumeSessionId)
	}

	return cmd, args
}

107		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
108			"provider":       providerID,
109			"custom_command": custom,
110			"command_path":   commandPath,
111			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
112			"version":        version,
113			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
114		})
115	}
116	
117	// trackCheckFailure emits the standard install-check failure analytics event.
118	func trackCheckFailure(custom bool, commandPath, resolvedPath, errorType, message string) {
119		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
120			"provider":       providerID,
121			"custom_command": custom,
122			"command_path":   commandPath,
123			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
124			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
125			"error_type":     errorType,
126			"error_message":  message,
127		})
128	}
129	
130	// sessionFile pairs a discovered pi session file with its header metadata.
131	type sessionFile struct {
132		Path   string
133		Header sessionHeader
134	}
135	
136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}
154	
155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}

Title: EncodeCwd does not replace ':' and '\' the way pi does, causing silent zero-session miss for such project paths
File: specstory-cli/pkg/providers/piagent/path_utils.go line 28
Description: Pi's actual encoder (verified in the installed @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent source) strips one leading separator and replaces every '/', '\', AND ':' with '-': dist/core/session-manager.js:245 `const safePath = `--${resolvedCwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")}--`;`. EncodeCwd only replaces '/'. For a project directory whose path contains a colon or backslash (legal POSIX filename characters on macOS and Linux, e.g. /Users/jane/dev/foo:bar), pi writes sessions to --Users-jane-dev-foo-bar-- but ProjectSessionDir computes --Users-jane-dev-foo:bar--. SessionFilesInProject then hits os.IsNotExist and returns (nil, nil) (path_utils.go:64-67), so DetectAgent/sync silently report no pi sessions for that project — a total, errorless miss. The doc comment on EncodeCwd also mischaracterizes pi's algorithm as only replacing '/'. Note the claudecode sibling gets the equivalent case right for its agent (its regex [^a-zA-Z0-9-] replaces colons), so this is a standalone piagent deviation, not a shared pattern. For all paths without ':' or '\' the two algorithms agree exactly (verified against all 12 real dirs under ~/.pi/agent/sessions), so the fix is just extending the replacement set to match pi's [/\:] class.

```text
1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// piSessionsRoot returns ~/.pi/agent/sessions, the directory under which pi
11	// stores one subdirectory per working directory (each named with the encoded
12	// cwd, see EncodeCwd). It does not require the directory to exist.
13	func piSessionsRoot() (string, error) {
14		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
15		if err != nil {
16			return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
17		}
18		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), nil
19	}
20	
21	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name.
22	// pi replaces every '/' in the absolute path with '-' and wraps the result with
23	// a leading '-' and a trailing '--', producing e.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
24	// "--Users-jane-proj--". The encoding is derived from real session dirs:
25	// "/Users/jakelevirne" -> "--Users-jakelevirne--" and
26	// "/Users/jakelevirne/dev/getspecstory" -> "--Users-jakelevirne-dev-getspecstory--".
27	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
28		encoded := strings.ReplaceAll(cwd, "/", "-")
29		return "-" + encoded + "--"
30	}
31	
32	// ProjectSessionDir returns the absolute path to pi's session subdirectory for
33	// the given project, WITHOUT requiring it to exist. Callers (DetectAgent, sync)
34	// check existence separately. The path is symlink-resolved before encoding so
35	// it matches the directory pi actually wrote to (pi encodes the real cwd); a
36	// relative or symlinked projectPath would otherwise produce a different name.
37	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
38		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
39		if err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
43		if cwd == "" {
44			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
45			if err != nil {
46				return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
50		if err != nil {
51			realPath = cwd // fall back to the raw path if resolution fails
52		}
53		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(realPath)), nil
54	}
55	
56	// SessionFilesInProject lists the *.jsonl files in the project's pi session
57	// directory. Returns an empty slice (no error) if the directory does not exist.
58	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
59		dir, err := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath)
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
64		if err != nil {
65			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
66				return nil, nil
67			}
68			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading session dir %s: %w", dir, err)
69		}
70		var files []string
71		for _, e := range entries {
72			if e.IsDir() {
73				continue
74			}
75			if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl") {
76				continue
77			}
78			files = append(files, filepath.Join(dir, e.Name()))
79		}
80		return files, nil
81	}

<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Read PR 254 title and body

`gh pr view 254 --json title,body -q '.title + "\n\n" + .body' 2>/dev/null | head -120`

```text
feat(cli): add Pi agent provider

## Summary

Adds support for the [pi coding agent](https://pi.dev) to specstory-cli via a new provider package `pkg/providers/piagent/`, registered under provider id `"pi"`. This enables `specstory sync`, `list`, `search`, and `reindex` to work with pi sessions stored at `~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/*.jsonl`.

| Agent | Provider | Data Format | Source Location |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Pi](https://pi.dev) | `piagent` | JSONL | `~/.pi/agent/sessions/` |

## How it works

pi stores sessions as **JSONL v3 trees** — each entry has `id`/`parentId`, and the active conversation is the current leaf-path branch. The parser:

1. Walks the leaf → root, reverses to chronological order, and honors compaction (entries before a compaction entry's `firstKeptEntryId` are dropped, mirroring pi's own `buildContextEntries`).
2. Maps entries into the unified `schema.SessionData`:
   - **session header** → `SessionID` / `CreatedAt` / `WorkspaceRoot` / `Provider`
   - **user message** (string *or* content array) → user `Message`
   - **assistant message** (text / thinking / toolCall blocks) → agent `Message` with content parts, plus one `Message` per `toolCall` carrying a `ToolInfo`
   - **toolResult** (a top-level entry in pi, unlike Claude Code where it's a user-message content block) → merged into the matching `ToolInfo.Output` keyed by `toolCallId`
   - **usage** → `schema.Usage` (input / output / cacheRead / cacheWrite)
3. Groups the ordered entries into `Exchange`s (a new user message starts an exchange; assistant + toolResult append).

## Scope

**In scope (v1):** `sync`, `list`, `search`, `reindex`, `check`, `detect`, `--debug-raw`.

**Out of scope (follow-up):** the methods below exist to satisfy the `spi.Provider` interface but return `ErrReconstructionUnsupported` / a descriptive "not yet supported" error:
- `specstory run pi` (`ExecAgentAndWatch` wrapper + file watcher)
- `specstory watch pi` (`WatchAgent` live watch)
- `ReconstructSession` / `NativeSessionPath` (native JSONL v3 serializer for cross-machine resume)



## Docs

- `README.md` — Pi row added to the agent support table
- `docs/PROVIDER-SPI.md` — Pi added to the provider table, package directory tree, and dependency flow

## Testing

TDD: a RED test (`parser_test.go`, 8 subtests asserting the full schema mapping) was written and confirmed failing (`undefined: ParseSession`) before any parser code.

```
go test -count=1 ./...   → all packages ok (incl. piagent), exit 0
golangci-lint run        → 0 issues, exit 0
```

Proven against a real pi session (not proxy signals):
- `Check()` found `pi 0.80.3`
- `DetectAgent()` → true
- `GetAgentChatSession()` parsed **11 exchanges** from a live session
- `--debug-raw` wrote **242 files** (241 numbered JSON + `session-data.json` with 11 exchanges, `providerId="pi"`)
- `ListAllAgentChatSessions()` enumerated **17 sessions** across all projects with originating cwd

## Follow-up work

1. `specstory run pi` — exec wrapper + fsnotify watcher on the session dir
2. `specstory watch pi` — live watch without executing pi
3. `ReconstructSession` — pi JSONL v3 serializer (uses `spi.FlattenSessionData` + `spi.PrepareTurns`)
4. Image content blocks in user/assistant messages are currently dropped
5. `bashExecution` / `custom` / `branchSummary` / `compactionSummary` roles are skipped from exchanges in v1
6. `ListAgentChatSessions` slug/name is currently empty (header-only); a lightweight first-user-message scan would populate it
```
</details></tool-use>

54	}

13		// read sessions from the same place rather than assuming the default.

22		if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
23			return ""
24		}
25	
26		cleaned := filepath.Clean(path)
27	
28		absPath, err := filepath.Abs(cleaned)
29		if err == nil {
30			cleaned = absPath
31		}
32	
33		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cleaned); err == nil {
34			cleaned = resolved
35		}
36	
37		return filepath.Clean(cleaned)
38	}
39	
40	// readDirSortedDesc reads directory entries and sorts them descending by name.
41	func readDirSortedDesc(path string) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
42		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
43		if err != nil {
44			return nil, err
45		}
46	
47		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
48			return entries[i].Name() > entries[j].Name()
49		})
50	
51		return entries, nil
52	}

```text
1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// piSessionsRoot returns ~/.pi/agent/sessions, the directory under which pi
11	// stores one subdirectory per working directory (each named with the encoded
12	// cwd, see EncodeCwd). It does not require the directory to exist.
13	func piSessionsRoot() (string, error) {
14		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
15		if err != nil {
16			return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
17		}
18		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), nil
19	}
20	
21	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name.
22	// pi replaces every '/' in the absolute path with '-' and wraps the result with
23	// a leading '-' and a trailing '--', producing e.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
24	// "--Users-jane-proj--". The encoding is derived from real session dirs:
25	// "/Users/jakelevirne" -> "--Users-jakelevirne--" and
26	// "/Users/jakelevirne/dev/getspecstory" -> "--Users-jakelevirne-dev-getspecstory--".
27	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
28		encoded := strings.ReplaceAll(cwd, "/", "-")
29		return "-" + encoded + "--"
30	}
31	
32	// ProjectSessionDir returns the absolute path to pi's session subdirectory for
33	// the given project, WITHOUT requiring it to exist. Callers (DetectAgent, sync)
34	// check existence separately. The path is symlink-resolved before encoding so
35	// it matches the directory pi actually wrote to (pi encodes the real cwd); a
36	// relative or symlinked projectPath would otherwise produce a different name.
37	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
38		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
39		if err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
43		if cwd == "" {
44			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
45			if err != nil {
46				return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
50		if err != nil {
51			realPath = cwd // fall back to the raw path if resolution fails
52		}
53		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(realPath)), nil
54	}
55	
56	// SessionFilesInProject lists the *.jsonl files in the project's pi session
57	// directory. Returns an empty slice (no error) if the directory does not exist.
58	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
59		dir, err := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath)
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
64		if err != nil {
65			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
66				return nil, nil
67			}
68			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading session dir %s: %w", dir, err)
69		}
70		var files []string
71		for _, e := range entries {
72			if e.IsDir() {
73				continue
74			}
75			if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl") {
76				continue
77			}
78			files = append(files, filepath.Join(dir, e.Name()))
79		}
80		return files, nil
81	}
82

10	// codexSessionsRoot returns the root directory where Codex stores session files.
11	func codexSessionsRoot(homeDir string) string {
12		// Codex CLI honors CODEX_HOME as its base directory (default ~/.codex), so
13		// read sessions from the same place rather than assuming the default.
14		if codexHome := os.Getenv("CODEX_HOME"); codexHome != "" {
15			return filepath.Join(codexHome, "sessions")
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".codex", "sessions")
18	}
19	
20	// normalizeCodexPath resolves a path to an absolute, cleaned representation suitable for comparisons.
21	func normalizeCodexPath(path string) string {
22		if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
23			return ""
24		}
25	
26		cleaned := filepath.Clean(path)
27	
28		absPath, err := filepath.Abs(cleaned)
29		if err == nil {
30			cleaned = absPath
31		}
32	
33		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cleaned); err == nil {
34			cleaned = resolved
35		}
36	
37		return filepath.Clean(cleaned)
38	}
39	
40	// readDirSortedDesc reads directory entries and sorts them descending by name.
41	func readDirSortedDesc(path string) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
42		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
43		if err != nil {
44			return nil, err
45		}
46	
47		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
48			return entries[i].Name() > entries[j].Name()
49		})
50	
51		return entries, nil
52	}

1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// piSessionsRoot returns ~/.pi/agent/sessions, the directory under which pi
11	// stores one subdirectory per working directory (each named with the encoded
12	// cwd, see EncodeCwd). It does not require the directory to exist.
13	func piSessionsRoot() (string, error) {
14		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
15		if err != nil {
16			return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
17		}
18		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), nil
19	}
20	
21	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name.
22	// pi replaces every '/' in the absolute path with '-' and wraps the result with
23	// a leading '-' and a trailing '--', producing e.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
24	// "--Users-jane-proj--". The encoding is derived from real session dirs:
25	// "/Users/jakelevirne" -> "--Users-jakelevirne--" and
26	// "/Users/jakelevirne/dev/getspecstory" -> "--Users-jakelevirne-dev-getspecstory--".
27	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
28		encoded := strings.ReplaceAll(cwd, "/", "-")
29		return "-" + encoded + "--"
30	}
31	
32	// ProjectSessionDir returns the absolute path to pi's session subdirectory for
33	// the given project, WITHOUT requiring it to exist. Callers (DetectAgent, sync)
34	// check existence separately. The path is symlink-resolved before encoding so
35	// it matches the directory pi actually wrote to (pi encodes the real cwd); a
36	// relative or symlinked projectPath would otherwise produce a different name.
37	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
38		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
39		if err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
43		if cwd == "" {
44			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
45			if err != nil {
46				return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
50		if err != nil {
51			realPath = cwd // fall back to the raw path if resolution fails
52		}
53		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(realPath)), nil
54	}
55	
56	// SessionFilesInProject lists the *.jsonl files in the project's pi session
57	// directory. Returns an empty slice (no error) if the directory does not exist.
58	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
59		dir, err := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath)
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
64		if err != nil {
65			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
66				return nil, nil
67			}
68			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading session dir %s: %w", dir, err)
69		}
70		var files []string
71		for _, e := range entries {
72			if e.IsDir() {
73				continue
74			}
75			if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl") {
76				continue
77			}
78			files = append(files, filepath.Join(dir, e.Name()))
79		}
80		return files, nil
81	}
82

10	// codexSessionsRoot returns the root directory where Codex stores session files.
11	func codexSessionsRoot(homeDir string) string {
12		// Codex CLI honors CODEX_HOME as its base directory (default ~/.codex), so
13		// read sessions from the same place rather than assuming the default.
14		if codexHome := os.Getenv("CODEX_HOME"); codexHome != "" {
15			return filepath.Join(codexHome, "sessions")
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".codex", "sessions")
18	}
19	
20	// normalizeCodexPath resolves a path to an absolute, cleaned representation suitable for comparisons.
21	func normalizeCodexPath(path string) string {
22		if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
23			return ""
24		}
25	
26		cleaned := filepath.Clean(path)
27	
28		absPath, err := filepath.Abs(cleaned)
29		if err == nil {
30			cleaned = absPath
31		}
32	
33		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cleaned); err == nil {
34			cleaned = resolved
35		}
36	
37		return filepath.Clean(cleaned)
38	}
39	
40	// readDirSortedDesc reads directory entries and sorts them descending by name.
41	func readDirSortedDesc(path string) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
42		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
43		if err != nil {
44			return nil, err
45		}
46	
47		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
48			return entries[i].Name() > entries[j].Name()
49		})
50	
51		return entries, nil
52	}

Each gets a full sessions.db row (they pass scanPiSession and the GetAgentChatSessionByPath fast path), so they appear as top-level pi sessions in the resume/search TUI — but GetAgentChatSession(OriginCwd, id) returns nil for them (verified empirically). Consequences: TUI preview degrades to the raw FTS body (session_tui_view.go:411-425 fallback), `specstory sync pi -s <id>` reports "Session not found", and cross-agent resume of such a session fails with "source session has no data to reconstruct" (resume.go:315-321). claudecode keeps its enumeration and project views consistent and deliberately excludes sidechain-only transcripts from enumeration (provider.go scanClaudeSession foundRealMessage guard); codexcli walks the same tree for both views. piagent is the only provider whose global and project-scoped session sets disagree.
Evidence: provider.go:348 `return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)` (recursive) vs path_utils.go:72-77 `if e.IsDir() { continue } ... HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl")` (top-level only). 136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the

138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue

156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).

158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}

188				continue

192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}

268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}
425
```
</details></tool-use>

381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style
383	// cache fields (pi uses the same semantics).
384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}

351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}

415		}

420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),

37	// Check verifies the pi binary is on PATH and reports its version.
38	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
45		if err != nil {
46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
47			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "not_found", err.Error())
48			return spi.CheckResult{
49				Success:      false,
50				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi binary '%s' not found on PATH", cmdName),
51			}
52		}
53		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())
60			return spi.CheckResult{
61				Success:      false,
62				Location:     resolved,
63				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi version probe failed: %v", err),
64			}
65		}
66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}

158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
199	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
200		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if path == "" {
205			return nil, nil
206		}
207		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
208	}
209	
210	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
211	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
212		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {
219			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
220			if pErr != nil {
221				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil
230	}
231	
232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
282			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
284			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
285			SessionData: data,
286			RawData:     string(raw),
287		}, nil
288	}
289	
290	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
314		}
315		return result, nil
316	}
317	
318	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
319	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
320	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
321		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
322	}
323	
324	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
325	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
326	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
327	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
328		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
333			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
334				return nil, nil
335			}
336			return nil, statErr
337		}
338		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
339			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
340			if sErr != nil {
341				return nil, sErr
342			}
343			if s == nil {
344				return nil, nil // non-session file
345			}
346			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
347		}
348		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
349	}
350	
351	// piSessionScan holds the minimal fields read from a session file in one bounded
352	// pass: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd. The scan
353	// stops as soon as it has the first user message, so it does NOT parse the whole
354	// session. foundUser is false for sessions with no real user prompt; scanPiSession
355	// returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
356	type piSessionScan struct {
357		sessionID        string
358		timestamp        string
359		firstUserMessage string
360		cwd              string
361		foundUser        bool
362	}
363	
364	// scanPiSession reads minimal data from a pi session file in one bounded pass:
365	// the header (session id, timestamp, cwd) and the first user message text, then
366	// stops. Returns (scan, nil) for a real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session
367	// file or a session with no user message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse
368	// errors so ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
369	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
370		scan := &piSessionScan{}
371		headerRead := false
372		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
373			if !headerRead {
374				var h sessionHeader
375				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
376					return errStopRead // not a pi session (bad first line)
377				}
378				if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
379					return errStopRead // not a pi session header
380				}
381				scan.sessionID = h.ID
382				scan.timestamp = h.Timestamp
383				scan.cwd = h.Cwd
384				headerRead = true
385				return nil
386			}
387			var e rawEntry
388			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
389				return nil // skip malformed line
390			}
391			if e.Type != entryMessage {
392				return nil
393			}
394			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
395				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
396				scan.foundUser = true
397				return errStopRead // got what we need; stop reading
398			}
399			return nil
400		})
401		if err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404		if !headerRead || !scan.foundUser {
405			return nil, nil // non-session file or no user message
406		}
407		return scan, nil
408	}
409	
410	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
411	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
412	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
413		if !scan.foundUser {
414			return nil
415		}
416		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
417			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
418			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
419			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
420			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
421			NativePath: path,
422			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
423		}
424	}

1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// piSessionsRoot returns ~/.pi/agent/sessions, the directory under which pi
11	// stores one subdirectory per working directory (each named with the encoded
12	// cwd, see EncodeCwd). It does not require the directory to exist.
13	func piSessionsRoot() (string, error) {
14		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
15		if err != nil {
16			return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
17		}
18		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), nil
19	}
20	
21	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name.
22	// pi replaces every '/' in the absolute path with '-' and wraps the result with
23	// a leading '-' and a trailing '--', producing e.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
24	// "--Users-jane-proj--". The encoding is derived from real session dirs:
25	// "/Users/jakelevirne" -> "--Users-jakelevirne--" and
26	// "/Users/jakelevirne/dev/getspecstory" -> "--Users-jakelevirne-dev-getspecstory--".
27	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
28		encoded := strings.ReplaceAll(cwd, "/", "-")
29		return "-" + encoded + "--"
30	}
31	
32	// ProjectSessionDir returns the absolute path to pi's session subdirectory for
33	// the given project, WITHOUT requiring it to exist. Callers (DetectAgent, sync)
34	// check existence separately. The path is symlink-resolved before encoding so
35	// it matches the directory pi actually wrote to (pi encodes the real cwd); a
36	// relative or symlinked projectPath would otherwise produce a different name.
37	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
38		root, err := piSessionsRoot()
39		if err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
43		if cwd == "" {
44			cwd, err = os.Getwd()
45			if err != nil {
46				return "", fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
47			}
48		}
49		realPath, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cwd)
50		if err != nil {
51			realPath = cwd // fall back to the raw path if resolution fails
52		}
53		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(realPath)), nil
54	}
55	
56	// SessionFilesInProject lists the *.jsonl files in the project's pi session
57	// directory. Returns an empty slice (no error) if the directory does not exist.
58	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
59		dir, err := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath)
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, err
62		}
63		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
64		if err != nil {
65			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
66				return nil, nil
67			}
68			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading session dir %s: %w", dir, err)
69		}
70		var files []string
71		for _, e := range entries {
72			if e.IsDir() {
73				continue
74			}
75			if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl") {
76				continue
77			}
78			files = append(files, filepath.Join(dir, e.Name()))
79		}
80		return files, nil
81	}
82

381	// mapUsage converts a pi usage object to the schema Usage. pi's input/output map
382	// to InputTokens/OutputTokens; cacheRead/cacheWrite map to the Claude-style

384	func mapUsage(u *piUsage) *schema.Usage {
385		if u == nil {
386			return nil
387		}
388		return &schema.Usage{
389			InputTokens:              int(u.Input),
390			OutputTokens:             int(u.Output),
391			CacheReadInputTokens:     int(u.CacheRead),
392			CacheCreationInputTokens: int(u.CacheWrite),

396	// buildErrorMessage surfaces an assistant entry with stopReason=error and an
397	// empty content array (no text/thinking/toolCalls) as an agent text message so
398	// the error event is not dropped from the transcript (and compaction boundaries
399	// stay interpretable). Returns nil if there is no errorMessage to surface.
400	func buildErrorMessage(e rawEntry, am assistantMessage) []schema.Message {
401		if strings.TrimSpace(am.ErrorMessage) == "" {
402			return nil
403		}
404		return []schema.Message{{
405			ID:        e.ID,
406			Timestamp: e.Timestamp,
407			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
408			Model:     am.Model,
409			Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: "[error] " + am.ErrorMessage}},
410			Usage:     mapUsage(am.Usage),
411		}}
412	}
413	
414	// deriveSlug returns a filename-safe slug from the first user message text.
415	// The trimmed text is passed to GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage so slugs do not
416	// differ only by leading/trailing whitespace.
417	func deriveSlug(data *schema.SessionData) string {
418		for _, ex := range data.Exchanges {
419			for _, msg := range ex.Messages {
420				if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
421					continue
422				}
423				for _, part := range msg.Content {
424					if t := strings.TrimSpace(part.Text); t != "" {
425						return spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(t)
426					}
427				}
428			}
429		}
430		return ""
431	}
432	
433	// classifyToolType maps pi tool names to the schema tool-type taxonomy.
434	func classifyToolType(name string) string {
435		switch strings.ToLower(name) {
436		case "read":
437			return schema.ToolTypeRead
438		case "edit", "write":
439			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
440		case "bash", "ls":
441			return schema.ToolTypeShell
442		case "grep", "find", "web_search", "fetch_content":
443			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
444		case "until_done_set", "until_done_plan", "until_done_task_update",
445			"until_done_progress", "until_done_complete", "until_done_block",
446			"until_done_replan", "until_done_distill":
447			return schema.ToolTypeTask
448		default:
449			return schema.ToolTypeUnknown
450		}
451	}
452	
453	// firstUserText extracts the first user message text from a message entry, if
454	// its role is "user". Returns "" for non-user messages or empty content.
455	func firstUserText(e rawEntry) string {
456		var m struct {
457			Role    string          `json:"role"`
458			Content json.RawMessage `json:"content"`
459		}
460		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Message, &m); err != nil {
461			return ""
462		}
463		if m.Role != roleUser {
464			return ""
465		}
466		return userContentString(m.Content)
467	}
468	
469	// userContentString extracts a plain string from a pi user message content
470	// field (either a string or an array of {type:text} blocks). The result is
471	// trimmed so the scan path produces the same Slug/Name as the full-parse path
472	// (deriveSlug trims too).
473	func userContentString(raw json.RawMessage) string {
474		if len(raw) == 0 {
475			return ""
476		}
477		var s string
478		if raw[0] == '"' {
479			if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err == nil {
480				return strings.TrimSpace(s)
481			}
482		}
483		var blocks []contentBlock
484		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &blocks); err != nil {
485			return ""
486		}
487		for _, b := range blocks {
488			if b.Type == "text" && b.Text != "" {
489				return strings.TrimSpace(b.Text)
490			}
491		}
492		return ""
493	}
494

37	// Check verifies the pi binary is on PATH and reports its version.
38	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
39		cmdName := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand)
40		isCustom := cmdName != ""
41		if cmdName == "" {
42			cmdName = defaultCmd
43		}
44		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
45		if err != nil {
46			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
47			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "not_found", err.Error())
48			return spi.CheckResult{
49				Success:      false,
50				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi binary '%s' not found on PATH", cmdName),
51			}
52		}
53		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
54		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
55		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
56		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
57		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
58			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err)
59			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, "version_probe_failed", err.Error())
60			return spi.CheckResult{
61				Success:      false,
62				Location:     resolved,
63				ErrorMessage: fmt.Sprintf("pi version probe failed: %v", err),
64			}
65		}
66		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
67		if version == "" {
68			version = "unknown"
69		}
70		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
71		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
72	}

136	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
137	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
138	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
139		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
140		if err != nil {
141			return "", err
142		}
143		for _, f := range files {
144			h, err := readHeader(f)
145			if err != nil || h == nil {
146				continue
147			}
148			if h.ID == sessionID {
149				return f, nil
150			}
151		}
152		return "", nil
153	}
154	
155	// readHeader parses only the first line of a session file and returns it only
156	// if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty id).
157	// Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them.
158	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
159		f, err := os.Open(path)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
164		dec := json.NewDecoder(f)
165		var h sessionHeader
166		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
167			return nil, nil
168		}
169		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		return &h, nil
173	}
174	
175	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
176	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
177	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
178	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
179		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		var out []sessionFile
184		for _, f := range files {
185			h, err := readHeader(f)
186			if err != nil {
187				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
188				continue
189			}
190			if h == nil {
191				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
192			}
193			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}

213		if err != nil {

215		}
216		total := len(files)
217		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
218		for i, sf := range files {

222			} else if chat != nil {
223				result = append(result, *chat)
224			}
225			if progress != nil {
226				progress(i+1, total)
227			}
228		}
229		return result, nil

232	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
233	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
234	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
235		data, err := ParseSession(path)
236		if err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		if debugRaw {
240			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
241				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
242			}
243		}
244		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
247		}
248		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
249			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
250			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
251			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
252			SessionData: data,
253			RawData:     string(raw),
254		}, nil
255	}
256	
257	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
258	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
259	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
260	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
261	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
262	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
263	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
264	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
265		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)

267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
270			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
271		}
272		if debugRaw {
273			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
274				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
275			}
276		}
277		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
278		if err != nil {
279			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
280		}
281		return &spi.AgentChatSession{

283			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,

291	// deriving Slug/Name from the first user message via a bounded single-pass scan
292	// (no full parse), matching how other providers populate metadata.
293	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
294		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
299		for _, f := range files {
300			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
301			if scanErr != nil {
302				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
303				continue
304			}
305			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
306				continue
307			}
308			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
309				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
310				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
311				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
312				Name:      spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
313			})
