182		firstMessage: string;
183		allMessagesText: string;
184	}
185	
186	export type ReadonlySessionManager = Pick<
187		SessionManager,
188		| "getCwd"
189		| "getSessionDir"
190		| "getSessionId"
191		| "getSessionFile"
192		| "getLeafId"
193		| "getLeafEntry"
194		| "getEntry"
195		| "getLabel"
196		| "getBranch"
197		| "buildContextEntries"
198		| "getHeader"
199		| "getEntries"
200		| "getTree"
201		| "getSessionName"
202	>;
203	
204	function createSessionId(): string {
205		return uuidv7();
206	}
207	
208	export function assertValidSessionId(id: string): void {
209		if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9._-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$/.test(id)) {
210			throw new Error(
211				"Session id must be non-empty, contain only alphanumeric characters, '-', '_', and '.', and start and end with an alphanumeric character",
212			);
213		}
214	}
215	
216	/** Generate a unique short ID (8 hex chars, collision-checked) */
217	function generateId(byId: { has(id: string): boolean }): string {
218		for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
219			const id = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
220			if (!byId.has(id)) return id;
221		}
222		// Fallback to full UUID if somehow we have collisions
223		return randomUUID();
224	}
225	
226	/** Migrate v1 → v2: add id/parentId tree structure. Mutates in place. */
227	function migrateV1ToV2(entries: FileEntry[]): void {
228		const ids = new Set<string>();
229		let prevId: string | null = null;
230	
231		for (const entry of entries) {
232			if (entry.type === "session") {
233				entry.version = 2;
234				continue;
235			}
236	
237			entry.id = generateId(ids);
238			entry.parentId = prevId;
239			prevId = entry.id;
240	
241			// Convert firstKeptEntryIndex to firstKeptEntryId for compaction
242			if (entry.type === "compaction") {
243				const comp = entry as CompactionEntry & { firstKeptEntryIndex?: number };
244				if (typeof comp.firstKeptEntryIndex === "number") {
245					const targetEntry = entries[comp.firstKeptEntryIndex];
246					if (targetEntry && targetEntry.type !== "session") {
247						comp.firstKeptEntryId = targetEntry.id;
248					}
249					delete comp.firstKeptEntryIndex;
250				}
251			}
252		}
253	}
254	
255	/** Migrate v2 → v3: rename hookMessage role to custom. Mutates in place. */
256	function migrateV2ToV3(entries: FileEntry[]): void {
257		for (const entry of entries) {
258			if (entry.type === "session") {
259				entry.version = 3;
260				continue;
261			}
262	
263			// Update message entries with hookMessage role
264			if (entry.type === "message") {
265				const msgEntry = entry as SessionMessageEntry;
266				if (msgEntry.message && (msgEntry.message as { role: string }).role === "hookMessage") {
267					(msgEntry.message as { role: string }).role = "custom";
268				}
269			}
270		}
271	}
272	
273	/**
274	 * Run all necessary migrations to bring entries to current version.
275	 * Mutates entries in place. Returns true if any migration was applied.
276	 */
277	function migrateToCurrentVersion(entries: FileEntry[]): boolean {
278		const header = entries.find((e) => e.type === "session") as SessionHeader | undefined;
279		const version = header?.version ?? 1;
280	
281		if (version >= CURRENT_SESSION_VERSION) return false;
282	
283		if (version < 2) migrateV1ToV2(entries);
284		if (version < 3) migrateV2ToV3(entries);
285	
286		return true;
287	}
288	
289	/** Exported for testing */
290	export function migrateSessionEntries(entries: FileEntry[]): void {
291		migrateToCurrentVersion(entries);
292	}
293	
294	/** Exported for compaction.test.ts */
295	export function parseSessionEntries(content: string): FileEntry[] {
296		const entries: FileEntry[] = [];
297		const lines = content.trim().split("\n");
298	
299		for (const line of lines) {
300			if (!line.trim()) continue;
301			try {
302				const entry = JSON.parse(line) as FileEntry;
303				entries.push(entry);
304			} catch {
305				// Skip malformed lines
306			}
307		}
308	
309		return entries;
310	}
311	
312	export function getLatestCompactionEntry(entries: SessionEntry[]): CompactionEntry | null {
313		for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
314			if (entries[i].type === "compaction") {
315				return entries[i] as CompactionEntry;
316			}
317		}
318		return null;
319	}
320	
321	function buildEntryIndex(entries: SessionEntry[], byId?: Map<string, SessionEntry>): Map<string, SessionEntry> {
322		if (byId) return byId;
323		const index = new Map<string, SessionEntry>();
324		for (const entry of entries) {
325			index.set(entry.id, entry);
326		}
327		return index;
328	}
329	
330	function buildSessionPath(
331		entries: SessionEntry[],
332		leafId?: string | null,
333		byId?: Map<string, SessionEntry>,
334	): SessionEntry[] {
335		const index = buildEntryIndex(entries, byId);
336		let leaf: SessionEntry | undefined;
337		if (leafId === null) {
338			return [];
339		}
340		if (leafId) {
341			leaf = index.get(leafId);
342		}
343		leaf ??= entries[entries.length - 1];
344		if (!leaf) {
345			return [];
346		}
347	
348		const path: SessionEntry[] = [];
349		let current: SessionEntry | undefined = leaf;
350		while (current) {
351			path.push(current);
352			current = current.parentId ? index.get(current.parentId) : undefined;
353		}
354		path.reverse();
355		return path;
356	}
357	
358	function getSessionContextSettings(path: SessionEntry[]): Pick<SessionContext, "thinkingLevel" | "model"> {
359		let thinkingLevel = "off";
360		let model: { provider: string; modelId: string } | null = null;
361	
362		for (const entry of path) {
363			if (entry.type === "thinking_level_change") {
364				thinkingLevel = entry.thinkingLevel;
365			} else if (entry.type === "model_change") {
366				model = { provider: entry.provider, modelId: entry.modelId };
367			} else if (entry.type === "message" && entry.message.role === "assistant") {
368				model = { provider: entry.message.provider, modelId: entry.message.model };
369			}
370		}
371	
372		return { thinkingLevel, model };
373	}
374	
375	/**
376	 * Project one selected session entry into LLM/runtime messages.
377	 * Plain custom entries are display/state entries and do not participate in context.
378	 */
379	export function sessionEntryToContextMessages(entry: SessionEntry): AgentMessage[] {
380		if (entry.type === "message") {
381			const message = entry.message;
382			// Session files are parsed without validation; old versions, forks, or
383			// hand-edited files can contain messages with null/missing content.
384			if (
385				(message.role === "user" || message.role === "assistant" || message.role === "toolResult") &&
386				message.content == null
387			) {
388				return [{ ...message, content: [] }];
389			}
390			return [message];
391		}
392		if (entry.type === "custom_message") {
393			return [
394				createCustomMessage(entry.customType, entry.content ?? [], entry.display, entry.details, entry.timestamp),
395			];
396		}
397		if (entry.type === "branch_summary" && entry.summary) {
398			return [createBranchSummaryMessage(entry.summary, entry.fromId, entry.timestamp)];
399		}
400		if (entry.type === "compaction") {
401			return [createCompactionSummaryMessage(entry.summary, entry.tokensBefore, entry.timestamp)];
402		}
403		return [];
404	}
405	
406	/**
407	 * Build the active, compaction-aware session entry list.
408	 *
409	 * This follows the current leaf path. If the path contains compaction entries,
410	 * the latest compaction is represented by the compaction entry itself, followed
411	 * by the kept entries starting at firstKeptEntryId and all entries after the
412	 * compaction entry. Older summarized entries are omitted.
413	 */
414	export function buildContextEntries(
415		entries: SessionEntry[],
416		leafId?: string | null,
417		byId?: Map<string, SessionEntry>,
418	): SessionEntry[] {
419		const path = buildSessionPath(entries, leafId, byId);
420		let compaction: CompactionEntry | null = null;
421	
422		for (const entry of path) {
423			if (entry.type === "compaction") {
424				compaction = entry;
425			}
426		}
427	
428		if (!compaction) {
429			return path;
430		}
431	
432		const compactionIdx = path.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === compaction.id);
433		if (compactionIdx < 0) {
434			return path;
435		}
436	
437		const contextEntries: SessionEntry[] = [compaction];
438		let foundFirstKept = false;
439		for (let i = 0; i < compactionIdx; i++) {
440			const entry = path[i];
441			if (entry.id === compaction.firstKeptEntryId) {
442				foundFirstKept = true;
443			}
444			if (foundFirstKept) {
445				contextEntries.push(entry);
446			}
447		}
448		contextEntries.push(...path.slice(compactionIdx + 1));
449		return contextEntries;
450	}
451	
452	/**
453	 * Build the session context from entries using tree traversal.
454	 * If leafId is provided, walks from that entry to root.
455	 * Handles compaction and branch summaries along the path.
456	 */
457	export function buildSessionContext(
458		entries: SessionEntry[],
459		leafId?: string | null,
460		byId?: Map<string, SessionEntry>,
461	): SessionContext {
462		const path = buildSessionPath(entries, leafId, byId);
463		const { thinkingLevel, model } = getSessionContextSettings(path);
464		const messages = buildContextEntries(entries, leafId, byId).flatMap(sessionEntryToContextMessages);
465		return { messages, thinkingLevel, model };
466	}
467	
468	/**
469	 * Compute the default session directory for a cwd.
470	 * Encodes cwd into a safe directory name under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/.
471	 */
472	function getDefaultSessionDirPath(cwd: string, agentDir: string = getDefaultAgentDir()): string {
473		const resolvedCwd = resolvePath(cwd);
474		const resolvedAgentDir = resolvePath(agentDir);
475		const safePath = `--${resolvedCwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")}--`;
476		return join(resolvedAgentDir, "sessions", safePath);
477	}
478	
479	export function getDefaultSessionDir(cwd: string, agentDir: string = getDefaultAgentDir()): string {
480		const sessionDir = getDefaultSessionDirPath(cwd, agentDir);
481		if (!existsSync(sessionDir)) {
482			mkdirSync(sessionDir, { recursive: true });
483		}
484		return sessionDir;
485	}
486	
487	const SESSION_READ_BUFFER_SIZE = 1024 * 1024;
488	
489	function parseSessionEntryLine(line: string): FileEntry | null {
490		if (!line.trim()) return null;
491		try {
492			return JSON.parse(line) as FileEntry;
493		} catch {
494			// Skip malformed lines
495			return null;
496		}
497	}
498	
499	/** Exported for testing */
500	export function loadEntriesFromFile(filePath: string): FileEntry[] {
501		const resolvedFilePath = normalizePath(filePath);
502		if (!existsSync(resolvedFilePath)) return [];
503	
504		const entries: FileEntry[] = [];
505		const fd = openSync(resolvedFilePath, "r");
506		try {
507			const decoder = new StringDecoder("utf8");
508			const buffer = Buffer.allocUnsafe(SESSION_READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
509			let pending = "";
510	
511			while (true) {
512				const bytesRead = readSync(fd, buffer, 0, buffer.length, null);
513				if (bytesRead === 0) break;
514	
515				pending += decoder.write(buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead));
516				let lineStart = 0;
517				let newlineIndex = pending.indexOf("\n", lineStart);
518				while (newlineIndex !== -1) {
519					const entry = parseSessionEntryLine(pending.slice(lineStart, newlineIndex));
520					if (entry) entries.push(entry);
521					lineStart = newlineIndex + 1;
522					newlineIndex = pending.indexOf("\n", lineStart);
523				}
524				pending = pending.slice(lineStart);
525			}
526	
527			pending += decoder.end();
528			const finalEntry = parseSessionEntryLine(pending);
529			if (finalEntry) entries.push(finalEntry);
530		} finally {
531			closeSync(fd);
532		}
533	
534		// Validate session header
535		if (entries.length === 0) return entries;
536		const header = entries[0];
537		if (header.type !== "session" || typeof (header as { id?: unknown }).id !== "string") {
538			return [];
539		}
540	
541		return entries;
542	}
543	
544	function readSessionHeader(filePath: string): SessionHeader | null {
545		try {
546			const fd = openSync(filePath, "r");
547			const buffer = Buffer.alloc(512);
548			const bytesRead = readSync(fd, buffer, 0, 512, 0);
549			closeSync(fd);
550			const firstLine = buffer.toString("utf8", 0, bytesRead).split("\n")[0];
551			if (!firstLine) return null;
552			const header = JSON.parse(firstLine) as Record<string, unknown>;
553			if (header.type !== "session" || typeof header.id !== "string") {
554				return null;
555			}
556			return header as unknown as SessionHeader;
557		} catch {
558			return null;
559		}
560	}
561	
562	function getSessionHeaderCwd(header: SessionHeader): string | undefined {
563		const cwd = (header as { cwd?: unknown }).cwd;
564		return typeof cwd === "string" ? cwd : undefined;
565	}
566	
567	function sessionCwdMatches(cwd: string | undefined, resolvedCwd: string): boolean {
568		return cwd !== undefined && cwd !== "" && resolvePath(cwd) === resolvedCwd;
569	}
570	
571	/** Exported for testing */
572	export function findMostRecentSession(sessionDir: string, cwd?: string): string | null {
573		const resolvedSessionDir = normalizePath(sessionDir);
574		const resolvedCwd = cwd ? resolvePath(cwd) : undefined;
575		try {
576			const files = readdirSync(resolvedSessionDir)
577				.filter((f) => f.endsWith(".jsonl"))
578				.map((f) => join(resolvedSessionDir, f))
579				.map((path) => ({ path, header: readSessionHeader(path) }))
580				.filter(
581					(file): file is { path: string; header: SessionHeader } =>
582						file.header !== null &&
583						(!resolvedCwd || sessionCwdMatches(getSessionHeaderCwd(file.header), resolvedCwd)),
584				)
585				.map(({ path }) => ({ path, mtime: statSync(path).mtime }))
586				.sort((a, b) => b.mtime.getTime() - a.mtime.getTime());
587	
588			return files[0]?.path || null;
589		} catch {
590			return null;
591		}
592	}
593	
594	function isMessageWithContent(message: AgentMessage): message is Message {
595		return typeof (message as Message).role === "string" && "content" in message;
596	}
597	
598	function extractTextContent(message: Message): string {
599		const content = message.content;
600		if (typeof content === "string") {
601			return content;
602		}
603		return content
604			.filter((block): block is TextContent => block.type === "text")
605			.map((block) => block.text)
606			.join(" ");
607	}
608	
609	function getMessageActivityTime(entry: SessionMessageEntry): number | undefined {
610		const message = entry.message;
611		if (!isMessageWithContent(message)) return undefined;
612		if (message.role !== "user" && message.role !== "assistant") return undefined;
613	
614		const msgTimestamp = (message as { timestamp?: number }).timestamp;
615		if (typeof msgTimestamp === "number") {
616			return msgTimestamp;
617		}
618	
619		const t = new Date(entry.timestamp).getTime();
620		return Number.isNaN(t) ? undefined : t;
621	}
622	
623	async function buildSessionInfo(filePath: string): Promise<SessionInfo | null> {
624		try {
625			const stats = await stat(filePath);
626			let header: SessionHeader | null = null;
627			let messageCount = 0;
628			let firstMessage = "";
629			const allMessages: string[] = [];
630			let name: string | undefined;
631			let lastActivityTime: number | undefined;
632	
633			const rl = createInterface({
634				input: createReadStream(filePath, { encoding: "utf8" }),
635				crlfDelay: Infinity,
636			});
637	
638			for await (const line of rl) {
639				const entry = parseSessionEntryLine(line);
640				if (!entry) continue;
641	
642				if (!header) {
643					if (entry.type !== "session") return null;
644					header = entry;
645					continue;
646				}
647	
648				// Extract session name (use latest, including explicit clears)
649				if (entry.type === "session_info") {
650					name = entry.name?.trim() || undefined;
651				}
652	
653				if (entry.type !== "message") continue;
654				messageCount++;
655	
656				const activityTime = getMessageActivityTime(entry);
657				if (typeof activityTime === "number") {
658					lastActivityTime = Math.max(lastActivityTime ?? 0, activityTime);
659				}
660	
661				const message = entry.message;
662				if (!isMessageWithContent(message)) continue;
663				if (message.role !== "user" && message.role !== "assistant") continue;
664	
665				const textContent = extractTextContent(message);
666				if (!textContent) continue;
667	
668				allMessages.push(textContent);
669				if (!firstMessage && message.role === "user") {
670					firstMessage = textContent;
671				}
672			}
673	
674			if (!header) return null;
675	
676			const cwd = typeof header.cwd === "string" ? header.cwd : "";
677			const parentSessionPath = header.parentSession;
678			const headerTime = typeof header.timestamp === "string" ? new Date(header.timestamp).getTime() : NaN;
679			const modified =
680				typeof lastActivityTime === "number" && lastActivityTime > 0
681					? new Date(lastActivityTime)
682					: !Number.isNaN(headerTime)
683						? new Date(headerTime)
684						: stats.mtime;
685	
686			return {
687				path: filePath,
688				id: header.id,
689				cwd,
690				name,
691				parentSessionPath,
692				created: new Date(header.timestamp),
693				modified,
694				messageCount,
695				firstMessage: firstMessage || "(no messages)",
696				allMessagesText: allMessages.join(" "),
697			};
698		} catch {
699			return null;
700		}
701	}
702	
703	export type SessionListProgress = (loaded: number, total: number) => void;
704	
705	const MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSION_INFO_LOADS = 10;
706	
707	async function buildSessionInfosWithConcurrency(
708		files: string[],
709		onLoaded: () => void,
710	): Promise<(SessionInfo | null)[]> {
711		const results: (SessionInfo | null)[] = new Array(files.length).fill(null);
712		const inFlight = new Set<Promise<void>>();
713		let nextIndex = 0;
714	
715		const startNext = (): void => {
716			const index = nextIndex++;
717			const file = files[index];
718			if (!file) return;
719	
720			let task: Promise<void>;
721			task = buildSessionInfo(file)
722				.then((info) => {
723					results[index] = info;
724				})
725				.catch(() => {
726					results[index] = null;
727				})
728				.finally(() => {
729					inFlight.delete(task);
730					onLoaded();
731				});
732			inFlight.add(task);
733		};
734	
735		while (nextIndex < files.length || inFlight.size > 0) {
736			while (nextIndex < files.length && inFlight.size < MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSION_INFO_LOADS) {
737				startNext();
738			}
739			if (inFlight.size > 0) {
740				await Promise.race(inFlight);
741			}
742		}
743	
744		return results;
745	}
746	
747	async function listSessionsFromDir(
748		dir: string,
749		onProgress?: SessionListProgress,
750		progressOffset = 0,
751		progressTotal?: number,
752	): Promise<SessionInfo[]> {
753		const sessions: SessionInfo[] = [];
754		if (!existsSync(dir)) {
755			return sessions;
756		}
757	
758		try {
759			const dirEntries = await readdir(dir);
760			const files = dirEntries.filter((f) => f.endsWith(".jsonl")).map((f) => join(dir, f));
761			const total = progressTotal ?? files.length;
762	
763			let loaded = 0;
764			const results = await buildSessionInfosWithConcurrency(files, () => {
765				loaded++;
766				onProgress?.(progressOffset + loaded, total);
767			});
768			for (const info of results) {
769				if (info) {
770					sessions.push(info);
771				}
772			}
773		} catch {
774			// Return empty list on error
775		}
776	
777		return sessions;
778	}
779	
780	/**
781	 * Manages conversation sessions as append-only trees stored in JSONL files.
782	 *
783	 * Each session entry has an id and parentId forming a tree structure. The "leaf"
784	 * pointer tracks the current position. Appending creates a child of the current leaf.
785	 * Branching moves the leaf to an earlier entry, allowing new branches without
786	 * modifying history.
787	 *
788	 * Use buildSessionContext() to get the resolved message list for the LLM, which
789	 * handles compaction summaries and follows the path from root to current leaf.
790	 */
791	export class SessionManager {
792		private sessionId: string = "";
793		private sessionFile: string | undefined;
794		private sessionDir: string;
795		private cwd: string;
796		private persist: boolean;
797		private flushed: boolean = false;
798		private fileEntries: FileEntry[] = [];
799		private byId: Map<string, SessionEntry> = new Map();
800		private labelsById: Map<string, string> = new Map();
801		private labelTimestampsById: Map<string, string> = new Map();
802		private leafId: string | null = null;
803	
804		private constructor(
805			cwd: string,
806			sessionDir: string,
807			sessionFile: string | undefined,
808			persist: boolean,
809			newSessionOptions?: NewSessionOptions,
810		) {
811			this.cwd = resolvePath(cwd);
812			this.sessionDir = normalizePath(sessionDir);
813			this.persist = persist;
814			if (persist && this.sessionDir && !existsSync(this.sessionDir)) {
815				mkdirSync(this.sessionDir, { recursive: true });
816			}
817	
818			if (sessionFile) {
819				this.setSessionFile(sessionFile);
820			} else {
821				this.newSession(newSessionOptions);
822			}
823		}
824	
825		/** Switch to a different session file (used for resume and branching) */
826		setSessionFile(sessionFile: string): void {
827			this.sessionFile = resolvePath(sessionFile);
828			if (existsSync(this.sessionFile)) {
829				this.fileEntries = loadEntriesFromFile(this.sessionFile);
830	
831				// If file was empty, initialize it with a valid session header. If it was
832				// non-empty but did not parse as a pi session, fail without modifying it.
833				if (this.fileEntries.length === 0) {
834					const explicitPath = this.sessionFile;
835					if (statSync(explicitPath).size > 0) {
836						throw new Error(`Session file is not a valid pi session: ${explicitPath}`);
837					}
838					this.newSession();
839					this.sessionFile = explicitPath;
840					this._rewriteFile();
841					this.flushed = true;
842					return;
843				}
844	
845				const header = this.fileEntries.find((e) => e.type === "session") as SessionHeader | undefined;
846				this.sessionId = header?.id ?? createSessionId();
847	
848				if (migrateToCurrentVersion(this.fileEntries)) {
849					this._rewriteFile();
850				}
851	
852				this._buildIndex();
853				this.flushed = true;
854			} else {
855				const explicitPath = this.sessionFile;
856				this.newSession();
857				this.sessionFile = explicitPath; // preserve explicit path from --session flag
858			}
859		}
860	
861		newSession(options?: NewSessionOptions): string | undefined {
862			if (options?.id !== undefined) {
863				assertValidSessionId(options.id);
864			}
865			this.sessionId = options?.id ?? createSessionId();
866			const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
867			const header: SessionHeader = {
868				type: "session",
869				version: CURRENT_SESSION_VERSION,
870				id: this.sessionId,
871				timestamp,
872				cwd: this.cwd,
873				parentSession: options?.parentSession,
874			};
875			this.fileEntries = [header];
876			this.byId.clear();
877			this.labelsById.clear();
878			this.labelTimestampsById.clear();
879			this.leafId = null;
880			this.flushed = false;
881	
882			if (this.persist) {
883				const fileTimestamp = timestamp.replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
884				this.sessionFile = join(this.getSessionDir(), `${fileTimestamp}_${this.sessionId}.jsonl`);
885			}
886			return this.sessionFile;
887		}
888	
889		private _buildIndex(): void {
890			this.byId.clear();
891			this.labelsById.clear();
892			this.labelTimestampsById.clear();
893			this.leafId = null;
894			for (const entry of this.fileEntries) {
895				if (entry.type === "session") continue;
896				this.byId.set(entry.id, entry);
897				this.leafId = entry.id;
898				if (entry.type === "label") {
899					if (entry.label) {
900						this.labelsById.set(entry.targetId, entry.label);
901						this.labelTimestampsById.set(entry.targetId, entry.timestamp);
902					} else {
903						this.labelsById.delete(entry.targetId);
904						this.labelTimestampsById.delete(entry.targetId);
905					}
906				}
907			}
908		}
909	
910		private _rewriteFile(): void {
911			if (!this.persist || !this.sessionFile) return;
912			const fd = openSync(this.sessionFile, "w");
913			try {
914				for (const entry of this.fileEntries) {
915					writeFileSync(fd, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);
916				}
917			} finally {
918				closeSync(fd);
919			}
920		}
921	
922		isPersisted(): boolean {
923			return this.persist;
924		}
925	
926		getCwd(): string {
927			return this.cwd;
928		}
929	
930		getSessionDir(): string {
931			return this.sessionDir;
932		}
933	
934		usesDefaultSessionDir(): boolean {

936		}
937	
938		getSessionId(): string {

940		}
941	
942		getSessionFile(): string | undefined {

944		}
945	
946		_persist(entry: SessionEntry): void {
947			if (!this.persist || !this.sessionFile) return;
948	
949			const hasAssistant = this.fileEntries.some((e) => e.type === "message" && e.message.role === "assistant");
950			if (!hasAssistant) {
951				if (this.flushed) {
952					appendFileSync(this.sessionFile, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);
953				} else {
954					// Mark as not flushed so when assistant arrives, all entries get written
955					this.flushed = false;
956				}
957				return;
958			}
959	
960			if (!this.flushed) {
961				const fd = openSync(this.sessionFile, "wx");
962				try {
963					for (const e of this.fileEntries) {
964						writeFileSync(fd, `${JSON.stringify(e)}\n`);
965					}
966				} finally {
967					closeSync(fd);
968				}
969				this.flushed = true;
970			} else {
971				appendFileSync(this.sessionFile, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);
972			}
973		}
974	
975		private _appendEntry(entry: SessionEntry): void {
976			this.fileEntries.push(entry);
977			this.byId.set(entry.id, entry);
978			this.leafId = entry.id;
979			this._persist(entry);
980		}

982		/** Append a message as child of current leaf, then advance leaf. Returns entry id.

984		 * Reason: we want these to be top-level entries in the session, not message session entries,
985		 * so it is easier to find them.
986		 * These need to be appended via appendCompaction() and appendBranchSummary() methods.
987		 */

993				timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
994				message,
995			};
996			this._appendEntry(entry);
997			return entry.id;
998		}

1078		/** Get the current session name from the latest session_info entry, if any. */
1079		getSessionName(): string | undefined {
1080			// Walk entries in reverse to find the latest session_info entry.
1081			// Empty names explicitly clear the session title.
1082			const entries = this.getEntries();
1083			for (let i = entries.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
1084				const entry = entries[i];
1085				if (entry.type === "session_info") {
1086					return entry.name?.trim() || undefined;
1087				}
1088			}
1089			return undefined;
1090		}

1096		 * @param display Whether to show in TUI (true = styled display, false = hidden)
1097		 * @param details Optional extension-specific metadata (not sent to LLM)

1101			customType: string,

1110				display,

1115			};

1119	
1120		// =========================================================================
1121		// Tree Traversal
1122		// =========================================================================
1123	
1124		getLeafId(): string | null {
1125			return this.leafId;
1126		}
1127	
1128		getLeafEntry(): SessionEntry | undefined {
1129			return this.leafId ? this.byId.get(this.leafId) : undefined;

1132		getEntry(id: string): SessionEntry | undefined {

1134		}
1135	
1136		/**
1137		 * Get all direct children of an entry.
1138		 */
1139		getChildren(parentId: string): SessionEntry[] {
1140			const children: SessionEntry[] = [];
1141			for (const entry of this.byId.values()) {
1142				if (entry.parentId === parentId) {
1143					children.push(entry);
1144				}
1145			}
1146			return children;
1147		}
1148	
1149		/**
1150		 * Get the label for an entry, if any.
1151		 */
1152		getLabel(id: string): string | undefined {
1153			return this.labelsById.get(id);
1154		}
1155	
1156		/**
1157		 * Set or clear a label on an entry.
1158		 * Labels are user-defined markers for bookmarking/navigation.
1159		 * Pass undefined or empty string to clear the label.
1160		 */
1161		appendLabelChange(targetId: string, label: string | undefined): string {
1162			if (!this.byId.has(targetId)) {
1163				throw new Error(`Entry ${targetId} not found`);
1164			}
1165			const entry: LabelEntry = {
1166				type: "label",
1167				id: generateId(this.byId),
1168				parentId: this.leafId,
1169				timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
1170				targetId,
1171				label,
1172			};
1173			this._appendEntry(entry);
1174			if (label) {
1175				this.labelsById.set(targetId, label);
1176				this.labelTimestampsById.set(targetId, entry.timestamp);
1177			} else {
1178				this.labelsById.delete(targetId);
1179				this.labelTimestampsById.delete(targetId);
1180			}
1181			return entry.id;
1182		}
1183	
1184		/**
1185		 * Walk from entry to root, returning all entries in path order.
1186		 * Includes all entry types (messages, compaction, model changes, etc.).
1187		 * Use buildSessionContext() to get the resolved messages for the LLM.
1188		 */
1189		getBranch(fromId?: string): SessionEntry[] {
1190			const path: SessionEntry[] = [];
1191			const startId = fromId ?? this.leafId;
1192			let current = startId ? this.byId.get(startId) : undefined;
1193			while (current) {
1194				path.push(current);
1195				current = current.parentId ? this.byId.get(current.parentId) : undefined;
1196			}
1197			path.reverse();
1198			return path;
1199		}
1200	
1201		/**
1202		 * Build the active, compaction-aware entry list for context/rendering.
1203		 * Uses tree traversal from current leaf.
1204		 */
1205		buildContextEntries(): SessionEntry[] {
1206			return buildContextEntries(this.getEntries(), this.leafId, this.byId);
1207		}
1208	
1209		/**
1210		 * Build the session context (what gets sent to the LLM).
1211		 * Uses tree traversal from current leaf.
1212		 */
1213		buildSessionContext(): SessionContext {
1214			return buildSessionContext(this.getEntries(), this.leafId, this.byId);
1215		}
1216	
1217		/**
1218		 * Get session header.
1219		 */
1220		getHeader(): SessionHeader | null {
1221			const h = this.fileEntries.find((e) => e.type === "session");
1222			return h ? (h as SessionHeader) : null;
1223		}
1224	
1225		/**
1226		 * Get all session entries (excludes header). Returns a shallow copy.
1227		 * The session is append-only: use appendXXX() to add entries, branch() to
1228		 * change the leaf pointer. Entries cannot be modified or deleted.
1229		 */
1230		getEntries(): SessionEntry[] {
1231			return this.fileEntries.filter((e): e is SessionEntry => e.type !== "session");
1232		}
1233	
1234		/**
1235		 * Get the session as a tree structure. Returns a shallow defensive copy of all entries.
1236		 * A well-formed session has exactly one root (first entry with parentId === null).
1237		 * Orphaned entries (broken parent chain) are also returned as roots.
1238		 */
1239		getTree(): SessionTreeNode[] {
1240			const entries = this.getEntries();
1241			const nodeMap = new Map<string, SessionTreeNode>();
1242			const roots: SessionTreeNode[] = [];
1243	
1244			// Create nodes with resolved labels
1245			for (const entry of entries) {
1246				const label = this.labelsById.get(entry.id);
1247				const labelTimestamp = this.labelTimestampsById.get(entry.id);
1248				nodeMap.set(entry.id, { entry, children: [], label, labelTimestamp });
1249			}
1250	
1251			// Build tree
1252			for (const entry of entries) {
1253				const node = nodeMap.get(entry.id)!;
1254				if (entry.parentId === null || entry.parentId === entry.id) {
1255					roots.push(node);
1256				} else {
1257					const parent = nodeMap.get(entry.parentId);
1258					if (parent) {
1259						parent.children.push(node);
1260					} else {
1261						// Orphan - treat as root
1262						roots.push(node);
1263					}
1264				}
1265			}
1266	
1267			// Sort children by timestamp (oldest first, newest at bottom)
1268			// Use iterative approach to avoid stack overflow on deep trees
1269			const stack: SessionTreeNode[] = [...roots];
1270			while (stack.length > 0) {
1271				const node = stack.pop()!;
1272				node.children.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.entry.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.entry.timestamp).getTime());
1273				stack.push(...node.children);
1274			}
1275	
1276			return roots;
1277		}
1278	
1279		// =========================================================================
1280		// Branching
1281		// =========================================================================
1282	
1283		/**
1284		 * Start a new branch from an earlier entry.
1285		 * Moves the leaf pointer to the specified entry. The next appendXXX() call
1286		 * will create a child of that entry, forming a new branch. Existing entries
1287		 * are not modified or deleted.
1288		 */
1289		branch(branchFromId: string): void {
1290			if (!this.byId.has(branchFromId)) {
1291				throw new Error(`Entry ${branchFromId} not found`);
1292			}
1293			this.leafId = branchFromId;
1294		}
1295	
1296		/**
1297		 * Reset the leaf pointer to null (before any entries).
1298		 * The next appendXXX() call will create a new root entry (parentId = null).
1299		 * Use this when navigating to re-edit the first user message.
1300		 */
1301		resetLeaf(): void {
1302			this.leafId = null;
1303		}
1304	
1305		/**
1306		 * Start a new branch with a summary of the abandoned path.
1307		 * Same as branch(), but also appends a branch_summary entry that captures
1308		 * context from the abandoned conversation path.
1309		 */
1310		branchWithSummary(branchFromId: string | null, summary: string, details?: unknown, fromHook?: boolean): string {
1311			if (branchFromId !== null && !this.byId.has(branchFromId)) {
1312				throw new Error(`Entry ${branchFromId} not found`);
1313			}
1314			this.leafId = branchFromId;
1315			const entry: BranchSummaryEntry = {
1316				type: "branch_summary",
1317				id: generateId(this.byId),
1318				parentId: branchFromId,
1319				timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
1320				fromId: branchFromId ?? "root",
1321				summary,
1322				details,
1323				fromHook,
1324			};
1325			this._appendEntry(entry);
1326			return entry.id;
1327		}
1328	
1329		/**
1330		 * Create a new session file containing only the path from root to the specified leaf.
1331		 * Useful for extracting a single conversation path from a branched session.
1332		 * Returns the new session file path, or undefined if not persisting.
1333		 */
1334		createBranchedSession(leafId: string): string | undefined {
1335			const previousSessionFile = this.sessionFile;
1336			const path = this.getBranch(leafId);
1337			if (path.length === 0) {
1338				throw new Error(`Entry ${leafId} not found`);
1339			}
1340	
1341			// Filter out LabelEntry from path - we'll recreate them from the resolved map.
1342			// Because labels are real tree entries, later entries can be children of labels;
1343			// removing labels requires re-chaining the retained path to avoid orphaned subtrees.
1344			const pathWithoutLabels: SessionEntry[] = [];
1345			let pathParentId: string | null = null;
1346			for (const entry of path) {
1347				if (entry.type === "label") continue;
1348				pathWithoutLabels.push({ ...entry, parentId: pathParentId });
1349				pathParentId = entry.id;
1350			}
1351	
1352			const newSessionId = createSessionId();
1353			const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
1354			const fileTimestamp = timestamp.replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
1355			const newSessionFile = join(this.getSessionDir(), `${fileTimestamp}_${newSessionId}.jsonl`);
1356	
1357			const header: SessionHeader = {
1358				type: "session",
1359				version: CURRENT_SESSION_VERSION,
1360				id: newSessionId,
1361				timestamp,
1362				cwd: this.cwd,
1363				parentSession: this.persist ? previousSessionFile : undefined,
1364			};
1365	
1366			// Collect labels for entries in the path
1367			const pathEntryIds = new Set(pathWithoutLabels.map((e) => e.id));
1368			const labelsToWrite: Array<{ targetId: string; label: string; timestamp: string }> = [];
1369			for (const [targetId, label] of this.labelsById) {
1370				if (pathEntryIds.has(targetId)) {
1371					labelsToWrite.push({ targetId, label, timestamp: this.labelTimestampsById.get(targetId)! });
1372				}
1373			}
1374	
1375			if (this.persist) {
1376				// Build label entries
1377				const lastEntryId = pathWithoutLabels[pathWithoutLabels.length - 1]?.id || null;
1378				let parentId = lastEntryId;
1379				const labelEntries: LabelEntry[] = [];
1380				for (const { targetId, label, timestamp: labelTimestamp } of labelsToWrite) {
1381					const labelEntry: LabelEntry = {
1382						type: "label",
1383						id: generateId(new Set(pathEntryIds)),
1384						parentId,
1385						timestamp: labelTimestamp,
1386						targetId,
1387						label,
1388					};
1389					pathEntryIds.add(labelEntry.id);
1390					labelEntries.push(labelEntry);
1391					parentId = labelEntry.id;
1392				}
1393	
1394				this.fileEntries = [header, ...pathWithoutLabels, ...labelEntries];
1395				this.sessionId = newSessionId;
1396				this.sessionFile = newSessionFile;
1397				this._buildIndex();
1398	
1399				// Only write the file now if it contains an assistant message.
1400				// Otherwise defer to _persist(), which creates the file on the
1401				// first assistant response, matching the newSession() contract
1402				// and avoiding the duplicate-header bug when _persist()'s
1403				// no-assistant guard later resets flushed to false.
1404				const hasAssistant = this.fileEntries.some((e) => e.type === "message" && e.message.role === "assistant");
1405				if (hasAssistant) {
1406					this._rewriteFile();
1407					this.flushed = true;
1408				} else {
1409					this.flushed = false;
1410				}
1411	
1412				return newSessionFile;
1413			}
1414	
1415			// In-memory mode: replace current session with the path + labels
1416			const labelEntries: LabelEntry[] = [];
1417			let parentId = pathWithoutLabels[pathWithoutLabels.length - 1]?.id || null;
1418			for (const { targetId, label, timestamp: labelTimestamp } of labelsToWrite) {
1419				const labelEntry: LabelEntry = {
1420					type: "label",
1421					id: generateId(new Set([...pathEntryIds, ...labelEntries.map((e) => e.id)])),
1422					parentId,
1423					timestamp: labelTimestamp,
1424					targetId,
1425					label,
1426				};
1427				labelEntries.push(labelEntry);
1428				parentId = labelEntry.id;
1429			}
1430			this.fileEntries = [header, ...pathWithoutLabels, ...labelEntries];
1431			this.sessionId = newSessionId;
1432			this._buildIndex();
1433			return undefined;
1434		}
1435	
1436		/**
1437		 * Create a new session.
1438		 * @param cwd Working directory (stored in session header)
1439		 * @param sessionDir Optional session directory. If omitted, uses default (~/.pi/agent/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/).
1440		 */
1441		static create(cwd: string, sessionDir?: string, options?: NewSessionOptions): SessionManager {
1442			const dir = sessionDir ? normalizePath(sessionDir) : getDefaultSessionDir(cwd);
1443			return new SessionManager(cwd, dir, undefined, true, options);
1444		}
1445	
1446		/**
1447		 * Open a specific session file.
1448		 * @param path Path to session file
1449		 * @param sessionDir Optional session directory for /new or /branch. If omitted, derives from file's parent.
1450		 * @param cwdOverride Optional cwd override instead of the session header cwd.
1451		 */
1452		static open(path: string, sessionDir?: string, cwdOverride?: string): SessionManager {
1453			const resolvedPath = resolvePath(path);
1454			// Extract cwd from session header if possible, otherwise use process.cwd()
1455			const entries = loadEntriesFromFile(resolvedPath);
1456			const header = entries.find((e) => e.type === "session") as SessionHeader | undefined;
1457			const cwd = cwdOverride ?? header?.cwd ?? process.cwd();
1458			// If no sessionDir provided, derive from file's parent directory
1459			const dir = sessionDir ? normalizePath(sessionDir) : resolve(resolvedPath, "..");
1460			return new SessionManager(cwd, dir, resolvedPath, true);
1461		}
1462	
1463		/**
1464		 * Continue the most recent session, or create new if none.
1465		 * @param cwd Working directory
1466		 * @param sessionDir Optional session directory. If omitted, uses default (~/.pi/agent/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/).
1467		 */
1468		static continueRecent(cwd: string, sessionDir?: string): SessionManager {
1469			const dir = sessionDir ? normalizePath(sessionDir) : getDefaultSessionDir(cwd);
1470			const filterCwd = sessionDir !== undefined && dir !== getDefaultSessionDirPath(cwd);

1483		/**
1484		 * Fork a session from another project directory into the current project.

1486		 * @param sourcePath Path to the source session file

1489		 */
1490		static forkFrom(
1491			sourcePath: string,
1492			targetCwd: string,
1493			sessionDir?: string,
1494			options?: NewSessionOptions,
1495		): SessionManager {
1496			const resolvedSourcePath = resolvePath(sourcePath);
1497			const resolvedTargetCwd = resolvePath(targetCwd);
1498			const sourceEntries = loadEntriesFromFile(resolvedSourcePath);
1499			if (sourceEntries.length === 0) {
1500				throw new Error(`Cannot fork: source session file is empty or invalid: ${resolvedSourcePath}`);
1501			}
1502	
1503			const sourceHeader = sourceEntries.find((e) => e.type === "session") as SessionHeader | undefined;
1504			if (!sourceHeader) {
1505				throw new Error(`Cannot fork: source session has no header: ${resolvedSourcePath}`);
1506			}
1507	
1508			const dir = sessionDir ? normalizePath(sessionDir) : getDefaultSessionDir(resolvedTargetCwd);
1509			if (!existsSync(dir)) {
1510				mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
1511			}
1512	
1513			// Create new session file with new ID but forked content
1514			if (options?.id !== undefined) {
1515				assertValidSessionId(options.id);
1516			}
1517			const newSessionId = options?.id ?? createSessionId();
1518			const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
1519			const fileTimestamp = timestamp.replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
1520			const newSessionFile = join(dir, `${fileTimestamp}_${newSessionId}.jsonl`);
1521	
1522			// Write new header pointing to source as parent, with updated cwd
1523			const newHeader: SessionHeader = {
1524				type: "session",
1525				version: CURRENT_SESSION_VERSION,
1526				id: newSessionId,
1527				timestamp,
1528				cwd: resolvedTargetCwd,
1529				parentSession: resolvedSourcePath,
1530			};
1531			writeFileSync(newSessionFile, `${JSON.stringify(newHeader)}\n`, { flag: "wx" });
1532	
1533			// Copy all non-header entries from source
1534			for (const entry of sourceEntries) {
1535				if (entry.type !== "session") {
1536					appendFileSync(newSessionFile, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);

1589				let totalFiles = 0;
1590				const dirFiles: string[][] = [];
1591				for (const dir of dirs) {

35	// Check verifies that the Droid CLI is available and returns its resolved
36	// location and version information based on the provided custom command override.
37	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
38		cmdName, _ := parseDroidCommand(customCommand)
39		isCustom := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != ""
40		versionFlag := "--version"
41	
42		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
43		if err != nil {
44			msg := buildCheckErrorMessage("not_found", cmdName, isCustom, "")
45			trackCheckFailure("droid", isCustom, cmdName, "", versionFlag, "", "not_found", err.Error())
46			return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: "", ErrorMessage: msg}
47		}
48	
49		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
50		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
51		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
52		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
53		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
54			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
55			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
56			msg := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, resolved, isCustom, stderrOutput)
57			trackCheckFailure("droid", isCustom, cmdName, resolved, versionFlag, stderrOutput, errorType, err.Error())
58			return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: resolved, ErrorMessage: msg}
59		}
60	
61		versionOutput := sanitizeDroidVersion(stdout.String())
62		version := extractDroidVersion(versionOutput)
63		if version == "" {
64			version = strings.TrimSpace(versionOutput)
65		}
66		trackCheckSuccess("droid", isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version, versionFlag)
67		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
68	}

103	// additional raw session details may be included in the converted sessions.
104	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
105		files, err := listSessionFiles()
106		if err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, len(files))
110		normalizedProject := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
111	
112		// Filter files to those matching the project (for accurate progress count)
113		var matchingFiles []sessionFile
114		for _, file := range files {
115			if normalizedProject != "" && !sessionMentionsProject(file.Path, normalizedProject) {
116				continue
117			}
118			matchingFiles = append(matchingFiles, file)
119		}
120	
121		totalFiles := len(matchingFiles)
122	
123		for i, file := range matchingFiles {
124			session, err := parseFactorySession(file.Path)
125			if err != nil {
126				slog.Debug("droidcli: skipping session", "path", file.Path, "error", err)
127				// Report progress even for failed sessions
128				if progress != nil {
129					progress(i+1, totalFiles)
130				}
131				continue
132			}
133			chat := convertToAgentSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
134			if chat != nil {
135				result = append(result, *chat)
136			}
137	
138			// Report progress after each session
139			if progress != nil {
140				progress(i+1, totalFiles)
141			}
142		}
143		return result, nil
144	}

164	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Factory Droid CLI agent for the given project and,
165	// when a session callback is provided, watches for new or updated chat sessions and
166	// invokes the callback as they are discovered.
167	func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
168		if sessionCallback == nil {
169			return ExecuteDroid(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
170		}
171	
172		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
173		defer cancel()
174	
175		watchErr := make(chan error, 1)
176		go func() {
177			watchErr <- watchSessions(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
178		}()
179	
180		err := ExecuteDroid(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
181		cancel()
182	
183		if werr := <-watchErr; werr != nil && !errors.Is(werr, context.Canceled) {
184			slog.Warn("droidcli: watcher stopped with error", "error", werr)
185		}
186	
187		if err != nil {
188			return fmt.Errorf("factory droid CLI execution failed: %w", err)
189		}
190		return nil
191	}

230	func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
231		var execErr *exec.Error
232		var pathErr *os.PathError
233		switch {
234		case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
235			return "not_found"
236		case errors.As(err, &pathErr) && errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission):
237			return "permission_denied"
238		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
239			return "permission_denied"
240		default:
241			return "version_failed"
242		}
243	}
244	
245	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
246		var builder strings.Builder
247		switch errorType {
248		case "not_found":
249			builder.WriteString("Factory Droid CLI was not found.\n\n")
250			if isCustom {
251				builder.WriteString("• Verify the custom path you provided is executable.\n")
252				fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "• Provided command: %s\n", command)
253			} else {
254				builder.WriteString("• Install the Factory CLI and ensure `droid` is on your PATH.\n")

162	// Check verifies Claude Code installation and returns version info
163	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
164		// Parse the command (no resume session for version check)
165		claudeCmd, _ := parseClaudeCommand(customCommand, "")
166	
167		// Determine if custom command was used
168		isCustomCommand := customCommand != ""
169	
170		// Resolve the actual path of the command
171		resolvedPath := claudeCmd
172		if !filepath.IsAbs(claudeCmd) {
173			// Try to find the command in PATH
174			if path, err := exec.LookPath(claudeCmd); err == nil {
175				resolvedPath = path
176			}
177		}
178	
179		// Run claude -v to check version (ignore custom args for version check)
180		cmd := exec.Command(claudeCmd, "-v")
181		var out bytes.Buffer
182		var errOut bytes.Buffer
183		cmd.Stdout = &out
184		cmd.Stderr = &errOut
185	
186		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
187			// Track installation check failure
188			errorType := "unknown"
189	
190			var execErr *exec.Error
191			var pathErr *os.PathError
192	
193			// Check error types in order of specificity
194			switch {
195			case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
196				errorType = "not_found"
197			case errors.As(err, &pathErr):
198				if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrNotExist) {
199					errorType = "not_found"
200				} else if errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission) {
201					errorType = "permission_denied"
202				}
203			case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
204				errorType = "permission_denied"
205			}
206	
207			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(errOut.String())
208			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
209				"provider":       "claude",
210				"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
211				"command_path":   claudeCmd,
212				"error_type":     errorType,
213				"error_message":  err.Error(),
214			})
215	
216			errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, stderrOutput)
217	
218			return spi.CheckResult{
219				Success:      false,
220				Version:      "",
221				Location:     resolvedPath,
222				ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
223			}
224		}
225	
226		// Check if output contains "Claude Code"
227		output := out.String()
228		if !strings.Contains(output, "(Claude Code)") {
229			// Track unexpected output error
230			analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, analytics.Properties{
231				"provider":       "claude",
232				"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
233				"command_path":   claudeCmd,
234				"error_type":     "unexpected_output",
235				"output":         strings.TrimSpace(output),
236			})
237	
238			errorMessage := buildCheckErrorMessage("unexpected_output", claudeCmd, isCustomCommand, output)
239	
240			return spi.CheckResult{
241				Success:      false,
242				Version:      "",
243				Location:     resolvedPath,
244				ErrorMessage: errorMessage,
245			}
246		}
247	
248		// Success! Track it
249		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, analytics.Properties{
250			"provider":       "claude",
251			"custom_command": isCustomCommand,
252			"command_path":   resolvedPath,
253			"version":        strings.TrimSpace(output),
254		})
255	
256		return spi.CheckResult{
257			Success:      true,
258			Version:      strings.TrimSpace(output),
259			Location:     resolvedPath,
260			ErrorMessage: "",
261		}
262	}

436	// extractPathHints extracts file paths from tool input.
437	// cwd is the shell's working directory at the time of the tool call (from the
438	// JSONL record's top-level cwd field), used to resolve relative paths in shell commands.
439	func extractPathHints(input map[string]interface{}, cwd, workspaceRoot string) []string {
440		var paths []string
441	
442		// Common path field names
443		pathFields := []string{"file_path", "path", "filename", "old_path", "new_path"}
444		arrayFields := []string{"paths", "files", "targets"}
445	
446		// Extract single path fields
447		for _, field := range pathFields {
448			if value, ok := input[field].(string); ok && value != "" {
449				normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
450				if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
451					paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
452				}
453			}
454		}
455	
456		// Extract array path fields
457		for _, field := range arrayFields {
458			if arr, ok := input[field].([]interface{}); ok {
459				for _, item := range arr {
460					if path, ok := item.(string); ok && path != "" {
461						normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(path, workspaceRoot)
462						if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
463							paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
464						}
465					}
466				}
467			}
468		}
469	
470		// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
471		if command, ok := input["command"].(string); ok && command != "" {
472			shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
473			for _, sp := range shellPaths {
474				if !contains(paths, sp) {
475					paths = append(paths, sp)
476				}
477			}
478		}
479	
480		return paths
481	}

570	// extractPathHints extracts file paths from tool inputs.
571	// For apply_patch: parses patch format for file paths.
572	// For other tools: checks common path fields like "path", "file", etc.
573	func extractPathHints(toolName string, input map[string]interface{}, inputText string, workspaceRoot string) []string {
574		var paths []string
575	
576		if toolName == "apply_patch" {
577			// Parse patch format to extract file paths
578			// Look for lines like "*** Modify File: path", "*** Create File: path", "*** Delete File: path"
579			if inputText != "" {
580				paths = extractPathsFromPatch(inputText, workspaceRoot)
581			} else if inputStr, ok := input["input"].(string); ok {
582				paths = extractPathsFromPatch(inputStr, workspaceRoot)
583			}
584		} else {
585			// For other tools, check common path fields
586			pathFields := []string{"path", "file", "filename", "file_path"}
587			for _, field := range pathFields {
588				if value, ok := input[field].(string); ok && value != "" {
589					normalizedPath := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
590					if !contains(paths, normalizedPath) {
591						paths = append(paths, normalizedPath)
592					}
593				}
594			}
595	
596			// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
597			// exec_command uses "cmd", shell_command uses "command"
598			command, _ := input["command"].(string)
599			if command == "" {
600				command, _ = input["cmd"].(string)
601			}
602			if command != "" {
603				cwd, _ := input["workdir"].(string)
604				if cwd == "" {
605					cwd = workspaceRoot
606				}
607				shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
608				for _, sp := range shellPaths {
609					if !contains(paths, sp) {
610						paths = append(paths, sp)
611					}
612				}
613			}
614		}
615	
616		return paths
617	}

122	// writePatchSection writes a file operation section (Add/Modify) with its diff content.
123	// This is a helper to avoid code duplication in formatApplyPatch.
124	func writePatchSection(result *strings.Builder, operation, filename string, patchContent *strings.Builder) {
125		if patchContent.Len() > 0 {
126			fmt.Fprintf(result, "**%s: `%s`**\n\n", capitalizeFirst(operation), filename)

133	// formatApplyPatch formats the apply_patch tool usage with file operations and patch content.
134	// The input parameter contains the patch in unified diff format with special markers:
135	// *** Begin Patch, *** Add File:, *** Modify File:, *** Update File:, *** Delete File:, *** End Patch
136	func formatApplyPatch(toolName string, input string) string {
137		var result strings.Builder
138	
139		if input == "" {
140			return ""
141		}
142	
143		// Parse the patch to extract file operations
144		lines := strings.Split(input, "\n")
145		var currentFile string
146		var currentOp string // "add", "modify", "delete"
147		var patchContent strings.Builder
148		inPatch := false
149	
150		for _, line := range lines {
151			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** Begin Patch") {
152				inPatch = true
153				continue
154			}
155			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** End Patch") {
156				// Write any remaining patch content
157				if currentFile != "" {
158					writePatchSection(&result, currentOp, currentFile, &patchContent)
159				}
160				break
161			}
162	
163			if !inPatch {
164				continue
165			}
166	
167			// Check for file operation markers
168			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** Add File: ") {
169				// Write previous file's patch if any
170				if currentFile != "" {
171					writePatchSection(&result, currentOp, currentFile, &patchContent)
172				}
173				currentFile = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "*** Add File: ")
174				currentOp = "add"
175				patchContent.Reset()
176			} else if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** Modify File: ") {
177				// Write previous file's patch if any
178				if currentFile != "" {
179					writePatchSection(&result, currentOp, currentFile, &patchContent)
180				}
181				currentFile = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "*** Modify File: ")
182				currentOp = "modify"
183				patchContent.Reset()
184			} else if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** Update File: ") {
185				// Write previous file's patch if any
186				if currentFile != "" {
187					writePatchSection(&result, currentOp, currentFile, &patchContent)
188				}
189				currentFile = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "*** Update File: ")
190				currentOp = "update"
191				patchContent.Reset()
192			} else if strings.HasPrefix(line, "*** Delete File: ") {
193				// Write previous file's patch if any
194				if currentFile != "" {
195					writePatchSection(&result, currentOp, currentFile, &patchContent)
196				}
197				currentFile = strings.TrimPrefix(line, "*** Delete File: ")
198				patchContent.Reset()
199				// For delete operations, just show the header
200				fmt.Fprintf(&result, "**Delete: `%s`**\n\n", currentFile)
201				currentFile = ""
202				currentOp = ""
203			} else if currentFile != "" {
204				// This is patch content for the current file
205				patchContent.WriteString(line)
206				patchContent.WriteString("\n")
207			}
208		}
209	
210		return result.String()
211	}

241				} else {

220		items: TIn[],

222		fn: (item: TIn, index: number) => Promise<TOut>,
223	): Promise<TOut[]> {
224		if (items.length === 0) return [];
225		const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(concurrency, items.length));
226		const results: TOut[] = new Array(items.length);
227		let nextIndex = 0;

132	func formatBashTool(toolName string, input map[string]interface{}, description string) string {
133		var result strings.Builder
134	
135		// Add description with blank line separator if provided
136		if description != "" {
137			result.WriteString(description)
138			result.WriteString("\n")
139		}
140	
141		// Add command on new line in backticks
142		if input != nil {
143			if command, ok := input["command"].(string); ok && command != "" {
144				// If command includes \n we wrap it in a code block
145				if strings.Contains(command, "\n") {
146					escapedCommand := strings.ReplaceAll(command, "```", "\\```")
147					fmt.Fprintf(&result, "\n```bash\n%s\n```", escapedCommand)
148				} else {
149					fmt.Fprintf(&result, "\n`%s`", command)
150				}
151			}
152		}
153	
154		return result.String()
155	}

350	func extractPathHints(input map[string]interface{}, workspaceRoot string) []string {
351		fields := []string{"path", "file_path", "filePath", "dir", "directory",
352			"workdir", "cwd", "target"}
353		var hints []string
354		if input == nil {
355			return hints
356		}
357		for _, field := range fields {
358			val, ok := input[field]
359			if !ok {
360				continue
361			}
362			switch v := val.(type) {
363			case string:
364				addPathHint(&hints, v, workspaceRoot)
365			case []interface{}:
366				for _, entry := range v {
367					if s, ok := entry.(string); ok {
368						addPathHint(&hints, s, workspaceRoot)
369					}
370				}
371			case json.Number:
372				addPathHint(&hints, v.String(), workspaceRoot)
373			}
374		}
375	
376		// Extract paths from shell commands (redirect targets, file-creating commands)
377		// Check both "command" and "cmd" field names for shell tools
378		command, _ := input["command"].(string)
379		if command == "" {
380			command, _ = input["cmd"].(string)
381		}
382		if command != "" {
383			cwd, _ := input["workdir"].(string)
384			if cwd == "" {
385				cwd, _ = input["cwd"].(string)
386			}
387			if cwd == "" {
388				cwd = workspaceRoot
389			}
390			shellPaths := spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot)
391			for _, sp := range shellPaths {
392				addPathHint(&hints, sp, workspaceRoot)
393			}
394		}
395	
396		return hints
397	}
398	
399	func addPathHint(hints *[]string, value string, workspaceRoot string) {
400		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
401		if value == "" {
402			return
403		}
404		normalized := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
405		for _, existing := range *hints {
406			if existing == normalized {
407				return
408			}
409		}

14	// WatchAgents starts watchers for all registered providers concurrently.
15	// Convenience wrapper around WatchProviders that resolves the full provider registry.
16	func WatchAgents(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(providerID string, session *spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
17		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
18		providers := registry.GetAll()
19	
20		if len(providers) == 0 {
21			return fmt.Errorf("no providers registered")
22		}
23	
24		return WatchProviders(ctx, projectPath, providers, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
25	}

27	// WatchProviders starts watchers for the given providers concurrently.
28	// Calls sessionCallback when any provider detects activity.
29	// Runs until context is cancelled or all watchers stop.
30	// Context cancellation (Ctrl+C) is treated as a clean exit, not an error.
31	//
32	// Parameters:
33	//   - ctx: Context for cancellation and timeout control
34	//   - projectPath: Agent's working directory to watch
35	//   - providers: map of provider ID to provider instance to watch
36	//   - debugRaw: whether to write debug raw data files
37	//   - sessionCallback: called with provider ID and AgentChatSession data on each update
38	//
39	// The callback includes the provider ID to help consumers route/filter sessions.
40	// The callback should not block as it may delay other provider notifications.
41	func WatchProviders(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, providers map[string]spi.Provider, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(providerID string, session *spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
42		slog.Info("WatchProviders: Starting multi-provider watch", "projectPath", projectPath, "providerCount", len(providers), "debugRaw", debugRaw)
43	
44		// Track last-seen message count per session to suppress duplicate callbacks.
45		// Providers fire callbacks on every JSONL change, but not all changes produce
46		// new messages in the parsed SessionData. Messages are append-only, so a
47		// matching total count means nothing meaningful changed.
48		var mu sync.Mutex
49		lastMsgCount := make(map[string]int)
50	
51		var wg sync.WaitGroup
52		errChan := make(chan error, len(providers))
53	
54		for providerID, provider := range providers {
55			wg.Add(1)
56			go func() {
57				defer wg.Done()
58	
59				slog.Info("WatchProviders: Starting watcher for provider", "providerID", providerID, "providerName", provider.Name())
60	
61				// Wrap the callback to deduplicate and include provider ID
62				wrappedCallback := func(session *spi.AgentChatSession) {
63					if session == nil || session.SessionData == nil {
64						return
65					}
66	
67					// Count total messages across all exchanges
68					totalMsgs := 0
69					for _, exchange := range session.SessionData.Exchanges {
70						totalMsgs += len(exchange.Messages)
71					}
72	
73					// Skip if message count hasn't changed for this session
74					mu.Lock()
75					prev, seen := lastMsgCount[session.SessionID]
76					if seen && prev == totalMsgs {
77						mu.Unlock()
78						slog.Debug("WatchProviders: Skipping duplicate callback",
79							"providerID", providerID,
80							"sessionID", session.SessionID,
81							"totalMsgs", totalMsgs)
82						return
83					}
84					lastMsgCount[session.SessionID] = totalMsgs
85					mu.Unlock()
86	
87					slog.Debug("WatchProviders: Provider callback fired",
88						"providerID", providerID,
89						"sessionID", session.SessionID,
90						"totalMsgs", totalMsgs)
91	
92					sessionCallback(providerID, session)
93				}
94	
95				err := provider.WatchAgent(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, wrappedCallback)
96				if err != nil {
97					// Context cancellation is expected when user presses Ctrl+C, not an error
98					if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
99						slog.Info("WatchProviders: Provider watcher stopped", "provider", provider.Name())
100						errChan <- nil
101					} else {
102						slog.Error("WatchProviders: Provider watcher failed", "provider", provider.Name(), "error", err)
103						errChan <- fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", provider.Name(), err)
104					}
105				} else {
106					errChan <- nil
107				}
108			}()
109		}
110	
111		// Wait for all watchers to complete (they run until Ctrl+C)
112		wg.Wait()
113	
114		// Drain error channel — errors are already logged in the goroutines with full context
115		for range len(providers) {
116			<-errChan
117		}
118	
119		return nil
120	}
121

10	// codexSessionsRoot returns the root directory where Codex stores session files.
11	func codexSessionsRoot(homeDir string) string {
12		// Codex CLI honors CODEX_HOME as its base directory (default ~/.codex), so
13		// read sessions from the same place rather than assuming the default.
14		if codexHome := os.Getenv("CODEX_HOME"); codexHome != "" {
15			return filepath.Join(codexHome, "sessions")
16		}
17		return filepath.Join(homeDir, ".codex", "sessions")
18	}
19	
20	// normalizeCodexPath resolves a path to an absolute, cleaned representation suitable for comparisons.
21	func normalizeCodexPath(path string) string {
22		if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
23			return ""
24		}
25	
26		cleaned := filepath.Clean(path)
27	
28		absPath, err := filepath.Abs(cleaned)
29		if err == nil {
30			cleaned = absPath
31		}
32	
33		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(cleaned); err == nil {
34			cleaned = resolved
35		}
36	
37		return filepath.Clean(cleaned)
38	}
39	
40	// readDirSortedDesc reads directory entries and sorts them descending by name.
41	func readDirSortedDesc(path string) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
42		entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
43		if err != nil {
44			return nil, err
45		}
46	
47		sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
48			return entries[i].Name() > entries[j].Name()
49		})
50	
51		return entries, nil
52	}
53

12	
13	// GlobalSessionRef is a lightweight, project-discovering reference to a single
14	// native session, returned by Provider.ListAllAgentChatSessions.
15	//
16	// Unlike the project-scoped ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath), the project is NOT
17	// an input here: each ref carries the originating working directory (read from inside
18	// the session) so the caller — the `specstory reindex` command — can resolve project
19	// identity with utils.ComputeProjectID. The project is discovered, not supplied.
20	//
21	// It is intentionally metadata-only (no full SessionData parse); reindex re-fetches
22	// full data per ref via GetAgentChatSession(OriginCwd, SessionID) when it needs the
23	// conversation body. See docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
24	type GlobalSessionRef struct {
25		SessionID  string // native session id (uuid)
26		CreatedAt  string // ISO 8601 creation timestamp (first turn), may be empty
27		Slug       string // filename-safe slug derived from the first user message
28		Name       string // human-readable description (may be empty)
29		NativePath string // absolute path the provider opens to read this session
30		OriginCwd  string // working directory the session was launched from (-> project_id)
31	}
32	
33	// PathSessionReader is an OPTIONAL capability a Provider may implement: parse a single
34	// session directly from its already-known native file path, skipping the by-id discovery
35	// search that GetAgentChatSession performs.
36	//
37	// Why: some providers locate a session by scanning their native store. Codex's by-id
38	// lookup walks the entire ~/.codex/sessions tree on every call, so resolving N sessions
39	// that way is O(N²). reindex already holds each session's exact file path
40	// (GlobalSessionRef.NativePath) from enumeration, so a path-keyed parse turns that back
41	// into O(N). reindex prefers this when a provider implements it and the ref carries a
42	// NativePath, and falls back to GetAgentChatSession otherwise.
43	//
44	// originCwd is the session's originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd),
45	// passed through as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
46	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath.
47	type PathSessionReader interface {
48		GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath string, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*AgentChatSession, error)
49	}
50	
51	// ScanReporter accumulates a provider's enumeration progress (sessions found) so the CLI can
52	// render a live "scanning" display. It is safe for concurrent use and safe to call on a nil
53	// receiver (a no-op), so providers can report unconditionally.
54	type ScanReporter struct {
55		found atomic.Int64
56	}
57	
58	// Add records that n more sessions have been found. Files that yield no session (warmup-only or
59	// sidechain-only transcripts) are deliberately not counted, so the running total reflects real
60	// sessions rather than raw files.
61	func (r *ScanReporter) Add(n int) {
62		if r != nil {
63			r.found.Add(int64(n))
64		}
65	}
66	
67	// Found returns the number of sessions found so far.
68	func (r *ScanReporter) Found() int64 {
69		if r == nil {
70			return 0
71		}
72		return r.found.Load()
73	}
74	
75	// ProgressEnumerator is an OPTIONAL Provider capability: enumerate all sessions while reporting
76	// scan progress into r (which may be nil — ScanReporter is nil-safe, so report unconditionally).
77	// Providers that don't implement it are enumerated via ListAllAgentChatSessions with no live
78	// feedback. reindex uses this to render a per-agent "Scanning agents…" display.
79	type ProgressEnumerator interface {
80		ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *ScanReporter) ([]GlobalSessionRef, error)
81	}
82	
83	// ScanSessionsInParallel walks root for *.jsonl session files and scans each one concurrently
84	// with scan, returning the collected refs. It is the shared engine behind each provider's
85	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress: providers differ only in where their sessions live (root)
86	// and how a single file's header maps to a GlobalSessionRef (scan).
87	//
88	// scan returns (ref, nil) to include a session, (nil, nil) to skip a non-session file
89	// (warmup-only / empty / sidechain-only), or (nil, err) to log-and-skip a malformed file.
90	// Files are independent and the per-file read+parse is CPU-bound, so scanning fans out across
91	// CPUs; output order is unspecified (reindex dedups and sorts later). r counts sessions found
92	// (not files scanned) and is nil-safe. label names the provider in scan-failure logs.
93	func ScanSessionsInParallel(root, label string, r *ScanReporter, scan func(path string) (*GlobalSessionRef, error)) ([]GlobalSessionRef, error) {
94		// Phase 1: collect file paths (dirents only — no opens).
95		var paths []string
96		walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
97			if err != nil {
98				return nil // skip unreadable entries rather than abort the whole sweep
99			}
100			if d.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(path) != ".jsonl" {
101				return nil
102			}
103			paths = append(paths, path)
104			return nil
105		})
106		if walkErr != nil {
107			return nil, fmt.Errorf("walking %s sessions: %w", label, walkErr)
108		}
109	
110		// Phase 2: scan headers in parallel. min(NumCPU, 12) is always ≥ 1, so no lower-bound guard.
111		workers := min(runtime.NumCPU(), 12)
112		pathCh := make(chan string, workers)
113		refs := make([]GlobalSessionRef, 0, len(paths))
114		var mu sync.Mutex
115		var wg sync.WaitGroup
116		for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
117			wg.Add(1)
118			go func() {
119				defer wg.Done()
120				for path := range pathCh {
121					ref, scanErr := safeScan(scan, path)
122					if scanErr != nil {
123						slog.Warn("reindex: failed to scan session", "agent", label, "path", path, "error", scanErr)
124						continue
125					}
126					if ref == nil {
127						continue // not a session (warmup / empty / sidechain)
128					}
129					mu.Lock()
130					refs = append(refs, *ref)
131					mu.Unlock()
132					r.Add(1) // count sessions found, not files scanned
133				}
134			}()
135		}
136		for _, path := range paths {
137			pathCh <- path
138		}
139		close(pathCh)
140		wg.Wait()
141		return refs, nil
142	}
143	
144	// safeScan runs scan(path), converting a panic into an error so one malformed session file is
145	// logged and skipped (via the caller's normal error path) rather than crashing the whole sweep.
146	func safeScan(scan func(string) (*GlobalSessionRef, error), path string) (ref *GlobalSessionRef, err error) {
147		defer func() {
148			if r := recover(); r != nil {
149				ref, err = nil, fmt.Errorf("panic scanning session: %v", r)
150			}
151		}()
152		return scan(path)
153	}
154

204					// Check if markdown file already exists to determine if this is an update or creation
205					fileFullPath := session.BuildSessionFilePath(sess, config.GetHistoryDir(), useUTC)
206					_, fileExistsErr := os.Stat(fileFullPath)
207					fileExists := fileExistsErr == nil
208	
209					// Process the session (write markdown and sync to cloud)
210					// Don't show output during watch mode
211					// This is autosave mode (true)
212					markdownSize, err := session.ProcessSingleSession(ctx, sess, config, session.ProcessingOptions{
213						OnlyCloudSync:      onlyCloudSync,
214						IsAutosave:         true,
215						DebugRaw:           debugRaw,
216						UseUTC:             useUTC,
217						NoTelemetryPrompts: noTelemetryPrompts,
218					})
219					if err != nil {
220						// Log error but continue - don't fail the whole watch
221						// In watch mode, we prioritize keeping the watcher running.
222						// Failed markdown writes or cloud syncs can be retried later via
223						// the sync command, so we just log and continue.
224						slog.Error("Failed to process session update",
225							"sessionId", sess.SessionID,
226							"provider", providerID,
227							"error", err)
228						return
229					}
230	
231					// Mirror the markdown write into the restore index in real time.
232					liveIndex.Record(providerID, sess)
233	
234					// Suppress output for existing sessions seen for the first time (initial scan).
235					// New sessions (!fileExists) always get output since they represent real activity.
236					seenMu.Lock()
237					firstSeen := !seenSessions[sess.SessionID]
238					seenSessions[sess.SessionID] = true
239					seenMu.Unlock()
240					if firstSeen && fileExists {
241						return
242					}
243	
244					// Output formatted line to stdout for watch mode
245					if !log.IsSilent() {
246						// Determine if this was an update or creation
247						action := "updated"
248						if !fileExists {
249							action = "created"
250						}
251	
252						// Get timestamps from session data
253						startTime := sess.CreatedAt
254						endTime := startTime
255						if sess.SessionData != nil && sess.SessionData.UpdatedAt != "" {
256							endTime = sess.SessionData.UpdatedAt
257						}
258	
259						// Count messages by role
260						userPrompts := 0
261						agentActivity := 0
262						if sess.SessionData != nil {
263							for _, exchange := range sess.SessionData.Exchanges {
264								for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
265									if msg.Role == schema.RoleUser {
266										userPrompts++
267									} else {
268										agentActivity++
269									}
270								}
271							}
272						}
273	
274						// Output the formatted line
275						if jsonOutput {
276							record := map[string]interface{}{
277								"timestamp":          time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
278								"action":             action,
279								"session_id":         sess.SessionID,
280								"start_time":         startTime,
281								"end_time":           endTime,
282								"provider":           providerID,
283								"markdown_size":      markdownSize,
284								"total_user_prompts": userPrompts,
285								"agent_activity":     agentActivity,
286							}
287							if !onlyCloudSync {
288								record["markdown_file"] = fileFullPath
289							}
290							_ = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(record)
291						} else {
292							emoji := "♻️"
293							if action == "created" {
294								emoji = "✨"
295							}
296							activityWord := "activities"
297							if agentActivity == 1 {
298								activityWord = "activity"
299							}
300							promptWord := "prompts"
301							if userPrompts == 1 {
302								promptWord = "prompt"
303							}
304							fmt.Printf("  %s  %s  %s · %s · %d %s · %d agent %s\n",
305								time.Now().Format("15:04:05"),
306								emoji,
307								providerID,
308								truncateSessionID(sess.SessionID),
309								userPrompts,
310								promptWord,
311								agentActivity,
312								activityWord)
313						}
314					}
315	
316					// Push agent events to provenance engine for correlation
317					provenance.ProcessEvents(ctx, provenanceEngine, sess)
318				}
319	
320				return utils.WatchProviders(ctx, cwd, providers, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
321			},
322		}
323

327		watchCmd.Flags().String("debug-dir", debugDir, "custom output directory for debug data (default: ./.specstory/debug)")

34		options: { entryId?: string; position?: "before" | "at" },

36		if (!options.entryId) return storage.getEntries();
37		const target = await storage.getEntry(options.entryId);
38		if (!target) {
39			throw new SessionError("invalid_fork_target", `Entry ${options.entryId} not found`);
40		}
41		let effectiveLeafId: string | null;
42		if ((options.position ?? "before") === "at") {
43			effectiveLeafId = target.id;
44		} else {
45			if (target.type !== "message" || target.message.role !== "user") {
46				throw new SessionError("invalid_fork_target", `Entry ${options.entryId} is not a user message`);
47			}
48			effectiveLeafId = target.parentId;
49		}
50		return storage.getPathToRoot(effectiveLeafId);

	FileSystem,
	JsonlSessionCreateOptions,
	JsonlSessionListOptions,

	Session,
} from "../types.ts";

	createSessionId,

type JsonlSessionRepoFileSystem = Pick<
	FileSystem,
	| "cwd"
	| "absolutePath"
	| "joinPath"
	| "readTextFile"
	| "readTextLines"
	| "writeFile"
	| "appendFile"
	| "listDir"
	| "exists"
	| "createDir"
	| "remove"
>;

function encodeCwd(cwd: string): string {
	return `--${cwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")}--`;
}
