10	// Environment overrides pi documents in `pi --help` (config.ts ENV_AGENT_DIR /
11	// ENV_SESSION_DIR). PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR relocates the agent dir (sessions live
12	// under <dir>/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/). PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR points
13	// at a sessions directory used FLAT — pi writes session files directly into it
14	// with no per-cwd encoding, so project scoping must filter by header cwd.
15	const (
16		envAgentDir   = "PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR"
17		envSessionDir = "PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR"
18	)
19	
20	// piSessionsRoot returns the directory under which pi stores sessions and
21	// whether that directory uses the flat layout (files directly in the root)
22	// instead of the default per-cwd encoded subdirectories. Precedence mirrors
23	// pi's own resolution (main.ts): PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR >
24	// PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/sessions > ~/.pi/agent/sessions. pi's --session-dir flag
25	// and settings.json sessionDir are per-invocation and not visible here.
26	// It does not require the directory to exist.
27	func piSessionsRoot() (string, bool, error) {
28		if dir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(envSessionDir)); dir != "" {
29			return expandTilde(dir), true, nil
30		}
31		if dir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(envAgentDir)); dir != "" {
32			return filepath.Join(expandTilde(dir), "sessions"), false, nil
33		}
34		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
35		if err != nil {
36			return "", false, fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
37		}
38		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), false, nil
39	}
40	
41	// expandTilde expands a leading "~/" to the user's home directory, matching
42	// how pi itself expands its env overrides (expandTildePath).
43	func expandTilde(path string) string {
44		if strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") {
45			home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
46			if err == nil {
47				return filepath.Join(home, path[2:])
48			}
49		}
50		return path
51	}
52	
53	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name,
54	// mirroring pi's own encoder exactly (session-manager.js:
55	// `--${resolvedCwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")}--`):
56	// one leading '/' or '\' is stripped, every remaining '/', '\', and ':' becomes
57	// '-', and the result is wrapped in '--'. E.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
58	// "--Users-jane-proj--". Replacing the full character class matters: a project
59	// path containing ':' (legal on macOS/Linux) would otherwise compute a
60	// directory name pi never writes, silently finding zero sessions.
61	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
62		trimmed := cwd
63		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, `\`) {
64			trimmed = trimmed[1:]
65		}
66		encoded := strings.NewReplacer("/", "-", `\`, "-", ":", "-").Replace(trimmed)
67		return "--" + encoded + "--"
68	}
69	
70	// projectCandidates returns the working-directory forms a pi session for this
71	// project may have been recorded under: the absolute path as given and, when
72	// different, its symlink-resolved form. pi encodes the cwd as its own process
73	// saw it, which may be either form (e.g. /tmp/foo vs /private/tmp/foo on
74	// macOS), so callers must check both.
75	func projectCandidates(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
76		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
77		if cwd == "" {
78			wd, err := os.Getwd()
79			if err != nil {
80				return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
81			}
82			cwd = wd
83		}
84		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
85		if err != nil {
86			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve %s: %w", cwd, err)
87		}
88		candidates := []string{abs}
89		if real, rErr := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs); rErr == nil && real != abs {
90			candidates = append(candidates, real)
91		}
92		return candidates, nil
93	}
94	
95	// ProjectSessionDir returns the session directory pi would use for the given
96	// project (for display/diagnostics), WITHOUT requiring it to exist. In the
97	// flat PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR layout this is the override directory
98	// itself; otherwise it is the encoded per-cwd subdirectory for the project's
99	// absolute path.
100	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
101		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
102		if err != nil {
103			return "", err
104		}
105		if flat {
106			return root, nil
107		}
108		candidates, err := projectCandidates(projectPath)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(candidates[0])), nil
113	}
114	
115	// SessionFilesInProject lists the pi session files belonging to the given
116	// project. In the default layout it unions the encoded directories for each
117	// project-path candidate (raw and symlink-resolved). In the flat override
118	// layout it lists the root and keeps files whose header cwd matches the
119	// project, the same filtering pi applies to custom session dirs. Returns an
120	// empty slice (no error) if nothing exists yet.
121	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
122		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, err
125		}
126		candidates, err := projectCandidates(projectPath)
127		if err != nil {
128			return nil, err
129		}
130		if flat {
131			return flatSessionFiles(root, candidates)
132		}
133		var files []string
134		seen := make(map[string]bool)
135		for _, c := range candidates {
136			dir := filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(c))
137			dirFiles, dErr := jsonlFilesInDir(dir)
138			if dErr != nil {
139				return nil, dErr
140			}
141			for _, f := range dirFiles {
142				if !seen[f] {
143					seen[f] = true
144					files = append(files, f)
145				}
146			}
147		}
148		return files, nil
149	}
150	
151	// flatSessionFiles lists *.jsonl in a flat override sessions dir, keeping only
152	// files whose session header cwd matches one of the project candidates.
153	func flatSessionFiles(root string, candidates []string) ([]string, error) {
154		all, err := jsonlFilesInDir(root)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158		var files []string
159		for _, f := range all {
160			h, hErr := readHeader(f)
161			if hErr != nil || h == nil {
162				continue // unreadable or not a pi session; skip in listing
163			}
164			for _, c := range candidates {
165				if h.Cwd == c {
166					files = append(files, f)
167					break
168				}
169			}
170		}
171		return files, nil
172	}

175	// Returns an empty slice (no error) if the directory does not exist.

177		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
178		if err != nil {
179			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
180				return nil, nil
181			}
182			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading session dir %s: %w", dir, err)
183		}

189			if !strings.HasSuffix(e.Name(), ".jsonl") {
190				continue
191			}
192			files = append(files, filepath.Join(dir, e.Name()))
193		}
194		return files, nil
195	}

589	// parseFullSession reads a session's full data for indexing. It prefers a provider's
590	// path-keyed parse (spi.PathSessionReader) using the ref's already-known NativePath, which
591	// avoids the provider's by-id discovery search — for Codex that search walks the entire
592	// ~/.codex/sessions tree, so this is the difference between an O(N) and an O(N²) reindex.
593	// Providers without the capability (or refs lacking a NativePath) fall back to the by-id
594	// lookup. Parsing the known NativePath is also more consistent: the row's freshness
595	// fingerprint is stat'd from NativePath, so the body now comes from that same file.
596	func parseFullSession(prov spi.Provider, ref spi.GlobalSessionRef) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
597		if pr, ok := prov.(spi.PathSessionReader); ok && ref.NativePath != "" {
598			return pr.GetAgentChatSessionByPath(ref.NativePath, ref.OriginCwd, false)
599		}
600		return prov.GetAgentChatSession(ref.OriginCwd, ref.SessionID, false)
601	}

603	// drainToStore writes parsed sessions to the index in batched transactions.
604	func drainToStore(store *sessionindex.Store, ch <-chan sessionindex.Session) error {
605		batch := make([]sessionindex.Session, 0, reindexWriteBatch)
606		flush := func() error {
607			if err := store.UpsertBatch(batch); err != nil {
608				return err
609			}
610			batch = batch[:0]
611			return nil
612		}
613		for sess := range ch {
614			batch = append(batch, sess)
615			if len(batch) >= reindexWriteBatch {

617					return err
618				}
619			}
620		}
621		return flush()
622	}

FINDING [low]: DetectAgent stays silent on SessionFilesInProject errors even with helpOutput=true, so `specstory list pi` exits 0 with no output
specstory-cli/pkg/providers/piagent/provider.go:143
The new helpOutput guidance only fires on the `len(files) == 0` path. When SessionFilesInProject returns an error (e.g. the encoded session directory or flat override dir exists but is unreadable — jsonlFilesInDir returns a non-IsNotExist ReadDir error — or os.Getwd fails in projectCandidates), DetectAgent logs at slog.Debug and returns false without printing anything. Its only helpOutput=true caller, pkg/cmd/list.go:128-130, does `if !provider.DetectAgent(cwd, true) { return nil }`, so the command exits 0 printing nothing — the exact silent-no-op failure mode this fix set was targeting for `watch pi`. Repro: chmod 000 ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>-- then run `specstory list pi` — exits 0 with no output.

30	// Provider implements spi.Provider for the pi coding agent.
31	// pi stores sessions as JSONL v3 trees under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/.
32	type Provider struct{}
33	
34	// NewProvider returns a new pi provider instance.
35	func NewProvider() *Provider { return &Provider{} }
36	
37	// Name returns the human-readable provider name.
38	func (p *Provider) Name() string { return providerName }
39	
40	// parsePiCommand splits a custom check/run command into binary + args,
41	// expanding a leading ~ like sibling providers (spi.SplitCommandLine handles
42	// quoting). Falls back to the default `pi` binary when no custom command is
43	// given.
44	func parsePiCommand(customCommand string) (string, []string) {
45		if strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != "" {
46			parts := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
47			if len(parts) > 0 {
48				return expandTilde(parts[0]), parts[1:]
49			}
50		}
51		return defaultCmd, nil
52	}
53	
54	// classifyCheckError buckets a Check failure for messaging and analytics,
55	// matching the sibling providers' error taxonomy. errors.Is unwraps through
56	// exec.Error/os.PathError, covering both PATH lookups (exec.ErrNotFound) and
57	// explicit custom paths (os.ErrNotExist).
58	func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
59		switch {
60		case errors.Is(err, exec.ErrNotFound) || errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist):
61			return "not_found"
62		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
63			return "permission_denied"
64		default:
65			return "version_failed"
66		}
67	}
68	
69	// buildCheckErrorMessage renders the user-facing Check failure text. The
70	// custom-command branch avoids the misleading "not found on PATH" wording when
71	// the user pointed at an explicit path, and version-probe failures surface the
72	// probe's stderr so the underlying diagnostic is not lost.
73	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
74		var b strings.Builder
75		switch errorType {
76		case "not_found":
77			b.WriteString("The pi coding agent was not found.\n\n")
78			if isCustom {
79				b.WriteString("• Verify the custom command/path you provided exists and is executable.\n")
80				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "• Provided command: %s\n", command)
81			} else {
82				b.WriteString("• Install pi (see https://pi.dev) and ensure `pi` is on your PATH.\n")
83				b.WriteString("• Re-run `specstory check pi` after installation.\n")
84			}
85		case "permission_denied":
86			b.WriteString("SpecStory cannot execute the pi binary due to permissions.\n\n")
87			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Try: chmod +x %s\n", command)
88		default:
89			b.WriteString("`pi --version` failed.\n\n")
90			if stderr != "" {
91				b.WriteString("Error output:\n")
92				b.WriteString(stderr)
93				b.WriteString("\n\n")
94			}
95			b.WriteString("Run `pi --version` manually to diagnose, then retry.")
96		}
97		return b.String()
98	}

100	// Check verifies the pi binary is available and reports its version.
101	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
102		isCustom := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != ""
103		cmdName, _ := parsePiCommand(customCommand)
104		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
105		if err != nil {
106			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
107			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
108			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "", errorType, err.Error())
109			return spi.CheckResult{
110				Success:      false,
111				ErrorMessage: buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, cmdName, isCustom, ""),
112			}
113		}
114		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
115		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
116		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
117		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
118		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
119			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
120			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
121			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err, "stderr", stderrOutput)
122			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, stderrOutput, errorType, err.Error())
123			return spi.CheckResult{
124				Success:      false,
125				Location:     resolved,
126				ErrorMessage: buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, cmdName, isCustom, stderrOutput),
127			}
128		}
129		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
130		if version == "" {
131			version = "unknown"
132		}
133		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
134		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
135	}

137	// DetectAgent reports whether pi has created sessions for the given project.
138	// When helpOutput is true and nothing is found, it prints guidance like the
139	// sibling providers do — the CLI callers (sync/list) rely on the provider to
140	// explain a negative result instead of exiting silently.
141	func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
142		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
143		if err != nil {
144			slog.Debug("pi: DetectAgent error", "error", err)
145			return false
146		}
147		if len(files) > 0 {
148			return true
149		}
150		if helpOutput {
151			log.UserMessage("No pi sessions found for this project yet.\n")
152			if dir, dirErr := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath); dirErr == nil {
153				log.UserMessage("Expected session directory: %s\n", dir)
154			}
155			log.UserMessage("Run pi inside this project to create a session, then rerun `specstory sync pi`.\n")
156		}
157		return false
158	}

211	// sessionFile pairs a discovered pi session file with its header metadata.
212	type sessionFile struct {
213		Path   string
214		Header sessionHeader
215	}
216	
217	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
218	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
219	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
220		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
221		if err != nil {
222			return "", err
223		}
224		for _, f := range files {
225			h, err := readHeader(f)
226			if err != nil || h == nil {
227				continue
228			}
229			if h.ID == sessionID {
230				return f, nil
231			}
232		}
233		return "", nil
234	}
235	
236	// readHeader parses only the first JSON value of a session file and returns it
237	// only if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty
238	// id). Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them. The read is
239	// capped at 1MB: a real pi header is a few hundred bytes, and the cap keeps a
240	// crafted file with a multi-GB first value from being buffered into memory.
241	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
242		f, err := os.Open(path)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, err
245		}
246		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
247		dec := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(f, 1*MB))
248		var h sessionHeader
249		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
250			return nil, nil
251		}
252		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
253			return nil, nil
254		}
255		return &h, nil
256	}
257	
258	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
259	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
260	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
261	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
262		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
263		if err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		var out []sessionFile
267		for _, f := range files {
268			h, err := readHeader(f)
269			if err != nil {
270				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
271				continue
272			}
273			if h == nil {
274				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
275			}
276			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
277		}
278		return out, nil
279	}

281	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
282	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
283		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
284		if err != nil {
285			return nil, err
286		}
287		if path == "" {
288			return nil, nil
289		}
290		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
291	}
292	
293	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
294	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
295		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
296		if err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		total := len(files)
300		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
301		for i, sf := range files {
302			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
303			if pErr != nil {
304				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
305			} else if chat != nil {
306				result = append(result, *chat)
307			}
308			if progress != nil {
309				progress(i+1, total)
310			}
311		}
312		return result, nil
313	}

315	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
316	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
317	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
318		data, err := ParseSession(path)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if debugRaw {
323			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
324				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
325			}
326		}
327		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
330		}
331		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
332			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
333			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
334			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
335			SessionData: data,
336			RawData:     string(raw),
337		}, nil
338	}
339	
340	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
341	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
342	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
343	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
344	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
345	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
346	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
347	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
348		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
353			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
354		}
355		if debugRaw {
356			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
357				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
358			}
359		}
360		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
361		if err != nil {
362			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
363		}
364		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
365			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
366			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
367			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
368			SessionData: data,
369			RawData:     string(raw),
370		}, nil
371	}

373	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
374	// deriving Slug/Name from the leaf path's first user message (and the user-set
375	// session name when present) without decoding full message payloads.
376	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
377		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
378		if err != nil {
379			return nil, err
380		}
381		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
382		for _, f := range files {
383			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
384			if scanErr != nil {
385				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
386				continue

388			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
389				continue
390			}
391			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
392				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
393				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
394				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
395				Name:      scanName(scan),
396			})
397		}
398		return result, nil
399	}
400	
401	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
402	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
403	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
404		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
405	}
406	
407	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
408	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
409	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
410	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
411		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
412		if err != nil {
413			return nil, err
414		}
415		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
416			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
417				return nil, nil
418			}
419			return nil, statErr
420		}
421		// ScanSessionsInParallel walks recursively, but pi session files live at a
422		// fixed depth: directly in the root for the flat override layout, else in
423		// root/<encoded-cwd>/. Deeper *.jsonl files are extension/subagent
424		// internals (observed: <proj>/<ts>_<uuid>/<hash>/run-0/session.jsonl) that
425		// the project-scoped APIs (SessionFilesInProject) can never resolve by id;
426		// indexing them would create rows sync/preview/resume cannot fetch.
427		wantDepth := 1
428		if flat {
429			wantDepth = 0
430		}
431		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
432			rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, path)
433			if relErr != nil || strings.Count(rel, string(filepath.Separator)) != wantDepth {
434				return nil, nil
435			}
436			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
437			if sErr != nil {
438				return nil, sErr
439			}
440			if s == nil {
441				return nil, nil // non-session file
442			}
443			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
444		}
445		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
446	}
447	
448	// piSessionScan holds the metadata fields read from a session file for
449	// listing/reindex: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd +
450	// the latest user-set session name. The scan walks the SAME leaf path the full
451	// parse uses, so its Slug/Name always match what deriveSlug produces for the
452	// generated markdown (file order can differ from the active branch when the
453	// first prompt was re-edited). foundUser is false for sessions with no real
454	// user prompt; scanPiSession returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
455	type piSessionScan struct {
456		sessionID        string
457		timestamp        string
458		firstUserMessage string
459		sessionName      string
460		cwd              string
461		foundUser        bool
462	}
463	
464	// scanPiSession reads a pi session file's metadata for listing: the header
465	// (session id, timestamp, cwd), the first user message text on the active leaf
466	// path, and the latest session_info display name. Returns (scan, nil) for a
467	// real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session file or a session with no user
468	// message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse errors so
469	// ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
470	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
471		h, err := readHeader(path)
472		if err != nil {
473			return nil, err
474		}
475		if h == nil {
476			return nil, nil // not a pi session file
477		}
478		_, entries, err := readEntries(path)
479		if err != nil {
480			return nil, err
481		}
482		if len(entries) == 0 {
483			return nil, nil // header-only session; nothing to list
484		}
485		scan := &piSessionScan{sessionID: h.ID, timestamp: h.Timestamp, cwd: h.Cwd}
486		// pi resolves the display name from the LATEST session_info entry in file
487		// order (not the leaf path), and an empty name explicitly clears the title
488		// (session-manager.ts getSessionName) — mirror both rules.
489		for _, e := range entries {
490			if e.Type == entrySessionInfo {
491				scan.sessionName = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
492			}
493		}
494		for _, e := range leafPathEntries(entries) {
495			if scan.foundUser || e.Type != entryMessage {
496				continue
497			}
498			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
499				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
500				scan.foundUser = true
501			}
502		}
503		if !scan.foundUser {
504			return nil, nil // no user prompt; nothing worth listing
505		}
506		return scan, nil
507	}
508	
509	// scanName returns the display name for a scanned session: the user-set
510	// session_info name when present (pi lets users rename sessions), otherwise a
511	// readable name derived from the first user message like other providers.
512	func scanName(scan *piSessionScan) string {
513		if scan.sessionName != "" {
514			return scan.sessionName
515		}
516		return spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage)
517	}
518	
519	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
520	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
521	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
522		if !scan.foundUser {
523			return nil
524		}
525		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
526			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
527			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
528			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
529			Name:       scanName(scan),
530			NativePath: path,
531			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
532		}
533	}
534

1	package piagent
2	
3	import (
4		"bufio"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"errors"
7		"fmt"
8		"io"
9		"log/slog"
10		"os"
11		"path/filepath"
12		"strings"
13	)
14	
15	// Line-size sanity limits, mirroring claudecode/codex. bufio.Reader.ReadString
16	// has no line-size limit, so a 250MB cap guards against OOM from pathological or
17	// malicious files (a legitimate pi session line — a big tool result or base64
18	// image — can exceed the 16MB bufio.Scanner cap, so we do NOT use Scanner).
19	const (
20		KB                    = 1024
21		MB                    = 1024 * 1024
22		maxReasonableLineSize = 250 * MB
23	)
24	
25	// errStopRead is a sentinel a visit callback may return to stop iteration early
26	// (without error). readLines treats it as a clean stop.
27	var errStopRead = errors.New("stop reading")
28	
29	// readLines reads a pi session file line-by-line via bufio.Reader (unbounded
30	// line size, unlike bufio.Scanner) and calls visit for each non-empty trimmed
31	// line. Lines exceeding maxReasonableLineSize are refused with an error to
32	// prevent OOM. Returning errStopRead from visit stops iteration cleanly.
33	func readLines(path string, visit func(line string) error) error {
34		f, err := os.Open(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return fmt.Errorf("pi: opening session %s: %w", path, err)
37		}
38		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
39	
40		reader := bufio.NewReader(f)
41		lineNum := 0
42		for {
43			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
44			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
45				return fmt.Errorf("pi: reading line %d of %s: %w", lineNum+1, path, readErr)
46			}
47			line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
48			lineNum++
49			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
50			if trimmed != "" {
51				if len(trimmed) > maxReasonableLineSize {
52					slog.Warn("pi: line exceeds reasonable size limit",
53						"lineNumber", lineNum, "sizeMB", len(trimmed)/MB,
54						"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB, "file", filepath.Base(path))
55					return fmt.Errorf("pi: line %d of %s exceeds %dMB (refusing to process potentially malformed file)",
56						lineNum, path, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
57				}
58				if vErr := visit(trimmed); vErr != nil {
59					if errors.Is(vErr, errStopRead) {
60						return nil
61					}
62					return vErr
63				}
64			}
65			if readErr == io.EOF {
66				return nil
67			}
68		}
69	}
70	
71	// readEntries parses every line of the session file into a header (line 1) and
72	// a list of message/control entries (the rest). Malformed lines are skipped
73	// rather than aborting the whole parse.
74	func readEntries(path string) (*sessionHeader, []rawEntry, error) {
75		var header *sessionHeader
76		var entries []rawEntry
77		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
78			if header == nil {
79				h := sessionHeader{}
80				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
81					return fmt.Errorf("pi: parsing session header: %w", jErr)
82				}
83				header = &h
84				return nil
85			}
86			var e rawEntry
87			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
88				return nil // skip malformed line, keep going
89			}
90			// An entry with no type carries nothing the mapper can use; skip it so
91			// a stray malformed line cannot mislead leaf selection.
92			if e.Type == "" {
93				slog.Debug("pi: skipping entry with empty type", "file", path)
94				return nil
95			}
96			// Unmigrated pi v1 files store a flat linear sequence with no id/parentId
97			// (pi's migrateV1ToV2 synthesizes them at load). Chain such entries to the
98			// previous one so the tree walk sees the same linear path pi would build.
99			if e.ID == "" {
100				e.ID = fmt.Sprintf("legacy-%d", len(entries)+1)
101				if len(entries) > 0 {
102					pid := entries[len(entries)-1].ID
103					e.ParentID = &pid
104				}
105			}
106			entries = append(entries, e)
107			return nil
108		})
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, nil, err
111		}
112		return header, entries, nil
113	}
114	
115	// leafPathEntries walks from the leaf (last entry in file order) to the root
116	// and reverses to chronological order. Compaction entries on the path are NOT
117	// applied as truncation: pi's buildContextEntries drops pre-compaction entries
118	// only to fit the LLM context window, but SpecStory's job is preserving the
119	// full transcript, so every entry on the active branch is kept (the compaction
120	// summary itself is rendered as a marker by buildExchanges).
121	func leafPathEntries(entries []rawEntry) []rawEntry {
122		byID := indexByID(entries)
123		leaf := entries[len(entries)-1]
124		path := walkToRoot(leaf, byID)
125		reverse(path)
126		return path
127	}
128	
129	// indexByID builds an id -> entry lookup for the tree walk.
130	func indexByID(entries []rawEntry) map[string]rawEntry {
131		m := make(map[string]rawEntry, len(entries))
132		for _, e := range entries {
133			m[e.ID] = e
134		}
135		return m
136	}
137	
138	// walkToRoot collects entries from the given leaf up to the root (parentId
139	// null). A visited set guards against parentId cycles in corrupted sessions so
140	// the walk terminates instead of looping forever.
141	func walkToRoot(leaf rawEntry, byID map[string]rawEntry) []rawEntry {
142		var path []rawEntry
143		cur := leaf
144		visited := make(map[string]bool)
145		for !visited[cur.ID] {
146			visited[cur.ID] = true
147			path = append(path, cur)
148			if cur.ParentID == nil {
149				break
150			}
151			parent, ok := byID[*cur.ParentID]
152			if !ok {
153				break
154			}
155			cur = parent
156		}
157		return path
158	}
159	
160	// reverse reverses a slice of rawEntry in place.
161	func reverse(s []rawEntry) {
162		for i, j := 0, len(s)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
163			s[i], s[j] = s[j], s[i]
164		}
165	}
166

22	const (
23		providerID    = "pi"
24		providerName  = "Pi"
25		defaultCmd    = "pi"
26		versionFlag   = "--version"
27		notYetSupport = "pi: %s not yet supported for the pi provider (v1 ships sync/list/search/reindex only)"
28	)
29	
30	// Provider implements spi.Provider for the pi coding agent.
31	// pi stores sessions as JSONL v3 trees under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/.
32	type Provider struct{}
33	
34	// NewProvider returns a new pi provider instance.
35	func NewProvider() *Provider { return &Provider{} }
36	
37	// Name returns the human-readable provider name.
38	func (p *Provider) Name() string { return providerName }
39	
40	// parsePiCommand splits a custom check/run command into binary + args,
41	// expanding a leading ~ like sibling providers (spi.SplitCommandLine handles
42	// quoting). Falls back to the default `pi` binary when no custom command is
43	// given.
44	func parsePiCommand(customCommand string) (string, []string) {
45		if strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != "" {
46			parts := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
47			if len(parts) > 0 {
48				return expandTilde(parts[0]), parts[1:]
49			}
50		}
51		return defaultCmd, nil
52	}
53	
54	// classifyCheckError buckets a Check failure for messaging and analytics,
55	// matching the sibling providers' error taxonomy. errors.Is unwraps through
56	// exec.Error/os.PathError, covering both PATH lookups (exec.ErrNotFound) and
57	// explicit custom paths (os.ErrNotExist).
58	func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
59		switch {
60		case errors.Is(err, exec.ErrNotFound) || errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist):
61			return "not_found"
62		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
63			return "permission_denied"
64		default:
65			return "version_failed"
66		}
67	}
68	
69	// buildCheckErrorMessage renders the user-facing Check failure text. The
70	// custom-command branch avoids the misleading "not found on PATH" wording when
71	// the user pointed at an explicit path, and version-probe failures surface the
72	// probe's stderr so the underlying diagnostic is not lost.
73	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
74		var b strings.Builder
75		switch errorType {
76		case "not_found":
77			b.WriteString("The pi coding agent was not found.\n\n")
78			if isCustom {
79				b.WriteString("• Verify the custom command/path you provided exists and is executable.\n")
80				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "• Provided command: %s\n", command)
81			} else {
82				b.WriteString("• Install pi (see https://pi.dev) and ensure `pi` is on your PATH.\n")
83				b.WriteString("• Re-run `specstory check pi` after installation.\n")
84			}
85		case "permission_denied":
86			b.WriteString("SpecStory cannot execute the pi binary due to permissions.\n\n")
87			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Try: chmod +x %s\n", command)
88		default:
89			b.WriteString("`pi --version` failed.\n\n")
90			if stderr != "" {
91				b.WriteString("Error output:\n")
92				b.WriteString(stderr)
93				b.WriteString("\n\n")
94			}
95			b.WriteString("Run `pi --version` manually to diagnose, then retry.")
96		}
97		return b.String()
98	}

100	// Check verifies the pi binary is available and reports its version.
101	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
102		isCustom := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != ""
103		cmdName, _ := parsePiCommand(customCommand)
104		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
105		if err != nil {
106			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
107			slog.Info("pi: Check binary not found", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
108			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, "", "", errorType, err.Error())
109			return spi.CheckResult{
110				Success:      false,
111				ErrorMessage: buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, cmdName, isCustom, ""),
112			}
113		}
114		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
115		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
116		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
117		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
118		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
119			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
120			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
121			slog.Info("pi: Check version probe failed", "resolved", resolved, "error", err, "stderr", stderrOutput)
122			trackCheckFailure(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, stderrOutput, errorType, err.Error())
123			return spi.CheckResult{
124				Success:      false,
125				Location:     resolved,
126				ErrorMessage: buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, cmdName, isCustom, stderrOutput),
127			}
128		}
129		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
130		if version == "" {
131			version = "unknown"
132		}
133		trackCheckSuccess(isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version)
134		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
135	}
136	
137	// DetectAgent reports whether pi has created sessions for the given project.
138	// When helpOutput is true and nothing is found, it prints guidance like the
139	// sibling providers do — the CLI callers (sync/list) rely on the provider to
140	// explain a negative result instead of exiting silently.
141	func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
142		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
143		if err != nil {
144			slog.Debug("pi: DetectAgent error", "error", err)
145			return false
146		}
147		if len(files) > 0 {
148			return true
149		}
150		if helpOutput {
151			log.UserMessage("No pi sessions found for this project yet.\n")
152			if dir, dirErr := ProjectSessionDir(projectPath); dirErr == nil {
153				log.UserMessage("Expected session directory: %s\n", dir)
154			}
155			log.UserMessage("Run pi inside this project to create a session, then rerun `specstory sync pi`.\n")
156		}
157		return false
158	}

195	func trackCheckFailure(custom bool, commandPath, resolvedPath, stderrOutput, errorType, message string) {
196		props := analytics.Properties{
197			"provider":       providerID,
198			"custom_command": custom,
199			"command_path":   commandPath,

212	type sessionFile struct {
213		Path   string
214		Header sessionHeader
215	}

217	// findProjectSession locates the session file with the given ID within the
218	// project's pi session directory. Returns "" if not found.
219	func findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID string) (string, error) {
220		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
221		if err != nil {
222			return "", err
223		}
224		for _, f := range files {
225			h, err := readHeader(f)
226			if err != nil || h == nil {
227				continue
228			}
229			if h.ID == sessionID {
230				return f, nil
231			}
232		}
233		return "", nil
234	}

237	// only if it is a valid pi session header (type=="session" with a non-empty
238	// id). Non-session files return (nil, nil) so callers skip them. The read is
239	// capped at 1MB: a real pi header is a few hundred bytes, and the cap keeps a
240	// crafted file with a multi-GB first value from being buffered into memory.
241	func readHeader(path string) (*sessionHeader, error) {
242		f, err := os.Open(path)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, err
245		}
246		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
247		dec := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(f, 1*MB))
248		var h sessionHeader
249		if err := dec.Decode(&h); err != nil {
250			return nil, nil
251		}
252		if h.Type != entrySession || h.ID == "" {
253			return nil, nil
254		}
255		return &h, nil
256	}
257	
258	// listProjectSessions returns all session files in the project's pi directory
259	// with their headers. Non-session files (readHeader returns nil,nil) are
260	// skipped silently; only a genuine read error is logged.
261	func listProjectSessions(projectPath string) ([]sessionFile, error) {
262		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
263		if err != nil {
264			return nil, err
265		}
266		var out []sessionFile
267		for _, f := range files {
268			h, err := readHeader(f)
269			if err != nil {
270				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", err)
271				continue
272			}
273			if h == nil {
274				continue // not a pi session file (bad header type/id)
275			}
276			out = append(out, sessionFile{Path: f, Header: *h})
277		}
278		return out, nil
279	}
280	
281	// GetAgentChatSession returns a single pi session by ID for the project.
282	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSession(projectPath, sessionID string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
283		path, err := findProjectSession(projectPath, sessionID)
284		if err != nil {
285			return nil, err
286		}
287		if path == "" {
288			return nil, nil
289		}
290		return parseToAgentSession(path, debugRaw)
291	}
292	
293	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all pi sessions for the project.
294	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
295		files, err := listProjectSessions(projectPath)
296		if err != nil {
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		total := len(files)
300		var result []spi.AgentChatSession
301		for i, sf := range files {
302			chat, pErr := parseToAgentSession(sf.Path, debugRaw)
303			if pErr != nil {
304				slog.Debug("pi: skipping session", "path", sf.Path, "error", pErr)
305			} else if chat != nil {
306				result = append(result, *chat)
307			}
308			if progress != nil {
309				progress(i+1, total)
310			}
311		}
312		return result, nil
313	}
314	
315	// parseToAgentSession parses one session file into an AgentChatSession,
316	// writing debug-raw artifacts when debugRaw is true.
317	func parseToAgentSession(path string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
318		data, err := ParseSession(path)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if debugRaw {
323			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(path, data); dErr != nil {
324				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
325			}
326		}
327		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
330		}
331		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
332			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
333			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
334			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
335			SessionData: data,
336			RawData:     string(raw),
337		}, nil
338	}
339	
340	// GetAgentChatSessionByPath parses a single pi session directly from its native
341	// file path, skipping the by-id discovery search. originCwd is the session's
342	// originating working directory (GlobalSessionRef.OriginCwd), passed through
343	// as the workspace root for path normalization — matching what
344	// GetAgentChatSession receives as projectPath. Implements spi.PathSessionReader
345	// so `specstory reindex` uses the O(N) path-keyed fast path instead of the
346	// O(N²) by-id lookup.
347	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessionByPath(nativePath, originCwd string, debugRaw bool) (*spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
348		data, err := ParseSession(nativePath)
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		if data.WorkspaceRoot == "" && originCwd != "" {
353			data.WorkspaceRoot = originCwd
354		}
355		if debugRaw {
356			if dErr := writeDebugRaw(nativePath, data); dErr != nil {
357				slog.Warn("pi: debug-raw write failed", "error", dErr)
358			}
359		}
360		raw, err := os.ReadFile(nativePath)
361		if err != nil {
362			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: reading raw session: %w", err)
363		}
364		return &spi.AgentChatSession{
365			SessionID:   data.SessionID,
366			CreatedAt:   data.CreatedAt,
367			Slug:        deriveSlug(data),
368			SessionData: data,
369			RawData:     string(raw),
370		}, nil
371	}
372	
373	// ListAgentChatSessions returns lightweight metadata for all project sessions,
374	// deriving Slug/Name from the leaf path's first user message (and the user-set
375	// session name when present) without decoding full message payloads.
376	func (p *Provider) ListAgentChatSessions(projectPath string) ([]spi.SessionMetadata, error) {
377		files, err := SessionFilesInProject(projectPath)
378		if err != nil {
379			return nil, err
380		}
381		result := make([]spi.SessionMetadata, 0, len(files))
382		for _, f := range files {
383			scan, scanErr := scanPiSession(f)
384			if scanErr != nil {
385				slog.Debug("pi: skipping unreadable session file", "path", f, "error", scanErr)
386				continue
387			}
388			if scan == nil || !scan.foundUser {
389				continue
390			}
391			result = append(result, spi.SessionMetadata{
392				SessionID: scan.sessionID,
393				CreatedAt: scan.timestamp,
394				Slug:      spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
395				Name:      scanName(scan),
396			})
397		}
398		return result, nil
399	}
400	
401	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,
402	// each ref carrying its originating cwd (read from the session header).
403	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
404		return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
405	}
406	
407	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
408	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
409	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
410	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
411		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
412		if err != nil {
413			return nil, err
414		}
415		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
416			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
417				return nil, nil
418			}
419			return nil, statErr
420		}
421		// ScanSessionsInParallel walks recursively, but pi session files live at a
422		// fixed depth: directly in the root for the flat override layout, else in
423		// root/<encoded-cwd>/. Deeper *.jsonl files are extension/subagent
424		// internals (observed: <proj>/<ts>_<uuid>/<hash>/run-0/session.jsonl) that
425		// the project-scoped APIs (SessionFilesInProject) can never resolve by id;
426		// indexing them would create rows sync/preview/resume cannot fetch.
427		wantDepth := 1
428		if flat {
429			wantDepth = 0
430		}
431		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
432			rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, path)
433			if relErr != nil || strings.Count(rel, string(filepath.Separator)) != wantDepth {
434				return nil, nil
435			}
436			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
437			if sErr != nil {
438				return nil, sErr
439			}
440			if s == nil {
441				return nil, nil // non-session file
442			}
443			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
444		}
445		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
446	}
447	
448	// piSessionScan holds the metadata fields read from a session file for
449	// listing/reindex: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd +
450	// the latest user-set session name. The scan walks the SAME leaf path the full
451	// parse uses, so its Slug/Name always match what deriveSlug produces for the
452	// generated markdown (file order can differ from the active branch when the
453	// first prompt was re-edited). foundUser is false for sessions with no real
454	// user prompt; scanPiSession returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
455	type piSessionScan struct {
456		sessionID        string
457		timestamp        string
458		firstUserMessage string
459		sessionName      string
460		cwd              string
461		foundUser        bool
462	}
463	
464	// scanPiSession reads a pi session file's metadata for listing: the header
465	// (session id, timestamp, cwd), the first user message text on the active leaf
466	// path, and the latest session_info display name. Returns (scan, nil) for a
467	// real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session file or a session with no user
468	// message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse errors so
469	// ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
470	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
471		h, err := readHeader(path)
472		if err != nil {
473			return nil, err
474		}
475		if h == nil {
476			return nil, nil // not a pi session file
477		}
478		_, entries, err := readEntries(path)
479		if err != nil {
480			return nil, err
481		}
482		if len(entries) == 0 {
483			return nil, nil // header-only session; nothing to list
484		}
485		scan := &piSessionScan{sessionID: h.ID, timestamp: h.Timestamp, cwd: h.Cwd}
486		// pi resolves the display name from the LATEST session_info entry in file
487		// order (not the leaf path), and an empty name explicitly clears the title
488		// (session-manager.ts getSessionName) — mirror both rules.
489		for _, e := range entries {
490			if e.Type == entrySessionInfo {
491				scan.sessionName = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
492			}
493		}
494		for _, e := range leafPathEntries(entries) {
495			if scan.foundUser || e.Type != entryMessage {
496				continue
497			}
498			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
499				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
500				scan.foundUser = true
501			}
502		}
503		if !scan.foundUser {
504			return nil, nil // no user prompt; nothing worth listing
505		}
506		return scan, nil
507	}
508	
509	// scanName returns the display name for a scanned session: the user-set
510	// session_info name when present (pi lets users rename sessions), otherwise a
511	// readable name derived from the first user message like other providers.
512	func scanName(scan *piSessionScan) string {
513		if scan.sessionName != "" {
514			return scan.sessionName
515		}
516		return spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage)
517	}
518	
519	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
520	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
521	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
522		if !scan.foundUser {
523			return nil
524		}
525		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
526			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
527			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
528			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
529			Name:       scanName(scan),
530			NativePath: path,
531			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
532		}
533	}
534
```

118	+		for j := range exchanges[i].Messages {
119	+			msg := &exchanges[i].Messages[j]
120	+			if msg.Tool == nil {
121	+				continue
122	+			}
123	+			msg.PathHints = extractPathHints(msg.Tool.Input, workspaceRoot)
124	+			summary, markdown := formatToolMarkdown(msg.Tool)

135	+// extractPathHints collects file paths from a pi tool call's arguments (pi
136	+// tools use "path"; the extra keys cover extension tools) plus paths mentioned
137	+// in shell commands, normalized and deduped like the sibling providers.
138	+func extractPathHints(input map[string]any, workspaceRoot string) []string {
139	+	if input == nil {
140	+		return nil
141	+	}
142	+	var hints []string
143	+	add := func(p string) {
144	+		if p == "" {
145	+			return
146	+		}
147	+		n := spi.NormalizePath(p, workspaceRoot)
148	+		for _, h := range hints {
149	+			if h == n {
150	+				return
151	+			}
152	+		}
153	+		hints = append(hints, n)
154	+	}
155	+	for _, field := range []string{"path", "file_path", "filePath", "dir", "directory", "target"} {
156	+		switch v := input[field].(type) {
157	+		case string:
158	+			add(v)
159	+		case []any:
160	+			for _, item := range v {
161	+				if s, ok := item.(string); ok {
162	+					add(s)
163	+				}
164	+			}
165	+		}
166	+	}
167	+	if command, _ := input["command"].(string); command != "" {
168	+		for _, sp := range spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, workspaceRoot, workspaceRoot) {
169	+			add(sp)
170	+		}
171	+	}
172	+	return hints
173	+}

175	+// formatToolMarkdown builds the pre-formatted markdown (and optional summary)
176	+// for the pi tools with a natural rendering: single-line bash commands become
177	+// an inline-code summary, multi-line commands and file writes become fenced
178	+// blocks, file tools show their path. Tools without a specific format return
179	+// empty so the CLI's generic fallback (which renders input and output) is
180	+// used instead. When a specific format is produced, the tool output is
181	+// appended so the markdown stays self-contained.
182	+func formatToolMarkdown(tool *schema.ToolInfo) (string, string) {
183	+	var summary string
184	+	var b strings.Builder
185	+	in := tool.Input
186	+	switch strings.ToLower(tool.Name) {
187	+	case "bash":
188	+		cmd, _ := in["command"].(string)
189	+		if cmd == "" {
190	+			return "", ""
191	+		}
192	+		if strings.Contains(cmd, "\n") {
193	+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "```bash\n%s\n```", strings.ReplaceAll(cmd, "```", "\\```"))
194	+		} else {
195	+			summary = fmt.Sprintf("Tool use: **%s** `%s`", tool.Name, cmd)
196	+		}
197	+	case "read", "edit", "ls":
198	+		p, _ := in["path"].(string)
199	+		if p == "" {
200	+			return "", ""
201	+		}
202	+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "`%s`", p)
203	+	case "write":
204	+		p, _ := in["path"].(string)
205	+		if p == "" {
206	+			return "", ""
207	+		}
208	+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "`%s`\n", p)
209	+		if content, _ := in["content"].(string); content != "" {
210	+			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "\n```\n%s\n```", strings.ReplaceAll(content, "```", "\\```"))
211	+		}
212	+	case "grep", "find":
213	+		pattern, _ := in["pattern"].(string)
214	+		if pattern == "" {
215	+			return "", ""
216	+		}
217	+		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "`%s`", pattern)
218	+	default:
219	+		return "", ""
220	+	}
221	+	appendToolOutput(&b, tool)
222	+	return summary, strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
223	+}

225	+// appendToolOutput appends the merged toolResult content as a fenced block
226	+// (truncated like codexcli) so formatted tools still show their result.
227	+func appendToolOutput(b *strings.Builder, tool *schema.ToolInfo) {
228	+	if tool.Output == nil {
229	+		return
230	+	}
231	+	content, _ := tool.Output["content"].(string)
232	+	content = strings.TrimSpace(content)
233	+	if content == "" {
234	+		return
235	+	}
236	+	if len(content) > 5000 {
237	+		content = content[:5000] + "\n... (truncated)"
238	+	}
239	+	if b.Len() > 0 {
240	+		b.WriteString("\n\n")
241	+	}
242	+	if isErr, _ := tool.Output["is_error"].(bool); isErr {
243	+		b.WriteString("Error:\n")
244	+	}
245	+	b.WriteString("```\n" + content + "\n```")
246	+}

```text
{"body":"## Summary\r\n\r\nAdds support for the [pi coding agent](https://pi.dev) to specstory-cli via a new provider package `pkg/providers/piagent/`, registered under provider id `\"pi\"`. This enables `specstory sync`, `list`, `search`, and `reindex` to work with pi sessions stored at `~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/*.jsonl`.\r\n\r\n| Agent | Provider | Data Format | Source Location |\r\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\r\n| [Pi](https://pi.dev) | `piagent` | JSONL | `~/.pi/agent/sessions/` |\r\n\r\n## How it works\r\n\r\npi stores sessions as **JSONL v3 trees** — each entry has `id`/`parentId`, and the active conversation is the current leaf-path branch. The parser:\r\n\r\n1. Walks the leaf → root, reverses to chronological order, and honors compaction (entries before a compaction entry's `firstKeptEntryId` are dropped, mirroring pi's own `buildContextEntries`).\r\n2. Maps entries into the unified `schema.SessionData`:\r\n   - **session header** → `SessionID` / `CreatedAt` / `WorkspaceRoot` / `Provider`\r\n   - **user message** (string *or* content array) → user `Message`\r\n   - **assistant message** (text / thinking / toolCall blocks) → agent `Message` with content parts, plus one `Message` per `toolCall` carrying a `ToolInfo`\r\n   - **toolResult** (a top-level entry in pi, unlike Claude Code where it's a user-message content block) → merged into the matching `ToolInfo.Output` keyed by `toolCallId`\r\n   - **usage** → `schema.Usage` (input / output / cacheRead / cacheWrite)\r\n3. Groups the ordered entries into `Exchange`s (a new user message starts an exchange; assistant + toolResult append).\r\n\r\n## Scope\r\n\r\n**In scope (v1):** `sync`, `list`, `search`, `reindex`, `check`, `detect`, `--debug-raw`.\r\n\r\n**Out of scope (follow-up):** the methods below exist to satisfy the `spi.Provider` interface but return `ErrReconstructionUnsupported` / a descriptive \"not yet supported\" error:\r\n- `specstory run pi` (`ExecAgentAndWatch` wrapper + file watcher)\r\n- `specstory watch pi` (`WatchAgent` live watch)\r\n- `ReconstructSession` / `NativeSessionPath` (native JSONL v3 serializer for cross-machine resume)\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n## Docs\r\n\r\n- `README.md` — Pi row added to the agent support table\r\n- `docs/PROVIDER-SPI.md` — Pi added to the provider table, package directory tree, and dependency flow\r\n\r\n## Testing\r\n\r\nTDD: a RED test (`parser_test.go`, 8 subtests asserting the full schema mapping) was written and confirmed failing (`undefined: ParseSession`) before any parser code.\r\n\r\n```\r\ngo test -count=1 ./...   → all packages ok (incl. piagent), exit 0\r\ngolangci-lint run        → 0 issues, exit 0\r\n```\r\n\r\nProven against a real pi session (not proxy signals):\r\n- `Check()` found `pi 0.80.3`\r\n- `DetectAgent()` → true\r\n- `GetAgentChatSession()` parsed **11 exchanges** from a live session\r\n- `--debug-raw` wrote **242 files** (241 numbered JSON + `session-data.json` with 11 exchanges, `providerId=\"pi\"`)\r\n- `ListAllAgentChatSessions()` enumerated **17 sessions** across all projects with originating cwd\r\n\r\n## Follow-up work\r\n\r\n1. `specstory run pi` — exec wrapper + fsnotify watcher on the session dir\r\n2. `specstory watch pi` — live watch without executing pi\r\n3. `ReconstructSession` — pi JSONL v3 serializer (uses `spi.FlattenSessionData` + `spi.PrepareTurns`)\r\n4. Image content blocks in user/assistant messages are currently dropped\r\n5. `bashExecution` / `custom` / `branchSummary` / `compactionSummary` roles are skipped from exchanges in v1\r\n6. `ListAgentChatSessions` slug/name is currently empty (header-only); a lightweight first-user-message scan would populate it\r\n","headRefName":"feat/pi-provider","state":"OPEN","title":"feat(cli): add Pi agent provider"}

420		}
421		// ScanSessionsInParallel walks recursively, but pi session files live at a
422		// fixed depth: directly in the root for the flat override layout, else in
423		// root/<encoded-cwd>/. Deeper *.jsonl files are extension/subagent
424		// internals (observed: <proj>/<ts>_<uuid>/<hash>/run-0/session.jsonl) that
425		// the project-scoped APIs (SessionFilesInProject) can never resolve by id;
426		// indexing them would create rows sync/preview/resume cannot fetch.
427		wantDepth := 1
428		if flat {
429			wantDepth = 0
430		}
431		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
432			rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, path)
433			if relErr != nil || strings.Count(rel, string(filepath.Separator)) != wantDepth {
434				return nil, nil
435			}
436			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
437			if sErr != nil {
438				return nil, sErr
439			}
440			if s == nil {
441				return nil, nil // non-session file
442			}
443			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
444		}
445		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
446	}
447	
448	// piSessionScan holds the metadata fields read from a session file for
449	// listing/reindex: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd +
450	// the latest user-set session name. The scan walks the SAME leaf path the full
451	// parse uses, so its Slug/Name always match what deriveSlug produces for the
452	// generated markdown (file order can differ from the active branch when the
453	// first prompt was re-edited). foundUser is false for sessions with no real
454	// user prompt; scanPiSession returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
455	type piSessionScan struct {
456		sessionID        string
457		timestamp        string
458		firstUserMessage string
459		sessionName      string
460		cwd              string
461		foundUser        bool
462	}
463	
464	// scanPiSession reads a pi session file's metadata for listing: the header
465	// (session id, timestamp, cwd), the first user message text on the active leaf
466	// path, and the latest session_info display name. Returns (scan, nil) for a
467	// real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session file or a session with no user
468	// message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse errors so
469	// ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.
470	func scanPiSession(path string) (*piSessionScan, error) {
471		h, err := readHeader(path)
472		if err != nil {
473			return nil, err
474		}
475		if h == nil {
476			return nil, nil // not a pi session file
477		}
478		_, entries, err := readEntries(path)
479		if err != nil {
480			return nil, err
481		}
482		if len(entries) == 0 {
483			return nil, nil // header-only session; nothing to list
484		}
485		scan := &piSessionScan{sessionID: h.ID, timestamp: h.Timestamp, cwd: h.Cwd}
486		// pi resolves the display name from the LATEST session_info entry in file
487		// order (not the leaf path), and an empty name explicitly clears the title
488		// (session-manager.ts getSessionName) — mirror both rules.
489		for _, e := range entries {
490			if e.Type == entrySessionInfo {
491				scan.sessionName = strings.TrimSpace(e.Name)
492			}
493		}
494		for _, e := range leafPathEntries(entries) {
495			if scan.foundUser || e.Type != entryMessage {
496				continue
497			}
498			if msg := firstUserText(e); msg != "" {
499				scan.firstUserMessage = msg
500				scan.foundUser = true
501			}
502		}
503		if !scan.foundUser {
504			return nil, nil // no user prompt; nothing worth listing
505		}
506		return scan, nil
507	}
508	
509	// scanName returns the display name for a scanned session: the user-set
510	// session_info name when present (pi lets users rename sessions), otherwise a
511	// readable name derived from the first user message like other providers.
512	func scanName(scan *piSessionScan) string {
513		if scan.sessionName != "" {
514			return scan.sessionName
515		}
516		return spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage)
517	}
518	
519	// scanToGlobalRef builds a GlobalSessionRef from a scan, deriving Slug/Name from
520	// the first user message. Returns nil for sessions with no user message.
521	func scanToGlobalRef(scan *piSessionScan, path string) *spi.GlobalSessionRef {
522		if !scan.foundUser {
523			return nil
524		}
525		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
526			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
527			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
528			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
529			Name:       scanName(scan),
530			NativePath: path,
531			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
532		}
533	}

15	// Line-size sanity limits, mirroring claudecode/codex. bufio.Reader.ReadString
16	// has no line-size limit, so a 250MB cap guards against OOM from pathological or
17	// malicious files (a legitimate pi session line — a big tool result or base64

19	const (

22		maxReasonableLineSize = 250 * MB
23	)

25	// errStopRead is a sentinel a visit callback may return to stop iteration early
26	// (without error). readLines treats it as a clean stop.
27	var errStopRead = errors.New("stop reading")

29	// readLines reads a pi session file line-by-line via bufio.Reader (unbounded
30	// line size, unlike bufio.Scanner) and calls visit for each non-empty trimmed
31	// line. Lines exceeding maxReasonableLineSize are refused with an error to
32	// prevent OOM. Returning errStopRead from visit stops iteration cleanly.
33	func readLines(path string, visit func(line string) error) error {
34		f, err := os.Open(path)
35		if err != nil {
36			return fmt.Errorf("pi: opening session %s: %w", path, err)
37		}
38		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
39	
40		reader := bufio.NewReader(f)
41		lineNum := 0
42		for {
43			line, readErr := reader.ReadString('\n')
44			if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
45				return fmt.Errorf("pi: reading line %d of %s: %w", lineNum+1, path, readErr)
46			}
47			line = strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\n")
48			lineNum++
49			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
50			if trimmed != "" {
51				if len(trimmed) > maxReasonableLineSize {
52					slog.Warn("pi: line exceeds reasonable size limit",
53						"lineNumber", lineNum, "sizeMB", len(trimmed)/MB,
54						"limitMB", maxReasonableLineSize/MB, "file", filepath.Base(path))
55					return fmt.Errorf("pi: line %d of %s exceeds %dMB (refusing to process potentially malformed file)",
56						lineNum, path, maxReasonableLineSize/MB)
57				}
58				if vErr := visit(trimmed); vErr != nil {
59					if errors.Is(vErr, errStopRead) {
60						return nil
61					}
62					return vErr
63				}
64			}
65			if readErr == io.EOF {
66				return nil
67			}
68		}
69	}

71	// readEntries parses every line of the session file into a header (line 1) and
72	// a list of message/control entries (the rest). Malformed lines are skipped
73	// rather than aborting the whole parse.
74	func readEntries(path string) (*sessionHeader, []rawEntry, error) {
75		var header *sessionHeader
76		var entries []rawEntry
77		err := readLines(path, func(line string) error {
78			if header == nil {
79				h := sessionHeader{}
80				if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &h); jErr != nil {
81					return fmt.Errorf("pi: parsing session header: %w", jErr)
82				}
83				header = &h
84				return nil
85			}
86			var e rawEntry
87			if jErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &e); jErr != nil {
88				return nil // skip malformed line, keep going
89			}
90			// An entry with no type carries nothing the mapper can use; skip it so
91			// a stray malformed line cannot mislead leaf selection.
92			if e.Type == "" {
93				slog.Debug("pi: skipping entry with empty type", "file", path)
94				return nil
95			}
96			// Unmigrated pi v1 files store a flat linear sequence with no id/parentId
97			// (pi's migrateV1ToV2 synthesizes them at load). Chain such entries to the
98			// previous one so the tree walk sees the same linear path pi would build.
99			if e.ID == "" {
100				e.ID = fmt.Sprintf("legacy-%d", len(entries)+1)
101				if len(entries) > 0 {
102					pid := entries[len(entries)-1].ID
103					e.ParentID = &pid
104				}
105			}
106			entries = append(entries, e)
107			return nil
108		})
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, nil, err
111		}
112		return header, entries, nil
113	}
114	
115	// leafPathEntries walks from the leaf (last entry in file order) to the root
116	// and reverses to chronological order. Compaction entries on the path are NOT
117	// applied as truncation: pi's buildContextEntries drops pre-compaction entries
118	// only to fit the LLM context window, but SpecStory's job is preserving the
119	// full transcript, so every entry on the active branch is kept (the compaction
120	// summary itself is rendered as a marker by buildExchanges).
121	func leafPathEntries(entries []rawEntry) []rawEntry {
122		byID := indexByID(entries)
123		leaf := entries[len(entries)-1]
124		path := walkToRoot(leaf, byID)
125		reverse(path)
126		return path
127	}
128	
129	// indexByID builds an id -> entry lookup for the tree walk.
130	func indexByID(entries []rawEntry) map[string]rawEntry {
131		m := make(map[string]rawEntry, len(entries))
132		for _, e := range entries {
133			m[e.ID] = e
134		}
135		return m
136	}
137	
138	// walkToRoot collects entries from the given leaf up to the root (parentId
139	// null). A visited set guards against parentId cycles in corrupted sessions so
140	// the walk terminates instead of looping forever.
141	func walkToRoot(leaf rawEntry, byID map[string]rawEntry) []rawEntry {
142		var path []rawEntry
143		cur := leaf
144		visited := make(map[string]bool)
145		for !visited[cur.ID] {
146			visited[cur.ID] = true
147			path = append(path, cur)
148			if cur.ParentID == nil {
149				break
150			}
151			parent, ok := byID[*cur.ParentID]
152			if !ok {
153				break
154			}
155			cur = parent
156		}
157		return path
158	}
159	
160	// reverse reverses a slice of rawEntry in place.
161	func reverse(s []rawEntry) {
162		for i, j := 0, len(s)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
163			s[i], s[j] = s[j], s[i]
164		}
165	}

// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every Claude Code session across all projects. It is the
// no-progress form of ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress.
func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
	return p.ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(nil)
}

// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates every Claude Code session across all projects by
// walking ~/.claude/projects/*/ for *.jsonl (the originating cwd comes from inside each session;
// the project directory name is a lossy, irreversible encoding of the path), reporting scan
// progress into r (nil-safe). Headers are scanned in parallel across CPUs; output order is
// irrelevant (reindex dedups and sorts later). Implements spi.ProgressEnumerator. See
// docs/SESSIONS-DB.md.
func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
	projectsDir, err := GetClaudeCodeProjectsDir()
	if err != nil {
		// No projects directory yet → nothing to enumerate (not an error).
		return []spi.GlobalSessionRef{}, nil
	}

	return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(projectsDir, "claude", r, func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
		scan, scanErr := scanClaudeSession(path)
		if scanErr != nil {
			return nil, scanErr
		}
		if !scan.foundRealMessage {
			return nil, nil // warmup-only or sidechain-only transcript (not a session)
		}
		return &spi.GlobalSessionRef{
			SessionID:  scan.sessionID,
			CreatedAt:  scan.timestamp,
			Slug:       spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(scan.firstUserMessage),
			Name:       spi.GenerateReadableName(scan.firstUserMessage),
			NativePath: path,
			OriginCwd:  scan.cwd,
		}, nil
	})
}

401	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every pi session across all projects,

403	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {

406	
407	// ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress enumerates all pi sessions with live scan
408	// progress, using the shared parallel scanner. Each ref carries Slug/Name
409	// derived from the first user message and the originating cwd from the header.
410	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessionsProgress(r *spi.ScanReporter) ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
411		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
412		if err != nil {
413			return nil, err
414		}
415		if _, statErr := os.Stat(root); statErr != nil {
416			if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
417				return nil, nil
418			}
419			return nil, statErr
420		}
421		// ScanSessionsInParallel walks recursively, but pi session files live at a
422		// fixed depth: directly in the root for the flat override layout, else in
423		// root/<encoded-cwd>/. Deeper *.jsonl files are extension/subagent
424		// internals (observed: <proj>/<ts>_<uuid>/<hash>/run-0/session.jsonl) that
425		// the project-scoped APIs (SessionFilesInProject) can never resolve by id;
426		// indexing them would create rows sync/preview/resume cannot fetch.
427		wantDepth := 1
428		if flat {
429			wantDepth = 0
430		}
431		scan := func(path string) (*spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
432			rel, relErr := filepath.Rel(root, path)
433			if relErr != nil || strings.Count(rel, string(filepath.Separator)) != wantDepth {
434				return nil, nil
435			}
436			s, sErr := scanPiSession(path)
437			if sErr != nil {
438				return nil, sErr
439			}
440			if s == nil {
441				return nil, nil // non-session file
442			}
443			return scanToGlobalRef(s, path), nil
444		}
445		return spi.ScanSessionsInParallel(root, providerID, r, scan)
446	}
447	
448	// piSessionScan holds the metadata fields read from a session file for
449	// listing/reindex: identity + first-user-message metadata + originating cwd +
450	// the latest user-set session name. The scan walks the SAME leaf path the full
451	// parse uses, so its Slug/Name always match what deriveSlug produces for the
452	// generated markdown (file order can differ from the active branch when the
453	// first prompt was re-edited). foundUser is false for sessions with no real
454	// user prompt; scanPiSession returns (nil, nil) for those so callers skip them.
455	type piSessionScan struct {
456		sessionID        string
457		timestamp        string
458		firstUserMessage string
459		sessionName      string
460		cwd              string
461		foundUser        bool
462	}
463	
464	// scanPiSession reads a pi session file's metadata for listing: the header
465	// (session id, timestamp, cwd), the first user message text on the active leaf
466	// path, and the latest session_info display name. Returns (scan, nil) for a
467	// real session, (nil, nil) for a non-session file or a session with no user
468	// message, and (nil, err) for genuine read/parse errors so
469	// ScanSessionsInParallel logs them during reindex.

1360	+{"type":"message","id":"u1","parentId":null,"timestamp":"2026-07-09T10:00:01.000Z","message":{"role":"user","content":"the first prompt","timestamp":1783600001000}}
1361	+`
1362	+	cases := []struct {
1363	+		name     string
1364	+		extra    string
1365	+		wantName string
1366	+	}{
1367	+		{
1368	+			name: "latest rename wins",
1369	+			extra: `{"type":"session_info","id":"s1","parentId":"u1","timestamp":"2026-07-09T10:00:02.000Z","name":"Old Name"}
1370	+{"type":"session_info","id":"s2","parentId":"s1","timestamp":"2026-07-09T10:00:03.000Z","name":"My Renamed Session"}
1371	+`,
1372	+			wantName: "My Renamed Session",
1373	+		},
1374	+		{
1375	+			name: "empty name clears back to prompt-derived",
1376	+			extra: `{"type":"session_info","id":"s1","parentId":"u1","timestamp":"2026-07-09T10:00:02.000Z","name":"Old Name"}
1377	+{"type":"session_info","id":"s2","parentId":"s1","timestamp":"2026-07-09T10:00:03.000Z","name":""}
1378	+`,
1379	+			wantName: "", // sessionName cleared; scanName falls back to readable name
1380	+		},
1381	+	}
1382	+	for _, tt := range cases {

The parser:\r\n\r\n1. Walks the leaf → root, reverses to chronological order, and honors compaction (entries before a compaction entry's `firstKeptEntryId` are dropped, mirroring pi's own `buildContextEntries`).\r\n2. 1	package piagent

3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"os"
6		"path/filepath"
7		"strings"
8	)
9	
10	// Environment overrides pi documents in `pi --help` (config.ts ENV_AGENT_DIR /
11	// ENV_SESSION_DIR). PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR relocates the agent dir (sessions live
12	// under <dir>/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/). PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR points
13	// at a sessions directory used FLAT — pi writes session files directly into it
14	// with no per-cwd encoding, so project scoping must filter by header cwd.
15	const (
16		envAgentDir   = "PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR"
17		envSessionDir = "PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR"
18	)
19	
20	// piSessionsRoot returns the directory under which pi stores sessions and
21	// whether that directory uses the flat layout (files directly in the root)
22	// instead of the default per-cwd encoded subdirectories. Precedence mirrors
23	// pi's own resolution (main.ts): PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR >
24	// PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/sessions > ~/.pi/agent/sessions. pi's --session-dir flag
25	// and settings.json sessionDir are per-invocation and not visible here.
26	// It does not require the directory to exist.
27	func piSessionsRoot() (string, bool, error) {
28		if dir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(envSessionDir)); dir != "" {
29			return expandTilde(dir), true, nil
30		}
31		if dir := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(envAgentDir)); dir != "" {
32			return filepath.Join(expandTilde(dir), "sessions"), false, nil
33		}
34		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
35		if err != nil {
36			return "", false, fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
37		}
38		return filepath.Join(home, ".pi", "agent", "sessions"), false, nil
39	}
40	
41	// expandTilde expands a leading "~/" to the user's home directory, matching
42	// how pi itself expands its env overrides (expandTildePath).
43	func expandTilde(path string) string {
44		if strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") {
45			home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
46			if err == nil {
47				return filepath.Join(home, path[2:])
48			}
49		}
50		return path
51	}
52	
53	// EncodeCwd maps a working directory to pi's session-subdirectory name,
54	// mirroring pi's own encoder exactly (session-manager.js:
55	// `--${resolvedCwd.replace(/^[/\\]/, "").replace(/[/\\:]/g, "-")}--`):
56	// one leading '/' or '\' is stripped, every remaining '/', '\', and ':' becomes
57	// '-', and the result is wrapped in '--'. E.g. "/Users/jane/proj" ->
58	// "--Users-jane-proj--". Replacing the full character class matters: a project
59	// path containing ':' (legal on macOS/Linux) would otherwise compute a
60	// directory name pi never writes, silently finding zero sessions.
61	func EncodeCwd(cwd string) string {
62		trimmed := cwd
63		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, `\`) {
64			trimmed = trimmed[1:]
65		}
66		encoded := strings.NewReplacer("/", "-", `\`, "-", ":", "-").Replace(trimmed)
67		return "--" + encoded + "--"
68	}
69	
70	// projectCandidates returns the working-directory forms a pi session for this
71	// project may have been recorded under: the absolute path as given and, when
72	// different, its symlink-resolved form. pi encodes the cwd as its own process
73	// saw it, which may be either form (e.g. /tmp/foo vs /private/tmp/foo on
74	// macOS), so callers must check both.
75	func projectCandidates(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
76		cwd := strings.TrimSpace(projectPath)
77		if cwd == "" {
78			wd, err := os.Getwd()
79			if err != nil {
80				return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot get working dir: %w", err)
81			}
82			cwd = wd
83		}
84		abs, err := filepath.Abs(cwd)
85		if err != nil {
86			return nil, fmt.Errorf("pi: cannot resolve %s: %w", cwd, err)
87		}
88		candidates := []string{abs}
89		if real, rErr := filepath.EvalSymlinks(abs); rErr == nil && real != abs {
90			candidates = append(candidates, real)
91		}
92		return candidates, nil
93	}
94	
95	// ProjectSessionDir returns the session directory pi would use for the given
96	// project (for display/diagnostics), WITHOUT requiring it to exist. In the
97	// flat PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR layout this is the override directory
98	// itself; otherwise it is the encoded per-cwd subdirectory for the project's
99	// absolute path.
100	func ProjectSessionDir(projectPath string) (string, error) {
101		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
102		if err != nil {
103			return "", err
104		}
105		if flat {
106			return root, nil
107		}
108		candidates, err := projectCandidates(projectPath)
109		if err != nil {
110			return "", err
111		}
112		return filepath.Join(root, EncodeCwd(candidates[0])), nil
113	}
114	
115	// SessionFilesInProject lists the pi session files belonging to the given
116	// project. In the default layout it unions the encoded directories for each
117	// project-path candidate (raw and symlink-resolved). In the flat override
118	// layout it lists the root and keeps files whose header cwd matches the
119	// project, the same filtering pi applies to custom session dirs. Returns an
120	// empty slice (no error) if nothing exists yet.
121	func SessionFilesInProject(projectPath string) ([]string, error) {
122		root, flat, err := piSessionsRoot()
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, err
125		}
126		candidates, err := projectCandidates(projectPath)
127		if err != nil {
128			return nil, err
129		}
130		if flat {
131			return flatSessionFiles(root, candidates)
132		}
133		var files []string
134		seen := make(map[string]bool)
135		for _, c := range candidates {
